`README.md`:

```md
# Konzte Faceit: client and KONZTE GUARD

Source code of the Konzte Faceit desktop client and the KONZTE GUARD anti-cheat for Combat Master.
Konzte is shutting down on December 2, 2026. The code is published so anyone can check what the installer actually did.

## What's here

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `app-tauri/` | Desktop shell (Rust, Tauri): window, tray, UI updater, Discord Rich Presence, Steam/screenshot helpers |
| `app-tauri/src/guard.rs` | KONZTE GUARD inside the client: scan reports and file uploads for staff review |
| `app-tauri/guard/installer-hooks.nsh` | Installer hooks: installs the GUARD service and removes it when Konzte is uninstalled |
| `app/native/kzguard/` | GUARD core library (process/module/driver checks, cheat signatures in `sigs.rs`) |
| `app/native/kzguard-svc/` | `KonzteGuard.exe`: Windows service + tray window |
| `app/winscan.cs` | Windows deep scan run through PowerShell |
| `app/src/` | The interface (HTML/CSS/JS) |

Images, sounds and other art are not included. The server is not included either.

## What KONZTE GUARD does

The GUARD service runs in the background and waits for Combat Master to start. It sends these results to the Konzte server:

- system settings that kernel cheats rely on: test signing, driver signature enforcement, kernel debugging;
- running processes and the modules loaded into the game, compared against known cheat signatures (CM Internal, MelonLoader/BepInEx, unlockers, Process Hacker during a match);
- injected code in the game process: executable private memory of Combat Master is scanned for cheat signatures;
- hashes of files in the game folder, to detect modified game files;
- a full report of programs, libraries and drivers loaded on the system (paths outside the game folder are masked);
- a hardware ID hash, used to tie bans to a device.

When staff review a suspicious player, they can request a copy of a file. Only two kinds of files can be sent:
- a file inside the Combat Master folder;
- an executable, library or driver that appeared in that player's own GUARD report.

Paths with `..`, absolute paths and anything else are rejected (`upload_inner` in `app-tauri/src/guard.rs`).

GUARD does not read documents, browser data, passwords or messages, and it has no keylogger or screen capture. The client only reads the Combat Master screenshots folder in Steam, so players can pick a scoreboard to submit. The service updates itself only with builds verified against the Konzte ed25519 key (`app/native/kzguard-svc/src/update.rs`).

## Why antivirus sandboxes flag it

The installer sets up a Windows service with administrator rights, enumerates processes and loaded drivers, reads the game's memory, talks to a server and updates itself. Behavioural sandboxes score exactly these actions as suspicious, and the binaries are not code-signed with a paid certificate. Every anti-cheat behaves the same way.

## Removing it

Windows Settings → Apps → Konzte → Uninstall. The installer hook stops and deletes the KONZTE GUARD service as part of the uninstall.

```

`app-tauri/guard/installer-hooks.nsh`:

```nsh

!define KZG_DIR "$PROGRAMFILES64\Konzte Guard"
!define KZG_EXE "$PROGRAMFILES64\Konzte Guard\KonzteGuard.exe"
!define KZG_RUN "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"

!macro NSIS_HOOK_POSTINSTALL
  StrCpy $R9 "1"
  ClearErrors
  GetDLLVersion "$INSTDIR\guard\KonzteGuard.exe" $R0 $R1
  IfErrors kzg_done
  ClearErrors
  GetDLLVersion "${KZG_EXE}" $R2 $R3
  IfErrors kzg_install
  StrCmp "$R0.$R1" "$R2.$R3" 0 kzg_install
  nsExec::ExecToStack 'sc.exe query KonzteGuard'
  Pop $R4
  Pop $R5
  StrCmp $R4 "0" kzg_tray kzg_install
  kzg_install:
    ExecShellWait "runas" "$INSTDIR\guard\KonzteGuard.exe" "install" SW_HIDE
  kzg_tray:
    IfFileExists "${KZG_EXE}" 0 kzg_done
    WriteRegStr HKCU "${KZG_RUN}" "KonzteGuard" '"${KZG_EXE}"'
    CreateShortCut "$SMPROGRAMS\KONZTE GUARD.lnk" "${KZG_EXE}" "open" "${KZG_EXE}" 0
    Exec '"${KZG_EXE}"'
  kzg_done:
!macroend

!macro NSIS_HOOK_PREUNINSTALL
  ${If} $UpdateMode <> 1
    IfFileExists "${KZG_EXE}" 0 kzg_un_done
      nsExec::ExecToStack '"${KZG_EXE}" call uninstall'
      Pop $R4
      Pop $R5
      StrCmp $R4 "0" kzg_un_wait
      ExecShellWait "runas" "${KZG_EXE}" "uninstall" SW_HIDE
    kzg_un_wait:
      Sleep 3000
    kzg_un_done:
    DeleteRegValue HKCU "${KZG_RUN}" "KonzteGuard"
    Delete "$SMPROGRAMS\KONZTE GUARD.lnk"
  ${EndIf}
!macroend

```

`app-tauri/prepare.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
A=../app
mkdir -p shell/ocr/core shell/ocr/lang
cp $A/node_modules/tesseract.js/dist/tesseract.min.js $A/node_modules/tesseract.js/dist/worker.min.js shell/ocr/
for v in tesseract-core-lstm tesseract-core-simd-lstm tesseract-core-relaxedsimd-lstm; do cp $A/node_modules/tesseract.js-core/$v.wasm.js shell/ocr/core/; done
cp $A/ocr/*.traineddata shell/ocr/lang/
cp $A/src/assets/logo.png icons/tray.png
echo ok
```

```js
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    const t = e.target instanceof Element ? e.target : null;
    if (!t || !t.closest('.titlebar') || t.closest(NO_DRAG)) return;
    if (e.detail === 2) { call('win_cmd', { cmd: 'max' }); return; }
    call('win_cmd', { cmd: 'drag' });

  const b64ToBlob = (b64, type) => { const s = atob(b64), u = new Uint8Array(s.length); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) u[i] = s.charCodeAt(i); return new Blob([u], { type }); };
  async function nativeClip() {
    const r = await call('clip_read').catch(() => null);
    if (r && r.png) return { type: 'image', blob: b64ToBlob(r.png, 'image/png') };
    if (r && typeof r.text === 'string' && r.text) return { type: 'text', text: r.text };
    return null;
  }
  try {
    const cb = navigator.clipboard || {};
    const origRead = cb.read?.bind(cb), origWrite = cb.writeText?.bind(cb);
    const read = async () => {
      if (PLATFORM === 'win32' && origRead) { try { return await origRead(); } catch {} }
      const c = await nativeClip();
      if (!c) return [];
      if (c.type === 'image') return [{ types: ['image/png'], getType: async () => c.blob }];
      return [{ types: ['text/plain'], getType: async () => new Blob([c.text], { type: 'text/plain' }) }];
    };
    const writeText = async s => { try { if (origWrite) return await origWrite(s); } catch {} return call('clip_write', { text: String(s) }); };
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      Object.defineProperty(navigator.clipboard, 'read', { value: read, configurable: true });
      Object.defineProperty(navigator.clipboard, 'writeText', { value: writeText, configurable: true });
    } else Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'clipboard', { value: { read, writeText }, configurable: true });
  } catch {}
  if (PLATFORM !== 'win32') addEventListener('keydown', async e => {
    if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) || e.shiftKey || e.altKey || (e.key !== 'v' && e.key !== 'V' && e.code !== 'KeyV')) return;
    const t = document.activeElement;
    if (t && (t.matches?.('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable], [contenteditable] *'))) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const c = await nativeClip();
    const dt = new DataTransfer();
    if (c?.type === 'image') dt.items.add(new File([c.blob], 'clipboard.png', { type: 'image/png' }));
    else if (c?.type === 'text') dt.setData('text/plain', c.text);
    let ev;
    try { ev = new ClipboardEvent('paste', { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); } catch { ev = null; }
    if (!ev || ev.clipboardData !== dt) { ev = new Event('paste', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); Object.defineProperty(ev, 'clipboardData', { value: dt }); }
    (t && t !== document.body ? t : document).dispatchEvent(ev);
  }, true);

  const OCR = new URL('/__shell/ocr/', location.href).href;
  let tessP = null, ocrW = null, digW = null;
  const loadTess = () => tessP || (tessP = new Promise((res, rej) => { const s = document.createElement('script'); s.src = OCR + 'tesseract.min.js'; s.onload = () => res(window.Tesseract); s.onerror = () => { tessP = null; rej(new Error('OCR failed to load')); }; document.head.appendChild(s); }));
  const wopts = { langPath: OCR + 'lang', corePath: OCR + 'core', workerPath: OCR + 'worker.min.js', workerBlobURL: false, gzip: false, cacheMethod: 'none' };
  async function getOcr() { if (!ocrW) { const Ts = await loadTess(); ocrW = await Ts.createWorker(['eng', 'rus', 'ukr'], 1, wopts); } return ocrW; }
  async function getDigits() { if (!digW) { const Ts = await loadTess(); digW = await Ts.createWorker('eng', 1, wopts); await digW.setParameters({ tessedit_char_whitelist: '0123456789./', tessedit_pageseg_mode: '7' }); } return digW; }
  let q = Promise.resolve();
  const serial = fn => (q = q.then(fn, fn));
  async function ocr(dataUrl) {
    return serial(async () => {
      const w = await getOcr();
      await w.setParameters({ tessedit_pageseg_mode: '6' });
      const { data } = await w.recognize(dataUrl, {}, { text: true, blocks: true });
      await w.setParameters({ tessedit_pageseg_mode: '11' });
      const sparse = (await w.recognize(dataUrl, {}, { text: true })).data.text;
      const lines = [];
      for (const b of data.blocks || []) for (const p of b.paragraphs || []) for (const l of p.lines || []) {
        lines.push({ text: l.text.trim(), y0: l.bbox.y0, y1: l.bbox.y1,
          words: l.words.map(w => ({ text: w.text, x0: w.bbox.x0, x1: w.bbox.x1, y0: w.bbox.y0, y1: w.bbox.y1, conf: w.confidence })) });
      }
      return { text: data.text + '\n' + sparse, lines };
    });
  }
  async function ocrDigits(dataUrl, rects) {
    return serial(async () => {
      const w = await getDigits(), out = [];
      for (const r of rects) out.push((await w.recognize(dataUrl, { rectangle: r })).data.text.trim());
      return out;
    });
  }

  window.konzte = {
    shell: 'tauri',
    settings: () => call('settings_get'),
    saveSettings: patch => call('settings_set', { patch: patch || {} }),
    open: url => call('open_url', { url: String(url || '') }),
    win: cmd => { call('win_cmd', { cmd: String(cmd) }); },

    info: () => call('app_info'),
    relaunch: () => call('relaunch'),
    clearCache: () => call('clear_cache'),
    asset: rel => call('asset', { rel: String(rel) }),
    ocr, ocrDigits,
    latestShot: () => call('latest_shot'),
    acScan: opts => call('ac_scan', { opts: opts || {} }),
    acUpload: o => call('ac_upload', { o: o || {} }),
    gameRunning: () => call('game_running'),
    shellInfo: () => call('shell_info'),
    shellInstall: () => call('shell_install'),
    onShellProgress: fn => { on('shell:progress', fn); },
    launchGame: () => call('launch_game'),
    guardSvc: () => call('guard_svc_status'),
    guardOpen: () => call('guard_open'),
    cm: {
      state: () => call('cm_state'),
      create: league => call('cm_create', { v: league ?? null }),
      join: blob => call('cm_join', { v: blob ?? null }),
      leave: () => call('cm_leave'),
      invite: id => call('cm_invite', { v: id ?? null }),
      roomBlob: () => call('cm_room_blob'),
      result: () => call('cm_result'),
      expectFriends: ids => call('cm_expect_friends', { v: ids ?? null }),
      addFriend: id => call('cm_add_friend', { v: id ?? null }),
      friends: () => call('cm_friends'),
      onState: fn => { on('cm:state', fn); },
      onEvent: fn => { on('cm:event', fn); },
    },
    presenceClient: id => call('presence_client', { id: id ?? null }),
    presence: a => call('presence_set', { a: a ?? null }),
    presenceClear: () => call('presence_clear'),
  };
})();
```

`app-tauri/src/assets.rs`:

```rs
use include_dir::{include_dir, Dir};
use std::borrow::Cow;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::RwLock;
use tauri::http::{header, Request, Response, StatusCode};

pub static BUNDLED: Dir<'static> = include_dir!("$CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../app/src");
static SHELL: Dir<'static> = include_dir!("$CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/shell");

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum UiSource {
    Bundled,
    Disk(PathBuf),
}

static ACTIVE: RwLock<UiSource> = RwLock::new(UiSource::Bundled);

pub fn set_active(src: UiSource) {
    *ACTIVE.write().unwrap() = src;
}
pub fn active() -> UiSource {
    ACTIVE.read().unwrap().clone()
}

pub fn clean_rel(p: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for seg in p.split(['/', '\\']) {
        match seg {
            "" | "." => continue,
            ".." => return None,
            s if s.contains(':') => return None,
            s => out.push(s),
        }
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(out.join("/"))
    }
}

pub fn ui_file(rel: &str) -> Option<Cow<'static, [u8]>> {
    let rel = clean_rel(rel)?;
    match active() {
        UiSource::Bundled => BUNDLED.get_file(&rel).map(|f| Cow::Borrowed(f.contents())),
        UiSource::Disk(dir) => std::fs::read(dir.join(&rel)).ok().map(Cow::Owned),
    }
}

pub fn shell_file(rel: &str) -> Option<&'static [u8]> {
    SHELL.get_file(clean_rel(rel)?).map(|f| f.contents())
}

pub fn bundled_file(rel: &str) -> Option<&'static [u8]> {
    BUNDLED.get_file(clean_rel(rel)?).map(|f| f.contents())
}

fn test_file(rel: &str) -> Option<Cow<'static, [u8]>> {
    if !cfg!(debug_assertions) {
        return None;
    }
    let dir = std::env::var_os("KONZTE_TEST_DIR")?;
    std::fs::read(Path::new(&dir).join(clean_rel(rel)?)).ok().map(Cow::Owned)
}

fn mime(path: &str) -> String {
    let ext = Path::new(path).extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()).unwrap_or("").to_ascii_lowercase();
    match ext.as_str() {
        "html" | "htm" => "text/html; charset=utf-8".into(),
        "js" | "mjs" => "text/javascript; charset=utf-8".into(),
        "css" => "text/css; charset=utf-8".into(),
        "json" => "application/json; charset=utf-8".into(),
        "svg" => "image/svg+xml".into(),
        "ogg" | "oga" => "audio/ogg".into(),
        "wasm" => "application/wasm".into(),
        "traineddata" => "application/octet-stream".into(),
        _ => mime_guess::from_path(path).first_or_octet_stream().essence_str().to_string(),
    }
}

fn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(b.len());
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        if b[i] == b'%' && i + 2 < b.len() {
            if let Some(v) = std::str::from_utf8(&b[i + 1..i + 3]).ok().and_then(|h| u8::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok()) {
                out.push(v);
                i += 3;
                continue;
            }
        }
        out.push(b[i]);
        i += 1;
    }
    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()
}

pub fn handle(req: &Request<Vec<u8>>) -> Response<Cow<'static, [u8]>> {
    let path = percent_decode(req.uri().path());
    let path = if path == "/" || path.is_empty() { "/index.html".to_string() } else { path };
    let data: Option<Cow<'static, [u8]>> = if let Some(rest) = path.strip_prefix("/__shell/") {
        shell_file(rest).map(Cow::Borrowed)
    } else if let Some(rest) = path.strip_prefix("/__test/") {
        test_file(rest)
    } else {
        ui_file(&path)
    };
    let Some(data) = data else {
        return Response::builder()
            .status(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)
            .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/plain")
            .body(Cow::Borrowed(&b"not found"[..]))
            .unwrap();
    };
    let ct = mime(&path);
    let total = data.len();
    if let Some(range) = req.headers().get(header::RANGE).and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()) {
        if let Some((a, b)) = parse_range(range, total) {
            let body: Vec<u8> = data[a..=b].to_vec();
            return Response::builder()
                .status(StatusCode::PARTIAL_CONTENT)
                .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct)
                .header(header::ACCEPT_RANGES, "bytes")
                .header(header::CONTENT_RANGE, format!("bytes {a}-{b}/{total}"))
                .header(header::CONTENT_LENGTH, body.len().to_string())
                .header(header::CACHE_CONTROL, "no-store")
                .body(Cow::Owned(body))
                .unwrap();
        }
    }
    Response::builder()
        .status(StatusCode::OK)
        .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, ct)
        .header(header::ACCEPT_RANGES, "bytes")
        .header(header::CONTENT_LENGTH, total.to_string())
        .header(header::CACHE_CONTROL, "no-store")
        .body(data)
        .unwrap()
}

fn parse_range(h: &str, total: usize) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
    if total == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let r = h.trim().strip_prefix("bytes=")?.split(',').next()?.trim();
    let (a, b) = r.split_once('-')?;
    let (start, end) = if a.is_empty() {
        let n: usize = b.parse().ok()?;
        (total.saturating_sub(n), total - 1)
    } else {
        let s: usize = a.parse().ok()?;
        let e: usize = if b.is_empty() { total - 1 } else { b.parse::<usize>().ok()?.min(total - 1) };
        (s, e)
    };
    if start > end || start >= total {
        None
    } else {
        Some((start, end))
    }
}
```

```rs
use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use regex::Regex;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::Duration;
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter};
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;

const PORT: u16 = 27870;

#[derive(Default)]
struct St {
    connected: bool,
    version: Value,
    me: Value,
    room: Value,
    room_blob: String,
    match_state: Value,
    last_result: Value,
}

static ST: Lazy<Mutex<St>> = Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(St { match_state: json!(-1), ..Default::default() }));
static OUT: Lazy<Mutex<Option<mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>>>> = Lazy::new(Default::default);
static TAG: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"<[^<>]{0,63}>").unwrap());
static INVIS: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new("[\\x00-\\x1f\\x7f\u{200b}-\u{200f}\u{feff}]").unwrap());
static SPACES: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r" +").unwrap());
static FRIEND_ID: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"^[0-9A-F]{6,24}$").unwrap());

pub fn lz4(src: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0usize;
    let get = |i: usize| -> Option<u8> { src.get(i).copied() };
    'outer: while i < src.len() {
        let Some(t) = get(i) else { break };
        i += 1;
        let mut l = (t >> 4) as usize;
        if l == 15 {
            loop {
                let Some(b) = get(i) else { break 'outer };
                i += 1;
                l += b as usize;
                if b != 255 {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        for _ in 0..l {
            let Some(b) = get(i) else { break 'outer };
            i += 1;
            out.push(b);
        }
        if i + 1 >= src.len() {
            break;
        }
        let off = src[i] as usize | ((src[i + 1] as usize) << 8);
        i += 2;
        let mut m = (t & 15) as usize;
        if m == 15 {
            loop {
                let Some(b) = get(i) else { break 'outer };
                i += 1;
                m += b as usize;
                if b != 255 {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        m += 4;
        if off == 0 || off > out.len() {
            break;
        }
        let s = out.len() - off;
        for k in 0..m {
            let b = out[s + k];
            out.push(b);
        }
    }
    out
}

pub fn decode_room(blob: &str) -> Value {
    use base64::Engine;
    if blob.is_empty() {
        return Value::Null;
    }
    let raw = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(blob.trim())
        .or_else(|_| base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD_NO_PAD.decode(blob.trim()))
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let bytes = lz4(&raw);
    let u: Vec<u16> = bytes.chunks_exact(2).map(|c| u16::from_le_bytes([c[0], c[1]])).collect();
    let txt = String::from_utf16_lossy(&u);
    let mut end = txt.rfind('}').map(|p| p + 1).unwrap_or(0);
    while end > 0 {
        if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&txt[..end]) {
            return v;
        }
        if end < 2 {
            break;
        }
        end = txt[..end - 1].rfind('}').map(|p| p + 1).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    Value::Null
}

pub fn clean_nick(n: &Value) -> String {
    let s = match n {
        Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        Value::Null => String::new(),
        Value::Bool(false) => String::new(),
        x => x.to_string(),
    };
    let s = TAG.replace_all(&s, "");
    let s = INVIS.replace_all(&s, "");
    SPACES.replace_all(&s, " ").trim().to_string()
}

fn truthy(v: &Value) -> bool {
    crate::settings::truthy(Some(v))
}
fn or(v: &Value, d: Value) -> Value {
    if truthy(v) { v.clone() } else { d }
}

fn room_view(r: &Value) -> Value {
    if r.is_null() {
        return Value::Null;
    }
    let players: Vec<Value> = r
        .get("_players")
        .and_then(|p| p.as_array())
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|p| {
                    let pd = p.get("PlayerData").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
                    let g = |k: &str| pd.get(k).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
                    json!({ "id": g("PlayFabId"), "nick": clean_nick(&g("Nickname")), "level": g("Level"),
                            "team": p.get("TeamId").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null), "leader": truthy(p.get("LeaderTag").unwrap_or(&Value::Null)) })
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let g = |k: &str| r.get(k).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
    json!({
        "id": g("_roomId"), "version": g("_roomAppVersion"), "region": g("_roomRegion"), "mode": g("_selectedGameMode"),
        "map": g("_selectedMatchIndex"), "league": g("_matchLeague"), "state": or(&g("_gameRoomMatchState"), json!(0)),
        "session": or(&g("_matchSessionId"), json!("")), "players": players,
    })
}

fn state_of(st: &St) -> Value {
    json!({ "connected": st.connected, "version": st.version, "me": st.me, "room": st.room, "matchState": st.match_state, "lastResult": st.last_result })
}
pub fn state() -> Value {
    state_of(&ST.lock().unwrap())
}

fn now_ms() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64).unwrap_or(0)
}

fn on_event(app: &AppHandle, ev: Value) {
    let kind = ev.get("ev").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let (out_ev, snapshot) = {
        let mut st = ST.lock().unwrap();
        match kind.as_str() {
            "status" => {
                st.version = ev.get("version").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
                if let Some(me) = ev.get("me").filter(|v| truthy(v)) {
                    let nick = st.me.get("nick").filter(|v| truthy(v)).cloned().unwrap_or(json!(""));
                    st.me = json!({ "id": me, "nick": nick });
                }
            }
            "me" => {
                let n = clean_nick(ev.get("nick").unwrap_or(&Value::Null));
                let nick = if !n.is_empty() { json!(n) } else { st.me.get("nick").filter(|v| truthy(v)).cloned().unwrap_or(json!("")) };
                st.me = json!({ "id": ev.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null), "nick": nick });
            }
            "room" => {
                let blob = ev.get("room").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
                st.room = room_view(&decode_room(&blob));
                st.room_blob = blob;
                let my_id = st.me.get("id").cloned();
                if let (Some(id), Some(players)) = (my_id, st.room.get("players").and_then(|p| p.as_array()).cloned()) {
                    if let Some(mine) = players.iter().find(|p| p.get("id") == Some(&id)) {
                        if mine.get("nick").map(truthy).unwrap_or(false) && st.me.is_object() {
                            st.me["nick"] = mine["nick"].clone();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            "match" => st.match_state = ev.get("state").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            "result" => {
                if ev.get("why").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) != Some("live") {
                    let mut r = ev.clone();
                    r["at"] = json!(now_ms());
                    st.last_result = r;
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        let out_ev = if kind == "room" { json!({ "ev": "room", "room": st.room }) } else { ev };
        (out_ev, state_of(&st))
    };
    let _ = app.emit("cm:event", out_ev);
    let _ = app.emit("cm:state", snapshot);
}

pub fn start(app: AppHandle) {
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            if let Ok(Ok(sock)) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", PORT))).await {
                let (r, mut w) = sock.into_split();
                let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel::<String>();
                *OUT.lock().unwrap() = Some(tx);
                ST.lock().unwrap().connected = true;
                let _ = app.emit("cm:state", state());
                let writer = tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
                    while let Some(line) = rx.recv().await {
                        if w.write_all(line.as_bytes()).await.is_err() {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                });
                let mut lines = BufReader::new(r).lines();
                while let Ok(Some(line)) = lines.next_line().await {
                    if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&line) {
                        on_event(&app, v);
                    }
                }
                writer.abort();
                *OUT.lock().unwrap() = None;
                let was = std::mem::replace(&mut ST.lock().unwrap().connected, false);
                if was {
                    let _ = app.emit("cm:state", state());
                }
            }
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(3)).await;
        }
    });
}

fn cmd(o: Value) -> Result<bool, String> {
    let tx = OUT.lock().unwrap().clone();
    match tx {
        Some(tx) if ST.lock().unwrap().connected => {
            tx.send(format!("{o}\n")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            Ok(true)
        }
        _ => Err("Мод CM не підключений — запусти гру з модом Konzte".into()),
    }
}

fn js_str(v: &Value) -> String {
    match v {
        Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        Value::Null => String::new(),
        Value::Bool(false) => String::new(),
        Value::Number(n) if n.as_f64() == Some(0.0) => String::new(),
        x => x.to_string(),
    }
}
fn int32(v: &Value) -> i64 {
    let x = match v {
        Value::Number(n) => n.as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0),
        Value::String(s) => s.trim().parse().unwrap_or(0.0),
        Value::Bool(b) => *b as i64 as f64,
        _ => 0.0,
    };
    if x.is_finite() { (x.trunc() as i64) as i32 as i64 } else { 0 }
}

pub fn create(league: &Value) -> Result<bool, String> {

mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn nick() {
        assert_eq!(clean_nick(&json!("<color=#ff0>Pro</color>  \u{200b}Gamer ")), "Pro Gamer");
    }
    #[test]
    fn lz4_literal_only() {
        let src = [0x50u8, b'h', b'e', b'l', b'l', b'o'];
        assert_eq!(lz4(&src), b"hello");
        let src = [0x20u8, b'a', b'b', 2, 0, 0x00, b'!'];
        assert_eq!(&lz4(&src)[..6], b"ababab");
    }
    #[test]
    fn room_trailing_garbage() {
        use base64::Engine;
        let json = r#"{"_roomId":"r1","_players":[{"PlayerData":{"PlayFabId":"AB12","Nickname":"<b>X</b>"},"TeamId":2,"LeaderTag":1}]}junk}"#;
        let u: Vec<u8> = json.encode_utf16().flat_map(|c| c.to_le_bytes()).collect();
        let mut src = vec![0xF0u8];
        let mut l = u.len() - 15;
        while l >= 255 { src.push(255); l -= 255; }
        src.push(l as u8);
        src.extend_from_slice(&u);
        let blob = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&src);
        let v = room_view(&decode_room(&blob));
        assert_eq!(v["id"], "r1");
        assert_eq!(v["players"][0]["nick"], "X");
        assert_eq!(v["players"][0]["leader"], true);
        assert_eq!(v["state"], 0);
    }
}
```

```rs
#[cfg(all(any(windows, target_os = "linux"), target_arch = "x86_64"))]
fn scan_v3(opts: &Value) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let list = |k: &str| json!(str_list(opts.get(k)));
    let o = json!({
        "nonce": opts.get("nonce").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or(""), "ver": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
        "names": list("names"), "hashes": list("hashes"), "driverHashes": list("driverHashes"),

        "modules": settings::truthy(opts.get("modules")), "deep": settings::truthy(opts.get("deep")),
        "report": settings::truthy(opts.get("report")),
    });
    let att: Value = serde_json::from_str(&kzguard::scan_signed(&o.to_string())).map_err(|e| format!("scan: {e}"))?;
    let d: Value = serde_json::from_str(att["d"].as_str().unwrap_or("")).map_err(|e| format!("scan: {e}"))?;
    if let Some(e) = d.get("err").and_then(|x| x.as_str()) { return Err(format!("scan: {e}")); }
    let files = if d["files"].is_object() { json!({ "digest": d["files"]["digest"], "n": d["files"]["n"] }) } else { Value::Null };
    Ok(json!({
        "v": 2, "gv": d["gv"], "platform": d["platform"], "ver": d["ver"], "found": d["found"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
        "proc": d["proc"], "hits": if d["hits"].is_array() { d["hits"].clone() } else { json!([]) }, "exe": d["exe"], "ga": d["ga"],
        "files": files, "scanned": d["scanned"], "ms": d["ms"], "att": att,
    }))
}
#[cfg(not(all(any(windows, target_os = "linux"), target_arch = "x86_64")))]
fn scan_v3(_: &Value) -> Result<Value, String> { Err("unsupported".into()) }
static GAME_RE: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"(?i)^combatmaster(\.exe|\.x86_64)?$").unwrap());
static FULL_HASH_RE: Lazy<Regex> =
    Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"(?i)^CombatMaster_Data/StreamingAssets/Bundles/(src/weapons/|src/first_person$|ui/)").unwrap());
static SKIP_FILE_RE: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"(?i)(\.log|\.tmp|\.dmp|\.bak|desktop\.ini|thumbs\.db)$").unwrap());
static ROOT_FILE_RE: Lazy<Regex> =
    Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"(?i)^(GameAssembly\.(dll|so)|CombatMaster(\.exe|\.x86_64)?|UnityPlayer\.(dll|so))$").unwrap());
static NORM_EXT: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"(?i)\.(exe|x86_64|app|bin)$").unwrap());

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Proc {
    pub name: String,
    pub pid: u32,
    pub argv0: String,
}

pub fn base_name(s: &str) -> String {
    s.rsplit(['\\', '/']).next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_string()
}
fn norm_proc(s: &str) -> String {
    NORM_EXT.replace(&base_name(s).to_lowercase(), "").into_owned()
}
fn sha_hex(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    hex::encode(Sha256::digest(b))
}
fn is_game(p: &Proc) -> bool {
    GAME_RE.is_match(&p.name) || GAME_RE.is_match(&base_name(&p.argv0))
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
pub fn list_procs() -> Vec<Proc> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir("/proc") else { return out };
    for e in rd.flatten() {
        let d = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
        let Ok(pid) = d.parse::<u32>() else { continue };
        let Ok(cmdline) = std::fs::read(format!("/proc/{d}/cmdline")) else { continue };
        let Ok(comm) = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{d}/comm")) else { continue };
        let argv0 = String::from_utf8_lossy(cmdline.split(|b| *b == 0).find(|s| !s.is_empty()).unwrap_or(&[])).into_owned();
        let bn = base_name(&argv0);
        out.push(Proc { name: if bn.is_empty() { comm.trim().to_string() } else { bn }, pid, argv0 });
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub fn list_procs() -> Vec<Proc> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE};
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Diagnostics::ToolHelp::*;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    unsafe {
        let snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
        if snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE {
            return out;
        }
        let mut e: PROCESSENTRY32W = std::mem::zeroed();
        e.dwSize = std::mem::size_of::<PROCESSENTRY32W>() as u32;
        if Process32FirstW(snap, &mut e) != 0 {
            loop {
                let n = e.szExeFile.iter().position(|c| *c == 0).unwrap_or(e.szExeFile.len());
                out.push(Proc { name: String::from_utf16_lossy(&e.szExeFile[..n]), pid: e.th32ProcessID, argv0: String::new() });
                if Process32NextW(snap, &mut e) == 0 {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        CloseHandle(snap);
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
pub fn list_procs() -> Vec<Proc> {
    let re = Regex::new(r"^(\d+)\s+(.+)$").unwrap();
    let mut procs: Vec<Proc> = sys::run_out("ps", &["-axo", "pid=,comm="])
        .unwrap_or_default()
        .lines()
        .filter_map(|l| re.captures(l.trim()).map(|m| Proc { name: base_name(&m[2]), pid: m[1].parse().unwrap_or(0), argv0: String::new() }))
        .collect();
    let w = Regex::new(r"(?i)([a-z]:\\[^\x22]*?\.exe)").unwrap();
    let by: HashMap<u32, usize> = procs.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, p)| (p.pid, i)).collect();
    for l in sys::run_out("ps", &["-axww", "-o", "pid=,args="]).unwrap_or_default().lines() {
        let Some(m) = re.captures(l.trim()) else { continue };
        let pid: u32 = m[1].parse().unwrap_or(0);
        if let (Some(c), Some(&i)) = (w.captures(&m[2]), by.get(&pid)) {
            procs[i].argv0 = c[1].to_string();
            procs[i].name = base_name(&c[1].replace('\\', "/"));
        }
    }
    procs
}

pub fn game_running() -> bool {
    list_procs().iter().any(is_game)
}

fn steam_libs() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let mut libs: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    let re = Regex::new(r#""path"\s+"([^"]+)""#).unwrap();
    for root in sys::steam_roots() {
        if !libs.contains(&root) {
            libs.push(root.clone());
        }
        if let Ok(vdf) = std::fs::read_to_string(root.join("steamapps").join("libraryfolders.vdf")) {
            for m in re.captures_iter(&vdf) {
                let mut p = m[1].replace("\\\\", "\\");
                let rs = root.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                if let Some(dc) = rs.find("/drive_c/") {
                    if p.len() > 3 && p.as_bytes()[1] == b':' && p.as_bytes()[2] == b'\\' {
                        let mut pb = PathBuf::from(&rs[..dc]).join("drive_c");
                        for s in p[3..].split('\\') {
                            pb.push(s);
                        }
                        p = pb.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
                    }
                }
                let pb = PathBuf::from(p);
                if !libs.contains(&pb) {
                    libs.push(pb);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    libs
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn win_image_path(pid: u32) -> Option<String> {
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::CloseHandle;
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{OpenProcess, QueryFullProcessImageNameW, PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION};
    unsafe {
        let h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, 0, pid);
        if h.is_null() {
            return None;
        }
        let mut buf = vec![0u16; 1024];
        let mut n = buf.len() as u32;
        let ok = QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf.as_mut_ptr(), &mut n) != 0;
        CloseHandle(h);
        if ok {
            Some(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n as usize]))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

pub fn game_exe_path(proc: Option<&Proc>) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    if let Some(p) = proc {
        if let Ok(exe) = std::fs::read_link(format!("/proc/{}/exe", p.pid)) {
            if GAME_RE.is_match(&base_name(&exe.to_string_lossy())) {
                return Some(exe);
            }
        }
        let a = &p.argv0;
        if a.len() > 2 && a[..2].eq_ignore_ascii_case("z:") && a.as_bytes()[2] == b'\\' {
            let pb = PathBuf::from(a[2..].replace('\\', "/"));
            if pb.exists() {
                return Some(pb);
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    if let Some(p) = proc {
        if let Some(path) = win_image_path(p.pid) {
            let pb = PathBuf::from(path);
            if pb.exists() {
                return Some(pb);
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    if let Some(p) = proc {
        if p.argv0.len() > 3 {
            for b in sys::mac_bottles() {
                let mut pb = b.join("drive_c");
                for s in p.argv0[3..].split('\\') {
                    pb.push(s);
                }
                if pb.exists() {
                    return Some(pb);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = proc;
    for lib in steam_libs() {
        for f in ["CombatMaster.exe", "CombatMaster.x86_64"] {
            let p = lib.join("steamapps").join("common").join("Combat Master").join(f);
            if p.exists() {
                return Some(p);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn stat_key(m: &std::fs::Metadata) -> String {
    let mt = m.modified().ok().and_then(|t| t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok()).map(|d| d.as_nanos()).unwrap_or(0);
    format!("{}:{}", m.len(), mt)
}
static HASH_CACHE: Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<PathBuf, (String, String)>>> = Lazy::new(Default::default);
static QUICK_CACHE: Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<PathBuf, (String, String)>>> = Lazy::new(Default::default);

pub fn file_hash(f: &Path) -> Option<(u64, String)> {
    let m = std::fs::metadata(f).ok()?;
    let key = stat_key(&m);
    if let Some((k, h)) = HASH_CACHE.lock().unwrap().get(f) {
        if *k == key {
            return Some((m.len(), h.clone()));
        }
    }
    let mut file = std::fs::File::open(f).ok()?;
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 1 << 20];
    loop {
        let n = file.read(&mut buf).ok()?;
        if n == 0 {
            break;
        }
        h.update(&buf[..n]);
    }
    let hash = hex::encode(h.finalize());
    HASH_CACHE.lock().unwrap().insert(f.to_path_buf(), (key, hash.clone()));
    Some((m.len(), hash))
}

fn quick_hash(f: &Path, m: &std::fs::Metadata) -> Option<String> {
    let key = stat_key(m);
    if let Some((k, h)) = QUICK_CACHE.lock().unwrap().get(f) {
        if *k == key {
            return Some(h.clone());
        }
    }
    let size = m.len();
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    h.update(size.to_string().as_bytes());
    let mut file = std::fs::File::open(f).ok()?;
    let n = size.min(1 << 20);
    let mut b = vec![0u8; n as usize];
    file.read_exact(&mut b).ok()?;
    h.update(&b);
    if size > n {
        let mm = (size - n).min(1 << 20);
        let mut e = vec![0u8; mm as usize];
        file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(size - mm)).ok()?;
        file.read_exact(&mut e).ok()?;
        h.update(&e);
    }
    let hash = hex::encode(h.finalize());
    QUICK_CACHE.lock().unwrap().insert(f.to_path_buf(), (key, hash.clone()));
    Some(hash)
}

fn game_modules(proc: &Proc) -> Option<Vec<String>> {
    let mut names: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    #[cfg(windows)]
    unsafe {
        use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::{CloseHandle, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE};
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::Diagnostics::ToolHelp::*;
        let snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPMODULE | TH32CS_SNAPMODULE32, proc.pid);
        if snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE {
            return None;
        }
        let mut e: MODULEENTRY32W = std::mem::zeroed();
        e.dwSize = std::mem::size_of::<MODULEENTRY32W>() as u32;
        if Module32FirstW(snap, &mut e) != 0 {
            loop {
                let n = e.szModule.iter().position(|c| *c == 0).unwrap_or(e.szModule.len());
                let s = String::from_utf16_lossy(&e.szModule[..n]).trim().to_lowercase();
                if !s.is_empty() {
                    names.insert(s);
                }
                if Module32NextW(snap, &mut e) == 0 {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        CloseHandle(snap);
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        let out = sys::run_out("lsof", &["-p", &proc.pid.to_string(), "-Fn"]).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = Regex::new(r"(?i)\.(dll|dylib|so)$").unwrap();
        for l in out.lines() {
            if let Some(f) = l.strip_prefix('n') {
                if re.is_match(f) {
                    names.insert(base_name(f).to_lowercase());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        let re = Regex::new(r"(?i)\.(dll|so)(\.[\d.]+)?$").unwrap();
        let maps = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{}/maps", proc.pid)).ok()?;
        for l in maps.lines() {
            let f = l.split_whitespace().skip(5).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
            if re.is_match(&f) {
                names.insert(base_name(&f.replace('\\', "/")).to_lowercase());
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = proc;
    let mut v: Vec<String> = names.into_iter().collect();
    v.sort();
    v.truncate(600);
    Some(v)
}

static FILES_SENT: Mutex<Option<String>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn game_files(root: &Path) -> Value {
    let mut out: Vec<(String, PathBuf)> = Vec::new();
    fn walk(d: &Path, rel: &str, out: &mut Vec<(String, PathBuf)>) {
        let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(d) else { return };
        for e in rd.flatten() {
            if out.len() >= 3000 {
                return;
            }
            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
            let r = if rel.is_empty() { name.clone() } else { format!("{rel}/{name}") };
            let Ok(ft) = e.file_type() else { continue };
            if ft.is_dir() {
                if rel.is_empty() && name != "CombatMaster_Data" {
                    continue;
                }
                walk(&e.path(), &r, out);
            } else if ft.is_file() && !SKIP_FILE_RE.is_match(&name) && (!rel.is_empty() || ROOT_FILE_RE.is_match(&name)) {
                out.push((r, e.path()));
            }
        }
    }
    walk(root, "", &mut out);
    let mut list: Vec<(String, u64, String)> = Vec::new();
    for (r, f) in out {
        let Ok(m) = std::fs::metadata(&f) else { continue };
        let full = FULL_HASH_RE.is_match(&r);
        let h = if full { file_hash(&f).map(|x| x.1) } else { quick_hash(&f, &m) };
        if let Some(h) = h {
            list.push((r, m.len(), format!("{}{}", if full { "f:" } else { "q:" }, &h[..32])));
        }
    }
    list.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.encode_utf16().cmp(b.0.encode_utf16()));
    let digest = sha_hex(list.iter().map(|x| format!("{}|{}|{}", x.0, x.1, x.2)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n").as_bytes());
    let mut sent = FILES_SENT.lock().unwrap();
    let mut res = json!({ "digest": digest, "n": list.len() });
    if sent.as_deref() != Some(digest.as_str()) {
        res["list"] = Value::Array(list.into_iter().map(|(r, s, h)| json!([r, s, h])).collect());
    }
    *sent = Some(digest);
    res
}

static DEEP_CACHE: Lazy<Mutex<Option<(Instant, u32, Value)>>> = Lazy::new(Default::default);

fn drv_hash(n: &str) -> String {
    sha_hex(format!("kzac:{}", n.strip_suffix(".sys").unwrap_or(n)).as_bytes())
}

fn deep_scan(game_pid: u32, driver_hashes: &[String]) -> Value {
    if let Some((at, pid, r)) = DEEP_CACHE.lock().unwrap().as_ref() {
        if at.elapsed() < Duration::from_millis(150_000) && *pid == game_pid {
            return r.clone();
        }
    }
    let mut r = deep_scan_platform(game_pid);
    if let Some(drv) = r.get("drivers").and_then(|v| v.as_array()).cloned() {
        let want: HashSet<&str> = driver_hashes.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).filter(|h| is_sha(h)).collect();
        let mut seen = Vec::<String>::new();
        for n in drv.iter().filter_map(|v| v.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_lowercase()) {
            let h = drv_hash(&n);
            let tag = format!("h:{h}");
            if want.contains(h.as_str()) && !seen.contains(&tag) {
                seen.push(tag);
            }
        }
        r["drivers"] = json!(seen);
    }
    *DEEP_CACHE.lock().unwrap() = Some((Instant::now(), game_pid, r.clone()));
    r
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn deep_scan_platform(game_pid: u32) -> Value {
    const CS: &str = include_str!("../../app/winscan.cs");
    let run = || -> Option<Value> {
        let tag = &sha_hex(CS.as_bytes())[..12];
        let dir = settings::user_data().join("guard");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).ok()?;
        let cs = dir.join("winscan.cs");
        let dll = dir.join(format!("kzscan-{tag}.dll"));
        let ps1 = dir.join("scan.ps1");
        std::fs::write(&cs, CS).ok()?;
        std::fs::write(&ps1, "param([int]$GamePid,[string]$Cs,[string]$Dll)\r\n$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'\r\nif (-not (Test-Path $Dll)) { Add-Type -TypeDefinition ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($Cs)) -Language CSharp -ReferencedAssemblies System.Core -OutputAssembly $Dll }\r\nAdd-Type -Path $Dll\r\n[KzScan]::Run($GamePid)").ok()?;
        let mut child = sys::cmd("powershell")
            .args(["-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File"])
            .arg(&ps1)
            .args(["-GamePid", &game_pid.to_string(), "-Cs"])
            .arg(&cs)
            .arg("-Dll")
            .arg(&dll)
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .spawn()
            .ok()?;
        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(45);
        loop {
            match child.try_wait() {
                Ok(Some(_)) => break,
                Ok(None) if Instant::now() < deadline => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)),
                _ => {
                    let _ = child.kill();
                    return None;
                }
            }
        }
        let mut s = String::new();
        child.stdout.take()?.read_to_string(&mut s).ok()?;
        serde_json::from_str(s.trim().lines().last()?).ok()
    };
    run().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
}

#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
fn deep_scan_platform(game_pid: u32) -> Value {
    if game_pid == 0 {
        return Value::Null;
    }
    let me = std::process::id();
    let mut handles: Vec<(u32, &str)> = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(st) = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{game_pid}/status")) {
        if let Some(c) = Regex::new(r"TracerPid:\s*(\d+)").unwrap().captures(&st) {
            let tr: u32 = c[1].parse().unwrap_or(0);
            if tr > 0 {
                handles.push((tr, "ptrace"));
            }
        }
    }
    let target = PathBuf::from(format!("/proc/{game_pid}/mem"));
    if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir("/proc") {
        for e in rd.flatten() {
            let Ok(pid) = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().parse::<u32>() else { continue };
            if pid == game_pid || pid == me {
                continue;
            }
            let Ok(fds) = std::fs::read_dir(format!("/proc/{pid}/fd")) else { continue };
            for f in fds.flatten() {
                if std::fs::read_link(f.path()).map(|t| t == target).unwrap_or(false) {
                    handles.push((pid, "mem"));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let hs: Vec<Value> = handles
        .iter()
        .map(|(pid, how)| {
            let name = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/comm")).map(|s| s.trim().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
            json!({ "name": name, "company": "", "sys": false, "read": true, "write": *how == "mem", "how": how })
        })
        .collect();
    json!({ "v": 1, "handles": hs, "overlays": [], "drivers": [] })
}

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
fn deep_scan_platform(_game_pid: u32) -> Value {
    Value::Null
}

fn is_sha(h: &str) -> bool {
    h.len() == 64 && h.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&c))
}

fn str_list(v: Option<&Value>) -> Vec<String> {
    v.and_then(|x| x.as_array()).map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|s| s.as_str().map(String::from)).collect()).unwrap_or_default()
}

pub fn scan(opts: &Value) -> Value {
    let pend = crate::svc::begin(opts);
    let guard_err = match scan_v3(opts) {
        Ok(mut v) => { crate::svc::finish(pend, &mut v); return v; }
        Err(e) if e == "unsupported" => None,
        Err(e) => Some(e.chars().take(110).collect::<String>()),
    };
    let mut r = scan_v2(opts);
    if let Some(e) = guard_err { r["guardErr"] = json!(e); }
    r
}

fn scan_v2(opts: &Value) -> Value {
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    let want: HashSet<String> =
        str_list(opts.get("names")).iter().map(|s| norm_proc(s)).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).take(500).collect();
    let procs = list_procs();
    let game = procs.iter().find(|p| is_game(p)).cloned();
    let want_h: HashSet<String> = str_list(opts.get("hashes")).into_iter().filter(|h| is_sha(h)).take(2000).collect();
    let mut hits: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for p in &procs {
        let n = norm_proc(&p.name);
        if n.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let hit = if want.contains(&n) {
            Some(n.clone())
        } else if !want_h.is_empty() {
            let h = sha_hex(format!("kzac:{n}").as_bytes());
            want_h.contains(&h).then(|| format!("h:{h}"))
        } else {
            None
        };
        if let Some(h) = hit {
            if !hits.contains(&h) {
                hits.push(h);
            }
        }
    }
    let exe_path = game_exe_path(game.as_ref());
    let (mut exe, mut ga) = (Value::Null, Value::Null);
    if let Some(ep) = &exe_path {
        if let Some((size, hash)) = file_hash(ep) {
            exe = json!({ "name": base_name(&ep.to_string_lossy()), "size": size, "hash": hash });
        }
        if let Some(dir) = ep.parent() {
            for g in ["GameAssembly.dll", "GameAssembly.so"] {
                let f = dir.join(g);
                if f.exists() {
                    if let Some((size, hash)) = file_hash(&f) {
                        ga = json!({ "size": size, "hash": hash });
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if settings::truthy(opts.get("filesFull")) {
        *FILES_SENT.lock().unwrap() = None;
    }
    let files = match (&exe_path, settings::truthy(opts.get("files"))) {
        (Some(ep), true) => ep.parent().map(game_files).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
        _ => Value::Null,
    };
    let modules = match (&game, settings::truthy(opts.get("modules"))) {
        (Some(g), true) => game_modules(g).map(|v| json!(v)).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
        _ => Value::Null,
    };
    let deep = match (&game, settings::truthy(opts.get("deep"))) {
        (Some(g), true) => deep_scan(g.pid, &str_list(opts.get("driverHashes"))),
        _ => Value::Null,
    };
    json!({
        "v": 1, "gv": GUARD_VERSION, "platform": sys::platform(), "ver": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"),
        "found": game.is_some(), "proc": game.as_ref().map(|g| base_name(&g.name)),
        "exe": exe, "ga": ga, "files": files, "modules": modules, "hits": hits, "deep": deep,
        "scanned": procs.len(), "ms": t0.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
    })
}

static UPLOADING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

pub async fn upload(o: Value) -> Value {
    if UPLOADING.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return json!({ "ok": false, "error": "busy" });
    }
    let r = upload_inner(&o).await.unwrap_or_else(|e| json!({ "ok": false, "error": e }));
    UPLOADING.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
    r
}

async fn upload_inner(o: &Value) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let s = |k: &str| o.get(k).map(|v| match v { Value::String(s) => s.clone(), Value::Null => String::new(), x => x.to_string() }).unwrap_or_default();
    let pc = o.get("pc").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false);
    let (full, size) = if pc {
        let masked = s("path");
        let Some(full) = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || kzguard::pc_file(&masked)).await.ok().flatten() else {
            return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": "not in report" }));
        };
        let size = std::fs::metadata(&full).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.len();
        if let Some(want) = o.get("size").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).map(|x| x as u64) { if want != size { return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": "size changed" })); } }
        (full, size)
    } else {
        let procs = list_procs();
        let game = procs.iter().find(|p| is_game(p)).cloned();
        let Some(exe) = game_exe_path(game.as_ref()) else { return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": "game not found" })) };
        let root = exe.parent().map(|p| p.to_path_buf()).ok_or("game not found")?;
        let root = std::fs::canonicalize(&root).unwrap_or(root);
        let rel = s("path");
        let bad = rel.is_empty()
            || rel.split(['/', '\\']).any(|x| x == "..")
            || rel.starts_with('/')
            || rel.starts_with('\\')
            || (rel.len() > 1 && rel.as_bytes()[1] == b':');
        if bad {
            return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": "bad path" }));
        }
        let mut full = root.clone();
        for seg in rel.split('/') {
            full.push(seg);
        }
        let meta = match std::fs::metadata(&full) {
            Ok(m) if m.is_file() && full.starts_with(&root) => m,
            _ => return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": "no file" })),
        };
        let size = meta.len();
        if o.get("size").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).map(|x| x as u64) != Some(size) {
            return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": "size changed" }));
        }
        (full, size)
    };
    let base = { let b = s("server"); if b.is_empty() { settings::server_url() } else { b } }.trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
    let id: String = s("id").bytes().map(|b| if b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"-_.!~*'()".contains(&b) { (b as char).to_string() } else { format!("%{b:02X}") }).collect();
    let c = crate::updater::client();
    let req = |url: String| {
        c.post(url)
            .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", s("token")))
            .header("X-Konzte-Hwid", s("hwid"))
            .header("X-Konzte-Client", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"))
            .header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
    };
    let mut off: u64 = o.get("off").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).map(|x| x as u64).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut f = std::fs::File::open(&full).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    const CH: u64 = 8 << 20;
    while off < size {
        let n = CH.min(size - off) as usize;
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; n];
        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(off)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        f.read_exact(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let r = req(format!("{base}/api/ac/upload?id={id}&off={off}&size={size}")).body(buf).send().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let st = r.status().as_u16();
        let j: Value = r.json().await.unwrap_or(json!({}));
        let got = j.get("got").and_then(|v| v.as_f64());
        if st == 409 && got.is_some() {
            off = got.unwrap() as u64;
            continue;
        }
        if !(200..300).contains(&st) {
            return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "error": j.get("error").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from).unwrap_or(format!("HTTP {st}")) }));
        }
        off = got.map(|g| g as u64).ok_or("bad server reply")?;
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(40)).await;
    }
    let r = req(format!("{base}/api/ac/upload?id={id}&off={off}&done=1")).send().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let st = r.status().as_u16();
    let j: Value = r.json().await.unwrap_or(json!({}));
    Ok(if (200..300).contains(&st) {
        json!({ "ok": true, "sha256": j.get("sha256").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null) })
    } else {
        json!({ "ok": false, "error": j.get("error").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from).unwrap_or(format!("HTTP {st}")) })
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn names() {
        assert_eq!(norm_proc("C:\\Games\\CheatEngine.EXE"), "cheatengine");
        assert_eq!(norm_proc("/usr/bin/foo.x86_64"), "foo");
        assert!(GAME_RE.is_match("CombatMaster.exe"));
        assert!(GAME_RE.is_match("combatmaster"));
        assert!(!GAME_RE.is_match("CombatMasterLauncher.exe"));
        assert!(FULL_HASH_RE.is_match("CombatMaster_Data/StreamingAssets/Bundles/src/first_person"));
        assert!(!FULL_HASH_RE.is_match("CombatMaster_Data/StreamingAssets/Bundles/src/first_person2"));
    }
    #[test]
    fn quick_hash_matches_node() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("kzq-{}", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let f = dir.join("x.bin");
        let data: Vec<u8> = (0..(3u32 << 20) / 2).map(|i| (i * 7 % 251) as u8).collect();
        std::fs::write(&f, &data).unwrap();
        let m = std::fs::metadata(&f).unwrap();
        let mut h = Sha256::new();
        h.update(data.len().to_string());
        h.update(&data[..1 << 20]);
        h.update(&data[data.len() - (data.len() - (1 << 20))..]);
        assert_eq!(quick_hash(&f, &m).unwrap(), hex::encode(h.finalize()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(dir);
    }
    #[test]
    fn scan_runs() {
        let r = scan(&json!({ "names": ["bash", "konzte"], "files": true, "modules": true, "deep": true }));
        assert_eq!(r["v"], 1);
        assert!(r["scanned"].as_u64().unwrap() > 0);
    }
}
```

```rs
const BRIDGE: &str = include_str!("../shell/bridge.js");
static QUITTING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static TRAY: Mutex<Option<TrayIcon>> = Mutex::new(None);
static UI: Lazy<Mutex<updater::Prepared>> = Lazy::new(Default::default);

fn ui_url(path: &str) -> Url {
    let base = if cfg!(windows) { "https://kz.localhost/" } else { "kz://localhost/" };
    Url::parse(&format!("{base}{path}")).unwrap()
}
fn is_ui_url(u: &Url) -> bool {
    (u.scheme() == "kz") || (matches!(u.scheme(), "http" | "https") && u.host_str() == Some("kz.localhost")) || u.as_str() == "about:blank"
}
fn open_external(url: &str) {
    if url.starts_with("http://") || url.starts_with("https://") || url.starts_with("HTTP") {
        let _ = open::that_detached(url);
    }
}

fn main_window(app: &AppHandle) -> Option<WebviewWindow> {
    app.get_webview_window("main")
}
fn show(app: &AppHandle) {
    if let Some(w) = main_window(app) {
        let _ = w.unminimize();
        let _ = w.show();
        let _ = w.set_focus();
    }
}

pub fn before_exit() {
    QUITTING.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    presence::stop_blocking();
}

fn ensure_tray(app: &AppHandle) {
    let mut t = TRAY.lock().unwrap();
    if t.is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let build = || -> tauri::Result<TrayIcon> {
        let open = MenuItem::with_id(app, "open", "Open Konzte", true, None::<&str>)?;
        let quit = MenuItem::with_id(app, "quit", "Quit", true, None::<&str>)?;
        let menu = Menu::with_items(app, &[&open, &PredefinedMenuItem::separator(app)?, &quit])?;
        TrayIconBuilder::with_id("konzte")
            .icon(Image::from_bytes(include_bytes!("../icons/64x64.png"))?)
            .tooltip("Konzte Faceit")
            .menu(&menu)
            .show_menu_on_left_click(false)
            .on_menu_event(|app, e| match e.id().as_ref() {
                "open" => show(app),
                "quit" => {
                    before_exit();
                    app.exit(0);
                }
                _ => {}
            })
            .on_tray_icon_event(|tray, e| {
                if let TrayIconEvent::Click { button: MouseButton::Left, button_state: MouseButtonState::Up, .. } = e {
                    let app = tray.app_handle();
                    if let Some(w) = main_window(app) {
                        if w.is_visible().unwrap_or(false) && w.is_focused().unwrap_or(false) {
                            let _ = w.hide();
                        } else {
                            show(app);
                        }
                    }
                }
            })
            .build(app)
    };
    match build() {
        Ok(tray) => *t = Some(tray),
        Err(e) => eprintln!("[tray] {e}"),
    }
}
fn remove_tray(app: &AppHandle) {
    if let Some(t) = TRAY.lock().unwrap().take() {
        let _ = app.remove_tray_by_id(t.id());
    }
}

fn apply_zoom(app: &AppHandle) {
    let z = settings::read().get("zoom").and_then(|v| v.as_f64()).filter(|z| *z > 0.2 && *z < 5.0).unwrap_or(1.0);
    if let Some(w) = main_window(app) {
        let _ = w.set_zoom(z);
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
fn settings_get() -> Value {
    let mut m = Map::new();
    m.insert("server".into(), json!(settings::DEFAULT_SERVER));
    m.insert("devUi".into(), json!(settings::dev()));
    m.insert("sysLangs".into(), json!(sys::sys_langs()));
    for (k, v) in settings::read() {
        m.insert(k, v);
    }
    if let Ok(s) = std::env::var("KONZTE_SERVER") {
        if !s.is_empty() {
            m.insert("server".into(), json!(s));
        }
    }
    Value::Object(m)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn settings_set(app: AppHandle, patch: Value) -> Value {
    let mut patch = patch.as_object().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    if patch.contains_key("server") && !settings::dev() {
        let ok = patch.get("server").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(|s| regex::Regex::new(r"^https://konzte\.online(/|$)").unwrap().is_match(s)).unwrap_or(false);
        if !ok {
            patch.remove("server");
        }
    }
    let mut s = settings::read();
    for (k, v) in patch.iter() {
        s.insert(k.clone(), v.clone());
    }
    settings::write(&s);
    if patch.contains_key("zoom") {
        apply_zoom(&app);
    }
    if patch.contains_key("autostart") || patch.contains_key("startHidden") {
        sys::set_autostart(settings::truthy(s.get("autostart")), settings::truthy(s.get("startHidden")));
    }
    if patch.contains_key("tray") || patch.contains_key("closeToTray") {
        let close_to_tray = settings::truthy(s.get("closeToTray"));
        if settings::is_false(s.get("tray")) && !close_to_tray {
            remove_tray(&app);
        } else {
            ensure_tray(&app);
        }
    }
    Value::Object(s)
}

#[tauri::command]
fn win_cmd(window: WebviewWindow, cmd: String) {
    match cmd.as_str() {
        "min" => {
            let _ = window.minimize();
        }
        "max" => {
            if window.is_maximized().unwrap_or(false) {
                let _ = window.unmaximize();
            } else {
                let _ = window.maximize();
            }
        }
        "close" => {
            let _ = window.close();
        }
        "drag" => {
            let _ = window.start_dragging();
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
fn attention(app: AppHandle, window: WebviewWindow, text: String, opts: Value) {
    let st = settings::read();
    if !window.is_focused().unwrap_or(false) {
        if !settings::is_false(st.get("flash")) {
            let _ = window.request_user_attention(Some(UserAttentionType::Informational));
        }
        if !settings::is_false(st.get("notify")) {
            let _ = app.notification().builder().title("Konzte").body(text).show();
        }
    }
    if settings::truthy(opts.get("raise")) && !settings::is_false(st.get("raise")) {
        let _ = window.unminimize();
        let _ = window.show();
    }
}

#[tauri::command]
async fn clip_read() -> Value {
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(|| {
        let mut g = CLIP.lock().unwrap();
        if g.is_none() {
            *g = arboard::Clipboard::new().ok();
        }
        let Some(cb) = g.as_mut() else { return Value::Null };
        if let Ok(img) = cb.get_image() {
            if let Some(buf) = image::RgbaImage::from_raw(img.width as u32, img.height as u32, img.bytes.into_owned()) {
                let mut png = Vec::new();
                if image::DynamicImage::ImageRgba8(buf).write_to(&mut std::io::Cursor::new(&mut png), image::ImageFormat::Png).is_ok() {
                    return json!({ "png": base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(png) });
                }
            }
        }
        match cb.get_text() {
            Ok(t) => json!({ "text": t }),
            Err(_) => Value::Null,
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap_or(Value::Null)
}

static CLIP: Mutex<Option<arboard::Clipboard>> = Mutex::new(None);

#[tauri::command]
async fn clip_write(text: String) -> bool {
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
        let mut g = CLIP.lock().unwrap();
        if g.is_none() {
            *g = arboard::Clipboard::new().ok();
        }
        g.as_mut().map(|c| c.set_text(text).is_ok()).unwrap_or(false)
    })
    .await
    .unwrap_or(false)
}

fn splash_set(w: &WebviewWindow, pct: u32, text: &str) {
    let _ = w.eval(format!(
        "(()=>{{const b=document.getElementById('b'),t=document.getElementById('t');if(b)b.style.width='{pct}%';if(t)t.textContent={}}})()",
        serde_json::to_string(text).unwrap()
    ));
}

fn create_window(app: &AppHandle) -> tauri::Result<WebviewWindow> {
    let st = settings::read();
    let hidden = std::env::args().any(|a| a == "--hidden");
    #[allow(unused_mut)]
    let mut b = WebviewWindowBuilder::new(app, "main", WebviewUrl::CustomProtocol(ui_url("__shell/splash.html")))
        .title("Konzte Faceit")
        .inner_size(1280.0, 800.0)
        .min_inner_size(1100.0, 680.0)
        .decorations(false)
        .center()
        .visible(!hidden)
        .background_color(Color(15, 15, 19, 255))
        .initialization_script(BRIDGE)
        .zoom_hotkeys_enabled(false)
        .data_directory(settings::user_data().join("webview"))
        .on_navigation(|u| {
            if is_ui_url(u) {
                return true;
            }
            open_external(u.as_str());
            false
        })
        .on_new_window(|u, _| {
            open_external(u.as_str());
            NewWindowResponse::Deny
        });
    if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
        if let Some(js) = std::env::var_os("KONZTE_TEST_JS").and_then(|f| std::fs::read_to_string(f).ok()) {
            b = b.initialization_script(format!("if(location.pathname==='/index.html')addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(async()=>{{const log=m=>__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('dbg_log',{{msg:String(m)}});try{{{js}\n}}catch(e){{log('FAIL exception '+(e&&e.stack||e))}}}},1500));"));
        }
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        b = b.use_https_scheme(true);
        let mut args = String::from("--disable-features=msWebOOUI,msPdfOOUI,msSmartScreenProtection");
        if settings::is_false(st.get("hwAccel")) {
            args.push_str(" --disable-gpu");
        }
        b = b.additional_browser_args(&args);
    }
    let w = b.build()?;
    if !settings::is_false(st.get("tray")) {
        ensure_tray(app);
    }
    Ok(w)
}

fn main() {
    if std::env::args().any(|a| a == "--kz-selftest") {
        let shot = sys::latest_shot();
        println!("{}", json!({
            "hwid": sys::hwid(), "platform": sys::platform(), "arch": sys::arch(), "osVer": sys::os_version(), "sysLangs": sys::sys_langs(),
            "userData": settings::user_data(), "steamRoots": sys::steam_roots(), "latestShot": shot.get("name"),
            "gameRunning": guard::game_running(), "settingsKeys": settings::read().keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        }));
        return;
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        let st = settings::read();
        if settings::is_false(st.get("hwAccel")) {
            std::env::set_var("WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE", "1");
            std::env::set_var("WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER", "1");
        }
        if std::env::var_os("DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS").is_none() && std::env::var_os("KONZTE_KEEP_LOWPOWER").is_none() {
            std::env::set_var("DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS", "unix:path=/nonexistent/konzte-no-system-bus");
        }
    }

    let app = tauri::Builder::default()
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_single_instance::init(|app, _args, _cwd| show(app)))
        .plugin(tauri_plugin_notification::init())
        .register_asynchronous_uri_scheme_protocol("kz", |_ctx, req, responder| {
            std::thread::spawn(move || responder.respond(assets::handle(&req)));
        })
        .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
            settings_get, settings_set, open_url, win_cmd, attention, hwid, app_info, relaunch, clear_cache, asset,
            latest_shot, ac_scan, ac_upload, game_running, shell_info, shell_install, launch_game, guard_svc_status, guard_open,
            cm_state, cm_create, cm_join, cm_leave, cm_invite, cm_room_blob, cm_result, cm_expect_friends, cm_add_friend, cm_friends,
            presence_client, presence_set, presence_clear, clip_read, clip_write, dbg_log
        ])
        .setup(|app| {
            let handle = app.handle().clone();
            let w = create_window(&handle)?;
            apply_zoom(&handle);
            tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
                let (w1, w2) = (w.clone(), w.clone());
                let prep = updater::prepare(
                    &settings::server_url(),
                    &settings::user_data(),
                    shellupdate::VERSION,
                    move |n| {
                        if n > 0 {
                            splash_set(&w1, 15, &format!("Downloading update… 0/{n}"));
                        }
                    },
                    Arc::new(move |d, n| splash_set(&w2, 15 + (80 * d / n.max(1)) as u32, &format!("Downloading update… {d}/{n}"))),
                )
                .await;
                if let Some(e) = &prep.error {
                    eprintln!("[update] {e}");
                }
                splash_set(&w, 100, "Starting…");
                assets::set_active(prep.ui_source());
                *UI.lock().unwrap() = prep;
                let _ = w.navigate(ui_url("index.html"));
                cmlink::start(handle);
            });
            Ok(())
        })
        .on_window_event(|window, e| {
            if let WindowEvent::CloseRequested { api, .. } = e {
                if !QUITTING.load(Ordering::SeqCst) && settings::truthy(settings::read().get("closeToTray")) {
                    api.prevent_close();
                    ensure_tray(window.app_handle());
                    let _ = window.hide();
                }
            }
        })
        .build(tauri::generate_context!())
        .expect("error while building Konzte");

    app.run(|_app, e| {
        if let RunEvent::Exit = e {
            if !QUITTING.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
                before_exit();
            }
        }
    });
}
```
