`app-tauri/src/presence.rs`:

```rs
use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use regex::Regex;
use serde_json::{json, Map, Value};
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncRead, AsyncReadExt, AsyncWrite, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio::time::Instant;

const MAX_PIPES: usize = 10;
const RETRY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
const MIN_GAP: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);
static SITE: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"^https://(?:www\.)?konzte\.online/").unwrap());
static CLIENT_ID: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"^\d{15,22}$").unwrap());
static PARTY_ID: Lazy<Regex> = Lazy::new(|| Regex::new(r"^[\w-]{1,64}$").unwrap());

pub enum Cmd {
    Client(Option<String>),
    Set(Value),
    Clear,
    Stop(tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<()>),
}

static TX: Lazy<mpsc::UnboundedSender<Cmd>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
    tauri::async_runtime::spawn(actor(rx));
    tx
});

pub fn set_client(id: &Value) {
    let s = match id {
        Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        Value::Number(n) => n.to_string(),
        _ => String::new(),
    };
    let _ = TX.send(Cmd::Client(CLIENT_ID.is_match(&s).then_some(s)));
}
pub fn set(a: &Value) {
    let _ = TX.send(Cmd::Set(clean(a)));
}
pub fn clear() {
    let _ = TX.send(Cmd::Clear);
}
pub fn stop_blocking() {
    let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
    if TX.send(Cmd::Stop(tx)).is_ok() {
        let _ = tauri::async_runtime::block_on(async { tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(500), rx).await });
    }
}

fn s(v: Option<&Value>, max: usize) -> Option<String> {
    let t: String = v?.as_str()?.chars().map(|c| if (c as u32) < 0x20 { ' ' } else { c }).collect();
    let t = t.trim();
    if t.encode_utf16().count() < 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let u: Vec<u16> = t.encode_utf16().take(max).collect();
    Some(String::from_utf16_lossy(&u))
}
fn img(v: Option<&Value>) -> Option<String> {
    let x = v?.as_str()?;
    (SITE.is_match(x) && x.len() < 256).then(|| x.to_string())
}
fn num(v: Option<&Value>) -> f64 {
    match v {
        Some(Value::Number(n)) => n.as_f64().unwrap_or(f64::NAN),
        Some(Value::String(s)) => s.trim().parse().unwrap_or(f64::NAN),
        _ => f64::NAN,
    }
}
fn int32(v: Option<&Value>) -> i64 {
    let x = num(v);
    if x.is_finite() { (x.trunc() as i64) as i32 as i64 } else { 0 }
}
fn now_ms() -> f64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_millis() as f64).unwrap_or(0.0)
}

pub fn clean(a: &Value) -> Value {
    let Some(a) = a.as_object() else { return Value::Null };
    let mut out = Map::new();
    out.insert("type".into(), json!(0));
    let details = s(a.get("details"), 128);
    let state = s(a.get("state"), 128);
    if let Some(d) = &details {
        out.insert("details".into(), json!(d));
    }
    if let Some(st) = &state {
        out.insert("state".into(), json!(st));
    }
    let (start, end) = (num(a.get("start")), num(a.get("end")));
    let mut ts = Map::new();
    if start.is_finite() && start > 0.0 {
        ts.insert("start".into(), json!(start.floor() as i64));
    }
    if end.is_finite() && end > now_ms() {
        ts.insert("end".into(), json!(end.floor() as i64));
    }
    if !ts.is_empty() {
        out.insert("timestamps".into(), Value::Object(ts));
    }
    let mut assets = Map::new();
    if let Some(x) = img(a.get("largeImage")) {
        assets.insert("large_image".into(), json!(x));
    }
    if let Some(x) = s(a.get("largeText"), 128) {
        assets.insert("large_text".into(), json!(x));
    }
    if let Some(x) = img(a.get("smallImage")) {
        assets.insert("small_image".into(), json!(x));
    }
    if let Some(x) = s(a.get("smallText"), 128) {
        assets.insert("small_text".into(), json!(x));
    }
    if !assets.is_empty() {
        out.insert("assets".into(), Value::Object(assets));
    }
    let (ps, pm) = (int32(a.get("partySize")), int32(a.get("partyMax")));
    if let Some(pid) = a.get("partyId").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).filter(|p| PARTY_ID.is_match(p)) {
        if ps >= 1 && pm >= ps && pm <= 10 {
            out.insert("party".into(), json!({ "id": pid, "size": [ps, pm] }));
        }
    }
    let buttons: Vec<Value> = a
        .get("buttons")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
        .map(|b| {
            b.iter()
                .take(2)
                .filter_map(|b| {
                    let label = s(b.get("label"), 32)?;
                    let url = b.get("url")?.as_str().filter(|u| SITE.is_match(u) && u.len() < 512)?;
                    Some(json!({ "label": label, "url": url }))
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    if !buttons.is_empty() {
        out.insert("buttons".into(), Value::Array(buttons));
    }
    if details.is_some() || state.is_some() {
        Value::Object(out)
    } else {
        Value::Null
    }
}

fn frame(op: u32, obj: &Value) -> Vec<u8> {
    let body = serde_json::to_vec(obj).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(8 + body.len());
    v.extend_from_slice(&op.to_le_bytes());
    v.extend_from_slice(&(body.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    v.extend_from_slice(&body);
    v
}

type Reader = Box<dyn AsyncRead + Unpin + Send>;
type Writer = Box<dyn AsyncWrite + Unpin + Send>;

fn pipe_paths() -> Vec<std::path::PathBuf> {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        (0..MAX_PIPES).map(|i| format!(r"\\?\pipe\discord-ipc-{i}").into()).collect()
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    {
        let mut bases: Vec<String> = ["XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", "TMPDIR", "TMP", "TEMP"].iter().filter_map(|k| std::env::var(k).ok()).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
        bases.push("/tmp".into());
        let mut dirs: Vec<std::path::PathBuf> = Vec::new();
        for b in &bases {
            let b = std::path::PathBuf::from(b);
            for d in [
                b.clone(),
                b.join("app/com.discordapp.Discord"),
                b.join("app/com.discordapp.DiscordCanary"),
                b.join("snap.discord"),
                b.join(".flatpak/dev.vencord.Vesktop/xdg-run"),
            ] {
                if !dirs.contains(&d) {
                    dirs.push(d);
                }
            }
        }
        dirs.iter().flat_map(|d| (0..MAX_PIPES).map(move |i| d.join(format!("discord-ipc-{i}")))).collect()
    }
}

async fn open_pipe() -> Option<(Reader, Writer)> {
    for p in pipe_paths() {
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {
            if let Ok(c) = tokio::net::windows::named_pipe::ClientOptions::new().open(&p) {
                let (r, w) = tokio::io::split(c);
                return Some((Box::new(r), Box::new(w)));
            }
        }
        #[cfg(not(windows))]
        {
            if !p.exists() {
                continue;
            }
            if let Ok(Ok(c)) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), tokio::net::UnixStream::connect(&p)).await {
                let (r, w) = c.into_split();
                return Some((Box::new(r), Box::new(w)));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

enum In {
    Ready,
    Ping(Value),
    Closed,
}

async fn reader(mut r: Reader, tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<In>) {
    let mut head = [0u8; 8];
    loop {
        if r.read_exact(&mut head).await.is_err() {
            break;
        }
        let op = u32::from_le_bytes(head[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
        let len = u32::from_le_bytes(head[4..8].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
        if len > 1 << 20 {
            break;
        }
        let mut body = vec![0u8; len];
        if r.read_exact(&mut body).await.is_err() {
            break;
        }
        let msg: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&body).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        match op {
            3 => {
                let _ = tx.send(In::Ping(if msg.is_null() { json!({}) } else { msg }));
            }
            2 => break,
            _ => {
                if msg.get("evt").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some("READY") {
                    let _ = tx.send(In::Ready);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = tx.send(In::Closed);
}

fn nonce() -> String {
    format!("{}{:06x}", now_ms() as u64, rand::random::<u32>() & 0xffffff)
}

async fn actor(mut rx: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<Cmd>) {
    let mut client: Option<String> = None;
    let mut wanted = Value::Null;
    let mut sent: Option<String> = None;
    let mut last_sent: Option<Instant> = None;
    let mut conn: Option<(Writer, mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<In>)> = None;
    let mut ready = false;
    let mut retry_at: Option<Instant> = None;
    let mut send_at: Option<Instant> = None;

    loop {
        if conn.is_none() && client.is_some() && retry_at.map(|t| Instant::now() >= t).unwrap_or(true) {
            match open_pipe().await {
                Some((r, mut w)) => {
                    let hs = frame(0, &json!({ "v": 1, "client_id": client.clone().unwrap() }));
                    if w.write_all(&hs).await.is_ok() {
                        let (itx, irx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel();
                        tauri::async_runtime::spawn(reader(r, itx));
                        conn = Some((w, irx));
                        ready = false;
                        retry_at = None;
                    } else {
                        retry_at = Some(Instant::now() + RETRY);
                    }
                }
                None => retry_at = Some(Instant::now() + RETRY),
            }
        }
        let wake = [send_at.filter(|_| ready), retry_at.filter(|_| conn.is_none() && client.is_some())]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .min()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3600));

        let mut drop_conn = false;
        let mut connect_now = false;
        tokio::select! {
            c = rx.recv() => match c {
                None => return,
                Some(Cmd::Client(id)) => {
                    if id != client {
                        client = id;
                        drop_conn = true;
                        connect_now = true;
                    }
                }
                Some(Cmd::Set(a)) => { wanted = a; connect_now = conn.is_none(); schedule(&mut send_at, last_sent, false); }
                Some(Cmd::Clear) => { wanted = Value::Null; schedule(&mut send_at, last_sent, false); }
                Some(Cmd::Stop(done)) => {
                    client = None;
                    if let Some((w, _)) = conn.as_mut() {
                        let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(300), w.write_all(&frame(1, &json!({ "cmd": "SET_ACTIVITY", "args": { "pid": std::process::id() }, "nonce": "bye" })))).await;
                    }
                    conn = None; ready = false; sent = None;
                    let _ = done.send(());
                    continue;
                }
            },
            m = async { match conn.as_mut() { Some((_, r)) => r.recv().await, None => std::future::pending().await } } => match m {
                Some(In::Ready) => { ready = true; schedule(&mut send_at, last_sent, true); }
                Some(In::Ping(p)) => { if let Some((w, _)) = conn.as_mut() { let _ = w.write_all(&frame(4, &p)).await; } }
                Some(In::Closed) | None => drop_conn = true,
            },
            _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(wake) => {
                if ready && send_at.map(|t| Instant::now() >= t).unwrap_or(false) {
                    send_at = None;
                    let js = wanted.to_string();
                    if sent.as_deref() != Some(js.as_str()) {
                        let mut args = json!({ "pid": std::process::id() });
                        if !wanted.is_null() { args["activity"] = wanted.clone(); }
                        let f = frame(1, &json!({ "cmd": "SET_ACTIVITY", "args": args, "nonce": nonce() }));
                        let ok = match conn.as_mut() { Some((w, _)) => w.write_all(&f).await.is_ok(), None => false };
                        if ok { sent = Some(js); last_sent = Some(Instant::now()); } else { drop_conn = true; }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if drop_conn {
            conn = None;
            ready = false;
            sent = None;
            if client.is_some() && retry_at.is_none() {
                retry_at = Some(Instant::now() + RETRY);
            }
        }
        if connect_now {
            retry_at = None;
        }
    }
}

fn schedule(send_at: &mut Option<Instant>, last: Option<Instant>, now: bool) {
    if send_at.is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let t = if now { Instant::now() } else { last.map(|l| (l + MIN_GAP).max(Instant::now())).unwrap_or_else(Instant::now) };
    *send_at = Some(t);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn clean_like_js() {
        assert_eq!(clean(&json!({ "state": "x" })), Value::Null);
        let a = clean(&json!({
            "details": "In queue\u{0001}", "state": "2v2", "start": 1700000000000.7, "largeImage": "https://konzte.online/a.png",
            "smallImage": "https://evil.com/x.png", "partyId": "p-1", "partySize": 2, "partyMax": 4,
            "buttons": [{ "label": "Join", "url": "https://konzte.online/j" }, { "label": "Bad", "url": "https://x.com" }]
        }));
        assert_eq!(a["details"], "In queue");
        assert_eq!(a["timestamps"]["start"], 1700000000000i64);
        assert_eq!(a["assets"]["large_image"], "https://konzte.online/a.png");
        assert!(a["assets"].get("small_image").is_none());
        assert_eq!(a["party"]["size"], json!([2, 4]));
        assert_eq!(a["buttons"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    }
}
```

```rs
use serde_json::{Map, Value};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Mutex;

pub const DEFAULT_SERVER: &str = "https://konzte.online/konzte";
static LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());

pub fn user_data() -> PathBuf {
    if let Some(d) = std::env::var_os("KONZTE_USER_DATA").filter(|d| !d.is_empty()) {
        return PathBuf::from(d);
    }
    let base = dirs::config_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
    base.join("Konzte Faceit")
}

fn file() -> PathBuf {
    user_data().join("settings.json")
}

pub fn read() -> Map<String, Value> {
    let _g = LOCK.lock().unwrap();
    std::fs::read_to_string(file())
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&s).ok())
        .and_then(|v| v.as_object().cloned())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

pub fn write(s: &Map<String, Value>) {
    let _g = LOCK.lock().unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(user_data());
    let f = file();
    let tmp = f.with_extension("json.tmp");
    if std::fs::write(&tmp, serde_json::to_string(s).unwrap_or_default()).is_ok() {
        let _ = std::fs::rename(&tmp, &f);
    }
}

pub fn dev() -> bool {
    std::env::var("KONZTE_DEV").ok().as_deref() == Some("1")
}

pub fn server_url() -> String {
    if let Ok(s) = std::env::var("KONZTE_SERVER") {
        if !s.is_empty() {
            return s;
        }
    }
    read()
        .get("server")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .map(String::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_SERVER.to_string())
}

pub fn truthy(v: Option<&Value>) -> bool {
    match v {
        None | Some(Value::Null) => false,
        Some(Value::Bool(b)) => *b,
        Some(Value::Number(n)) => n.as_f64().map(|x| x != 0.0 && !x.is_nan()).unwrap_or(false),
        Some(Value::String(s)) => !s.is_empty(),
        Some(_) => true,
    }
}

pub fn is_false(v: Option<&Value>) -> bool {
    matches!(v, Some(Value::Bool(false)))
}
```

`app-tauri/src/shellupdate.rs`:

```rs
use crate::updater::{client, cmp_ver, verify_sig};
use futures_util::StreamExt;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub const VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");

fn mac_arch() -> &'static str {
    if cfg!(target_arch = "aarch64") {
        return "arm64";
    }
    if crate::sys::run_out("sysctl", &["-in", "hw.optional.arm64"]).map(|s| s.trim() == "1").unwrap_or(false) {
        "arm64"
    } else {
        "x64"
    }
}

fn plat() -> String {
    if cfg!(windows) {
        "tauri-windows".into()
    } else if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        format!("tauri-mac-{}", mac_arch())
    } else {
        "tauri-linux".into()
    }
}

fn site_of(server: &str) -> String {
    let s = if server.is_empty() { "https://konzte.online/konzte" } else { server };
    let s = s.trim_end_matches('/');
    s.strip_suffix("/konzte").unwrap_or(s).trim_end_matches('/').to_string()
}

fn exe() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    std::env::current_exe().ok()
}
fn appimage() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    std::env::var("APPIMAGE").ok().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).map(PathBuf::from)
}
fn mac_bundle() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let e = exe()?;
    let s = e.to_string_lossy();
    let i = s.find(".app/Contents/MacOS/")?;
    Some(PathBuf::from(&s[..i + 4]))
}
fn writable(dir: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
    let t = dir.join(format!(".kz-w-{}", std::process::id()));
    let ok = std::fs::write(&t, b"").is_ok();
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&t);
    ok
}
fn linux_bin() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") || appimage().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    let e = exe()?;
    writable(e.parent()?).then_some(e)
}

fn can_install() -> bool {
    if cfg!(windows) {
        return exe().map(|e| e.extension().map(|x| x.eq_ignore_ascii_case("exe")).unwrap_or(false)).unwrap_or(false);
    }
    if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
        return appimage().is_some() || linux_bin().is_some();
    }
    if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        return mac_bundle().and_then(|b| b.parent().map(writable)).unwrap_or(false);
    }
    false
}

pub async fn info(server: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let site = site_of(server);
    let c = client();
    let q = format!("?t={}", std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_millis());
    let (u1, u2) = (format!("{site}/assets/shell.json{q}"), format!("{site}/assets/shell.sig{q}"));
    let (raw, sig) = tokio::join!(crate::updater::fetch(&c, &u1, 8000), crate::updater::fetch(&c, &u2, 8000));
    let (raw, sig) = (raw?, sig?);
    if !verify_sig(&raw, &String::from_utf8_lossy(&sig)) {
        return Err("bad shell signature".into());
    }
    let j: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&raw).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let latest = j.get("app").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("0").to_string();
    let f = j.get("files").and_then(|x| x.get(plat())).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
    let has_sha = f.get("sha256").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(|s| !s.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false);
    let newer = has_sha && cmp_ver(f.get("version").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or(&latest), VERSION) > 0;
    let lat = f.get("version").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from).unwrap_or(latest);
    Ok(json!({ "site": site, "latest": lat, "current": VERSION, "newer": newer, "can": can_install() && has_sha, "file": f }))
}

static BUSY: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

pub async fn install(server: &str, on_progress: impl Fn(Value)) -> Result<Value, String> {
    if BUSY.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return Err("Update is already running".into());
    }
    let r = install_inner(server, on_progress).await;
    BUSY.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
    r
}

async fn install_inner(server: &str, on_progress: impl Fn(Value)) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let i = info(server).await?;
    if !i["newer"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false) {
        return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "reason": "latest" }));
    }
    if !i["can"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false) {
        return Ok(json!({ "ok": false, "reason": "manual" }));
    }
    let site = i["site"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let latest = i["latest"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let furl = i["file"]["url"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let url = if furl.starts_with("https://") { furl } else { format!("{site}{furl}") };
    if !url.starts_with(&format!("{site}/")) {
        return Err("bad update url".into());
    }
    let want_sha = i["file"]["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    let ext = if cfg!(windows) { ".exe" } else if cfg!(target_os = "macos") { ".zip" } else { ".AppImage" };
    let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("konzte-update-{latest}-{}{ext}", std::process::id()));
    let sep = if url.contains('?') { '&' } else { '?' };
    let r = client().get(format!("{url}{sep}v={latest}")).send().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if !r.status().is_success() {
        return Err(format!("Download failed (HTTP {})", r.status().as_u16()));
    }
    let total = r.content_length().or_else(|| i["file"]["size"].as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    let mut out = std::fs::File::create(&tmp).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let (mut got, mut last) = (0u64, Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(1));
    let mut stream = r.bytes_stream();
    while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
        let chunk = chunk.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        h.update(&chunk);
        out.write_all(&chunk).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        got += chunk.len() as u64;
        if last.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(250) {
            last = Instant::now();
            on_progress(json!({ "got": got, "total": total }));
        }
    }
    out.flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    drop(out);
    on_progress(json!({ "got": got, "total": total, "done": true }));
    if hex::encode(h.finalize()) != want_sha {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp);
        return Err("Downloaded file is damaged — try again".into());
    }
    apply(&tmp)?;
    Ok(json!({ "ok": true, "restarting": true }))
}

#[cfg(unix)]
fn relaunch_later(exe: &std::path::Path) {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).filter(|a| a != "--updated").collect();
    let _ = std::process::Command::new("/bin/sh")
        .arg("-c")
        .arg("sleep 1.5; exec \"$0\" \"$@\"")
        .arg(exe)
        .args(args)
        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .spawn();
}

fn exit_soon() {
    std::thread::spawn(|| {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(400));
        crate::before_exit();
        std::process::exit(0);
    });
}

fn apply(tmp: &std::path::Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let exe = exe().ok_or("no exe")?;
        let line = format!("start \"\" /wait \"{}\" /S & start \"\" \"{}\"", tmp.display(), exe.display());
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        crate::sys::cmd("cmd").arg("/C").raw_arg(&line).spawn().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        exit_soon();
        return Ok(());
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        let bundle = mac_bundle().ok_or("no bundle")?;
        let dir = bundle.parent().ok_or("no dir")?.to_path_buf();
        let x = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("konzte-update-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&x);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&x).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let st = std::process::Command::new("ditto").args(["-x", "-k"]).arg(tmp).arg(&x).status().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if !st.success() {
            return Err("Update archive is damaged".into());
        }
        let fresh = std::fs::read_dir(&x).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?.flatten().find(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().ends_with(".app")).ok_or("Update archive is damaged")?.path();
        let old = dir.join(format!(".konzte-old-{}.app", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::rename(&bundle, &old).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if let Err(e) = std::fs::rename(&fresh, &bundle) {
            let _ = std::fs::rename(&old, &bundle);
            return Err(e.to_string());
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&old);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(tmp);
        relaunch_later(&bundle.join("Contents/MacOS").join(exe().and_then(|e| e.file_name().map(|n| n.to_owned())).ok_or("no exe")?));
        exit_soon();
        return Ok(());
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        if let Some(target) = appimage() {
            let next = PathBuf::from(format!("{}.new", target.display()));
            std::fs::copy(tmp, &next).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            std::fs::set_permissions(&next, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            std::fs::rename(&next, &target).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(tmp);
            relaunch_later(&target);
            exit_soon();
            return Ok(());
        }
        let bin = linux_bin().ok_or("manual")?;
        let parent = bin.parent().unwrap().to_path_buf();
        let work = parent.join(format!(".konzte-update-{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&work);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&work).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let img = work.join("Konzte.AppImage");
        std::fs::copy(tmp, &img).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        std::fs::set_permissions(&img, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let st = std::process::Command::new(&img)
            .arg("--appimage-extract")
            .current_dir(&work)
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .status()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let fresh = work.join("squashfs-root/usr/bin/konzte");
        if !st.success() || !fresh.exists() {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&work);
            return Err("Update archive is damaged".into());
        }
        let next = parent.join(".konzte.new");
        std::fs::copy(&fresh, &next).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        std::fs::set_permissions(&next, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        std::fs::rename(&next, &bin).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&work);
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(tmp);
        relaunch_later(&bin);
        exit_soon();
        return Ok(());
    }
    #[allow(unreachable_code)]
    {
        let _ = tmp;
        Err("manual".into())
    }
}
```

`app-tauri/src/svc.rs`:

```rs
use serde_json::{json, Value};

#[cfg(windows)]
mod imp {
    use super::*;
    use std::io::{Read, Write};
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::*;
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Services::*;

    const PIPE: &str = r"\\.\pipe\konzte-guard";
    const NAME: &str = "KonzteGuard";
    fn wz(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> { s.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect() }

    pub fn call(req: &Value, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Value, String> {
        let line = format!("{req}\n");
        let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let r = (|| -> Result<Value, String> {
                let t = Instant::now();
                let mut f = loop {
                    match std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(PIPE) {
                        Ok(f) => break f,
                        Err(e) if e.raw_os_error() == Some(231) && t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(3) => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)),
                        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Err("nopipe".into()),
                        Err(e) => return Err(format!("pipe: {e}")),
                    }
                };
                f.write_all(line.as_bytes()).map_err(|e| format!("write: {e}"))?;
                let (mut out, mut b) = (Vec::new(), [0u8; 65536]);
                loop {
                    let n = f.read(&mut b).map_err(|e| format!("read: {e}"))?;
                    if n == 0 { break; }
                    out.extend_from_slice(&b[..n]);
                    if out.contains(&b'\n') || out.len() > (8 << 20) { break; }
                }
                serde_json::from_slice(out.split(|c| *c == b'\n').next().unwrap_or(&[])).map_err(|e| format!("json: {e}"))
            })();
            let _ = tx.send(r);
        });
        rx.recv_timeout(timeout).unwrap_or_else(|_| Err("timeout".into()))
    }

    pub fn scm_running() -> Option<bool> {
        unsafe {
            let m = OpenSCManagerW(std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
            if m.is_null() { return None; }
            let s = OpenServiceW(m, wz(NAME).as_ptr(), SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS);
            let r = if s.is_null() { None } else {
                let mut st: SERVICE_STATUS = std::mem::zeroed();
                let ok = QueryServiceStatus(s, &mut st) != 0;
                CloseServiceHandle(s);
                Some(ok && st.dwCurrentState == SERVICE_RUNNING)
            };
            CloseServiceHandle(m);
            r
        }
    }

    pub fn start() -> bool {
        unsafe {
            let m = OpenSCManagerW(std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), SC_MANAGER_CONNECT);
            if m.is_null() { return false; }
            let s = OpenServiceW(m, wz(NAME).as_ptr(), SERVICE_START | SERVICE_QUERY_STATUS);
            let ok = !s.is_null() && (StartServiceW(s, 0, std::ptr::null()) != 0 || GetLastError() == ERROR_SERVICE_ALREADY_RUNNING);
            if !s.is_null() { CloseServiceHandle(s); }
            CloseServiceHandle(m);
            ok
        }
    }

    pub fn exe() -> std::path::PathBuf {
        std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("ProgramFiles").unwrap_or_else(|_| r"C:\Program Files".into())).join("Konzte Guard").join("KonzteGuard.exe")
    }
}

pub fn status() -> Value {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let scm = imp::scm_running();
        let mut v = json!({ "supported": true, "installed": scm.is_some() && imp::exe().exists(), "running": scm == Some(true) });
        if scm.is_some() {
            if let Ok(i) = imp::call(&json!({ "op": "info" }), std::time::Duration::from_secs(4)) {
                v["running"] = json!(true);
                for k in ["sv", "game", "pre", "since", "issues"] { v[k] = i[k].clone(); }
            }
        }
        v
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    json!({ "supported": false })
}

pub fn open_window() -> bool {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let e = imp::exe();
        if !e.exists() { return false; }
        ensure_running();
        return std::process::Command::new(e).arg("open").spawn().is_ok();
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    false
}

#[cfg_attr(not(windows), allow(dead_code))]
pub fn ensure_running() {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    if imp::scm_running() == Some(false) { imp::start(); }
}

pub struct Pending(#[allow(dead_code)] Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<Result<Value, String>>>);
pub fn begin(opts: &Value) -> Pending {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let nonce = opts.get("nonce").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if nonce.is_empty() { return Pending(None); }
        let pick = |k: &str| opts.get(k).cloned().unwrap_or(json!([]));
        let req = json!({ "op": "scan", "opts": { "nonce": nonce, "names": pick("names"), "hashes": pick("hashes"), "driverHashes": pick("driverHashes") } });
        return Pending(Some(std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let r = imp::call(&req, std::time::Duration::from_secs(8));
            if matches!(&r, Err(e) if e == "nopipe") && imp::scm_running() == Some(false) { imp::start(); }
            r
        })));
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    { let _ = opts; Pending(None) }
}
pub fn finish(p: Pending, r: &mut Value) {
    let Some(h) = p.0 else { return };
    match h.join().unwrap_or_else(|_| Err("panic".into())) {
        Ok(v) if v["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true) && v["att"].is_object() => { r["svc"] = v["att"].clone(); }
        Ok(v) => { r["svcErr"] = json!(v["error"].as_str().unwrap_or("bad reply")); }
        Err(e) => { r["svcErr"] = json!(e.chars().take(80).collect::<String>()); }
    }
}
```

`app-tauri/src/sys.rs`:

```rs
use crate::settings;
use base64::Engine;
use rand::RngCore;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::process::Command;

pub const CM_APPID: &str = "2281730";

pub fn platform() -> &'static str {
    if cfg!(windows) {
        "win32"
    } else if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
        "darwin"
    } else {
        "linux"
    }
}
pub fn arch() -> &'static str {
    match std::env::consts::ARCH {
        "x86_64" => "x64",
        "aarch64" => "arm64",
        "x86" => "ia32",
        a => a,
    }
}

pub fn cmd(prog: &str) -> Command {
    #[allow(unused_mut)]
    let mut c = Command::new(prog);
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        c.creation_flags(0x0800_0000);
    }
    c
}

pub fn run_out(prog: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Option<String> {
    let o = cmd(prog).args(args).output().ok()?;
    if !o.status.success() && o.stdout.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).into_owned())
}

fn machine_id() -> String {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use winreg::enums::*;
        if let Ok(k) = winreg::RegKey::predef(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE)
            .open_subkey_with_flags("SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Cryptography", KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY)
        {
            if let Ok(v) = k.get_value::<String, _>("MachineGuid") {
                if !v.is_empty() {
                    return v;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        if let Some(o) = run_out("ioreg", &["-rd1", "-c", "IOPlatformExpertDevice"]) {
            if let Some(c) = regex::Regex::new(r#""IOPlatformUUID" = "([^"]+)""#).unwrap().captures(&o) {
                return c[1].to_string();
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        for f in ["/etc/machine-id", "/var/lib/dbus/machine-id"] {
            if let Ok(s) = std::fs::read_to_string(f) {
                return s.trim().to_string();
            }
        }
    }
    let mut s = settings::read();
    if let Some(id) = s.get("fallbackId").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
        return id.to_string();
    }
    let mut b = [0u8; 16];
    rand::rng().fill_bytes(&mut b);
    let id = hex::encode(b);
    s.insert("fallbackId".into(), json!(id));
    settings::write(&s);
    id
}

fn cpu_model() -> String {
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        if let Ok(s) = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/cpuinfo") {
            for l in s.lines() {
                if let Some(r) = l.strip_prefix("model name") {
                    if let Some((_, v)) = r.split_once(": ") {
                        return v.to_string();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return String::new();
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use winreg::enums::*;
        return winreg::RegKey::predef(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE)
            .open_subkey("HARDWARE\\DESCRIPTION\\System\\CentralProcessor\\0")
            .and_then(|k| k.get_value::<String, _>("ProcessorNameString"))
            .unwrap_or_default();
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        return run_out("sysctl", &["-n", "machdep.cpu.brand_string"]).map(|s| s.trim().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
    }
    #[allow(unreachable_code)]
    String::new()
}

fn total_mem() -> f64 {
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        if let Ok(s) = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/meminfo") {
            for l in s.lines() {
                if let Some(r) = l.strip_prefix("MemTotal:") {
                    let kb: f64 = r.trim().trim_end_matches("kB").trim().parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                    return kb * 1024.0;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0.0;
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    unsafe {
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::{GlobalMemoryStatusEx, MEMORYSTATUSEX};
        let mut m: MEMORYSTATUSEX = std::mem::zeroed();
        m.dwLength = std::mem::size_of::<MEMORYSTATUSEX>() as u32;
        if GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&mut m) != 0 {
            return m.ullTotalPhys as f64;
        }
        return 0.0;
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        return run_out("sysctl", &["-n", "hw.memsize"]).and_then(|s| s.trim().parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
    }
    #[allow(unreachable_code)]
    0.0
}

pub fn hwid() -> String {
    static CACHE: once_cell::sync::OnceCell<String> = once_cell::sync::OnceCell::new();
    CACHE
        .get_or_init(|| {
            let gb = (total_mem() / (1u64 << 30) as f64 + 0.5).floor() as i64;
            let raw = format!("konzte-hw|{}|{}|{}|{}", platform(), machine_id(), cpu_model(), gb);
            hex::encode(Sha256::digest(raw.as_bytes()))
        })
        .clone()
}

pub fn os_version() -> String {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use winreg::enums::*;
        if let Ok(k) = winreg::RegKey::predef(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE).open_subkey("SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion") {
            let ma: u32 = k.get_value("CurrentMajorVersionNumber").unwrap_or(10);
            let mi: u32 = k.get_value("CurrentMinorVersionNumber").unwrap_or(0);
            let b: String = k.get_value("CurrentBuildNumber").unwrap_or_default();
            return format!("{ma}.{mi}.{b}");
        }
        return String::new();
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        return run_out("sw_vers", &["-productVersion"]).map(|s| s.trim().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        return std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease").map(|s| s.trim().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
    }
    #[allow(unreachable_code)]
    String::new()
}

pub fn sys_langs() -> Vec<String> {
    let v: Vec<String> = sys_locale::get_locales().map(|l| l.replace('_', "-")).filter(|l| !l.is_empty() && l != "C" && l != "POSIX").collect();
    if v.is_empty() {
        vec!["en-US".into()]
    } else {
        v
    }
}

pub fn home() -> PathBuf {
    dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."))
}

#[cfg_attr(not(target_os = "macos"), allow(dead_code))]
pub fn mac_bottles() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let h = home();
    let mut out = vec![h.join(".wine")];
    for d in [h.join("Library/Application Support/CrossOver/Bottles"), h.join("Library/Containers/com.isaacmarovitz.Whisky/Bottles")] {
        if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(&d) {
            for e in rd.flatten() {
                out.push(e.path());
            }
        }
    }
    out.into_iter().filter(|d| d.join("drive_c").exists()).collect()
}

pub fn steam_roots() -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let h = home();
    let mut out: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use winreg::enums::*;
        if let Ok(k) = winreg::RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER).open_subkey("Software\\Valve\\Steam") {
            if let Ok(p) = k.get_value::<String, _>("SteamPath") {
                out.push(PathBuf::from(p.trim().replace('/', "\\")));
            }
        }
        out.push(PathBuf::from("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam"));
        out.push(PathBuf::from("C:\\Program Files\\Steam"));
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        out.push(h.join("Library/Application Support/Steam"));
        for c in mac_bottles() {
            for pf in ["Program Files (x86)", "Program Files"] {
                out.push(c.join("drive_c").join(pf).join("Steam"));
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        out.push(h.join(".local/share/Steam"));
        out.push(h.join(".steam/steam"));
        out.push(h.join(".var/app/com.valvesoftware.Steam/.local/share/Steam"));
    }
    let _ = &h;
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    out.into_iter().filter(|d| seen.insert(d.clone()) && d.join("userdata").exists()).collect()
}

fn mtime_ms(p: &Path) -> Option<f64> {
    let m = std::fs::metadata(p).ok()?.modified().ok()?;
    Some(m.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok()?.as_secs_f64() * 1000.0)
}

pub fn latest_shot() -> Value {
    let mut best: Option<(PathBuf, f64)> = None;
    for root in steam_roots() {
        let Ok(users) = std::fs::read_dir(root.join("userdata")) else { continue };
        for u in users.flatten() {
            let dir = u.path().join("760").join("remote").join(CM_APPID).join("screenshots");
            let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) else { continue };
            for f in files.flatten() {
                let name = f.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
                if !(name.ends_with(".jpg") || name.ends_with(".jpeg") || name.ends_with(".png")) {
                    continue;
                }
                let p = f.path();
                if let Some(m) = mtime_ms(&p) {
                    if best.as_ref().map(|b| m > b.1).unwrap_or(true) {
                        best = Some((p, m));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let Some((file, mtime)) = best else { return Value::Null };
    let Ok(buf) = std::fs::read(&file) else { return Value::Null };
    let png = file.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase().ends_with("png");
    json!({
        "dataUrl": format!("data:image/{};base64,{}", if png { "png" } else { "jpeg" }, base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(buf)),
        "mtime": mtime,
        "name": file.file_name().map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default(),
    })
}

fn launch_path() -> String {
    std::env::var("APPIMAGE").ok().filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).unwrap_or_else(|| {
        std::env::current_exe().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default()
    })
}

pub fn set_autostart(on: bool, hidden: bool) {
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    {
        let dir = home().join(".config").join("autostart");
        let f = dir.join("konzte.desktop");
        if !on {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&f);
            return;
        }
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
        let _ = std::fs::write(
            &f,
            format!(
                "[Desktop Entry]\nType=Application\nName=Konzte Faceit\nExec=\"{}\"{}\nX-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true\n",
                launch_path(),
                if hidden { " --hidden" } else { "" }
            ),
        );
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use winreg::enums::*;
        if let Ok((k, _)) = winreg::RegKey::predef(HKEY_CURRENT_USER).create_subkey("Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run") {
            if on {
                let _ = k.set_value("Konzte Faceit", &format!("\"{}\"{}", launch_path(), if hidden { " --hidden" } else { "" }));
            } else {
                let _ = k.delete_value("Konzte Faceit");
            }
        }
    }
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        let f = home().join("Library/LaunchAgents/com.konzte.app.plist");
        if !on {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&f);
            return;
        }
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(f.parent().unwrap());
        let args = if hidden { "<string>--hidden</string>" } else { "" };
        let _ = std::fs::write(&f, format!(r#"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0"><dict><key>Label</key><string>com.konzte.app</string>
<key>ProgramArguments</key><array><string>{}</string>{}</array><key>RunAtLoad</key><true/></dict></plist>
"#, launch_path(), args));
    }
    let _ = (on, hidden);
}
```

`app-tauri/src/updater.rs`:

```rs
use crate::assets::{self, UiSource};
use base64::Engine;
use ed25519_dalek::{pkcs8::DecodePublicKey, Signature, Verifier, VerifyingKey};
use serde_json::{json, Map, Value};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub const PUBLIC_KEY: &str = "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
MCowBQYDK2VwAyEA5o2Uvz6O39Y5c+fwKLDlhiWi6Xxgb6to50FL8h7Ozeo=
-----END PUBLIC KEY-----";

pub fn sha256_hex(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    hex::encode(Sha256::digest(b))
}

pub fn verify_sig(raw: &[u8], sig_b64: &str) -> bool {
    let Ok(key) = VerifyingKey::from_public_key_pem(PUBLIC_KEY) else { return false };
    let Ok(sig) = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(sig_b64.trim()) else { return false };
    let Ok(sig) = Signature::from_slice(&sig) else { return false };
    key.verify(raw, &sig).is_ok()
}

pub fn cmp_ver(a: &str, b: &str) -> i64 {
    let p = |s: &str| -> Vec<i64> { s.split('.').map(|x| x.trim().parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(0)).collect() };
    let (x, y) = (p(a), p(b));
    for i in 0..3 {
        let (u, v) = (x.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0), y.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0));
        if u != v {
            return u - v;
        }
    }
    0
}

pub fn client() -> reqwest::Client {
    reqwest::Client::builder()
        .user_agent(concat!("Konzte/", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), " (tauri)"))
        .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
        .build()
        .expect("http client")
}

pub async fn fetch(c: &reqwest::Client, url: &str, ms: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let r = c.get(url).timeout(Duration::from_millis(ms)).send().await.map_err(|e| format!("{url}: {e}"))?;
    if !r.status().is_success() {
        return Err(format!("{url}: HTTP {}", r.status().as_u16()));
    }
    r.bytes().await.map(|b| b.to_vec()).map_err(|e| format!("{url}: {e}"))
}

fn now_ms() -> u128 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_millis()).unwrap_or(0)
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Current {
    pub src: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub ui: f64,
    pub files: Map<String, Value>,
    pub slot: Option<String>,
}

fn ui_num(v: Option<&Value>) -> f64 {
    v.and_then(|x| x.as_f64()).unwrap_or(0.0)
}

pub fn current(ui_root: &Path) -> Current {
    let bundled: Value = assets::bundled_file("build.json")
        .and_then(|b| serde_json::from_slice(b).ok())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| json!({ "ui": 0, "files": {} }));
    let b_ui = ui_num(bundled.get("ui"));
    let st: Option<Value> = std::fs::read(ui_root.join("state.json")).ok().and_then(|b| serde_json::from_slice(&b).ok());
    if let Some(st) = st {
        let active = st.get("active").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        let s_ui = ui_num(st.get("ui"));
        if (active == "a" || active == "b") && s_ui > b_ui && ui_root.join(active).join("index.html").exists() {
            return Current {
                src: Some(ui_root.join(active)),
                ui: s_ui,
                files: st.get("files").and_then(|v| v.as_object()).cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
                slot: Some(active.to_string()),
            };
        }
    }
    Current { src: None, ui: b_ui, files: bundled.get("files").and_then(|v| v.as_object()).cloned().unwrap_or_default(), slot: None }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Prepared {
    pub source: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub ui: f64,
    pub updated: bool,
    pub need_shell: Option<String>,
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

impl Prepared {
    pub fn ui_source(&self) -> UiSource {
        match &self.source {
            Some(p) => UiSource::Disk(p.clone()),
            None => UiSource::Bundled,
        }
    }
}

fn safe_path(p: &str) -> bool {
    !p.contains("..") && !p.is_empty() && p.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "_-. /".contains(c))
}
fn is_sha(h: &str) -> bool {
    h.len() == 64 && h.chars().all(|c| matches!(c, '0'..='9' | 'a'..='f'))
}

fn read_have(cur: &Current, rel: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    match &cur.src {
        None => assets::bundled_file(rel).map(|b| b.to_vec()),
        Some(dir) => std::fs::read(dir.join(rel)).ok(),
    }
}

pub async fn prepare(
    server: &str,
    user_data: &Path,
    shell_version: &str,
    on_start: impl Fn(usize) + Send + Sync,
    on_progress: Arc<dyn Fn(usize, usize) + Send + Sync>,
) -> Prepared {
    let ui_root = user_data.join("ui");
    let cur = current(&ui_root);
    let mut res = Prepared { source: cur.src.clone(), ui: cur.ui, ..Default::default() };
    match run(server, &ui_root, shell_version, &cur, on_start, on_progress).await {
        Ok(Some(p)) => p,
        Ok(None) => res,
        Err(Need(v)) if v.starts_with("shell:") => {
            res.need_shell = Some(v[6..].to_string());
            res
        }
        Err(Need(e)) => {
            res.error = Some(e);
            res
        }
    }
}

struct Need(String);
impl From<String> for Need {
    fn from(s: String) -> Self {
        Need(s)
    }
}

async fn run(
    server: &str,
    ui_root: &Path,
    shell_version: &str,
    cur: &Current,
    on_start: impl Fn(usize),
    on_progress: Arc<dyn Fn(usize, usize) + Send + Sync>,
) -> Result<Option<Prepared>, Need> {
    let c = client();
    let base = format!("{}/update", server.trim_end_matches('/'));
    let t = now_ms();
    let (u1, u2) = (format!("{base}/manifest.json?t={t}"), format!("{base}/manifest.sig?t={t}"));
    let (raw, sig) = tokio::join!(fetch(&c, &u1, 5000), fetch(&c, &u2, 5000));
    let (raw, sig) = (raw?, sig?);
    if !verify_sig(&raw, &String::from_utf8_lossy(&sig)) {
        return Err(Need("bad manifest signature".into()));
    }
    let man: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&raw).map_err(|e| Need(format!("bad manifest: {e}")))?;
    let m_ui = ui_num(man.get("ui"));
    if !(m_ui > cur.ui) {
        return Ok(None);
    }
    if let Some(ms) = man.get("minShell").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
        if cmp_ver(shell_version, ms) < 0 {
            return Err(Need(format!("shell:{ms}")));
        }
    }
    let files = man.get("files").and_then(|v| v.as_object()).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    let entries: Vec<(String, String)> =
        files.iter().map(|(p, h)| (p.clone(), h.as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string())).collect();
    if entries.is_empty() || !entries.iter().all(|(p, h)| safe_path(p) && is_sha(h)) {
        return Err(Need("bad manifest".into()));
    }

    let mut have: HashMap<String, String> = HashMap::new();
    for (p, h) in &cur.files {
        if let Some(h) = h.as_str() {
            have.insert(h.to_string(), p.clone());
        }
    }
    let local_ok = |h: &String| have.get(h).and_then(|src| read_have(cur, src)).is_some_and(|b| sha256_hex(&b) == *h);
    let todo: Vec<(String, String)> = entries.iter().filter(|(_, h)| !local_ok(h)).cloned().collect();
    on_start(todo.len());
    let slot = if cur.slot.as_deref() == Some("a") { "b" } else { "a" };
    let dir = ui_root.join(slot);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| Need(e.to_string()))?;
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(90);
    let total = todo.len();
    let done = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let queue = Arc::new(Mutex::new(todo.into_iter().collect::<std::collections::VecDeque<_>>()));

    let mut workers = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..6 {
        let (q, c, base, dir, done, prog) = (queue.clone(), c.clone(), base.clone(), dir.clone(), done.clone(), on_progress.clone());
        workers.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
            loop {
                let Some((p, h)) = q.lock().unwrap().pop_front() else { return Ok::<(), String>(()) };
                if Instant::now() > deadline {
                    return Err("update timeout".into());
                }
                let buf = fetch(&c, &format!("{base}/f/{h}"), 30_000).await?;
                if sha256_hex(&buf) != h {
                    return Err(format!("hash mismatch: {p}"));
                }
                let out = dir.join(&p);
                if let Some(par) = out.parent() {
                    std::fs::create_dir_all(par).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                }
                std::fs::write(&out, &buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                let n = done.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) + 1;
                prog(n, total);
            }
        }));
    }
    for w in workers {
        match w.await {
            Ok(Ok(())) => {}
            Ok(Err(e)) => return Err(Need(e)),
            Err(e) => return Err(Need(e.to_string())),
        }
    }
    for (p, h) in &entries {
        let out = dir.join(p);
        if out.exists() {
            continue;
        }
        let src = have.get(h).ok_or_else(|| Need(format!("missing {p}")))?;
        let buf = read_have(cur, src).filter(|b| sha256_hex(b) == *h).ok_or_else(|| Need(format!("missing {src}")))?;
        if let Some(par) = out.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(par).map_err(|e| Need(e.to_string()))?;
        }
        std::fs::write(&out, buf).map_err(|e| Need(e.to_string()))?;
    }
    let ui_val = man.get("ui").cloned().unwrap_or(json!(0));
    std::fs::write(dir.join("build.json"), serde_json::to_vec(&json!({ "ui": ui_val, "files": files })).unwrap())
        .map_err(|e| Need(e.to_string()))?;
    let tmp = ui_root.join("state.json.tmp");
    std::fs::write(&tmp, serde_json::to_vec(&json!({ "active": slot, "ui": ui_val, "files": files, "at": now_ms() as u64 })).unwrap())
        .map_err(|e| Need(e.to_string()))?;
    std::fs::rename(&tmp, ui_root.join("state.json")).map_err(|e| Need(e.to_string()))?;
    Ok(Some(Prepared { source: Some(dir), ui: m_ui, updated: true, need_shell: None, error: None }))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn versions() {
        assert!(cmp_ver("1.1.0", "1.0.13") > 0);
        assert!(cmp_ver("1.0.9", "1.0.13") < 0);

    }
```

```sh
#!/bin/sh
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/kz-xwin/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
VER=$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml | head -1)
OUT="$HOME/Downloads/Konzte_build/tauri-$VER"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
./prepare.sh
what=${1:-all}
if [ "$what" = all ] || [ "$what" = linux ]; then
  APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 cargo tauri build --bundles appimage
  cp "target/release/bundle/appimage/Konzte Faceit_${VER}_amd64.AppImage" "$OUT/Konzte-Tauri.AppImage"
  cp target/release/konzte "$OUT/konzte-linux-x64"
fi
if [ "$what" = all ] || [ "$what" = win ]; then
  (cd ../app/native/kzguard-svc && cargo xwin build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)
  cp ../app/native/kzguard-svc/target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/KonzteGuard.exe guard/KonzteGuard.exe
  WAYLAND_DISPLAY= DISPLAY= cargo tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
  cp "target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/bundle/nsis/Konzte Faceit_${VER}_x64-setup.exe" "$OUT/Konzte-Tauri-Setup.exe"
fi
node ../app/tools/guard-ref.js tauri
cd "$OUT" && sha256sum Konzte-Tauri* konzte-linux-x64 2>/dev/null > SHA256SUMS.txt; ls -la "$OUT"
```

`app-tauri/tools/parity-files.js`:

```js
const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), crypto = require('crypto');
const FULL_HASH_RE = /^CombatMaster_Data\/StreamingAssets\/Bundles\/(src\/weapons\/|src\/first_person$|ui\/)/i;
const SKIP_FILE_RE = /(\.log|\.tmp|\.dmp|\.bak|desktop\.ini|thumbs\.db)$/i;
const fileHash = f => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(f)).digest('hex');
function quickHash(f, st) {
  const h = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(st.size)); const fd = fs.openSync(f, 'r');
  try { const n = Math.min(st.size, 1 << 20), b = Buffer.alloc(n); fs.readSync(fd, b, 0, n, 0); h.update(b);
    if (st.size > n) { const m = Math.min(st.size - n, 1 << 20), e = Buffer.alloc(m); fs.readSync(fd, e, 0, m, st.size - m); h.update(e); } } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
  return h.digest('hex');
}
const root = process.argv[2], out = [];
const walk = (d, rel) => { let es = []; try { es = fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
  for (const e of es) { if (out.length >= 3000) return; const r = rel ? rel + '/' + e.name : e.name, f = path.join(d, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) { if (!rel && e.name !== 'CombatMaster_Data') continue; walk(f, r); }
    else if (e.isFile() && !SKIP_FILE_RE.test(e.name) && (rel || /^(GameAssembly\.(dll|so)|CombatMaster(\.exe|\.x86_64)?|UnityPlayer\.(dll|so))$/i.test(e.name))) out.push([r, f]); } };
walk(root, '');
const list = [];
for (const [r, f] of out) { const st = fs.statSync(f); const h = FULL_HASH_RE.test(r) ? fileHash(f) : quickHash(f, st); list.push([r, st.size, (FULL_HASH_RE.test(r) ? 'f:' : 'q:') + h.slice(0, 32)]); }
list.sort((a, b) => a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : 1);
console.log(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(list.map(x => x.join('|')).join('\n')).digest('hex'), list.length);
```

`app/native/kzguard-svc/build.rs`:

```rs
fn main() {
    if std::env::var("CARGO_CFG_TARGET_OS").as_deref() != Ok("windows") { return; }
    let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR").unwrap()).join("res");
    let out_dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("OUT_DIR").unwrap());
    let v = std::env::var("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").unwrap();
    let n: Vec<&str> = v.split('.').collect();
    let comma = format!("{},{},{},0", n[0], n.get(1).unwrap_or(&"0"), n.get(2).unwrap_or(&"0"));
    let rc = format!(r#"1 ICON "{ico}"
1 VERSIONINFO
FILEVERSION {comma}
PRODUCTVERSION {comma}
FILEOS 0x40004
FILETYPE 0x1
BEGIN
  BLOCK "StringFileInfo"
  BEGIN
    BLOCK "040904b0"
    BEGIN
      VALUE "CompanyName", "Konzte"
      VALUE "FileDescription", "KONZTE GUARD"
      VALUE "ProductName", "KONZTE GUARD"
      VALUE "FileVersion", "{v}"
      VALUE "ProductVersion", "{v}"
      VALUE "OriginalFilename", "KonzteGuard.exe"
    END
  END
  BLOCK "VarFileInfo"
  BEGIN
    VALUE "Translation", 0x409, 1200
  END
END
"#, ico = dir.join("guard.ico").display().to_string().replace('\\', "/"));
    let rc_path = out_dir.join("guard.rc");
    std::fs::write(&rc_path, rc).unwrap();
    let out = out_dir.join("guard.res");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=res/guard.ico");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=Cargo.toml");
    let ok = std::process::Command::new("llvm-rc").args(["/nologo", "/fo"]).arg(&out).arg(&rc_path)
        .status().map(|s| s.success()).unwrap_or(false);
    if ok { println!("cargo:rustc-link-arg-bins={}", out.display()); } else { println!("cargo:warning=llvm-rc не спрацював — exe без значка"); }
}

```
