`app/native/kzguard-svc/src/main.rs`:

```rs

#![cfg_attr(windows, windows_subsystem = "windows")]

#[cfg(windows)]
mod tray;
#[cfg(windows)]
mod ui;
#[cfg(windows)]
mod update;

#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn main() {
    eprintln!("kzguard-svc: лише для Windows");
    std::process::exit(1);
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn main() { win::main() }

#[cfg(windows)]
mod win {
    use serde_json::{json, Value};
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    use std::ffi::OsString;
    use std::io::{Read, Write};
    use std::os::windows::io::FromRawHandle;
    use std::path::PathBuf;
    use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
    use std::sync::{mpsc, Mutex};
    use std::time::{Duration, Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
    use windows_service::service::*;
    use windows_service::service_control_handler::{self, ServiceControlHandlerResult};
    use windows_service::service_manager::{ServiceManager, ServiceManagerAccess};
    use windows_service::{define_windows_service, service_dispatcher};
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::*;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::Authorization::*;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Security::SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Storage::FileSystem::*;
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::Pipes::*;

    pub const NAME: &str = "KonzteGuard";
    const DISPLAY: &str = "KONZTE GUARD";
    const DESC: &str = "Konzte Faceit anti-cheat: watches who accesses Combat Master memory while the game is running. Reads system tables only, changes nothing.";
    pub const PIPE: &str = r"\\.\pipe\konzte-guard";
    pub const VERSION: &str = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION");
    const POLL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
    const HANDLES_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
    const INJECT_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);
    const SYS_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
    const PROCS_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
    const DRV_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
    const OVL_STALE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(25);
    const GAP: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);

    fn now_ms() -> u64 { SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64).unwrap_or(0) }
    fn wz(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> { s.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect() }

    struct Sess { pid: u32, seen: u64, pre: bool, polls: u64, gaps: u32, max_gap: u64, last_poll: Instant, hchecks: u32, herr: u32, last_h: Option<Instant>, handles: BTreeMap<String, Value>,
                 ichecks: u32, ierr: u32, last_i: Option<Instant>, mz: u64, foreign: u64, rx_kb: u64, mods: BTreeMap<String, Value>, sig: std::collections::BTreeSet<String>,
                 pchecks: u32, procs: BTreeMap<String, u64>, ovl_n: u32, last_ovl: Option<Instant>, ovl: BTreeMap<String, Value>, started_at: Instant,
                 drv_base: Option<std::collections::BTreeSet<String>>, drv_new: BTreeMap<String, u64>, last_d: Option<Instant>, dbg: u32, dchecks: u32 }
    struct Watch { since: u64, started: Instant, saw_no_game: bool, cur: Option<Sess>, prev: Option<Value>, sys: Value, sys_at: Option<Instant>,
                   names: Vec<String>, hashes: Vec<String>, procs_at: Option<Instant>, pre_hits: BTreeMap<String, u64> }
    static W: Mutex<Option<Watch>> = Mutex::new(None);
    static STOP: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
    static EXIT_TX: Mutex<Option<mpsc::Sender<()>>> = Mutex::new(None);

    fn summary(s: &Sess, ended: Option<u64>) -> Value {
        json!({ "pid": s.pid, "seen": s.seen, "pre": s.pre, "polls": s.polls, "gaps": s.gaps, "maxGap": s.max_gap,
                "hchecks": s.hchecks, "herr": s.herr, "handles": s.handles.values().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                "ichecks": s.ichecks, "ierr": s.ierr,
                "pchecks": s.pchecks, "procs": s.procs.iter().map(|(k, t)| json!({ "h": k, "at": t })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                "ovlN": s.ovl_n, "ovlAge": s.last_ovl.map(|t| t.elapsed().as_secs()), "ovl": s.ovl.values().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                "age": s.started_at.elapsed().as_secs(),
                "drvNew": s.drv_new.iter().map(|(k, t)| json!({ "name": k, "at": t })).collect::<Vec<_>>(), "dbg": s.dbg, "dchecks": s.dchecks, "inject": { "mz": s.mz, "foreign": s.foreign, "rxKb": s.rx_kb, "mods": s.mods.values().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(), "sig": s.sig.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>() },
                "ended": ended })
    }

    pub fn state() -> Value {
        let g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        let Some(w) = g.as_ref() else { return json!({ "v": 1, "sv": VERSION, "err": "init" }) };
        json!({ "v": 1, "sv": VERSION, "since": w.since, "up": w.started.elapsed().as_secs(),
                "game": w.cur.as_ref().map(|s| summary(s, None)), "prev": w.prev, "sys": w.sys, "list": w.names.len() + w.hashes.len(),
                "preHits": w.pre_hits.iter().map(|(k, t)| json!({ "h": k, "at": t })).collect::<Vec<_>>() })
    }

    fn tick() {
        let pid = kzguard::find_game();
        let (mut need_h, mut need_i, mut need_sys): (Option<u32>, Option<u32>, bool) = (None, None, false);
        let mut need_p: Option<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>)> = None;
        let mut need_d: Option<u32> = None;
        {
            let mut g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            let Some(w) = g.as_mut() else { return };
            if w.sys_at.map(|t| t.elapsed() >= SYS_EVERY).unwrap_or(true) { w.sys_at = Some(Instant::now()); need_sys = true; }
            if (!w.names.is_empty() || !w.hashes.is_empty()) && w.procs_at.map(|t| t.elapsed() >= PROCS_EVERY).unwrap_or(true) {
                w.procs_at = Some(Instant::now()); need_p = Some((w.names.clone(), w.hashes.clone()));
            }
            match pid {
                None => {
                    if let Some(s) = w.cur.take() { w.prev = Some(summary(&s, Some(now_ms()))); }
                    w.saw_no_game = true;
                }
                Some(p) => {
                    if w.cur.as_ref().map(|s| s.pid) != Some(p) {
                        if let Some(s) = w.cur.take() { w.prev = Some(summary(&s, Some(now_ms()))); }
                        w.cur = Some(Sess { pid: p, seen: now_ms(), pre: w.saw_no_game, polls: 0, gaps: 0, max_gap: 0, last_poll: Instant::now(), hchecks: 0, herr: 0, last_h: None, handles: BTreeMap::new(),
                                           ichecks: 0, ierr: 0, last_i: None, mz: 0, foreign: 0, rx_kb: 0, mods: BTreeMap::new(), sig: Default::default(),
                                           pchecks: 0, procs: BTreeMap::new(), ovl_n: 0, last_ovl: None, ovl: BTreeMap::new(), started_at: Instant::now(),
                                           drv_base: None, drv_new: BTreeMap::new(), last_d: None, dbg: 0, dchecks: 0 });
                    }
                    let s = w.cur.as_mut().unwrap();
                    let gap = s.last_poll.elapsed();
                    if s.polls > 0 { if gap > GAP { s.gaps += 1; } s.max_gap = s.max_gap.max(gap.as_millis() as u64); }
                    s.polls += 1; s.last_poll = Instant::now();
                    if s.last_h.map(|t| t.elapsed() >= HANDLES_EVERY).unwrap_or(true) { s.last_h = Some(Instant::now()); need_h = Some(p); }
                    if s.last_i.map(|t| t.elapsed() >= INJECT_EVERY).unwrap_or(true) { s.last_i = Some(Instant::now()); need_i = Some(p); }
                    if s.last_d.map(|t| t.elapsed() >= DRV_EVERY).unwrap_or(true) { s.last_d = Some(Instant::now()); need_d = Some(p); }
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some((n, h)) = need_p {
            let hits = kzguard::proc_hits(&n, &h);
            let t = now_ms();
            let mut g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            if let Some(w) = g.as_mut() {
                w.pre_hits.retain(|_, at| t.saturating_sub(*at) < 600_000);
                match w.cur.as_mut() {
                    Some(s) => { s.pchecks += 1; for x in hits { if s.procs.len() < 40 { s.procs.entry(x).or_insert(t); } } }
                    None => for x in hits { w.pre_hits.insert(x, t); },
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(p) = need_d {
            let dbg = kzguard::game_debugged(p);
            let drv = kzguard::driver_names();
            let t = now_ms();
            let mut g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            if let Some(s) = g.as_mut().and_then(|w| w.cur.as_mut()).filter(|s| s.pid == p) {
                s.dchecks += 1;
                if dbg == Some(true) { s.dbg += 1; }
                if !drv.is_empty() {
                    match &s.drv_base {
                        None => s.drv_base = Some(drv.into_iter().collect()),
                        Some(base) => {
                            let fresh: Vec<String> = drv.into_iter().filter(|d| !base.contains(d)).collect();
                            for d in fresh { if s.drv_new.len() < 30 { s.drv_new.entry(d).or_insert(t); } }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if need_sys {
            let v = kzguard::sys_state();
            if let Some(w) = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).as_mut() { w.sys = v; }
        }
        if let Some(p) = need_i {
            let x = kzguard::game_inject(p);
            let mut g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            if let Some(s) = g.as_mut().and_then(|w| w.cur.as_mut()).filter(|s| s.pid == p) {
                s.ichecks += 1;
                if x.get("err").is_some() { s.ierr += 1; } else {
                    s.mz = s.mz.max(x["mem"]["mz"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0));
                    s.rx_kb = s.rx_kb.max(x["mem"]["rxKb"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0));
                    s.foreign = s.foreign.max(x["threads"]["foreign"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0));
                    for id in x["sig"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().filter_map(|v| v.as_str()) { if s.sig.len() < 16 { s.sig.insert(id.to_string()); } }
                    for m in x["mods"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
                        let k = m["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase();
                        if !k.is_empty() && s.mods.len() < 30 { s.mods.entry(k).or_insert_with(|| m.clone()); }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(p) = need_h {
            let h = kzguard::game_handles(p);
            let mut g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            let Some(s) = g.as_mut().and_then(|w| w.cur.as_mut()).filter(|s| s.pid == p) else { return };
            s.hchecks += 1;
            let Some(arr) = h.as_array() else { s.herr += 1; return };
            let t = now_ms();
            for v in arr {
                let name = v["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase();
                let key = if name.is_empty() { format!("?{}", v["path"].as_str().unwrap_or("")) } else { name };
                if let Some(e) = s.handles.get_mut(&key) {
                    e["n"] = json!(e["n"].as_u64().unwrap_or(1) + 1);
                    e["last"] = json!(t);
                    if v["write"].as_bool() == Some(true) { e["write"] = json!(true); }
                    if v["read"].as_bool() == Some(true) { e["read"] = json!(true); }
                } else if s.handles.len() < 40 {
                    let mut e = v.clone();
                    e["first"] = json!(t); e["last"] = json!(t); e["n"] = json!(1);
                    s.handles.insert(key, e);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn watch_loop() {
        while !STOP.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
            let _ = std::panic::catch_unwind(tick);
            std::thread::sleep(POLL);
        }
    }

    pub fn issues(st: &Value) -> Vec<&'static str> {
        let (mut v, sys, g) = (Vec::new(), &st["sys"], &st["game"]);
        if sys["testsign"].as_bool() == Some(true) { v.push("testsign"); }
        if sys["dse"].as_bool() == Some(false) { v.push("dse"); }
        if sys["kdbg"].as_bool() == Some(true) || sys["debugmode"].as_bool() == Some(true) { v.push("kdbg"); }
        if g.is_object() {
            if g["pre"].as_bool() != Some(true) { v.push("late"); }
            if g["gaps"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) > 0 { v.push("gaps"); }
            let inj = &g["inject"];
            let sig_hard = inj["sig"].as_array().map(|a| a.iter().any(|x| x.as_str().map(|s| s != "imgui").unwrap_or(false))).unwrap_or(false);
            if inj["mz"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) > 0 || inj["foreign"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) > 0 || sig_hard { v.push("inject"); }
            if g["procs"].as_array().map(|a| !a.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false) { v.push("procs"); }
            if g["dbg"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) > 0 { v.push("debugger"); }
            if g["age"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) > OVL_STALE.as_secs() && g["ovlAge"].as_u64().map(|a| a > OVL_STALE.as_secs()).unwrap_or(true) { v.push("notray"); }
        }
        v
    }

    static SCAN: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());

    fn list_file() -> PathBuf {
        PathBuf::from(std::env::var("ProgramData").unwrap_or_else(|_| r"C:\ProgramData".into())).join("Konzte Guard").join("list.json")
    }
    fn set_list(o: &Value) {
        let pick = |k: &str| o[k].as_array().map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|x| x.as_str().map(String::from)).take(2000).collect::<Vec<_>>()).unwrap_or_default();
        let (n, h) = (pick("names"), pick("hashes"));
        if n.is_empty() && h.is_empty() { return; }
        if let Some(w) = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).as_mut() { w.names = n; w.hashes = h; }
    }

    fn client_is_guard(pid: u32) -> bool {
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::*;
        unsafe {
            let h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, 0, pid);
            if h.is_null() { return false; }
            let mut buf = vec![0u16; 1024];
            let mut n = buf.len() as u32;
            let ok = QueryFullProcessImageNameW(h, 0, buf.as_mut_ptr(), &mut n) != 0;
            CloseHandle(h);
            ok && String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n as usize]).to_lowercase() == install_dir().join("KonzteGuard.exe").to_string_lossy().to_lowercase()
        }
    }

    fn handle(req: &Value, client: u32) -> Value {
        match req["op"].as_str().unwrap_or("") {
            "uninstall" => {
                std::thread::spawn(|| {
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1500));
                    let _ = uninstall(false);
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500));
                    std::process::exit(0);
                });
                json!({ "ok": true })
            }
            "stop" => {
                if !client_is_guard(client) { return json!({ "ok": false, "error": "caller" }); }
                if state()["game"].is_object() { return json!({ "ok": false, "error": "ingame" }); }
                std::thread::spawn(|| {
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(800));
                    if let Some(tx) = EXIT_TX.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).as_ref() { let _ = tx.send(()); }
                });
                json!({ "ok": true })
            }
            "overlay" => {
                if !client_is_guard(client) { return json!({ "ok": false, "error": "caller" }); }
                let pid = req["pid"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                let mut g = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
                let Some(s) = g.as_mut().and_then(|w| w.cur.as_mut()).filter(|s| s.pid == pid) else { return json!({ "ok": false, "error": "nogame" }) };
                s.ovl_n += 1; s.last_ovl = Some(Instant::now());
                let t = now_ms();
                for o in req["list"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().take(40) {
                    let k = o["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase();
                    if k.is_empty() { continue; }
                    if let Some(e) = s.ovl.get_mut(&k) { e["n"] = json!(e["n"].as_u64().unwrap_or(1) + 1); e["last"] = json!(t); if o["hidden"].as_bool() == Some(true) { e["hidden"] = json!(true); } }
                    else if s.ovl.len() < 40 { let mut e = o.clone(); e["first"] = json!(t); e["last"] = json!(t); e["n"] = json!(1); s.ovl.insert(k, e); }
                }
                json!({ "ok": true })
            }
            "info" => {
                let st = state();
                json!({ "ok": true, "sv": VERSION, "guard": serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&kzguard::info_json()).unwrap_or(Value::Null),
                        "since": st["since"], "game": st["game"].is_object(), "pre": st["game"]["pre"], "pid": st["game"]["pid"],
                        "sys": st["sys"], "issues": issues(&st), "upd": UPD.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone() })
            }
            "scan" => {
                let _one = SCAN.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
                let mut opts = req["opts"].clone();
                if !opts.is_object() { opts = json!({}); }
                set_list(&opts);
                if opts["names"].as_array().map(|a| !a.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false) || opts["hashes"].as_array().map(|a| !a.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false) {
                    let f = list_file();
                    if let Some(d) = f.parent() { let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(d); }
                    let _ = std::fs::write(&f, json!({ "names": opts["names"], "hashes": opts["hashes"] }).to_string());
                }
                opts["ver"] = json!(format!("svc-{VERSION}"));
                let att: Value = serde_json::from_str(&kzguard::scan_svc(&opts.to_string(), state())).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
                json!({ "ok": att.is_object(), "att": att })
            }
            _ => json!({ "ok": false, "error": "op" }),
        }
    }

    fn serve(h: HANDLE) {
        let mut client = 0u32;
        unsafe { GetNamedPipeClientProcessId(h, &mut client); }
        let mut f = unsafe { std::fs::File::from_raw_handle(h as _) };
        let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        let mut chunk = [0u8; 65536];
        loop {
            match f.read(&mut chunk) {
                Ok(0) => break,
                Ok(n) => { buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..n]); if buf.contains(&b'\n') || buf.len() > (1 << 20) { break; } }
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }
        let line = buf.split(|b| *b == b'\n').next().unwrap_or(&[]);
        let out = match serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(line) {
            Ok(req) => std::panic::catch_unwind(|| handle(&req, client)).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "ok": false, "error": "panic" })),
            Err(_) => json!({ "ok": false, "error": "json" }),
        };
        let mut s = out.to_string(); s.push('\n');
        let _ = f.write_all(s.as_bytes());
        unsafe { FlushFileBuffers(h); }
        let t = Instant::now();
        while t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10) { match f.read(&mut chunk) { Ok(0) | Err(_) => break, Ok(_) => {} } }
        unsafe { DisconnectNamedPipe(h); }
        drop(f);
    }

    fn pipe_loop() {
        let sddl = wz("D:P(A;;GA;;;SY)(A;;GA;;;BA)(A;;GRGW;;;AU)");
        let mut psd: *mut core::ffi::c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();
        unsafe { ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW(sddl.as_ptr(), SDDL_REVISION_1, &mut psd as *mut _ as _, std::ptr::null_mut()); }
        let sa = SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES { nLength: std::mem::size_of::<SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES>() as u32, lpSecurityDescriptor: psd, bInheritHandle: 0 };
        let name = wz(PIPE);
        let mut first = true;
        while !STOP.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
            let flags = PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX | if first { FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE } else { 0 };
            let h = unsafe {
                CreateNamedPipeW(name.as_ptr(), flags, PIPE_TYPE_BYTE | PIPE_READMODE_BYTE | PIPE_WAIT | PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS,
                    PIPE_UNLIMITED_INSTANCES, 1 << 16, 1 << 16, 0, &sa)
            };
            if h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5));
                continue;
            }
            first = false;
            let ok = unsafe { ConnectNamedPipe(h, std::ptr::null_mut()) } != 0 || unsafe { GetLastError() } == ERROR_PIPE_CONNECTED;
            if !ok { unsafe { CloseHandle(h); } continue; }
            let hv = h as usize;
            std::thread::spawn(move || serve(hv as HANDLE));
        }
    }

    fn start_workers() {
        *W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(Watch { since: now_ms(), started: Instant::now(), saw_no_game: false, cur: None, prev: None, sys: Value::Null, sys_at: None,
                                                                    names: Vec::new(), hashes: Vec::new(), procs_at: None, pre_hits: BTreeMap::new() });
        if let Ok(v) = std::fs::read_to_string(list_file()).map(|s| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&s).unwrap_or(Value::Null)) { set_list(&v); }
        std::thread::spawn(watch_loop);
        std::thread::spawn(pipe_loop);
    }

    static UPD: Mutex<String> = Mutex::new(String::new());

    fn update_loop() {
        if let Ok(me) = std::env::current_exe() { if let Some(d) = me.parent() { let _ = std::fs::remove_file(d.join("KonzteGuard.old")); } }
        let set = |v: &str| *UPD.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = v.to_string();
        set("wait");
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(120));
        loop {
            let in_game = W.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).as_ref().map(|w| w.cur.is_some()).unwrap_or(false);
            if in_game { set("game"); std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(300)); continue; }
            set("check");
            let r = std::env::current_exe().map_err(|e| e.to_string()).and_then(|me| crate::update::check_and_apply(&me));
            *UPD.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = match &r { Ok(Some(v)) => format!("updated {v}"), Ok(None) => "ok".into(), Err(e) => e.clone() };
            if let Ok(Some(_)) = r {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(6 * 3600));
        }
    }

    pub fn pipe_call(req: &Value, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Value, String> {
        let line = format!("{req}\n");
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let r = (|| -> Result<Value, String> {
                let t = Instant::now();
                let mut f = loop {
                    match std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).write(true).open(PIPE) {
                        Ok(f) => break f,
                        Err(e) if e.raw_os_error() == Some(231) && t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(3) => std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)),
                        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Err("nopipe".into()),
                        Err(e) => return Err(format!("pipe: {e}")),
                    }
                };
                f.write_all(line.as_bytes()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                let (mut s, mut b) = (Vec::new(), [0u8; 65536]);
                loop { let n = f.read(&mut b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?; if n == 0 { break; } s.extend_from_slice(&b[..n]); if s.contains(&b'\n') { break; } }
                serde_json::from_slice(s.split(|c| *c == b'\n').next().unwrap_or(&[])).map_err(|e| format!("json: {e}"))
            })();
            let _ = tx.send(r);
        });
        rx.recv_timeout(timeout).unwrap_or_else(|_| Err("timeout".into()))
    }

    define_windows_service!(ffi_service_main, service_main);

    fn service_main(_args: Vec<OsString>) { let _ = run_service(); }

    fn run_service() -> windows_service::Result<()> {
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
        *EXIT_TX.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = Some(tx.clone());
        let h = service_control_handler::register(NAME, move |c| match c {
            ServiceControl::Stop | ServiceControl::Shutdown => { let _ = tx.send(()); ServiceControlHandlerResult::NoError }
            ServiceControl::Interrogate => ServiceControlHandlerResult::NoError,
            _ => ServiceControlHandlerResult::NotImplemented,
        })?;
        let status = |state, accept| ServiceStatus {
            service_type: ServiceType::OWN_PROCESS, current_state: state, controls_accepted: accept,
            exit_code: ServiceExitCode::Win32(0), checkpoint: 0, wait_hint: Duration::from_secs(5), process_id: None,
        };
        start_workers();
        std::thread::spawn(update_loop);
        h.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Running, ServiceControlAccept::STOP | ServiceControlAccept::SHUTDOWN))?;
        let _ = rx.recv();
        STOP.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        h.set_service_status(status(ServiceState::Stopped, ServiceControlAccept::empty()))?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn install_dir() -> PathBuf {
        PathBuf::from(std::env::var("ProgramFiles").unwrap_or_else(|_| r"C:\Program Files".into())).join("Konzte Guard")
    }

    fn kill_trays() {
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::Diagnostics::ToolHelp::*;
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::{OpenProcess, TerminateProcess, WaitForSingleObject, PROCESS_TERMINATE, PROCESS_SYNCHRONIZE};
        let me = std::process::id();
        unsafe {
            let snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS, 0);
            if snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE { return; }
            let mut e: PROCESSENTRY32W = std::mem::zeroed();
            e.dwSize = std::mem::size_of::<PROCESSENTRY32W>() as u32;
            let mut ok = Process32FirstW(snap, &mut e) != 0;
            while ok {
                let n = e.szExeFile.iter().position(|c| *c == 0).unwrap_or(e.szExeFile.len());
                let name = String::from_utf16_lossy(&e.szExeFile[..n]).to_lowercase();
                if e.th32ProcessID != me && (name == "konzteguard.exe" || name == "konzteguard.old") {
                    let h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE | PROCESS_SYNCHRONIZE, 0, e.th32ProcessID);
                    if !h.is_null() { TerminateProcess(h, 0); WaitForSingleObject(h, 3000); CloseHandle(h); }
                }
                ok = Process32NextW(snap, &mut e) != 0;
            }
            CloseHandle(snap);
        }
    }

    fn wait_state(svc: &windows_service::service::Service, want: ServiceState, secs: u64) -> bool {
        let t = Instant::now();
        while t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(secs) {
            if svc.query_status().map(|s| s.current_state == want).unwrap_or(false) { return true; }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250));
        }
        false
    }

    fn install() -> Result<Value, String> {
        let m = ServiceManager::local_computer(None::<&str>, ServiceManagerAccess::CONNECT | ServiceManagerAccess::CREATE_SERVICE).map_err(|e| format!("scm: {e} (потрібні права адміністратора)"))?;
        let access = ServiceAccess::QUERY_STATUS | ServiceAccess::START | ServiceAccess::STOP | ServiceAccess::CHANGE_CONFIG | ServiceAccess::DELETE;
        let existing = m.open_service(NAME, access).ok();
        if let Some(s) = &existing {
            if s.query_status().map(|x| x.current_state != ServiceState::Stopped).unwrap_or(false) { let _ = s.stop(); wait_state(s, ServiceState::Stopped, 15); }
        }
        let dir = install_dir();
        if std::env::current_exe().map(|p| p != dir.join("KonzteGuard.exe")).unwrap_or(true) { kill_trays(); }
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| format!("mkdir: {e}"))?;
        let dest = dir.join("KonzteGuard.exe");
        let me = std::env::current_exe().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let installed = if dest.exists() && me != dest {
            std::process::Command::new(&dest).arg("version").output().ok().map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim().to_string()).unwrap_or_default()
        } else { String::new() };
        if me != dest && !crate::update::newer(&installed, VERSION) {
            let mut ok = false;
            for i in 0..20 {
                if std::fs::copy(&me, &dest).is_ok() { ok = true; break; }
                if i == 3 { let old = dir.join("KonzteGuard.old"); let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&old); let _ = std::fs::rename(&dest, &old); }
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500));
            }
            if !ok { return Err("copy: file busy".into()); }
        }
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(dir.join("kzguard-svc.exe"));
        let info = ServiceInfo {
            name: NAME.into(), display_name: DISPLAY.into(), service_type: ServiceType::OWN_PROCESS,
            start_type: ServiceStartType::AutoStart, error_control: ServiceErrorControl::Normal,
            executable_path: dest.clone(), launch_arguments: vec!["service".into()], dependencies: vec![],
            account_name: None, account_password: None,
        };
        let svc = match existing { Some(s) => { s.change_config(&info).map_err(|e| format!("config: {e}"))?; s }, None => m.create_service(&info, access).map_err(|e| format!("create: {e}"))? };
        let _ = svc.set_description(DESC);
        let _ = svc.update_failure_actions(ServiceFailureActions {
            reset_period: ServiceFailureResetPeriod::After(Duration::from_secs(86400)), reboot_msg: None, command: None,
            actions: Some(vec![ServiceAction { action_type: ServiceActionType::Restart, delay: Duration::from_secs(3) }; 3]),
        });
        let sd = "D:(A;;CCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRRC;;;SY)(A;;CCDCLCSWRPWPDTLOCRSDRCWDWO;;;BA)(A;;CCLCSWRPLOCRRC;;;AU)";
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("sc.exe").args(["sdset", NAME, sd]).output();
        svc.start::<&str>(&[]).map_err(|e| format!("start: {e}"))?;
        let running = wait_state(&svc, ServiceState::Running, 15);
        Ok(json!({ "ok": running, "sv": VERSION, "path": dest.to_string_lossy() }))
    }

    fn remove_later(dir: &std::path::Path) {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        let exe = wz(&dir.join("KonzteGuard.exe").to_string_lossy());
        let d = wz(&dir.to_string_lossy());
        unsafe {
            MoveFileExW(exe.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(), MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);
            MoveFileExW(d.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(), MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);
        }
        let cmd = format!("ping -n 6 127.0.0.1 >nul & rmdir /s /q \"{}\"", dir.display());
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("cmd.exe").args(["/c", &cmd]).creation_flags(0x08000000  | 0x00000008 ).spawn();
    }

    fn uninstall(keep: bool) -> Result<Value, String> {
        kill_trays();
        let dir = install_dir();
        let in_dir = std::env::current_exe().map(|p| p.starts_with(&dir)).unwrap_or(false);
        let m = ServiceManager::local_computer(None::<&str>, ServiceManagerAccess::CONNECT).map_err(|e| format!("scm: {e}"))?;
        let svc = m.open_service(NAME, ServiceAccess::QUERY_STATUS | ServiceAccess::STOP | ServiceAccess::DELETE).ok();
        if let Some(s) = &svc { s.delete().map_err(|e| format!("delete: {e}"))?; }
        if !keep && in_dir { remove_later(&dir); }
        if let Some(s) = &svc {
            if s.query_status().map(|x| x.current_state != ServiceState::Stopped).unwrap_or(false) { let _ = s.stop(); wait_state(s, ServiceState::Stopped, 15); }
        }
        if !keep && !in_dir {
            for _ in 0..20 { if std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).is_ok() || !dir.exists() { break; } std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(500)); }
        }
        Ok(json!({ "ok": true }))
    }

    pub fn main() {
        let arg = std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap_or_default();
        if arg.is_empty() || arg == "tray" || arg == "open" { return crate::tray::run(); }
        if arg == "service" {
            if service_dispatcher::start(NAME, ffi_service_main).is_err() { std::process::exit(2); }
            return;
        }
        unsafe { windows_sys::Win32::System::Console::AttachConsole(windows_sys::Win32::System::Console::ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS); }
        let out = |r: Result<Value, String>| -> ! {
            let (v, code) = match r { Ok(v) => { let c = if v["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true) { 0 } else { 1 }; (v, c) } Err(e) => (json!({ "ok": false, "error": e }), 1) };
            println!("{v}");
            std::process::exit(code)
        };
        match arg.as_str() {
            "install" => out(install()),
            "uninstall" => out(uninstall(std::env::args().nth(2).as_deref() == Some("keep"))),
            "version" => println!("{VERSION}"),
            "call" => {
                let req = std::env::args().nth(2).unwrap_or_else(|| r#"{"op":"info"}"#.into());
                let req: Value = if req.trim_start().starts_with('{') { serde_json::from_str(&req).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "op": "info" })) } else { json!({ "op": req.trim() }) };
                match pipe_call(&req, Duration::from_secs(30)) { Ok(v) => println!("{v}"), Err(e) => { eprintln!("{e}"); std::process::exit(1) } }
            }
            "update" => {
                match std::env::current_exe().map_err(|e| e.to_string()).and_then(|me| crate::update::check_and_apply(&me)) {
                    Ok(Some(v)) => { println!("{{\"ok\":true,\"updated\":\"{v}\"}}"); }
                    Ok(None) => { println!("{{\"ok\":true,\"latest\":true}}"); }
                    Err(e) => { println!("{{\"ok\":false,\"error\":{}}}", json!(e)); std::process::exit(1) }
                }
            }
            "console" => {
                start_workers();
                eprintln!("KONZTE GUARD {VERSION}: канал {PIPE}, Ctrl+C — вихід");
                loop { std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)); eprintln!("{}", state()); }
            }
            _ => { eprintln!("KONZTE GUARD {VERSION}\nКоманди: install | uninstall [keep] | console | call | version"); std::process::exit(2) }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
fn wz(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> { s.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect() }
fn fill(dst: &mut [u16], s: &str) {
    let v: Vec<u16> = s.encode_utf16().take(dst.len() - 1).collect();
    dst[..v.len()].copy_from_slice(&v);
    dst[v.len()] = 0;
}

fn query(last_start: &mut Option<Instant>) -> St {
    if let Ok(p) = std::env::var("KZG_PREVIEW") {
        let mut st = St { svc: Svc::Running, sv: VERSION.into(), game: false, pre: None, pid: 0, issues: Vec::new() };
        match p.as_str() {
            "late" => { st.game = true; st.pre = Some(false); st.pid = 1; }
            "play" => { st.game = true; st.pre = Some(true); st.pid = 1; }
            "blocked" => st.issues = vec!["testsign".into(), "kdbg".into()],
            "stopped" => st.svc = Svc::Stopped,
            "missing" => st.svc = Svc::Missing,
            "wait" => st.issues = vec!["syswait".into()],
            _ => {}
        }
        return st;
    }
    let mut st = St { svc: Svc::Missing, sv: String::new(), game: false, pre: None, pid: 0, issues: Vec::new() };
    let Ok(m) = ServiceManager::local_computer(None::<&str>, ServiceManagerAccess::CONNECT) else { return st };
    let Ok(s) = m.open_service(NAME, ServiceAccess::QUERY_STATUS | ServiceAccess::START) else { return st };
    match s.query_status().map(|x| x.current_state) {
        Ok(ServiceState::Running) => match pipe_call(&json!({ "op": "info" }), Duration::from_secs(4)) {
            Ok(i) => {
                st.svc = Svc::Running;
                st.sv = i["sv"].as_str().unwrap_or("").into();
                st.game = i["game"].as_bool() == Some(true);
                st.pre = i["pre"].as_bool();
                st.pid = i["pid"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
                st.issues = i["issues"].as_array().into_iter().flatten().filter_map(|x| x.as_str().map(String::from)).collect();
                if i["sys"].is_null() { st.issues.push("syswait".into()); }
            }
            Err(_) => st.svc = Svc::NoPipe,
        },
        Ok(ServiceState::StartPending) => st.svc = Svc::NoPipe,
        _ => {
            st.svc = Svc::Stopped;
            if last_start.map(|t| t.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(30)).unwrap_or(true) {
                *last_start = Some(Instant::now());
                let _ = s.start::<&str>(&[]);
            }
        }
    }
    st
}

fn poll_loop() {
    let mut last_start = None;
    let mut last_ovl: Option<Instant> = None;
    loop {
        let st = query(&mut last_start);
        if st.svc == Svc::Running && crate::update::newer(&st.sv, VERSION) { relaunch(); }
        if st.svc == Svc::Running && st.game && st.pid != 0 && last_ovl.map(|t| t.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(5)).unwrap_or(true) {
            last_ovl = Some(Instant::now());
            let list = kzguard::game_overlays(st.pid);
            let list = if list.is_array() { list } else { json!([]) };
            let _ = pipe_call(&json!({ "op": "overlay", "pid": st.pid, "list": list }), Duration::from_secs(4));
        }
        let changed = { let mut g = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()); let c = g.as_ref() != Some(&st); if c { *g = Some(st); } c };
        let h = HWND_.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
        if changed && h != 0 { unsafe { PostMessageW(h as HWND, WM_STATE, 0, 0); } }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(3));
    }
}

fn svc_line(st: &St) -> &'static str {
    match st.svc { Svc::Running => t("running"), Svc::Stopped => t("stopped"), Svc::Missing => t("missing"), Svc::NoPipe => t("nopipe") }
}
fn game_line(st: &St) -> &'static str {
    if !st.game { t("g_none") } else if st.pre == Some(true) { t("g_pre") } else { t("g_late") }
}

pub fn svc_value(st: &St) -> (&'static str, Tone) {
    match st.svc { Svc::Running => (t("running"), Tone::Ok), Svc::Stopped | Svc::NoPipe => (svc_line(st), Tone::Warn), Svc::Missing => (t("missing"), Tone::Bad) }
}
pub fn sys_value(st: &St) -> (String, Tone) {
    if st.svc != Svc::Running { return (t("v_sys_off").into(), Tone::Off); }
    if st.issues.iter().any(|x| x == "syswait") { return (t("v_sys_wait").into(), Tone::Warn); }
    let mut v: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
    for (k, m) in [("testsign", "i_testsign"), ("dse", "i_dse"), ("kdbg", "i_kdbg"), ("gaps", "i_gaps"), ("inject", "i_inject"), ("procs", "i_procs"), ("notray", "i_notray"), ("debugger", "i_debugger")] {
        if st.issues.iter().any(|x| x == k) { v.push(t(m)); }
    }
    if v.is_empty() { (t("v_sys_ok").into(), Tone::Ok) } else { (v.into_iter().take(3).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n"), Tone::Bad) }
}
pub fn game_value(st: &St) -> (&'static str, Tone) {
    if !st.game { (t("v_g_none"), Tone::Off) } else if st.pre == Some(true) { (t("v_g_pre"), Tone::Ok) } else { (t("late_long"), Tone::Bad) }
}

fn icon() -> HICON {
    unsafe {
        let (cx, cy) = (GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSMICON), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSMICON));
        let h = LoadImageW(GetModuleHandleW(std::ptr::null()), 1 as _, IMAGE_ICON, cx, cy, 0);
        if h.is_null() { LoadIconW(std::ptr::null_mut(), IDI_SHIELD) } else { h as HICON }
    }
}

fn nid(hwnd: HWND) -> NOTIFYICONDATAW {
    let mut n: NOTIFYICONDATAW = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
    n.cbSize = std::mem::size_of::<NOTIFYICONDATAW>() as u32;
    n.hWnd = hwnd;
    n.uID = 1;
    n
}

fn tip_text() -> String {
    let st = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    match st { Some(st) => format!("KONZTE GUARD\n{}\n{}", svc_line(&st), game_line(&st)), None => "KONZTE GUARD".into() }
}

fn add_icon(hwnd: HWND) {
    let mut n = nid(hwnd);
    n.uFlags = NIF_ICON | NIF_MESSAGE | NIF_TIP;
    n.uCallbackMessage = WM_TRAY;
    n.hIcon = icon();
    fill(&mut n.szTip, &tip_text());
    unsafe { Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_ADD, &n); }
}

fn update_tip(hwnd: HWND) {
    let mut n = nid(hwnd);
    n.uFlags = NIF_TIP;
    fill(&mut n.szTip, &tip_text());
    unsafe { Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &n); }
}

fn balloon(hwnd: HWND, text: &str, warn: bool) {
    let mut n = nid(hwnd);
    n.uFlags = NIF_INFO;
    fill(&mut n.szInfoTitle, "KONZTE GUARD");
    fill(&mut n.szInfo, text);
    n.dwInfoFlags = if warn { NIIF_WARNING } else { NIIF_INFO };
    unsafe { Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_MODIFY, &n); }
}

fn open(url: &str) {
    let (verb, file) = (wz("open"), wz(url));
    unsafe { ShellExecuteW(std::ptr::null_mut(), verb.as_ptr(), file.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), SW_SHOWNORMAL); }
}

fn launch(hwnd: HWND) {
    let st = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    if let Some(st) = &st {
        if st.game && st.pre != Some(true) { balloon(hwnd, t("g_late"), true); return; }
        if let Some(i) = blocking(st) { balloon(hwnd, t(i), true); return; }
        if st.svc != Svc::Running {
            if let Ok(m) = ServiceManager::local_computer(None::<&str>, ServiceManagerAccess::CONNECT) {
                if let Ok(s) = m.open_service(NAME, ServiceAccess::START | ServiceAccess::QUERY_STATUS) {
                    let _ = s.start::<&str>(&[]);
                    let t0 = Instant::now();
                    while t0.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(8) && s.query_status().map(|x| x.current_state != ServiceState::Running).unwrap_or(true) {
                        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    open(&format!("steam://rungameid/{CM_APPID}"));
}

fn menu(hwnd: HWND) {
    let st = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    unsafe {
        let m = CreatePopupMenu();
        let head = wz(&format!("KONZTE GUARD {VERSION}"));
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING | MF_GRAYED, 1, head.as_ptr());
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, std::ptr::null());
        let (a, b) = st.as_ref().map(|s| (svc_line(s), game_line(s))).unwrap_or(("…", ""));
        let (a, b) = (wz(a), wz(b));
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING | MF_GRAYED, 2, a.as_ptr());
        if st.is_some() { AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING | MF_GRAYED, 3, b.as_ptr()); }
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_SEPARATOR, 0, std::ptr::null());
        let o = wz(t("open"));
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING, ID_OPEN, o.as_ptr());
        let l = wz(t("launch"));
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING, ID_LAUNCH, l.as_ptr());
        let h = wz(t("hide"));
        let in_game = st.as_ref().map(|s| s.game).unwrap_or(false);
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING | if in_game { MF_GRAYED } else { 0 }, ID_HIDE, h.as_ptr());
        let x = wz(t("exit"));
        AppendMenuW(m, MF_STRING | if in_game { MF_GRAYED } else { 0 }, ID_EXIT, x.as_ptr());
        let mut p = POINT { x: 0, y: 0 };
        GetCursorPos(&mut p);
        SetForegroundWindow(hwnd);
        let cmd = TrackPopupMenu(m, TPM_RIGHTBUTTON | TPM_RETURNCMD | TPM_NONOTIFY, p.x, p.y, 0, hwnd, std::ptr::null());
        PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_NULL, 0, 0);
        DestroyMenu(m);
        match cmd as usize {
            ID_LAUNCH => { let hv = hwnd as isize; std::thread::spawn(move || launch(hv as HWND)); }
            ID_OPEN => show(hwnd),
            ID_HIDE => { DestroyWindow(hwnd); }
            ID_EXIT => {
                let r = pipe_call(&json!({ "op": "stop" }), Duration::from_secs(4));
                if r.map(|v| v["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true)).unwrap_or(true) { DestroyWindow(hwnd); }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

static PREV: Mutex<Option<St>> = Mutex::new(None);

unsafe extern "system" fn wndproc(hwnd: HWND, msg: u32, wp: WPARAM, lp: LPARAM) -> LRESULT {
    let st = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    let hv = hwnd as isize;
    if let Some(r) = crate::ui::handle(hwnd, msg, wp, lp, st.as_ref(), &move || main_action(hv as HWND)) { return r; }
    match msg {
        WM_TRAY => {
            match lp as u32 { WM_LBUTTONUP | WM_LBUTTONDBLCLK => show(hwnd), WM_RBUTTONUP | WM_CONTEXTMENU => menu(hwnd), _ => {} }
            0
        }
        WM_SHOWWIN => { show(hwnd); 0 }
        WM_CLOSE => { ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_HIDE); 0 }
        WM_STATE => {
            update_tip(hwnd);
            refresh(hwnd);
            let cur = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
            let mut prev = PREV.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            if let Some(c) = &cur {
                let was_late = prev.as_ref().map(|p| p.game && p.pre != Some(true)).unwrap_or(false);
                if c.svc == Svc::Running && c.game && c.pre != Some(true) && !was_late { show(hwnd); }
            }
            if let (Some(c), Some(p)) = (&cur, prev.as_ref()) {
                if c.game && !p.game {
                    if c.svc == Svc::Running && c.pre == Some(true) { balloon(hwnd, t("n_on"), false); } else if c.svc == Svc::Running { balloon(hwnd, t("g_late"), true); }
                }
                if p.svc == Svc::Running && c.svc != Svc::Running { balloon(hwnd, t("n_off"), true); }
            }
            *prev = cur;
            0
        }
        WM_DESTROY => {
            let n = nid(hwnd);
            Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &n);
            PostQuitMessage(0);
            0
        }
        _ => {
            let tb = TASKBAR_CREATED.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
            if tb != 0 && msg == tb as u32 { add_icon(hwnd); return 0; }
            DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wp, lp)
        }
    }
}

pub fn run() {
    unsafe {
        let open_win = std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() == Some("open");
        crate::ui::init();
        if std::env::var_os("KZG_PREVIEW").is_none() && !installed_copy() && offer_install() { return; }
        let mx = wz("Local\\KonzteGuardTray");
        let m = CreateMutexW(std::ptr::null(), 0, mx.as_ptr());
        MUTEX.store(m as isize, Ordering::SeqCst);
        if GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS {
            if open_win {
                let c = wz(CLASS);
                let w = FindWindowW(c.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null());
                if !w.is_null() { PostMessageW(w, WM_SHOWWIN, 0, 0); }
            }
            return;
        }

        let tb = wz("TaskbarCreated");
        TASKBAR_CREATED.store(RegisterWindowMessageW(tb.as_ptr()) as isize, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let inst = GetModuleHandleW(std::ptr::null());
        let cls = wz(CLASS);
        let mut wc: WNDCLASSW = std::mem::zeroed();
        wc.lpfnWndProc = Some(wndproc);
        wc.hInstance = inst;
        wc.lpszClassName = cls.as_ptr();
        wc.style = CS_DROPSHADOW;
        wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(std::ptr::null_mut(), IDC_ARROW);
        wc.hIcon = LoadIconW(inst, 1 as _);
        RegisterClassW(&wc);
        let hwnd = crate::ui::create(&cls, inst);
        if hwnd.is_null() { return; }
        HWND_.store(hwnd as isize, Ordering::SeqCst);
        add_icon(hwnd);
        std::thread::spawn(poll_loop);
        if open_win { show(hwnd); }
        let mut msg: MSG = std::mem::zeroed();
        while GetMessageW(&mut msg, std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, 0) > 0 {
            TranslateMessage(&msg);
            DispatchMessageW(&msg);
        }
    }
}

fn blocking(st: &St) -> Option<&'static str> {
    for (k, m) in [("testsign", "i_testsign"), ("dse", "i_dse"), ("kdbg", "i_kdbg")] { if st.issues.iter().any(|x| x == k) { return Some(m); } }
    None
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Act { Start, Close, Launch, Blocked, Running, Wait }
pub fn action(st: Option<&St>) -> Act {
    let Some(st) = st else { return Act::Wait };
    if st.svc != Svc::Running { return if st.svc == Svc::Missing { Act::Blocked } else { Act::Start } }
    if st.game { return if st.pre == Some(true) { Act::Running } else { Act::Close } }
    if blocking(st).is_some() { return Act::Blocked }
    if st.issues.iter().any(|x| x == "syswait") { return Act::Wait }
    Act::Launch
}

fn refresh(hwnd: HWND) {
    unsafe { InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0); }
}

fn show(hwnd: HWND) {
    refresh(hwnd);
    unsafe { ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOWNORMAL); SetForegroundWindow(hwnd); }
}

fn main_action(hwnd: HWND) {
    let st = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    match action(st.as_ref()) {
        Act::Close => {
            let pid = st.map(|s| s.pid).unwrap_or(0);
            if pid != 0 { unsafe { let h = OpenProcess(PROCESS_TERMINATE, 0, pid); if !h.is_null() { TerminateProcess(h, 0); CloseHandle(h); } } }
        }
        Act::Start | Act::Launch => { let hv = hwnd as isize; std::thread::spawn(move || launch_or_start(hv as HWND)); }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn launch_or_start(hwnd: HWND) {
    let st = ST.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()).clone();
    if st.as_ref().map(|s| s.svc != Svc::Running).unwrap_or(true) {
        if let Ok(m) = ServiceManager::local_computer(None::<&str>, ServiceManagerAccess::CONNECT) {
            if let Ok(s) = m.open_service(NAME, ServiceAccess::START) { let _ = s.start::<&str>(&[]); }
        }
        return;
    }
    launch(hwnd);
}

fn pf_exe() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("ProgramFiles").unwrap_or_else(|_| r"C:\Program Files".into())).join("Konzte Guard").join("KonzteGuard.exe")
}
fn installed_copy() -> bool {
    std::env::current_exe().ok().and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.to_path_buf())).map(|d| Some(d.as_path()) == pf_exe().parent()).unwrap_or(false)
}
fn offer_install() -> bool {
    unsafe {
        let (q, title) = (wz(t("inst_q")), wz("KONZTE GUARD"));
        if MessageBoxW(std::ptr::null_mut(), q.as_ptr(), title.as_ptr(), MB_YESNO | MB_ICONQUESTION) != IDYES { return true; }
        let me = wz(&std::env::current_exe().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default());
        let (verb, args) = (wz("runas"), wz("install"));
        let mut si: SHELLEXECUTEINFOW = std::mem::zeroed();
        si.cbSize = std::mem::size_of::<SHELLEXECUTEINFOW>() as u32;
        si.fMask = SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS | SEE_MASK_NOASYNC;
        si.lpVerb = verb.as_ptr(); si.lpFile = me.as_ptr(); si.lpParameters = args.as_ptr(); si.nShow = SW_HIDE;
        if ShellExecuteExW(&mut si) == 0 || si.hProcess.is_null() { return true; }
        windows_sys::Win32::System::Threading::WaitForSingleObject(si.hProcess, 120_000);
        CloseHandle(si.hProcess);
        let pf = pf_exe();
        if pf.exists() {
            let _ = std::process::Command::new("reg.exe").args(["add", r"HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", "/v", "KonzteGuard", "/t", "REG_SZ", "/d", &format!("\"{}\"", pf.display()), "/f"]).output();
            let _ = std::process::Command::new(&pf).arg("open").spawn();
        }
        true
    }
}
fn relaunch() {
    let pf = pf_exe();
    if !pf.exists() { return; }
    unsafe { let m = MUTEX.swap(0, Ordering::SeqCst); if m != 0 { CloseHandle(m as HANDLE); } }
    let h = HWND_.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
    if h != 0 { let n = nid(h as HWND); unsafe { Shell_NotifyIconW(NIM_DELETE, &n); } }
    let _ = std::process::Command::new(&pf).spawn();
    std::process::exit(0);
}
```

```rs
use crate::tray::{action, game_value, svc_value, sys_value, t, Act, St, Tone};

const W: f32 = 560.0;
static LAYOUT_H: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32::new(0x43D20000);
fn hh() -> f32 { f32::from_bits(LAYOUT_H.load(Ordering::SeqCst)) }

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum Hit { None = 0, Main = 1, Hide = 2, Min = 3, Close = 4, Caption = 5 }
fn hit_from(v: u8) -> Hit { match v { 1 => Hit::Main, 2 => Hit::Hide, 3 => Hit::Min, 4 => Hit::Close, 5 => Hit::Caption, _ => Hit::None } }

static HOVER: AtomicU8 = AtomicU8::new(0);
static PRESSED: AtomicU8 = AtomicU8::new(0);
static FONTS: Mutex<Option<(u32, [isize; 6])>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn wz(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> { s.encode_utf16().collect() }
fn rgb(c: u32) -> u32 { ((c >> 16) & 0xff) | (c & 0xff00) | ((c & 0xff) << 16) }
fn col(c: u32, a: u8) -> Color { Color::from_rgba8((c >> 16) as u8, (c >> 8) as u8, c as u8, a) }

const GOLD: u32 = 0xF4C542;
const GOLD_HI: u32 = 0xFFE08A;
const GOLD_LO: u32 = 0xD9A22B;
const TEXT: u32 = 0xF2F2F5;

const GREEN: u32 = 0x3DDC84;

fn tone_color(t: Tone) -> u32 { match t { Tone::Ok => GREEN, Tone::Warn => AMBER, Tone::Bad => RED, Tone::Off => DIM } }

pub fn init() {
    unsafe {
        SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(DPI_AWARENESS_CONTEXT_PER_MONITOR_AWARE_V2);
        for f in [&include_bytes!("../res/RussoOne-Regular.ttf")[..]] {
            let mut n = 0u32;
            AddFontMemResourceEx(f.as_ptr() as _, f.len() as u32, std::ptr::null(), &mut n);
        }
    }

pub fn dpi(hwnd: HWND) -> f32 { let d = unsafe { GetDpiForWindow(hwnd) }; if d == 0 { 1.0 } else { d as f32 / 96.0 } }

pub fn create(cls: &[u16], inst: HINSTANCE) -> HWND {
    unsafe {
        let s = { let d = GetDpiForSystem(); if d == 0 { 1.0 } else { d as f32 / 96.0 } };
        let (w, h) = ((W * s) as i32, (hh() * s) as i32);
        let (sx, sy) = (GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN), GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN));
        let title: Vec<u16> = "KONZTE GUARD\0".encode_utf16().collect();
        let hwnd = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_APPWINDOW, cls.as_ptr(), title.as_ptr(), WS_POPUP | WS_SYSMENU | WS_MINIMIZEBOX,
            (sx - w) / 2, (sy - h) / 2, w, h, std::ptr::null_mut(), std::ptr::null_mut(), inst, std::ptr::null());
        if !hwnd.is_null() {
            let round: u32 = 2;
            DwmSetWindowAttribute(hwnd, 33, &round as *const u32 as _, 4);
        }
        hwnd
    }
}

struct R { x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32 }
impl R {
    fn has(&self, px: f32, py: f32) -> bool { px >= self.x && px < self.x + self.w && py >= self.y && py < self.y + self.h }
    fn sc(&self, s: f32) -> RECT { RECT { left: (self.x * s) as i32, top: (self.y * s) as i32, right: ((self.x + self.w) * s) as i32, bottom: ((self.y + self.h) * s) as i32 } }
}
fn r_close() -> R { R { x: W - 50.0, y: 12.0, w: 36.0, h: 30.0 } }
fn r_min() -> R { R { x: W - 88.0, y: 12.0, w: 36.0, h: 30.0 } }
fn r_main() -> R { R { x: 24.0, y: hh() - 112.0, w: W - 48.0 - 148.0, h: 52.0 } }
fn r_hide() -> R { R { x: W - 24.0 - 136.0, y: hh() - 112.0, w: 136.0, h: 52.0 } }

pub fn hit_test(hwnd: HWND, x: i32, y: i32) -> Hit {
    let s = dpi(hwnd);
    let (px, py) = (x as f32 / s, y as f32 / s);
    if r_close().has(px, py) { Hit::Close } else if r_min().has(px, py) { Hit::Min }
    else if r_main().has(px, py) { Hit::Main } else if r_hide().has(px, py) { Hit::Hide }
    else if py < HEADER { Hit::Caption } else { Hit::None }
}

fn enabled(a: Act) -> bool { matches!(a, Act::Launch | Act::Start | Act::Close) }

fn rrect(x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32, r: f32) -> Option<Path> {
    let r = r.min(w / 2.0).min(h / 2.0);
    let k = 0.5523 * r;
    let mut pb = PathBuilder::new();
    pb.move_to(x + r, y);
    pb.line_to(x + w - r, y);
    pb.cubic_to(x + w - r + k, y, x + w, y + r - k, x + w, y + r);
    pb.line_to(x + w, y + h - r);
    pb.cubic_to(x + w, y + h - r + k, x + w - r + k, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    pb.line_to(x + r, y + h);
    pb.cubic_to(x + r - k, y + h, x, y + h - r + k, x, y + h - r);
    pb.line_to(x, y + r);
    pb.cubic_to(x, y + r - k, x + r - k, y, x + r, y);
    pb.close();
    pb.finish()
}

fn solid(c: u32, a: u8) -> Paint<'static> { let mut p = Paint::default(); p.anti_alias = true; p.set_color(col(c, a)); p }
fn vgrad(y0: f32, y1: f32, c0: Color, c1: Color) -> Paint<'static> {
    let mut p = Paint::default();
    p.anti_alias = true;
    if let Some(sh) = LinearGradient::new(Point::from_xy(0.0, y0), Point::from_xy(0.0, y1), vec![GradientStop::new(0.0, c0), GradientStop::new(1.0, c1)], SpreadMode::Pad, Transform::identity()) { p.shader = sh; }
    p
}

struct Fonts { title: HFONT, sub: HFONT, label: HFONT, value: HFONT, btn: HFONT, small: HFONT }
fn fonts(dpi_raw: u32, s: f32) -> Fonts {
    let mut g = FONTS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if g.as_ref().map(|(d, _)| *d) != Some(dpi_raw) {
        if let Some((_, old)) = g.take() { for f in old { unsafe { DeleteObject(f as _); } } }
        let mk = |px: f32, weight: i32, face: &str| -> isize {
            let f: Vec<u16> = format!("{face}\0").encode_utf16().collect();
            unsafe { CreateFontW(-(px * s).round() as i32, 0, 0, 0, weight, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 5, 0, f.as_ptr()) as isize }
        };
        *g = Some((dpi_raw, [
            mk(34.0, 400, "Russo One"),
            mk(12.5, 400, "Russo One"),
            mk(11.5, 400, "Russo One"),
            mk(15.0, 600, "Segoe UI"),
            mk(17.0, 400, "Russo One"),
            mk(12.0, 400, "Segoe UI"),
        ]));
    }
    let f = g.as_ref().unwrap().1;
    Fonts { title: f[0] as _, sub: f[1] as _, label: f[2] as _, value: f[3] as _, btn: f[4] as _, small: f[5] as _ }
}

unsafe fn text(dc: HDC, s: &str, r: &mut RECT, font: HFONT, color: u32, flags: u32, spacing: i32) {
    SelectObject(dc, font as _);
    SetTextColor(dc, rgb(color));
    SetTextCharacterExtra(dc, spacing);
    let w = wz(s);
    DrawTextW(dc, w.as_ptr() as _, w.len() as i32, r, flags);
}
unsafe fn measure(dc: HDC, s: &str, width: i32, font: HFONT) -> i32 {
    SelectObject(dc, font as _);
    SetTextCharacterExtra(dc, 0);
    let w = wz(s);
    let mut r = RECT { left: 0, top: 0, right: width, bottom: 0 };
    DrawTextW(dc, w.as_ptr() as _, w.len() as i32, &mut r, DT_WORDBREAK | DT_CALCRECT | DT_NOPREFIX);
    r.bottom
}

pub fn paint(hwnd: HWND, st: Option<&St>) {
    unsafe {
        let mut ps: PAINTSTRUCT = std::mem::zeroed();
        let hdc = BeginPaint(hwnd, &mut ps);
        let mut cr: RECT = std::mem::zeroed();
        GetClientRect(hwnd, &mut cr);
        let (pw, ph) = ((cr.right - cr.left).max(1), (cr.bottom - cr.top).max(1));
        let dpi_raw = GetDpiForWindow(hwnd).max(96);
        let s = dpi_raw as f32 / 96.0;
        let f = fonts(dpi_raw, s);
        let a = action(st);
        let hover = hit_from(HOVER.load(Ordering::SeqCst));
        let pressed = hit_from(PRESSED.load(Ordering::SeqCst));

        let mut bmi: BITMAPINFO = std::mem::zeroed();
        bmi.bmiHeader.biSize = std::mem::size_of::<BITMAPINFOHEADER>() as u32;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biWidth = pw;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biHeight = -ph;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biPlanes = 1;
        bmi.bmiHeader.biBitCount = 32;
        let mut bits: *mut core::ffi::c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let dib = CreateDIBSection(hdc, &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &mut bits, std::ptr::null_mut(), 0);
        let mdc = CreateCompatibleDC(hdc);
        let old_bmp = SelectObject(mdc, dib as _);
        SetBkMode(mdc, TRANSPARENT as i32);

        let rows: Vec<(&str, String, Tone)> = match st {
            Some(st) => vec![(t("l_svc"), svc_value(st).0.into(), svc_value(st).1), (t("l_sys"), sys_value(st).0, sys_value(st).1), (t("l_game"), game_value(st).0.into(), game_value(st).1)],
            None => vec![(t("l_svc"), "…".into(), Tone::Off), (t("l_sys"), "…".into(), Tone::Off), (t("l_game"), "…".into(), Tone::Off)],
        };
        let (cx, cw) = (24.0, W - 48.0);
        let val_w = ((cw - 64.0) * s) as i32;
        let heights: Vec<f32> = rows.iter().map(|(_, v, _)| { let hv = measure(mdc, v, val_w, f.value) as f32 / s; (30.0 + hv + 14.0).max(58.0) }).collect();
        let card_y = HEADER + 8.0;
        let card_h: f32 = heights.iter().sum::<f32>();
        let need = (card_y + card_h + 16.0 + 112.0).round();
        if (need - hh()).abs() > 0.5 {
            LAYOUT_H.store(need.to_bits(), Ordering::SeqCst);
            SetWindowPos(hwnd, std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, 0, (W * s) as i32, (need * s) as i32, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            SelectObject(mdc, old_bmp);
            DeleteObject(dib as _);
            DeleteDC(mdc);
            InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0);
            EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
            return;
        }
        #[allow(non_snake_case)]
        let H = hh();

        if let Some(mut pm) = Pixmap::new(pw as u32, ph as u32) {
            let tf = Transform::from_scale(s, s);
            let full = Rect::from_xywh(0.0, 0.0, W, H).unwrap();
            pm.fill_rect(full, &vgrad(0.0, H, col(0x18161F, 255), col(0x09090C, 255)), tf, None);
            let mut glow = Paint::default();
            glow.anti_alias = true;
            if let Some(sh) = RadialGradient::new(Point::from_xy(58.0, 52.0), 0.0, Point::from_xy(58.0, 52.0), 230.0,
                vec![GradientStop::new(0.0, col(GOLD, 46)), GradientStop::new(1.0, col(GOLD, 0))], SpreadMode::Pad, Transform::identity()) { glow.shader = sh; }
            pm.fill_rect(full, &glow, tf, None);
            if let Some(p) = rrect(0.5, 0.5, W - 1.0, H - 1.0, 8.0) { pm.stroke_path(&p, &solid(GOLD, 70), &Stroke { width: 1.0, ..Default::default() }, tf, None); }
            for (r, hv, close) in [(r_min(), hover == Hit::Min, false), (r_close(), hover == Hit::Close, true)] {
                if hv { if let Some(p) = rrect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, 6.0) { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(if close { 0xE5484D } else { 0x2A2833 }, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); } }
                let (mx, my) = (r.x + r.w / 2.0, r.y + r.h / 2.0);
                let mut pb = PathBuilder::new();
                if close { pb.move_to(mx - 5.5, my - 5.5); pb.line_to(mx + 5.5, my + 5.5); pb.move_to(mx + 5.5, my - 5.5); pb.line_to(mx - 5.5, my + 5.5); }
                else { pb.move_to(mx - 6.0, my); pb.line_to(mx + 6.0, my); }
                if let Some(p) = pb.finish() { pm.stroke_path(&p, &solid(if hv { 0xFFFFFF } else { MUTED }, 255), &Stroke { width: 1.4, line_cap: LineCap::Round, ..Default::default() }, tf, None); }
            }
            if let Some(p) = rrect(cx, card_y, cw, card_h, 12.0) {
                pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(0x15141B, 235), FillRule::Winding, tf, None);
                pm.stroke_path(&p, &solid(0x2C2A35, 255), &Stroke { width: 1.0, ..Default::default() }, tf, None);
            }
            let mut y = card_y;
            for (i, (_, _, tone)) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
                let c = tone_color(*tone);
                let (dx, dy) = (cx + 26.0, y + 22.0);
                if let Some(p) = PathBuilder::from_circle(dx, dy, 9.0) { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(c, 40), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); }
                if let Some(p) = PathBuilder::from_circle(dx, dy, 4.5) { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(c, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); }
                y += heights[i];
                if i + 1 < rows.len() { pm.fill_rect(Rect::from_xywh(cx + 16.0, y - 0.5, cw - 32.0, 1.0).unwrap(), &solid(0x24222C, 255), tf, None); }
            }
            let m = r_main();
            let on = enabled(a);
            let (hov, prs) = (on && hover == Hit::Main, on && pressed == Hit::Main && hover == Hit::Main);
            if let Some(p) = rrect(m.x, m.y, m.w, m.h, 10.0) {
                match a {
                    Act::Launch | Act::Start => {
                        let (top, bot) = if prs { (GOLD_LO, GOLD_LO) } else if hov { (0xFFE9A8, GOLD) } else { (GOLD_HI, GOLD_LO) };
                        pm.fill_path(&p, &vgrad(m.y, m.y + m.h, col(top, 255), col(bot, 255)), FillRule::Winding, tf, None);
                    }
                    Act::Close => { let c = if prs { 0xB8292E } else if hov { 0xF0585D } else { 0xE5484D }; pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(c, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); }
                    Act::Running => { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(0x10251A, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); pm.stroke_path(&p, &solid(GREEN, 150), &Stroke { width: 1.2, ..Default::default() }, tf, None); }
                    Act::Blocked => { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(0x2A1517, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); pm.stroke_path(&p, &solid(RED, 120), &Stroke { width: 1.2, ..Default::default() }, tf, None); }
                    Act::Wait => { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(0x1D1C24, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); }
                }
            }
            let hd = r_hide();
            if let Some(p) = rrect(hd.x, hd.y, hd.w, hd.h, 10.0) {
                if hover == Hit::Hide { pm.fill_path(&p, &solid(0x22212A, 255), FillRule::Winding, tf, None); }
                pm.stroke_path(&p, &solid(0x3A3844, 255), &Stroke { width: 1.0, ..Default::default() }, tf, None);
            }
            let dst = std::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(bits as *mut u8, (pw * ph * 4) as usize);
            for (d, sp) in dst.chunks_exact_mut(4).zip(pm.data().chunks_exact(4)) { d[0] = sp[2]; d[1] = sp[1]; d[2] = sp[0]; d[3] = 255; }
        }

        let inst = GetModuleHandleW(std::ptr::null());
        let isz = (62.0 * s) as i32;
        let ico = LoadImageW(inst, 1 as _, IMAGE_ICON, isz, isz, 0);
        if !ico.is_null() { DrawIconEx(mdc, (26.0 * s) as i32, (20.0 * s) as i32, ico as HICON, isz, isz, 0, std::ptr::null_mut(), DI_NORMAL); DestroyIcon(ico as HICON); }
        let mut r = R { x: 104.0, y: 18.0, w: 340.0, h: 44.0 }.sc(s);
        text(mdc, "KONZTE GUARD", &mut r, f.title, TEXT, DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX, 0);
        let mut r = R { x: 106.0, y: 62.0, w: 340.0, h: 20.0 }.sc(s);
        text(mdc, &format!("{} · v{VERSION}", t("sub")), &mut r, f.sub, GOLD, DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX, (2.0 * s) as i32);

        let mut y = card_y;
        for (i, (label, value, tone)) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut r = R { x: cx + 46.0, y: y + 13.0, w: cw - 64.0, h: 18.0 }.sc(s);
            text(mdc, &label.to_uppercase(), &mut r, f.label, MUTED, DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX, (1.2 * s) as i32);
            let mut r = R { x: cx + 46.0, y: y + 30.0, w: cw - 64.0, h: heights[i] - 34.0 }.sc(s);
            let vc = match tone { Tone::Bad => 0xFF8A8D, Tone::Warn => 0xFFD08A, _ => TEXT };
            text(mdc, value, &mut r, f.value, vc, DT_WORDBREAK | DT_NOPREFIX | DT_END_ELLIPSIS, 0);
            y += heights[i];
        }

        let (label, lc) = match a {
            Act::Launch => (t("b_launch"), 0x17140C), Act::Start => (t("b_start"), 0x17140C), Act::Close => (t("b_close"), 0xFFFFFF),
            Act::Running => (t("b_running"), GREEN), Act::Blocked => (t("b_blocked"), 0xFF8A8D), Act::Wait => ("…", MUTED),
        };
        let mut r = r_main().sc(s);
        text(mdc, &label.to_uppercase(), &mut r, f.btn, lc, DT_SINGLELINE | DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER | DT_NOPREFIX, (0.8 * s) as i32);
        let mut r = r_hide().sc(s);
        text(mdc, &t("b_hide").to_uppercase(), &mut r, f.btn, if hover == Hit::Hide { TEXT } else { 0xC9C7D3 }, DT_SINGLELINE | DT_CENTER | DT_VCENTER | DT_NOPREFIX, (0.8 * s) as i32);
        let mut r = R { x: 24.0, y: H - 46.0, w: W - 48.0, h: 20.0 }.sc(s);
        text(mdc, t("foot"), &mut r, f.small, DIM, DT_SINGLELINE | DT_CENTER | DT_NOPREFIX, 0);

        BitBlt(hdc, 0, 0, pw, ph, mdc, 0, 0, SRCCOPY);
        SelectObject(mdc, old_bmp);
        DeleteObject(dib as _);
        DeleteDC(mdc);
        EndPaint(hwnd, &ps);
    }
}

pub fn handle(hwnd: HWND, msg: u32, wp: WPARAM, lp: LPARAM, st: Option<&St>, on_main: &dyn Fn()) -> Option<LRESULT> {
    let xy = || ((lp & 0xffff) as i16 as i32, ((lp >> 16) & 0xffff) as i16 as i32);
    unsafe {
        match msg {
            WM_PAINT => { paint(hwnd, st); Some(0) }
            WM_ERASEBKGND => Some(1),
            WM_NCHITTEST => {
                let (sx, sy) = xy();
                let mut p = POINT { x: sx, y: sy };
                ScreenToClient(hwnd, &mut p);
                Some(if hit_test(hwnd, p.x, p.y) == Hit::Caption { HTCAPTION as isize } else { HTCLIENT as isize })
            }
            WM_MOUSEMOVE => {
                let (x, y) = xy();
                let h = hit_test(hwnd, x, y) as u8;
                if HOVER.swap(h, Ordering::SeqCst) != h { InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0); }
                let mut tme = TRACKMOUSEEVENT { cbSize: std::mem::size_of::<TRACKMOUSEEVENT>() as u32, dwFlags: TME_LEAVE, hwndTrack: hwnd, dwHoverTime: 0 };
                TrackMouseEvent(&mut tme);
                Some(0)
            }
            WM_MOUSELEAVE => { if HOVER.swap(0, Ordering::SeqCst) != 0 { InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0); } Some(0) }
            WM_LBUTTONDOWN => {
                let (x, y) = xy();
                PRESSED.store(hit_test(hwnd, x, y) as u8, Ordering::SeqCst);
                SetCapture(hwnd);
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0);
                Some(0)
            }
            WM_LBUTTONUP => {
                ReleaseCapture();
                let (x, y) = xy();
                let h = hit_test(hwnd, x, y);
                let p = hit_from(PRESSED.swap(0, Ordering::SeqCst));
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0);
                if h == p {
                    match h {
                        Hit::Main => if enabled(action(st)) { on_main() },
                        Hit::Hide | Hit::Close => { ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_HIDE); }
                        Hit::Min => { ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_MINIMIZE); }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                }
                Some(0)
            }
            WM_SETCURSOR => {
                let h = hit_from(HOVER.load(Ordering::SeqCst));
                let hand = match h { Hit::Main => enabled(action(st)), Hit::Hide | Hit::Min | Hit::Close => true, _ => false };
                if hand && (lp & 0xffff) as u32 == HTCLIENT { SetCursor(LoadCursorW(std::ptr::null_mut(), IDC_HAND)); return Some(1); }
                None
            }
            WM_KEYDOWN => {
                match wp as u16 {
                    VK_RETURN => if enabled(action(st)) { on_main() },
                    VK_ESCAPE => { ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_HIDE); }
                    _ => {}
                }
                Some(0)
            }
            WM_DPICHANGED => {
                let r = &*(lp as *const RECT);
                SetWindowPos(hwnd, std::ptr::null_mut(), r.left, r.top, r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
                InvalidateRect(hwnd, std::ptr::null(), 0);
                Some(0)
            }
            _ => None,
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
use base64::Engine;
use ed25519_dalek::{Signature, VerifyingKey};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::path::Path;
use windows_sys::Win32::Networking::WinHttp::*;

const HOST: &str = "konzte.online";
const MANIFEST: &str = "/assets/guard/guard.json";
const SIG: &str = "/assets/guard/guard.sig";
const PUBKEY: [u8; 32] = hex32("e68d94bf3e8edfd63973e7f028b0e58625a2e97c606fab68e7414bf21ececdea");

const fn hexd(c: u8) -> u8 { if c >= b'a' { c - b'a' + 10 } else { c - b'0' } }

const fn hex32(s: &str) -> [u8; 32] {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < 32 {
        out[i] = hexd(b[2 * i]) << 4 | hexd(b[2 * i + 1]);
        i += 1;
    }
    out
}

fn wz(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> { s.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect() }

pub fn get(path: &str, max: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    unsafe {
        let ua = wz(&format!("KonzteGuard/{}", crate::win::VERSION));
        let s = WinHttpOpen(ua.as_ptr(), WINHTTP_ACCESS_TYPE_DEFAULT_PROXY, std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), 0);
        if s.is_null() { return Err("open".into()); }
        let close = |h: *mut core::ffi::c_void| { if !h.is_null() { WinHttpCloseHandle(h); } };
        WinHttpSetTimeouts(s, 10_000, 10_000, 20_000, 60_000);
        let host = wz(HOST);
        let c = WinHttpConnect(s, host.as_ptr(), 443, 0);
        if c.is_null() { close(s); return Err("connect".into()); }
        let (verb, p) = (wz("GET"), wz(path));
        let r = WinHttpOpenRequest(c, verb.as_ptr(), p.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), std::ptr::null(), WINHTTP_FLAG_SECURE);
        let res = (|| {
            if r.is_null() { return Err("request".to_string()); }
            if WinHttpSendRequest(r, std::ptr::null(), 0, std::ptr::null(), 0, 0, 0) == 0 { return Err("send".into()); }
            if WinHttpReceiveResponse(r, std::ptr::null_mut()) == 0 { return Err("receive".into()); }
            let mut code: u32 = 0;
            let mut len = 4u32;
            WinHttpQueryHeaders(r, WINHTTP_QUERY_STATUS_CODE | WINHTTP_QUERY_FLAG_NUMBER, std::ptr::null(), &mut code as *mut u32 as _, &mut len, std::ptr::null_mut());
            if code != 200 { return Err(format!("http {code}")); }
            let mut out = Vec::new();
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65536];
            loop {
                let mut n = 0u32;
                if WinHttpReadData(r, buf.as_mut_ptr() as _, buf.len() as u32, &mut n) == 0 { return Err("read".into()); }
                if n == 0 { break; }
                out.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n as usize]);
                if out.len() > max { return Err("too big".into()); }
            }
            Ok(out)
        })();
        close(r); close(c); close(s);
        res
    }
}

pub fn newer(a: &str, b: &str) -> bool {
    let p = |v: &str| v.split('.').map(|x| x.parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0)).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let (a, b) = (p(a), p(b));
    for i in 0..3 { let (x, y) = (a.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0), b.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(0)); if x != y { return x > y; } }
    false
}

pub fn manifest() -> Result<Value, String> {
    let raw = get(MANIFEST, 64 << 10)?;
    let sig = get(SIG, 4 << 10)?;
    let sig = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(String::from_utf8_lossy(&sig).trim()).map_err(|_| "sig b64")?;
    let sig = Signature::from_slice(&sig).map_err(|_| "sig len")?;
    let key = VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&PUBKEY).map_err(|_| "key")?;
    key.verify_strict(&raw, &sig).map_err(|_| "bad signature")?;
    serde_json::from_slice(&raw).map_err(|e| format!("json: {e}"))
}

pub fn check_and_apply(exe: &Path) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
    let m = manifest()?;
    let ver = m["version"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    if !newer(&ver, crate::win::VERSION) { return Ok(None); }
    let file = m["file"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
    if file.is_empty() || file.contains('/') || file.contains('\\') || file.contains("..") { return Err("file".into()); }
    let want = m["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase();
    let size = m["size"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as usize;
    let data = get(&format!("/assets/guard/{file}"), 64 << 20)?;
    if data.len() != size { return Err(format!("size {} != {size}", data.len())); }
    let got: String = Sha256::digest(&data).iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
    if got != want { return Err("sha256 mismatch".into()); }
    let dir = exe.parent().ok_or("dir")?;
    let (newf, oldf) = (dir.join("KonzteGuard.new"), dir.join("KonzteGuard.old"));
    std::fs::write(&newf, &data).map_err(|e| format!("write: {e}"))?;
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&oldf);
    std::fs::rename(exe, &oldf).map_err(|e| format!("rename old: {e}"))?;
    if let Err(e) = std::fs::rename(&newf, exe) { let _ = std::fs::rename(&oldf, exe); return Err(format!("rename new: {e}")); }
    Ok(Some(ver))
}
```

`app/native/kzguard/build.rs`:

```rs
use std::{env, fs, path::Path};

fn main() {
    #[cfg(feature = "node")]
    napi_build::setup();
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=keys/key.hex");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=keys/kid");
    let hex = fs::read_to_string("keys/key.hex").expect("keys/key.hex");
    let kid = fs::read_to_string("keys/kid").expect("keys/kid").trim().to_string();
    let key: Vec<u8> = (0..hex.trim().len() / 2).map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&hex.trim()[i * 2..i * 2 + 2], 16).unwrap()).collect();
    let mut seed: u64 = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_nanos() as u64 ^ 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15;
    let mask: Vec<u8> = (0..key.len()).map(|_| { seed ^= seed << 13; seed ^= seed >> 7; seed ^= seed << 17; (seed >> 24) as u8 }).collect();
    let enc: Vec<u8> = key.iter().zip(&mask).map(|(k, m)| k ^ m).collect();
    let out = Path::new(&env::var("OUT_DIR").unwrap()).join("key.rs");
    fs::write(out, format!("pub const KID: &str = {:?};\npub static KA: [u8; {}] = {:?};\npub static KB: [u8; {}] = {:?};\n", kid, enc.len(), enc, mask.len(), mask)).unwrap();
}
```

```rs
fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let mode = a.get(1).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("none");
    #[cfg(windows)]
    unsafe {
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::Memory::*;
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::*;
        if mode == "map" {
            let b = std::fs::read(&a[2]).unwrap();
            let p = VirtualAlloc(std::ptr::null(), b.len(), MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) as *mut u8;
            std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(b.as_ptr(), p, b.len());
        }
        if mode == "image" {
            let w: Vec<u16> = a[2].encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
            let h = LoadLibraryExW(w.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null_mut(), DONT_RESOLVE_DLL_REFERENCES);
            eprintln!("loaded: {}", !h.is_null());
        }
    }
    let r = kzguard::game_inject(std::process::id());
    println!("{} sig={} mz={} mods={}", mode, r["sig"], r["mem"]["mz"], r["mods"]);
}
```
