`app/native/kzguard/src/common.rs`:

```rs
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::fs;
use std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom};
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::UNIX_EPOCH;

pub fn hex(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    const H: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789abcdef";
    let mut s = String::with_capacity(b.len() * 2);
    for x in b { s.push(H[(x >> 4) as usize] as char); s.push(H[(x & 15) as usize] as char); }
    s
}
pub fn sha_hex(b: &[u8]) -> String { hex(&Sha256::digest(b)) }

pub fn base_name(s: &str) -> String { s.rsplit(|c| c == '/' || c == '\\').next().unwrap_or("").trim().to_string() }
pub fn norm_proc(s: &str) -> String {
    let b = base_name(s).to_lowercase();
    for ext in [".exe", ".x86_64", ".app", ".bin"] { if let Some(x) = b.strip_suffix(ext) { return x.to_string(); } }
    b
}
pub fn name_hash(n: &str) -> String { sha_hex(format!("kzac:{n}").as_bytes()) }
pub fn is_game_name(n: &str) -> bool {
    let l = base_name(n).to_lowercase();
    l == "combatmaster" || l == "combatmaster.exe" || l == "combatmaster.x86_64"
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Proc { pub pid: u32, pub name: String, pub argv0: String }

fn mtime(m: &fs::Metadata) -> u128 { m.modified().ok().and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok()).map(|d| d.as_nanos()).unwrap_or(0) }

static FULL: Mutex<Option<HashMap<String, (u64, u128, String)>>> = Mutex::new(None);
static QUICK: Mutex<Option<HashMap<String, (u64, u128, String)>>> = Mutex::new(None);

pub fn full_hash(p: &Path) -> Option<(u64, String)> {
    let m = fs::metadata(p).ok()?;
    let key = p.to_string_lossy().to_string();
    let (sz, mt) = (m.len(), mtime(&m));
    if let Some((s, t, h)) = FULL.lock().ok()?.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).get(&key) { if *s == sz && *t == mt { return Some((sz, h.clone())); } }
    let mut f = fs::File::open(p).ok()?;
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; 1 << 20];
    loop { let n = f.read(&mut buf).ok()?; if n == 0 { break; } h.update(&buf[..n]); }
    let r = hex(&h.finalize());
    FULL.lock().ok()?.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).insert(key, (sz, mt, r.clone()));
    Some((sz, r))
}
pub fn quick_hash(p: &Path) -> Option<(u64, String)> {
    let m = fs::metadata(p).ok()?;
    let key = p.to_string_lossy().to_string();
    let (sz, mt) = (m.len(), mtime(&m));
    if let Some((s, t, h)) = QUICK.lock().ok()?.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).get(&key) { if *s == sz && *t == mt { return Some((sz, h.clone())); } }
    let mut f = fs::File::open(p).ok()?;
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    h.update(sz.to_string().as_bytes());
    let n = sz.min(1 << 20) as usize;
    let mut b = vec![0u8; n]; f.read_exact(&mut b).ok()?; h.update(&b);
    if sz > n as u64 {
        let k = (sz - n as u64).min(1 << 20) as usize;
        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(sz - k as u64)).ok()?;
        let mut e = vec![0u8; k]; f.read_exact(&mut e).ok()?; h.update(&e);
    }
    let r = hex(&h.finalize());
    QUICK.lock().ok()?.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).insert(key, (sz, mt, r.clone()));
    Some((sz, r))
}

fn ends_ci(s: &str, suf: &str) -> bool { s.len() >= suf.len() && s.is_char_boundary(s.len() - suf.len()) && s[s.len() - suf.len()..].eq_ignore_ascii_case(suf) }
fn skip_file(n: &str) -> bool { [".log", ".tmp", ".dmp", ".bak", "desktop.ini", "thumbs.db"].iter().any(|x| ends_ci(n, x)) }
fn top_file(n: &str) -> bool {
    let l = n.to_lowercase();
    matches!(l.as_str(), "gameassembly.dll" | "gameassembly.so" | "combatmaster" | "combatmaster.exe" | "combatmaster.x86_64" | "unityplayer.dll" | "unityplayer.so")
}
fn full_hash_path(r: &str) -> bool {
    let l = r.to_lowercase();
    let p = "combatmaster_data/streamingassets/bundles/";
    if let Some(rest) = l.strip_prefix(p) { rest.starts_with("src/weapons/") || rest == "src/first_person" || rest.starts_with("ui/") } else { false }
}

static FILES_SENT: Mutex<Option<String>> = Mutex::new(None);

pub fn game_files(root: &Path, full: bool) -> serde_json::Value {
    if full { if let Ok(mut s) = FILES_SENT.lock() { *s = None; } }
    let mut out: Vec<(String, std::path::PathBuf)> = Vec::new();
    fn walk(d: &Path, rel: &str, out: &mut Vec<(String, std::path::PathBuf)>) {
        let Ok(rd) = fs::read_dir(d) else { return };
        for e in rd.flatten() {
            if out.len() >= 3000 { return; }
            let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
            let r = if rel.is_empty() { name.clone() } else { format!("{rel}/{name}") };
            let Ok(ft) = e.file_type() else { continue };
            if ft.is_dir() { if rel.is_empty() && name != "CombatMaster_Data" { continue; } walk(&e.path(), &r, out); }
            else if ft.is_file() && !skip_file(&name) && (!rel.is_empty() || top_file(&name)) { out.push((r, e.path())); }
        }
    }
    walk(root, "", &mut out);
    let mut list: Vec<(String, u64, String)> = Vec::new();
    for (r, f) in out {
        let fh = full_hash_path(&r);
        let h = if fh { full_hash(&f) } else { quick_hash(&f) };
        if let Some((sz, h)) = h { list.push((r, sz, format!("{}{}", if fh { "f:" } else { "q:" }, &h[..32]))); }
    }
    list.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.encode_utf16().cmp(b.0.encode_utf16()));
    let joined = list.iter().map(|(p, s, h)| format!("{p}|{s}|{h}")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n");
    let digest = sha_hex(joined.as_bytes());
    let mut sent = FILES_SENT.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let mut v = serde_json::json!({ "digest": digest, "n": list.len() });
    if sent.as_deref() != Some(digest.as_str()) {
        v["list"] = serde_json::Value::Array(list.iter().map(|(p, s, h)| serde_json::json!([p, s, h])).collect());
    }
    *sent = Some(digest);
    v
}

pub fn shell_integrity(module_path: &Path) -> serde_json::Value {
    let modh = full_hash(module_path).map(|x| x.1).unwrap_or_default();
    let native = module_path.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    let app = native.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    let an = app.file_name().map(|x| x.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
    if an.eq_ignore_ascii_case("app.asar.unpacked") {
        let asar = app.with_file_name("app.asar");
        let h = full_hash(&asar).map(|x| x.1).unwrap_or_default();
        return serde_json::json!({ "mod": modh, "kind": "asar", "shell": h });
    }
    let mut names: Vec<String> = fs::read_dir(app).map(|rd| rd.flatten().filter(|e| e.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false))
        .map(|e| e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string()).filter(|n| n.ends_with(".js") || n == "package.json").collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    names.sort();
    let mut h = Sha256::new();
    for n in &names { h.update(n.as_bytes()); h.update(b"\0"); if let Some((_, fh)) = full_hash(&app.join(n)) { h.update(fh.as_bytes()); } h.update(b"\n"); }
    serde_json::json!({ "mod": modh, "kind": "dir", "shell": hex(&h.finalize()), "files": names.len() })
}

pub fn exe_integrity(exe: &Path) -> serde_json::Value {
    let h = full_hash(exe).map(|x| x.1).unwrap_or_default();
    serde_json::json!({ "mod": h, "kind": "exe", "shell": h })
}

pub fn cpu_brand() -> String {
    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
    {
        use std::arch::x86_64::__cpuid;
        #[allow(unused_unsafe)]
        let max = unsafe { __cpuid(0x8000_0000) }.eax;
        if max < 0x8000_0004 { return String::new(); }
        let mut b = Vec::new();
        for l in 0x8000_0002u32..=0x8000_0004 { #[allow(unused_unsafe)] let r = unsafe { __cpuid(l) }; for x in [r.eax, r.ebx, r.ecx, r.edx] { b.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes()); } }
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&b).trim_matches(char::from(0)).trim().to_string()
    }
    #[cfg(not(target_arch = "x86_64"))]
    String::new()
}

pub fn group_by_name(items: Vec<serde_json::Value>, cap: usize) -> serde_json::Value {
    let mut order: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut map: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value> = HashMap::new();
    for v in items {
        let k = v["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase();
        if k.is_empty() { continue; }
        if let Some(e) = map.get_mut(&k) { e["n"] = serde_json::json!(e["n"].as_u64().unwrap_or(1) + 1); continue; }
        let mut v = v; v["n"] = serde_json::json!(1);
        order.push(k.clone()); map.insert(k, v);
        if order.len() >= cap { break; }
    }
    let mut out: Vec<serde_json::Value> = order.into_iter().filter_map(|k| map.remove(&k)).collect();
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase().cmp(&b["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_lowercase()));
    serde_json::Value::Array(out)
}

pub fn hypervisor() -> serde_json::Value {
    #[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
    {
        use std::arch::x86_64::__cpuid;
        #[allow(unused_unsafe)]
        let (l1, r) = unsafe { (__cpuid(1), __cpuid(0x4000_0000)) };
        if l1.ecx & (1 << 31) == 0 { return serde_json::json!(null); }
        let mut b = Vec::new();
        for x in [r.ebx, r.ecx, r.edx] { b.extend_from_slice(&x.to_le_bytes()); }
        let s: String = String::from_utf8_lossy(&b).chars().filter(|c| c.is_ascii_graphic() || *c == ' ').collect();
        serde_json::json!(s.trim())
    }
    #[cfg(not(target_arch = "x86_64"))]
    serde_json::json!(null)
}

static ALLOWED: std::sync::Mutex<Option<HashSet<String>>> = std::sync::Mutex::new(None);
fn home_tag() -> (String, &'static str) {
    if cfg!(windows) { (std::env::var("USERPROFILE").unwrap_or_default(), "%USERPROFILE%") } else { (std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_default(), "~") }
}
fn strip_prefix_ci<'a>(p: &'a str, pre: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    if pre.len() < 3 { return None; }
    let head = p.get(..pre.len())?;
    let rest = &p[pre.len()..];
    (head.eq_ignore_ascii_case(pre) && (rest.is_empty() || rest.starts_with('\\') || rest.starts_with('/'))).then_some(rest)
}
pub fn mask_path(p: &str) -> String {
    let (home, tag) = home_tag();
    let p = p.trim_start_matches("\\\\?\\");
    if let Some(rest) = strip_prefix_ci(p, home.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/'])) { return format!("{tag}{rest}"); }
    if cfg!(windows) { if let Ok(w) = std::env::var("SystemRoot") { if let Some(rest) = strip_prefix_ci(p, w.trim_end_matches('\\')) { return format!("%WINDIR%{rest}"); } } }
    p.chars().take(300).collect()
}
pub fn unmask_path(p: &str) -> String {
    let (home, tag) = home_tag();
    if let Some(rest) = p.strip_prefix(tag) { return format!("{}{rest}", home.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/'])); }
    if let Some(rest) = p.strip_prefix("%WINDIR%") { return format!("{}{rest}", std::env::var("SystemRoot").unwrap_or_else(|_| "C:\\Windows".into()).trim_end_matches('\\')); }
    p.to_string()
}
fn path_key(p: &str) -> String { p.trim_start_matches("\\\\?\\").replace('/', if cfg!(windows) { "\\" } else { "/" }).to_lowercase() }
pub fn allow_path(p: &str) { if p.is_empty() { return; } if let Ok(mut a) = ALLOWED.lock() { a.get_or_insert_with(HashSet::new).insert(path_key(p)); } }
pub fn reset_allowed() { if let Ok(mut a) = ALLOWED.lock() { *a = Some(HashSet::new()); } }
pub fn is_allowed(p: &str) -> bool {
    let l = path_key(p);
    let ext_ok = [".exe", ".dll", ".sys", ".asi", ".drv", ".ocx", ".so", ".ko"].iter().any(|e| l.ends_with(e)) || l.contains(".so.");
    ext_ok && ALLOWED.lock().ok().and_then(|a| a.as_ref().map(|s| s.contains(&l))).unwrap_or(false)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod pc_tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn mask_roundtrip_and_allow() {
        let (home, tag) = home_tag();
        let real = format!("{home}/Downloads/x/loader.so");
        let m = mask_path(&real);
        assert!(m.starts_with(tag) && !m.contains(&home), "{m}");
        assert_eq!(unmask_path(&m), real);
        reset_allowed();
        assert!(!is_allowed(&real));
        allow_path(&real);
        assert!(is_allowed(&real));
        let doc = format!("{home}/Documents/passwords.txt");
        allow_path(&doc);
        assert!(!is_allowed(&doc), "лише виконувані файли");
        assert_eq!(mask_path(&format!("{home}x/a.dll")), format!("{home}x/a.dll"), "префікс лише цілою текою");
    }
}
```

```rs
mod common;
#[cfg(windows)] mod sigs;
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")] mod linux;
#[cfg(target_os = "linux")] use linux as os;
#[cfg(windows)] mod win;
#[cfg(windows)] use win as os;

use common::*;
use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use sha2::Sha256;
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::time::Instant;

include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/key.rs"));
pub const GUARD: &str = "3.0";

#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(default, rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct Opts {
    nonce: String,
    ver: String,
    names: Vec<String>,
    hashes: Vec<String>,
    driver_hashes: Vec<String>,
    files: bool,
    files_full: bool,
    modules: bool,
    deep: bool,
    report: bool,
}

fn list_digest(v: &[String]) -> String {
    let mut s: Vec<&str> = v.iter().map(|x| x.as_str()).filter(|x| x.len() == 64 && x.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit())).collect();
    s.sort(); s.dedup();
    sha_hex(s.join("\n").as_bytes())
}

fn sign(d: &str) -> String {
    let key: Vec<u8> = KA.iter().zip(KB.iter()).map(|(a, b)| a ^ b).collect();
    let mut m = <Hmac<Sha256> as Mac>::new_from_slice(&key).expect("key");
    m.update(d.as_bytes());
    hex(&m.finalize().into_bytes())
}

fn match_procs(procs: &[Proc], want: &HashSet<String>, want_h: &HashSet<&str>) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut hits: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for p in procs {
        let n = norm_proc(&p.name);
        if n.is_empty() { continue; }
        let h = if want.contains(&n) { n.clone() } else { let x = name_hash(&n); if want_h.contains(x.as_str()) { format!("h:{x}") } else { continue } };
        if !hits.contains(&h) { hits.push(h); }
    }
    hits
}

fn run(o: Opts) -> Value {
    let t0 = Instant::now();
    let procs = os::list_procs();
    let game = procs.iter().find(|p| is_game_name(&p.name) || is_game_name(&p.argv0)).cloned();
    let want: HashSet<String> = o.names.iter().map(|n| norm_proc(n)).filter(|n| !n.is_empty()).take(500).collect();
    let want_h: HashSet<&str> = o.hashes.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).filter(|s| s.len() == 64).take(2000).collect();
    let hits = match_procs(&procs, &want, &want_h);
    let exe_path = game.as_ref().and_then(os::game_exe);
    let (mut exe, mut ga, mut files) = (Value::Null, Value::Null, Value::Null);
    if let Some(ep) = &exe_path {
        if let Some((sz, h)) = full_hash(ep) { exe = json!({ "name": base_name(&ep.to_string_lossy()), "size": sz, "hash": h }); }
        let dir = ep.parent().unwrap_or(std::path::Path::new("."));
        for g in ["GameAssembly.dll", "GameAssembly.so"] { let f = dir.join(g); if f.exists() { if let Some((sz, h)) = full_hash(&f) { ga = json!({ "size": sz, "hash": h }); } break; } }
        if o.files { files = game_files(dir, o.files_full); }
    }
    let game_dir = exe_path.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|x| x.to_path_buf()));
    let (mut modules, mut inject) = (Value::Null, Value::Null);
    if let (true, Some(g)) = (o.modules || o.deep, &game) {
        let (names, x) = os::modules(g, game_dir.as_deref());
        if o.modules { modules = json!(names); }
        if o.deep { inject = x; }
    }
    let mut deep = Value::Null;
    if let (true, Some(g)) = (o.deep, &game) {
        deep = os::deep(g.pid);
        let want_d: HashSet<&str> = o.driver_hashes.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
        let drv: Vec<String> = deep["drivers"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default().iter().filter_map(|x| x.as_str())
            .map(|n| name_hash(n.trim_end_matches(".sys").trim_end_matches(".ko"))).filter(|h| want_d.contains(h.as_str())).map(|h| format!("h:{h}"))
            .collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>().into_iter().collect();
        deep["drivers"] = json!(drv);
        deep["inject"] = inject;
    }
    let rep = if o.report { std::panic::catch_unwind(|| os::report(game.as_ref(), game_dir.as_deref())).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "err": "panic" })) } else { Value::Null };
    let self_info = os::module_path().map(|p| if cfg!(feature = "node") { shell_integrity(&p) } else { exe_integrity(&p) }).unwrap_or(json!({ "err": "path" }));
    let mut selfv = os::self_check();
    if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (selfv.as_object_mut(), self_info.as_object()) { for (k, v) in b { a.insert(k.clone(), v.clone()); } }
    json!({
        "v": 2, "gv": GUARD, "kid": KID, "nonce": o.nonce, "ts": std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64).unwrap_or(0),
        "platform": if cfg!(windows) { "win32" } else { "linux" }, "ver": o.ver,
        "found": game.is_some(), "proc": game.as_ref().map(|g| base_name(&g.name)), "exe": exe, "ga": ga, "files": files, "modules": modules,
        "hits": hits, "deep": deep, "sys": if o.deep { os::sys() } else { Value::Null }, "self": selfv,
        "lh": list_digest(&o.hashes), "dh": list_digest(&o.driver_hashes), "req": { "files": o.files, "modules": o.modules, "deep": o.deep, "report": o.report }, "rep": rep,
        "scanned": procs.len(), "ms": t0.elapsed().as_millis() as u64,
    })
}

pub fn scan_signed(opts: &str) -> String {
    let o: Opts = serde_json::from_str(opts).unwrap_or_default();
    let doc = std::panic::catch_unwind(move || run(o)).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "v": 2, "gv": GUARD, "kid": KID, "err": "panic" }));
    let d = doc.to_string();
    let s = sign(&d);
    json!({ "d": d, "s": s, "kid": KID }).to_string()
}

pub fn pc_file(masked: &str) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    let real = unmask_path(masked);
    if !is_allowed(&real) {
        let procs = os::list_procs();
        let game = procs.iter().find(|p| is_game_name(&p.name) || is_game_name(&p.argv0)).cloned();
        let gd = game.as_ref().and_then(os::game_exe).and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|x| x.to_path_buf()));
        let _ = std::panic::catch_unwind(|| os::report(game.as_ref(), gd.as_deref()));
        if !is_allowed(&real) { return None; }
    }
    let p = std::path::PathBuf::from(&real);
    p.is_file().then_some(p)
}

pub fn find_game() -> Option<u32> {
    os::list_procs().into_iter().find(|p| is_game_name(&p.name) || is_game_name(&p.argv0)).map(|p| p.pid)
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub fn game_handles(pid: u32) -> Value { std::panic::catch_unwind(|| win::handles(pid)).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "err": "panic" })) }

pub fn proc_hits(names: &[String], hashes: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let want: HashSet<String> = names.iter().map(|n| norm_proc(n)).filter(|n| !n.is_empty()).take(500).collect();
    let want_h: HashSet<&str> = hashes.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).filter(|s| s.len() == 64).take(2000).collect();
    if want.is_empty() && want_h.is_empty() { return Vec::new(); }
    match_procs(&os::list_procs(), &want, &want_h)
}

pub fn sys_state() -> Value { std::panic::catch_unwind(os::sys).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "err": "panic" })) }

pub fn game_inject(pid: u32) -> Value {
    std::panic::catch_unwind(|| {
        let procs = os::list_procs();
        let Some(g) = procs.iter().find(|p| p.pid == pid) else { return json!({ "err": "gone" }) };
        let gd = os::game_exe(g).and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|x| x.to_path_buf()));
        os::modules(g, gd.as_deref()).1
    }).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "err": "panic" }))
}

pub fn scan_svc(opts: &str, svc: Value) -> String {
    let mut o: Opts = serde_json::from_str(opts).unwrap_or_default();
    o.nonce = format!("svc:{}", o.nonce);
    o.files = false; o.files_full = false; o.report = false; o.modules = true; o.deep = true;
    let mut doc = std::panic::catch_unwind(move || run(o)).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "v": 2, "gv": GUARD, "kid": KID, "err": "panic" }));
    if let Some(s) = doc.get_mut("self").and_then(|x| x.as_object_mut()) { s.insert("kind".into(), json!("svc")); }
    doc["svc"] = svc;
    let d = doc.to_string();
    let s = sign(&d);
    json!({ "d": d, "s": s, "kid": KID }).to_string()
}
```

```rs
use crate::common::*;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;

pub fn list_procs() -> Vec<Proc> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let Ok(rd) = fs::read_dir("/proc") else { return out };
    for e in rd.flatten() {
        let n = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        let Ok(pid) = n.parse::<u32>() else { continue };
        let argv = fs::read(format!("/proc/{pid}/cmdline")).unwrap_or_default();
        let argv0 = String::from_utf8_lossy(argv.split(|b| *b == 0).next().unwrap_or(&[])).to_string();
        let comm = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/comm")).unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string();
        if argv0.is_empty() && comm.is_empty() { continue; }
        let name = { let b = base_name(&argv0); if b.is_empty() { comm.clone() } else { b } };
        out.push(Proc { pid, name, argv0 });
    }
    out
}

pub fn game_exe(p: &Proc) -> Option<PathBuf> {
    if let Ok(x) = fs::read_link(format!("/proc/{}/exe", p.pid)) { if is_game_name(&x.to_string_lossy()) { return Some(x); } }
    let a = &p.argv0;
    if a.len() > 2 && (a.starts_with("Z:") || a.starts_with("z:")) {
        let f = PathBuf::from(a[2..].replace('\\', "/"));
        if f.exists() { return Some(f); }
    }
    None
}

pub fn modules(p: &Proc, _game_dir: Option<&std::path::Path>) -> (Vec<String>, Value) {
    let maps = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{}/maps", p.pid)).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut names = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    let (mut rx, mut rx_bytes) = (0u64, 0u64);
    for l in maps.lines() {
        let cols: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect();
        if cols.len() < 5 { continue; }
        let file = if cols.len() > 5 { cols[5..].join(" ") } else { String::new() };
        let lf = file.to_lowercase();
        let is_lib = lf.ends_with(".dll") || lf.ends_with(".so") || lf.contains(".so.");
        if is_lib { names.insert(base_name(&file.replace('\\', "/")).to_lowercase()); }
        if cols[1].contains('x') && file.is_empty() {
            let (a, b) = cols[0].split_once('-').unwrap_or(("0", "0"));
            let sz = u64::from_str_radix(b, 16).unwrap_or(0).saturating_sub(u64::from_str_radix(a, 16).unwrap_or(0));
            rx += 1; rx_bytes += sz;
        }
    }
    (names.into_iter().take(600).collect(), json!({ "mods": [], "mem": { "rx": rx, "rxKb": rx_bytes / 1024, "mz": 0 }, "threads": null }))
}

pub fn deep(game_pid: u32) -> Value {
    let me = std::process::id();
    let mut handles = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(s) = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{game_pid}/status")) {
        if let Some(t) = s.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("TracerPid:")).and_then(|x| x.trim().parse::<u32>().ok()) { if t > 0 { handles.push((t, "ptrace")); } }
    }
    let target = format!("/proc/{game_pid}/mem");
    if let Ok(rd) = fs::read_dir("/proc") {
        for e in rd.flatten() {
            let Ok(pid) = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().parse::<u32>() else { continue };
            if pid == game_pid || pid == me { continue; }
            let Ok(fds) = fs::read_dir(format!("/proc/{pid}/fd")) else { continue };
            if fds.flatten().any(|f| fs::read_link(f.path()).map(|t| t.to_string_lossy() == target).unwrap_or(false)) { handles.push((pid, "mem")); }
        }
    }
    let hs: Vec<Value> = handles.iter().map(|(pid, how)| {
        let name = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/comm")).unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string();
        json!({ "name": name, "company": "", "sys": false, "signed": null, "read": true, "write": *how == "mem", "how": how })
    }).collect();
    let drivers: Vec<String> = fs::read_to_string("/proc/modules").unwrap_or_default().lines().filter_map(|l| l.split_whitespace().next().map(|s| s.to_lowercase())).collect();
    json!({ "v": 2, "handles": hs, "overlays": [], "drivers": drivers })
}

pub fn sys() -> Value {
    let tainted = fs::read_to_string("/proc/sys/kernel/tainted").ok().and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<u64>().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
    json!({ "os": "linux", "tainted": tainted, "hv": hypervisor() })
}

pub fn self_check() -> Value {
    let tracer = fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/status").ok().and_then(|s| s.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("TracerPid:").map(|x| x.trim().parse::<u32>().unwrap_or(0)))).unwrap_or(0);
    let cmd = String::from_utf8_lossy(&fs::read("/proc/self/cmdline").unwrap_or_default()).replace('\0', " ");
    let preload = std::env::var("LD_PRELOAD").map(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or(false);
    json!({ "dbg": tracer > 0, "inspect": cmd.contains("--inspect") || cmd.contains("--remote-debugging"), "sbx": false, "preload": preload })
}

pub fn module_path() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let addr = module_path as usize;
    let maps = fs::read_to_string("/proc/self/maps").ok()?;
    for l in maps.lines() {
        let cols: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect();
        if cols.len() < 6 { continue; }
        let (a, b) = cols[0].split_once('-')?;
        let (a, b) = (usize::from_str_radix(a, 16).ok()?, usize::from_str_radix(b, 16).ok()?);
        if addr >= a && addr < b { return Some(PathBuf::from(cols[5..].join(" "))); }
    }
    None
}

fn loc_unix(p: &str) -> &'static str {
    let l = p.to_lowercase();
    if l.is_empty() { "?" }
    else if l.contains("/steamapps/common/combat master") || l.contains("/combat master/") { "game" }
    else if l.contains("/wine") || l.contains("/proton") || l.contains("/pfx/") || l.contains("drive_c") { "wine" }
    else if l.starts_with("/usr/") || l.starts_with("/bin/") || l.starts_with("/sbin/") || l.starts_with("/lib") { "sys" }
    else if l.starts_with("/opt/") || l.contains("/.local/share/steam/") || l.contains("/.steam/") || l.contains("/flatpak/") || l.starts_with("/snap/") { "pf" }
    else if l.starts_with("/tmp/") || l.starts_with("/dev/shm/") || l.contains("/.cache/") { "temp" }
    else if l.contains("/downloads/") || l.contains("/desktop/") || l.contains("/завантаження/") || l.contains("/загрузки/") { "user" }
    else if l.starts_with("/home/") || l.starts_with("/root/") { "appdata" }
    else { "other" }
}

pub fn report(game: Option<&Proc>, _game_dir: Option<&std::path::Path>) -> Value {
    let me = std::process::id();
    reset_allowed();
    let mut items = Vec::new();
    for p in list_procs() {
        if p.pid == me { continue; }
        let exe = fs::read_link(format!("/proc/{}/exe", p.pid)).map(|x| x.to_string_lossy().to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        let wine = p.argv0.contains('\\') || p.argv0.to_lowercase().ends_with(".exe");
        let loc = if wine { let a = p.argv0.to_lowercase(); if a.contains("\\windows\\") { "sys" } else if a.contains("combat master") { "game" } else { loc_unix(&a.replace('\\', "/")) } } else { loc_unix(&exe) };
        let name = if wine { base_name(&p.argv0) } else { p.name.clone() };
        let shown = if wine { p.argv0.chars().take(300).collect() } else { allow_path(&exe); mask_path(&exe) };
        items.push(json!({ "name": name, "company": "", "signed": null, "loc": loc, "wine": wine, "path": shown }));
    }
    let procs = group_by_name(items, 600);
    let mut mods = Vec::new();
    if let Some(g) = game {
        let maps = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{}/maps", g.pid)).unwrap_or_default();
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for l in maps.lines() {
            let cols: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect();
            if cols.len() < 6 { continue; }
            let file = cols[5..].join(" ");
            let lf = file.to_lowercase();
            if !(lf.ends_with(".dll") || lf.ends_with(".so") || lf.contains(".so.") || lf.ends_with(".exe")) { continue; }
            let name = base_name(&file.replace('\\', "/"));
            if !seen.insert(name.to_lowercase()) { continue; }
            let loc = if lf.contains("/windows/system32/") || lf.contains("/windows/syswow64/") { "sys" } else { loc_unix(&file) };
            allow_path(&file);
            mods.push(json!({ "name": name, "loc": loc, "signed": null, "company": "", "path": mask_path(&file) }));
            if mods.len() >= 400 { break; }
        }
    }
    let drivers: Vec<String> = fs::read_to_string("/proc/modules").unwrap_or_default().lines().filter_map(|l| l.split_whitespace().next().map(|s| s.to_lowercase())).take(500).collect();
    let os = fs::read_to_string("/etc/os-release").ok().and_then(|s| s.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("PRETTY_NAME=").map(|x| x.trim_matches('"').to_string()))).unwrap_or_default();
    let kernel = fs::read_to_string("/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease").unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string();
    let ram = fs::read_to_string("/proc/meminfo").ok().and_then(|s| s.lines().find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("MemTotal:").and_then(|x| x.trim().trim_end_matches("kB").trim().parse::<u64>().ok()))).unwrap_or(0);
    let up = fs::read_to_string("/proc/uptime").ok().and_then(|s| s.split_whitespace().next().and_then(|x| x.parse::<f64>().ok())).unwrap_or(0.0);
    json!({ "v": 1, "procs": procs, "windows": [], "mods": mods, "drivers": drivers,
            "sys": { "os": format!("{os} · {kernel}"), "cpu": cpu_brand(), "ramMb": ram / 1024, "upMin": (up / 60.0) as u64 } })
}
```

```rs
const K: u8 = 0x5A;
const fn x<const N: usize>(s: &[u8; N]) -> [u8; N] { let mut o = [0u8; N]; let mut i = 0; while i < N { o[i] = s[i] ^ K; i += 1; } o }

pub struct Sig { pub id: &'static str, pub needles: &'static [&'static [u8]], pub min: usize }

static CMI: [&[u8]; 9] = [
    &x(b"o_ResourcesStore_TrySpend"), &x(b"bHostGodModeAll"), &x(b"[CMI] Attempting to Kick PlayFabID"), &x(b"Combat-Master-Internal"),
    &x(b"CM  INTERNAL"), &x(b"bHostSpoofKills"), &x(b"o_GameClient_get_ProfileApi"), &x(b"bTriggerbotVisCheck"), &x(b"bHostKillAllEnemies"),
];
static MELON: [&[u8]; 3] = [&x(b"MelonLoader"), &x(b"--melonloader."), &x(b"melonloader")];
static BEPINEX: [&[u8]; 3] = [&x(b"doorstop_config.ini"), &x(b"BepInEx"), &x(b"UnityDoorstop")];
static CMU: [&[u8]; 2] = [&x(b"CombatMasterHack_Joelmatic"), &x(b"CombatMasterHack-Joelmatic")];
static IMGUI: [&[u8]; 3] = [&x(b"(Main menu bar)"), &x(b"*Missing Text*"), &x(b"NewFrame(): ClearActiveID")];

pub static SIGS: &[Sig] = &[
    Sig { id: "cmi", needles: &CMI, min: 2 },
    Sig { id: "melon", needles: &MELON, min: 1 },
    Sig { id: "bepinex", needles: &BEPINEX, min: 1 },
    Sig { id: "cmu", needles: &CMU, min: 1 },
    Sig { id: "imgui", needles: &IMGUI, min: 2 },
];

pub const MAX_NEEDLE: usize = 64;

pub fn decoded() -> Vec<(&'static str, usize, Vec<Vec<u8>>)> {
    SIGS.iter().map(|s| (s.id, s.min, s.needles.iter().map(|n| n.iter().map(|b| b ^ K).collect()).collect())).collect()
}

pub fn mark(buf: &[u8], dec: &[(&'static str, usize, Vec<Vec<u8>>)], seen: &mut [Vec<bool>]) {
    for (i, (_, _, needles)) in dec.iter().enumerate() {
        for (j, n) in needles.iter().enumerate() {
            if seen[i][j] || n.is_empty() || buf.len() < n.len() { continue; }
            let first = n[0];
            let mut k = 0;
            while k + n.len() <= buf.len() {
                match buf[k..buf.len() - n.len() + 1].iter().position(|b| *b == first) {
                    None => break,
                    Some(p) => { let at = k + p; if &buf[at..at + n.len()] == n.as_slice() { seen[i][j] = true; break; } k = at + 1; }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn hits(dec: &[(&'static str, usize, Vec<Vec<u8>>)], seen: &[Vec<bool>]) -> Vec<String> {
    dec.iter().zip(seen).filter(|((_, min, _), s)| s.iter().filter(|b| **b).count() >= *min).map(|((id, _, _), _)| id.to_string()).collect()
}
```

```rs
fn loc_of(lp: &str, game_dir: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {

    else if lp.contains("\\program files") || lp.contains("\\programdata\\") { "pf" }

static SIGNED: std::sync::Mutex<Option<HashMap<String, (u64, bool)>>> = std::sync::Mutex::new(None);
fn signed(path: &Path) -> bool {
    let key = path.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
    let size = std::fs::metadata(path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);
    if let Ok(mut c) = SIGNED.lock() { if let Some((s, v)) = c.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).get(&key) { if *s == size { return *v; } } }
    let w = wz(&path.to_string_lossy());
    let ok = unsafe {
        let mut fi: WINTRUST_FILE_INFO = std::mem::zeroed();
        fi.cbStruct = std::mem::size_of::<WINTRUST_FILE_INFO>() as u32;
        fi.pcwszFilePath = w.as_ptr();
        let mut d: WINTRUST_DATA = std::mem::zeroed();
        d.cbStruct = std::mem::size_of::<WINTRUST_DATA>() as u32;
        d.dwUIChoice = WTD_UI_NONE;
        d.fdwRevocationChecks = WTD_REVOKE_NONE;
        d.dwUnionChoice = WTD_CHOICE_FILE;
        d.Anonymous.pFile = &mut fi;
        d.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_VERIFY;
        d.dwProvFlags = WTD_CACHE_ONLY_URL_RETRIEVAL;
        let mut g = WINTRUST_ACTION_GENERIC_VERIFY_V2;
        let r = WinVerifyTrust(null_mut(), &mut g, &mut d as *mut _ as *mut c_void);
        d.dwStateAction = WTD_STATEACTION_CLOSE;
        WinVerifyTrust(null_mut(), &mut g, &mut d as *mut _ as *mut c_void);
        r == 0
    };
    if let Ok(mut c) = SIGNED.lock() { c.get_or_insert_with(HashMap::new).insert(key, (size, ok)); }
    ok
}
fn company(path: &Path) -> String {
    unsafe {
        let w = wz(&path.to_string_lossy());
        let mut z = 0u32;
        let n = GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(w.as_ptr(), &mut z);
        if n == 0 { return String::new(); }
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; n as usize];
        if GetFileVersionInfoW(w.as_ptr(), 0, n, buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void) == 0 { return String::new(); }
        let mut p: *mut c_void = null_mut(); let mut len = 0u32;
        let mut tr = (0x0409u16, 0x04B0u16);
        if VerQueryValueW(buf.as_ptr() as *const c_void, wz("\\VarFileInfo\\Translation").as_ptr(), &mut p, &mut len) != 0 && len >= 4 {
            let a = p as *const u16; tr = (*a, *a.add(1));
        }
        let q = wz(&format!("\\StringFileInfo\\{:04x}{:04x}\\CompanyName", tr.0, tr.1));
        if VerQueryValueW(buf.as_ptr() as *const c_void, q.as_ptr(), &mut p, &mut len) == 0 || len == 0 { return String::new(); }
        let s = std::slice::from_raw_parts(p as *const u16, len as usize);
        wstr(s).chars().take(80).collect()
    }
}
fn proc_info(pid: u32) -> Value {
    let path = image_path(pid);
    let name = path.as_ref().map(|p| base_name(&p.to_string_lossy())).unwrap_or_default();
    let lp = path.as_ref().map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase()).unwrap_or_default();

}

pub fn modules(p: &Proc, game_dir: Option<&Path>) -> (Vec<String>, Value) {
    let gd = game_dir.map(|g| format!("{}\\", g.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase()));
    let Some(h) = open(p.pid, PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ) else { return (Vec::new(), json!({ "err": "open" })) };
    let mut mods: Vec<HMODULE> = vec![null_mut(); 1024];
    let mut need = 0u32;
    unsafe {
        if EnumProcessModulesEx(h.0, mods.as_mut_ptr(), (mods.len() * 8) as u32, &mut need, LIST_MODULES_ALL) == 0 { return (Vec::new(), json!({ "err": "enum" })); }
        if need as usize > mods.len() * 8 { mods = vec![null_mut(); need as usize / 8 + 16]; EnumProcessModulesEx(h.0, mods.as_mut_ptr(), (mods.len() * 8) as u32, &mut need, LIST_MODULES_ALL); }
    }
    mods.truncate((need as usize / 8).min(mods.len()));
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut ranges: Vec<(usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
    let mut odd = Vec::new();
    let mut scan_mods: Vec<(usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
    for m in &mods {
        let mut buf = vec![0u16; 1024];
        let n = unsafe { GetModuleFileNameExW(h.0, *m, buf.as_mut_ptr(), buf.len() as u32) };
        let mut mi: MODULEINFO = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        if unsafe { GetModuleInformation(h.0, *m, &mut mi, std::mem::size_of::<MODULEINFO>() as u32) } != 0 { ranges.push((mi.lpBaseOfDll as usize, mi.lpBaseOfDll as usize + mi.SizeOfImage as usize)); }
        if n == 0 { continue; }
        let path = PathBuf::from(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n as usize]));
        let lp = path.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
        let name = base_name(&lp);
        names.insert(name.clone());
        let loc = loc_of(&lp, gd.as_deref());
        if loc == "sys" { continue; }
        if loc == "game" {
            if (mi.SizeOfImage as usize) <= SIG_PER_ALLOC && mi.SizeOfImage > 0 && !signed(&path) { scan_mods.push((mi.lpBaseOfDll as usize, mi.SizeOfImage as usize)); }
            continue;
        }
        if !signed(&path) {
            if odd.len() < 40 { odd.push(json!({ "name": name, "loc": loc, "signed": false })); }
            if mi.SizeOfImage > 0 { scan_mods.push((mi.lpBaseOfDll as usize, mi.SizeOfImage as usize)); }
        }
    }
    ranges.sort();
    let in_mod = |a: usize| ranges.iter().any(|(s, e)| a >= *s && a < *e);
    let (mut rx, mut rx_bytes, mut mz) = (0u64, 0u64, 0u64);
    let mut exec_alloc: HashSet<usize> = HashSet::new();
    let mut addr = 0usize;
    unsafe {
        loop {
            let mut mbi: MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION = std::mem::zeroed();
            if VirtualQueryEx(h.0, addr as *const c_void, &mut mbi, std::mem::size_of::<MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION>()) == 0 { break; }
            let exec = mbi.Protect & (PAGE_EXECUTE | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY) != 0;
            if mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && mbi.Type == MEM_PRIVATE && exec {
                rx += 1; rx_bytes += mbi.RegionSize as u64;
                exec_alloc.insert(mbi.AllocationBase as usize);
                if mbi.BaseAddress == mbi.AllocationBase {
                    let mut b = [0u8; 2]; let mut got = 0usize;
                    if ReadProcessMemory(h.0, mbi.BaseAddress, b.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, 2, &mut got) != 0 && got == 2 && &b == b"MZ" { mz += 1; }
                }
            }
            let next = (mbi.BaseAddress as usize).wrapping_add(mbi.RegionSize);
            if next <= addr || rx > 100_000 { break; }
            addr = next;
        }
    }
    let (mut threads, mut foreign) = (0u32, 0u32);
    unsafe {
        let snap = H(CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0));
        if snap.0 != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE {
            let mut te: THREADENTRY32 = std::mem::zeroed();
            te.dwSize = std::mem::size_of::<THREADENTRY32>() as u32;
            if Thread32First(snap.0, &mut te) != 0 {
                loop {
                    if te.th32OwnerProcessID == p.pid {
                        threads += 1;
                        let th = OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, 0, te.th32ThreadID);
                        if !th.is_null() {
                            let th = H(th);
                            let mut start: usize = 0;
                            if NtQueryInformationThread(th.0, 9, &mut start as *mut _ as *mut c_void, 8, null_mut()) == 0 && start != 0 && !in_mod(start) { foreign += 1; }
                        }
                    }
                    if Thread32Next(snap.0, &mut te) == 0 { break; }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let sig = std::panic::catch_unwind(std::panic::AssertUnwindSafe(|| sig_scan(h.0, &scan_mods, &exec_alloc))).unwrap_or_default();
    (names.into_iter().take(600).collect(), json!({ "mods": odd, "mem": { "rx": rx, "rxKb": rx_bytes / 1024, "mz": mz }, "threads": { "n": threads, "foreign": foreign }, "sig": sig }))
}

const SIG_PER_ALLOC: usize = 48 << 20;
const SIG_TOTAL: usize = 192 << 20;
const SIG_CHUNK: usize = 1 << 20;
fn readable(p: u32) -> bool { p & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD) == 0 && p != 0 }
fn sig_scan(h: HANDLE, mods: &[(usize, usize)], exec_alloc: &HashSet<usize>) -> Vec<String> {
    let dec = crate::sigs::decoded();
    let mut seen: Vec<Vec<bool>> = dec.iter().map(|(_, _, n)| vec![false; n.len()]).collect();
    let mut spans: Vec<(usize, usize)> = mods.iter().filter(|(_, n)| *n <= SIG_PER_ALLOC).map(|(b, n)| (*b, b + n)).collect();
    let mut per: HashMap<usize, usize> = HashMap::new();
    let mut addr = 0usize;
    unsafe {
        loop {
            let mut mbi: MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION = std::mem::zeroed();
            if VirtualQueryEx(h, addr as *const c_void, &mut mbi, std::mem::size_of::<MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION>()) == 0 { break; }
            let ab = mbi.AllocationBase as usize;
            if mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && mbi.Type == MEM_PRIVATE && readable(mbi.Protect) && exec_alloc.contains(&ab) {
                let used = per.entry(ab).or_insert(0);
                if *used + mbi.RegionSize <= SIG_PER_ALLOC { *used += mbi.RegionSize; spans.push((mbi.BaseAddress as usize, mbi.BaseAddress as usize + mbi.RegionSize)); }
            }
            let next = (mbi.BaseAddress as usize).wrapping_add(mbi.RegionSize);
            if next <= addr { break; }
            addr = next;
        }
    }
    let mut total = 0usize;
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; SIG_CHUNK + crate::sigs::MAX_NEEDLE];
    'outer: for (s, e) in spans {
        let mut a = s;
        while a < e {
            if total >= SIG_TOTAL { break 'outer; }
            let want = (e - a).min(SIG_CHUNK + crate::sigs::MAX_NEEDLE);
            let mut got = 0usize;
            if unsafe { ReadProcessMemory(h, a as *const c_void, buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, want, &mut got) } != 0 && got > 0 {
                crate::sigs::mark(&buf[..got], &dec, &mut seen);
            } else {
                let mut p = a;
                while p < a + want {
                    let n = (4096 - (p & 4095)).min(a + want - p);
                    let mut g = 0usize;
                    if unsafe { ReadProcessMemory(h, p as *const c_void, buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, n, &mut g) } != 0 && g > 0 { crate::sigs::mark(&buf[..g], &dec, &mut seen); }
                    p += n;
                }
            }
            total += want;
            if a + want >= e { break; }
            a += SIG_CHUNK;
        }
    }
    crate::sigs::hits(&dec, &seen)
}

#[repr(C)]
struct HandleEx { object: *mut c_void, pid: usize, handle: usize, access: u32, backtrace: u16, typ: u16, attrs: u32, reserved: u32 }

pub fn handles(game: u32) -> Value {
    const VM: u32 = 0x8 | 0x10 | 0x20;
    let me = std::process::id();
    unsafe {
        let self_h = match open(me, PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION) { Some(h) => h, None => return json!({ "err": "self" }) };
        let game_h = open(game, PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION);
        let mut len: u32 = 1 << 20;
        let mut buf: Vec<u8>;
        let mut st;
        let mut tries = 0;
        loop {
            buf = vec![0u8; len as usize];
            let mut ret = 0u32;
            st = NtQuerySystemInformation(64, buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, len, &mut ret);
            if st as u32 == 0xC0000004 && tries < 8 { tries += 1; len = (len * 2).max(ret + (1 << 16)); continue; }
            break;
        }
        if st != 0 { return json!({ "err": format!("ntq {:X}", st as u32) }); }
        let count = *(buf.as_ptr() as *const usize);
        let base = buf.as_ptr().add(16) as *const HandleEx;
        let max = (buf.len() - 16) / std::mem::size_of::<HandleEx>();
        let n = count.min(max);
        let (mut proc_type, mut game_obj): (i32, *mut c_void) = (-1, null_mut());
        for i in 0..n {
            let e = &*base.add(i);
            if e.pid as u32 != me { continue; }
            if e.handle == self_h.0 as usize { proc_type = e.typ as i32; }
            if let Some(g) = &game_h { if e.handle == g.0 as usize { game_obj = e.object; } }
        }
        if proc_type < 0 { return json!({ "err": "type" }); }
        let by_obj = !game_obj.is_null();
        let mut owners: HashMap<u32, u32> = HashMap::new();
        let mut opened: HashMap<u32, Option<H>> = HashMap::new();
        for i in 0..n {
            let e = &*base.add(i);
            let pid = e.pid as u32;
            if e.typ as i32 != proc_type || pid == game || pid == me || pid <= 4 || e.access & VM == 0 { continue; }
            if by_obj { if e.object == game_obj { *owners.entry(pid).or_default() |= e.access; } continue; }
            let owner = opened.entry(pid).or_insert_with(|| open(pid, PROCESS_DUP_HANDLE));
            let Some(o) = owner else { continue };
            let mut dup: HANDLE = null_mut();
            if DuplicateHandle(o.0, e.handle as HANDLE, GetCurrentProcess(), &mut dup, PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION, 0, 0) == 0 { continue; }
            let d = H(dup);
            if GetProcessId(d.0) == game { *owners.entry(pid).or_default() |= e.access; }
        }
        Value::Array(owners.iter().map(|(pid, a)| { let mut v = proc_info(*pid); v["read"] = json!(a & 0x10 != 0); v["write"] = json!(a & 0x20 != 0); v }).collect())
    }
}

unsafe extern "system" fn collect(h: HWND, l: LPARAM) -> BOOL { (*(l as *mut Vec<HWND>)).push(h); 1 }
pub fn overlays(game: u32) -> Value {
    let mut wins: Vec<HWND> = Vec::new();
    unsafe { EnumWindows(Some(collect), &mut wins as *mut _ as LPARAM); }
    let mut g = RECT { left: 0, top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0 }; let mut area = 0i64;
    for &h in &wins {
        let mut pid = 0u32; unsafe { GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, &mut pid); }
        if pid != game || unsafe { IsWindowVisible(h) } == 0 { continue; }
        let mut r: RECT = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        if unsafe { GetWindowRect(h, &mut r) } == 0 { continue; }
        let a = (r.right - r.left) as i64 * (r.bottom - r.top) as i64;
        if a > area { area = a; g = r; }
    }
    if area <= 0 { return json!([]); }
    let mut out = Vec::new(); let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    for &h in &wins {
        let mut pid = 0u32; unsafe { GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, &mut pid); }
        if pid == game || pid == std::process::id() || unsafe { IsWindowVisible(h) } == 0 { continue; }
        let ex = unsafe { GetWindowLongW(h, GWL_EXSTYLE) } as u32;
        let (top, layered, transparent) = (ex & WS_EX_TOPMOST != 0, ex & WS_EX_LAYERED != 0, ex & WS_EX_TRANSPARENT != 0);
        let mut aff = 0u32; unsafe { GetWindowDisplayAffinity(h, &mut aff); }
        let hidden = aff == 0x11;
        if !hidden && !(top && (layered || transparent)) { continue; }
        let mut r: RECT = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        if unsafe { GetWindowRect(h, &mut r) } == 0 { continue; }
        let ix = 0i64.max((r.right.min(g.right) - r.left.max(g.left)) as i64);
        let iy = 0i64.max((r.bottom.min(g.bottom) - r.top.max(g.top)) as i64);
        let cover = (100 * ix * iy / area) as i32;
        if cover < if hidden { 10 } else { 30 } { continue; }
        let mut cls = [0u16; 256]; unsafe { GetClassNameW(h, cls.as_mut_ptr(), 256); }
        let cls = wstr(&cls);
        if !seen.insert(format!("{pid}|{cls}")) { continue; }
        let mut v = proc_info(pid);
        v["cls"] = json!(cls); v["cover"] = json!(cover); v["clickThrough"] = json!(transparent); v["hidden"] = json!(hidden);
        out.push(v);
    }
    Value::Array(out)
}

pub fn drivers() -> Vec<String> {
    let mut need = 0u32;
    unsafe {
        let mut probe = [null_mut::<c_void>(); 1];
        EnumDeviceDrivers(probe.as_mut_ptr(), 8, &mut need);
        let mut bases = vec![null_mut::<c_void>(); (need as usize / 8).max(1)];
        if EnumDeviceDrivers(bases.as_mut_ptr(), (bases.len() * 8) as u32, &mut need) == 0 { return Vec::new(); }
        bases.iter().filter_map(|b| { let mut n = [0u16; 260]; if GetDeviceDriverBaseNameW(*b, n.as_mut_ptr(), 260) == 0 { None } else { Some(wstr(&n).to_lowercase()) } }).collect()
    }
}

fn drivers_full() -> Vec<Value> {
    let mut need = 0u32;
    let root = std::env::var("SystemRoot").unwrap_or_else(|_| "C:\\Windows".into());
    let drive = std::env::var("SystemDrive").unwrap_or_else(|_| "C:".into());
    unsafe {
        let mut probe = [null_mut::<c_void>(); 1];
        EnumDeviceDrivers(probe.as_mut_ptr(), 8, &mut need);
        let mut bases = vec![null_mut::<c_void>(); (need as usize / 8).max(1)];
        if EnumDeviceDrivers(bases.as_mut_ptr(), (bases.len() * 8) as u32, &mut need) == 0 { return Vec::new(); }
        let mut seen = HashSet::new();
        bases.iter().filter_map(|b| {
            let mut n = [0u16; 260];
            if GetDeviceDriverBaseNameW(*b, n.as_mut_ptr(), 260) == 0 { return None; }
            let name = wstr(&n).to_lowercase();
            if !seen.insert(name.clone()) { return None; }
            let mut f = [0u16; 520];
            let raw = if GetDeviceDriverFileNameW(*b, f.as_mut_ptr(), 520) == 0 { String::new() } else { wstr(&f) };
            let lr = raw.to_lowercase();
            let real = if lr.starts_with("\\systemroot\\") { format!("{root}{}", &raw[11..]) }
                else if lr.starts_with("\\??\\") { raw[4..].to_string() }
                else if lr.starts_with("\\windows\\") { format!("{drive}{raw}") }
                else if raw.is_empty() { String::new() }
                else { format!("{root}\\System32\\drivers\\{name}") };
            if !real.is_empty() { allow_path(&real); }
            Some(json!({ "name": name, "path": if real.is_empty() { String::new() } else { mask_path(&real) } }))
        }).take(500).collect()
    }
}

pub fn deep(game: u32) -> Value {
    let h = std::panic::catch_unwind(|| handles(game)).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "err": "panic" }));
    let o = std::panic::catch_unwind(|| overlays(game)).unwrap_or_else(|_| json!({ "err": "panic" }));
    json!({ "v": 2, "handles": h, "overlays": o, "drivers": drivers() })
}

pub fn sys() -> Value {
    unsafe {
        let mut ci = [8u32, 0u32];
        let ci_ok = NtQuerySystemInformation(103, ci.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, 8, null_mut()) == 0;
        let mut kd = [0u8; 2];
        let kd_ok = NtQuerySystemInformation(35, kd.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, 2, null_mut()) == 0;
        let f = ci[1];
        json!({ "os": "win", "ci": if ci_ok { json!(f) } else { json!(null) }, "testsign": ci_ok && f & 0x2 != 0, "dse": if ci_ok { json!(f & 0x1 != 0) } else { json!(null) },
                "debugmode": ci_ok && f & 0x80 != 0, "kdbg": kd_ok && kd[0] != 0 && kd[1] == 0, "hv": hypervisor() })
    }
}

pub fn self_check() -> Value {
    unsafe {
        let mut remote: BOOL = 0;
        CheckRemoteDebuggerPresent(GetCurrentProcess(), &mut remote);
        let cl = GetCommandLineW();
        let mut n = 0; while *cl.add(n) != 0 && n < 32768 { n += 1; }
        let cmd = String::from_utf16_lossy(std::slice::from_raw_parts(cl, n));
        let sbx = !GetModuleHandleW(wz("SbieDll.dll").as_ptr()).is_null();
        json!({ "dbg": IsDebuggerPresent() != 0 || remote != 0, "inspect": cmd.contains("--inspect") || cmd.contains("--remote-debugging"), "sbx": sbx, "preload": false })
    }
}

pub fn module_path() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    unsafe {
        let mut m: HMODULE = null_mut();
        if GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT, module_path as *const () as *const u16, &mut m) == 0 { return None; }
        let mut buf = vec![0u16; 1024];
        let n = GetModuleFileNameW(m, buf.as_mut_ptr(), buf.len() as u32);
        if n == 0 { None } else { Some(PathBuf::from(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n as usize]))) }
    }
}

fn windows_report(game: Option<u32>) -> Value {
    let mut wins: Vec<HWND> = Vec::new();
    unsafe { EnumWindows(Some(collect), &mut wins as *mut _ as LPARAM); }
    let mut g = RECT { left: 0, top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0 }; let mut area = 0i64;
    if let Some(gp) = game {
        for &h in &wins {
            let mut pid = 0u32; unsafe { GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, &mut pid); }
            if pid != gp || unsafe { IsWindowVisible(h) } == 0 { continue; }
            let mut r: RECT = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
            if unsafe { GetWindowRect(h, &mut r) } == 0 { continue; }
            let a = (r.right - r.left) as i64 * (r.bottom - r.top) as i64;
            if a > area { area = a; g = r; }
        }
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new(); let mut seen = HashSet::new(); let mut info: HashMap<u32, Value> = HashMap::new();
    for &h in &wins {
        let mut pid = 0u32; unsafe { GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, &mut pid); }
        if Some(pid) == game || pid == std::process::id() || unsafe { IsWindowVisible(h) } == 0 { continue; }
        let mut r: RECT = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        if unsafe { GetWindowRect(h, &mut r) } == 0 || r.right - r.left < 8 || r.bottom - r.top < 8 { continue; }
        let ex = unsafe { GetWindowLongW(h, GWL_EXSTYLE) } as u32;
        let (top, layered, transparent) = (ex & WS_EX_TOPMOST != 0, ex & WS_EX_LAYERED != 0, ex & WS_EX_TRANSPARENT != 0);
        let mut aff = 0u32; unsafe { GetWindowDisplayAffinity(h, &mut aff); }
        let hidden = aff == 0x11;
        let cover = if area > 0 {
            let ix = 0i64.max((r.right.min(g.right) - r.left.max(g.left)) as i64);
            let iy = 0i64.max((r.bottom.min(g.bottom) - r.top.max(g.top)) as i64);
            (100 * ix * iy / area) as i32
        } else { 0 };
        if area > 0 { if cover < 1 && !hidden { continue; } } else if !top && !hidden { continue; }
        let mut cls = [0u16; 256]; unsafe { GetClassNameW(h, cls.as_mut_ptr(), 256); }
        let cls = wstr(&cls);
        if !seen.insert(format!("{pid}|{cls}")) { continue; }
        let mut v = info.entry(pid).or_insert_with(|| proc_info(pid)).clone();
        v["cls"] = json!(cls); v["cover"] = json!(cover); v["top"] = json!(top); v["layered"] = json!(layered); v["clickThrough"] = json!(transparent); v["hidden"] = json!(hidden);
        out.push(v);
        if out.len() >= 80 { break; }
    }
    Value::Array(out)
}

fn modules_report(p: &Proc, game_dir: Option<&Path>) -> Value {
    let gd = game_dir.map(|g| format!("{}\\", g.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase()));
    let Some(h) = open(p.pid, PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION | PROCESS_VM_READ) else { return json!([]) };
    let mut mods: Vec<HMODULE> = vec![null_mut(); 2048];
    let mut need = 0u32;
    unsafe { if EnumProcessModulesEx(h.0, mods.as_mut_ptr(), (mods.len() * 8) as u32, &mut need, LIST_MODULES_ALL) == 0 { return json!([]); } }
    mods.truncate((need as usize / 8).min(mods.len()));
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for m in &mods {
        let mut buf = vec![0u16; 1024];
        let n = unsafe { GetModuleFileNameExW(h.0, *m, buf.as_mut_ptr(), buf.len() as u32) };
        if n == 0 { continue; }
        let path = PathBuf::from(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n as usize]));
        let lp = path.to_string_lossy().to_lowercase();
        let loc = loc_of(&lp, gd.as_deref());
        let (sig, comp) = if loc == "sys" { (json!(null), String::new()) } else { (json!(signed(&path)), company(&path)) };
        allow_path(&path.to_string_lossy());
        out.push(json!({ "name": base_name(&path.to_string_lossy()), "loc": loc, "signed": sig, "company": comp, "path": mask_path(&path.to_string_lossy()) }));
        if out.len() >= 400 { break; }
    }
    Value::Array(out)
}

pub fn report(game: Option<&Proc>, game_dir: Option<&Path>) -> Value {
    let me = std::process::id();
    reset_allowed();
    let mut items = Vec::new();
    for p in list_procs() {
        if p.pid <= 4 || p.pid == me { continue; }
        let mut v = proc_info(p.pid);
        if v["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").is_empty() { v["name"] = json!(base_name(&p.name)); v["loc"] = json!("?"); }
        items.push(v);
    }
    let procs = group_by_name(items, 600);
    let mods = game.map(|g| modules_report(g, game_dir)).unwrap_or(json!([]));
    let (ver, ram, up) = unsafe {
        let mut v: OsVer = std::mem::zeroed(); v.size = std::mem::size_of::<OsVer>() as u32;
        let ver = if RtlGetVersion(&mut v) == 0 { format!("Windows {}.{}.{}", v.major, v.minor, v.build) } else { String::new() };
        let mut ms: windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::MEMORYSTATUSEX = std::mem::zeroed();
        ms.dwLength = std::mem::size_of::<windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::MEMORYSTATUSEX>() as u32;
        let ram = if windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&mut ms) != 0 { ms.ullTotalPhys / (1 << 20) } else { 0 };
        (ver, ram, windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::GetTickCount64() / 60000)
    };
    let mut drv = drivers_full(); drv.sort_by(|a, b| a["name"].as_str().cmp(&b["name"].as_str()));
    json!({ "v": 1, "procs": procs, "windows": windows_report(game.map(|g| g.pid)), "mods": mods, "drivers": drv,
            "sys": { "os": ver, "cpu": cpu_brand(), "ramMb": ram, "upMin": up } })
}
```

```js
  async function mountFull(uid, fx, reqs) {

    if (only) { only.onchange = apply; apply(); }

  async function mount(uid, where) {
    const [x, reqs] = await Promise.all([api('/api/staff/ac-forensics?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(uid)).catch(() => null), api('/api/staff/ac-requests?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(uid)).catch(() => [])]);
    if (!x || !where?.isConnected || where.querySelector('.fx')) return;
    where.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html(x));
    const fx = where.querySelector('.fx');
    const drawReqs = list => {
      fx.querySelector('.fx-reqs')?.remove(); fx.querySelector('.fx-flags').insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', reqHtml(list));
      fx.querySelectorAll('[data-dl]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => { const j = await api('/api/staff/ac-file-link', { id: b.dataset.dl }); K.open(j.url); }));
    };
    drawReqs(reqs);
    const reloadReqs = async () => drawReqs(await api('/api/staff/ac-requests?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(uid)).catch(() => []));
    mountFull(uid, fx, reloadReqs);
    fx.querySelectorAll('[data-pcname]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => { b.disabled = true; await api('/api/staff/ac-request', { uid, name: b.dataset.pcname, pc: true }); toast(tx('rqSent')); reloadReqs(); }));
    fx.querySelectorAll('[data-ap]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
      if (!b.dataset.sure) { b.dataset.sure = 1; b.textContent = tx('apSure'); return; }
      b.disabled = true;
      await api('/api/admin/ac-approve', { uid, path: b.dataset.ap, note: 'cosmetic' });
      toast(tx('apDone'));
      const tr = b.closest('tr'), tag = tr?.querySelector('.tag'); if (tag) { tag.className = 'tag green'; tag.textContent = tx('apOk'); } b.remove();
    }));
    fx.querySelectorAll('[data-rq]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
      b.disabled = true;
      await api('/api/staff/ac-request', { uid, path: b.dataset.rq });
      toast(tx('rqSent'));
      drawReqs(await api('/api/staff/ac-requests?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(uid)).catch(() => []));
    }));
  }

  function flagRow(f) {
    const short = n => n.length > 34 ? n.slice(0, 22) + '…' + n.slice(-10) : n;
    const v = { ...f, list: (f.list || []).slice(0, 4).map(short).join(', ') + ((f.list || []).length > 4 ? ' …' : ''), cats: (f.cats || []).map(c => tx('cat_' + c)).join(', ') };
    const tab = TAB_OF[f.code];
    return `<button class="aw-flag s${sev(f)}"${tab ? ` data-goto="${tab}"` : ' disabled'}><i></i><span>${esc(tx('f_' + f.code, v))}</span>${tab ? `<em>${tx('w_' + tab)} →</em>` : ''}</button>`;
  }

  function overHtml(a, x) {
    const sig = [...(a.signals || [])].sort((p, q) => q.pts - p.pts);
    const max = Math.max(10, ...sig.map(s => s.pts));
    const flags = [...(x?.flags || [])].sort((p, q) => sev(p) - sev(q));
    const anyStrong = flags.some(f => STRONG.has(f.code) || f.code === 'bundles');
    return `<div class="aw-cols">
      <section><h5>${tx('w_why')}</h5>${sig.length ? sig.map(s => `<div class="aw-sig ${s.pts >= 20 ? 'hi' : s.pts >= 10 ? 'mid' : ''}"><b>+${s.pts}</b><div><span>${t('ac_' + s.code, s)}</span><i><u style="width:${Math.round(s.pts / max * 100)}%"></u></i></div></div>`).join('') : empty(t('acNoSignals'))}</section>
      <section><h5>${tx('w_find')}</h5>${flags.length ? `<div class="aw-flags">${flags.map(flagRow).join('')}</div>` : empty(tx('fxNone'))}
        ${anyStrong ? `<p class="fx-ask">${tx('fxAsk')}</p>` : ''}</section></div>
      <p class="mute aw-disc">${t('acDisclaimer')}</p>`;
  }

  function filesHtml(x) {
    const F = x?.files;
    if (!F) return empty(tx('w_noFiles'));
    const d = F.diff || [];

    const admin = S.me?.admin || S.me?.auditor;
    return `<div class="aw-meta">${fmtDT(F.at)} · ${F.n} · ${!F.ref ? tx('fxNoRef') : F.same ? `<b class="win">${tx('fxRefOk', { n: F.refUsers })}</b>` : `<b class="lose">${tx('fxRefBad', { n: F.refUsers })}</b>`}${F.sameUsers && !F.same ? ' · ' + tx('fxSame', { n: F.sameUsers }) : ''}</div>
      ${F.history?.length > 1 ? `<div class="aw-hist"><span class="mute">${tx('fxHist')}:</span>${F.history.map(h => `<span class="tag ${h.ref ? 'green' : 'red'}">${fmtDT(h.at)} · ${esc(h.digest)}${h.ref ? ' · ' + tx('fxHistRef') : ''}</span>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}
      ${d.length ? `<div class="aw-bar"><div class="seg aw-chips">${chips.map(([k, n], i) => `<button data-fs="${k}" class="${i ?       <table class="aw-tbl"><tbody>${d.map(r => `<tr data-s="${r.s}${r.tool ? ' tool' : ''}" data-q="${esc((r.p + ' ' + tx('cat_' + r.cat)).toLowerCase())}" class="${r.tool ? 'tool' : ''}">

        <td title="${esc(r.p)}"><span class="aw-p">${esc(shortP(r.p))}</span>${r.tool ? ` <em class="fx-tool">${tx('tool')}</em>` : ''}<div class="mute">${tx('cat_' + r.cat)}</div></td>
        <td class="num">${r.s === 'changed' ? `${mb(r.ref)} → ${mb(r.me)}${r.pct != null ? ` <b class="${Math.abs(r.pct) >= 30 ? 'lose' : ''}">${r.pct > 0 ? '+' : ''}${r.pct}%</b>` : ''}` : mb(r.s === 'missing' ? r.ref : r.me)}</td>
        <td class="act">${r.s !== 'missing' ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-rq="${esc(r.p)}">${tx('rqBtn')}</button>` : ''}${r.s !== 'missing' && !r.ok && admin ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-ap="${esc(r.p)}">${tx('apBtn')}</button>` : ''}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>
      <div class="aw-empty aw-none" hidden>${tx('w_nothing')}</div>` : empty(tx('w_filesSame'))}`;
  }

  function checksHtml(x) {

  function wireFilter(root, sel) {
    const q = root.querySelector('.aw-q'), only = root.querySelector('.fu-only');
    const apply = () => {
      const s = (q?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase(), chip = root.querySelector('.aw-chips .on')?.dataset.fs || 'all';
      (sel ? [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)] : [root]).forEach(pane => {
        let n = 0;
        pane.querySelectorAll('tr[data-q]').forEach(tr => {
          const ok = (!s || tr.dataset.q.includes(s)) && (chip === 'all' || tr.dataset.s?.split(' ').includes(chip)) && (!only?.checked || tr.classList.contains('fu-m'));
          tr.hidden = !ok; if (ok) n++;
        });
        const none = pane.querySelector('.aw-none'); if (none) none.hidden = !!n;
      });
    };
    q && (q.oninput = apply); only && (only.onchange = apply);
    root.querySelectorAll('.aw-chips button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { root.querySelectorAll('.aw-chips button').forEach(z => z.classList.toggle('on', z === b)); apply(); });
    root.querySelectorAll('.aw-sub button').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { root.querySelectorAll('.aw-sub button').forEach(z => z.classList.toggle('on', z === b)); root.querySelectorAll('.aw-pane').forEach(p => p.hidden = p.dataset.pane !== b.dataset.sub); });
    apply();
  }
```

```js

function cosmeticSource(kind, id) {
  const pi = S.premInfo;
  if (S.shop?.items?.some(x => x.id === id && x.kind + 's' === kind)) return t('srcShop');
  if (/^Konzte_/.test(id)) return t('srcSeasonReward');
  if (PASS_FRAMES.includes(id) || PASS_BANNERS.includes(id)) return t('srcPassReward');
  if (typeof XMAS !== 'undefined' && [...XMAS.BANNERS, ...XMAS.FRAMES, ...XMAS.AVATARS].includes(id)) return kzPick({ en: 'Christmas tree · star reward', uk: 'Ялинка · нагорода за зірку', ru: 'Ёлка · награда за звезду' });
  if (/^s1_top\d+$/.test(id)) return t('srcSeason', { n: id.slice(6) + ' · 2×2' });
  if (/^a3_s2_(2v2_)?top\d+$/.test(id)) return 'Season 2 · ' + (id.includes('2v2') ? '2×2 ' : '5×5 ') + 'TOP ' + id.match(/\d+$/)[0];
  if (/^s1_2v2_top\d+$/.test(id)) return t('srcSeason', { n: id.slice(10) + ' · 1×1' });
  if (id === 'founder') return t('srcFounder');
  if (id === 's1_recruiter') return t('srcRecruiter');
  if (kind === 'emblems') {
    if (pi?.emblemsFree?.includes(id)) return t('free');
    const a = S.achList?.find(x => x.reward?.emblem === id);
    if (a) return t('srcAch', { n: t('a_' + a.id) });
    return pi?.tiers?.premium?.emblems?.includes(id) ? t('srcPremium') : t('srcPlus');
  }
  if (!id.startsWith('a_')) return pi?.tiers?.premium?.[kind]?.includes(id) ? t('srcPremium') : t('srcPlus');
  const a = S.achList?.find(x => x.reward?.[kind === 'banners' ? 'banner' : 'frame'] === id);
  return a ? t('srcAch', { n: t('a_' + a.id) }) : '';
}

const verLt = (a, b) => { const x = String(a).split('.').map(Number), y = String(b).split('.').map(Number); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) if ((x[i] || 0) !== (y[i] || 0)) return (x[i] || 0) < (y[i] || 0); return false; };
function checkUiUpdate() {
  S.uiChecked = Date.now();
  if (!S.appInfo || !S.server || document.querySelector('.uinote')) return;
  fetch(S.server.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/update/manifest.json?t=' + Date.now()).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null).then(m => {
    const need = m?.notify ?? m?.ui;
    if (!m || !(need > (S.appInfo.ui || 0)) || need === S.uiDismissed) return;
    if (m.minShell && verLt(S.appInfo.version, m.minShell)) return;
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'uinote';
    el.innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 4v11M7 10l5 5 5-5M5 20h14"/></svg><span>${t('uiNew')}</span>
      <button class="btn sm" data-uin="go">${t('uiUpdate')}</button><button class="uinote-x" data-uin="x" title="${t('later')}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg></button>`;
    el.querySelector('[data-uin="go"]').onclick = () => {
      if (S.live?.match && !confirm(t('uiUpdateInMatch'))) return;
      el.querySelector('[data-uin="go"]').disabled = true; K.relaunch();
    };
    el.querySelector('[data-uin="x"]').onclick = () => { S.uiDismissed = need; el.remove(); };
    document.body.append(el);
    sfx('ok', true);
  }).catch(() => {});
}

function toast(msg, bad) {
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast' + (bad ? ' bad' : '');
  el.textContent = msg;
  $('#toast').append(el);
  sfx(bad ? 'error' : 'ok', true);
  setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 3600);
}

const osHdr = () => document.documentElement.classList.contains('web') ? 'web' : [S.appInfo?.platform || '', S.appInfo?.osVer || '', S.appInfo?.arch || ''].join('|');
async function api(path, body) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = await fetch(S.server + path, {
    method: body ? 'POST' : 'GET',
    headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + S.token, 'X-Konzte-Hwid': S.hwid, 'X-Konzte-Client': S.appInfo?.version || '', 'X-Konzte-Os': osHdr(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: body && JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Server error' }));
  if (r.status === 426) { showClientBlock(j); throw new Error(tErr(j.error)); }
  if (r.status === 451 && j.legal) { if (!(S.legalOkAt > t0)) { if (S.me) S.me.legal = j.legal; showLegalGate(j.legal); } throw new Error(tErr(j.error)); }
  if (r.status === 403 && (j.guild || j.pcban) && window.KZGate) { KZGate.show(j); const er = new Error(tErr(j.error)); er.gate = true; throw er; }
  if (r.status === 401 && S.token) { logout(); throw new Error(t(S.gate ? 'keySessionEnded' : 'sessionExpired')); }
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(tErr(j.error || 'Error'));
  return j;
}

function shellUpdateUi(box, btn, ver) {
  const L = kzPick({
    en: ['Update now', 'Downloading Konzte {v}… {p}%', 'Installing — Konzte will restart by itself', 'Update failed: {e}. Use “Download” instead.'],
    uk: ['Оновити зараз', 'Завантажуємо Konzte {v}… {p}%', 'Встановлюємо — Konzte перезапуститься сам', 'Не вдалося оновити: {e}. Скористайся кнопкою «Завантажити».'],
    ru: ['Обновить сейчас', 'Скачиваем Konzte {v}… {p}%', 'Устанавливаем — Konzte перезапустится сам', 'Не удалось обновить: {e}. Воспользуйся кнопкой «Скачать».'],
  }) || [];
  const dl = btn.cloneNode(true); dl.classList.remove('gold'); dl.classList.add('ghost');
  dl.onclick = btn.onclick;
  btn.textContent = L[0]; btn.after(dl);
  const bar = document.createElement('div'); bar.className = 'kzb-prog'; bar.hidden = true; bar.innerHTML = '<i></i><span></span>';
  dl.after(bar);
  K.onShellProgress?.(p => { const pct = p.total ? Math.floor(p.got / p.total * 100) : 0; bar.querySelector('i').style.width = pct + '%'; bar.querySelector('span').textContent = p.done ? L[2] : L[1].replace('{v}', ver).replace('{p}', pct); });
  btn.onclick = async () => {
    btn.disabled = dl.disabled = true; bar.hidden = false; bar.querySelector('span').textContent = L[1].replace('{v}', ver).replace('{p}', 0);
    const r = await K.shellInstall().catch(e => ({ ok: false, error: e.message }));
    if (r?.ok) { bar.querySelector('span').textContent = L[2]; return; }
    btn.disabled = dl.disabled = false; bar.hidden = true;
    toast(L[3].replace('{e}', r?.error || r?.reason || '?'), true);
  };
}

function render(html) {
  const view = $('#view');
  const keep = {};
  view.querySelectorAll('input[id], textarea[id]').forEach(i => { keep[i.id] = { v: i.value, f: document.activeElement === i, s: i.selectionStart }; });
  const scroll = {};
  view.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll]').forEach(el => { scroll[el.dataset.scroll] = el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 4 ? -1 : el.scrollTop; });
  const mainScroll = view.scrollTop;
  view.innerHTML = `<div class="page">${html}</div>`;
  view.scrollTop = mainScroll;
  const pg = S.page, t0 = performance.now();
  if (!view.__userScroll) { view.__userScroll = 0; for (const ev of ['wheel', 'keydown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart']) view.addEventListener(ev, () => { view.__userScroll = performance.now(); }, { passive: true }); }
  if (mainScroll > 0) for (const d of [0, 60, 250, 600]) setTimeout(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    if (S.page === pg && view.__userScroll < t0 && Math.abs(view.scrollTop - mainScroll) > 1) view.scrollTop = mainScroll;
  }), d);
  for (const [id, k] of Object.entries(keep)) {
    const i = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!i) continue;
    i.value = k.v;
    if (k.f) { i.focus(); try { i.setSelectionRange(k.s, k.s); } catch {} }
  }
  view.querySelectorAll('[data-scroll]').forEach(el => { const s = scroll[el.dataset.scroll]; el.scrollTop = s === undefined || s === -1 ? el.scrollHeight : s; });
}

function resolveLang(pref) {
  if (pref && pref !== 'system' && I18N[pref]) return pref;
  for (const l of S.sysLangs || []) { const c = String(l).slice(0, 2).toLowerCase(); if (I18N[c]) return c; }
  return 'en';
}

  const cur = S.langPref === 'system' ? t('sysLang') : (LANGS.find(([c]) => c === S.langPref) || LANGS[0])[1];
  const code = (S.langPref === 'system' ? LANG : S.langPref).toUpperCase();
  return `<div class="ldd"><button type="button" class="ldd-btn" data-ldd><span class="ldd-code">${code === 'UK' ? 'UA' : code}</span><span class="ldd-cur">${esc(cur)}</span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
    <div class="ldd-list" role="listbox"><button data-lang="system" class="${S.langPref === 'system' ? 'on' : ''}"><span class="ldd-code">AUTO</span>${t('sysLang')}</button>${LANGS.map(([c, n]) => `<button data-lang="${c}" class="${S.langPref === c ? 'on' : ''}"><span class="ldd-code">${c === 'uk' ? 'UA' : c.toUpperCase()}</span>${n}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
};
function bindLang(after) {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ldd]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const dd = b.closest('.ldd'), open = !dd.classList.contains('open');
    document.querySelectorAll('.ldd.open').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('open'));
    dd.classList.toggle('open', open);
    if (open) { const off = ev => { if (!dd.contains(ev.target) || ev.key === 'Escape') { dd.classList.remove('open'); removeEventListener('click', off); removeEventListener('keydown', off); } }; setTimeout(() => { addEventListener('click', off); addEventListener('keydown', off); }); }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => {
    S.langPref = b.dataset.lang;
    LANG = resolveLang(S.langPref);
    await K.saveSettings({ lang: S.langPref, langV: 2 });
    applyStatic();
    after();
  });
}

function bootStep(pct, text) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('boot-bar'), st = document.getElementById('boot-st');
  if (bar) bar.style.width = pct + '%';
  if (st && text) st.textContent = text;
}
async function boot() {
  bootStep(15);
  const st = await K.settings();
  S.server = st.server; S.token = st.token || ''; S.hwid = await K.hwid(); S.sound = st.sound !== false; S.devUi = !!st.devUi;
  S.cfg = st; applyLook();
  S.mode = pubMode(st.defaultMode);
  S.appInfo = await K.info().catch(() => ({}));
  S.build = await fetch('version.json').then(r => r.json()).then(j => j.build).catch(() => null);
  if (S.appInfo.needShell) setTimeout(() => toast(t('needShell', { v: S.appInfo.needShell }), true), 1500);
  setTimeout(checkUiUpdate, 20_000); setInterval(checkUiUpdate, 3 * 60_000); window.addEventListener('focus', () => { if (Date.now() - (S.uiChecked || 0) > 60_000) checkUiUpdate(); });
  S.sysLangs = st.sysLangs || [navigator.language];
  if (st.langV !== 2) { st.lang = 'system'; K.saveSettings({ lang: 'system', langV: 2 }); }
  S.langPref = st.lang || 'system';
  LANG = resolveLang(S.langPref);
  applyStatic();
  bootStep(30, t('bootUpdates'));
  const info = await K.info().catch(() => ({}));
  if (info.uiUpdated) { bootStep(45, t('bootUpdated', { v: S.build ? `${info.version} (build ${S.build})` : info.ui })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); }
  if (!S.token) return showLogin();
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    bootStep(60, attempt === 1 ? t('bootConnect') : t('bootRetry', { n: attempt }));
    try {
      S.me = await api('/api/me');
      bootStep(85, t('bootProfile'));
      return afterLogin();
    } catch (e) {
      if (e.gate) return;
      if (!/fetch|network|Failed|timeout|Server error/i.test(e.message || '')) return showLogin();
      bootStep(60, t('bootOffline'));
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.min(15000, 3000 * attempt)));
    }
  }
}

function showLogin(dev = S.devLogin) {
  $('#nav').hidden = true;
  $('#tb-user').innerHTML = '';
  render(`<div class="center lobbybg"><div class="card accent login">
    <img src="assets/logo.png"><h1>KONZTE FACEIT</h1>
    <p class="mute">${t('loginText')}</p>
    ${S.gate ? `<p class="mute">${t('keyText')}</p><input id="akey" placeholder="KZ-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX" maxlength="24" spellcheck="false" style="width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;text-align:center;font-family:monospace;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:10px" value="${esc(S.cfg.accessKey || '')}">` : ''}
    <button class="btn big discord" id="login">${t('loginBtn')}</button>
    <p class="mute" id="login-wait" hidden>${t('loginWait')}</p>
    ${dev ? `<div class="row" style="margin-top:14px"><input id="devname" placeholder="dev name" style="flex:1"><button class="btn ghost" id="devlogin">Dev</button></div>` : ''}
    ${langButtons()}
  </div></div>`);
  $('#login').onclick = run(login);
  bindLang(() => showLogin());
  if (dev) $('#devlogin').onclick = run(async () => {
    const r = await fetch(S.server + '/auth/dev', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ name: $('#devname').value, staff: $('#devname').value.startsWith('staff') }) }).then(r => r.json());
    if (r.error) throw new Error(r.error);
    await setToken(r.token);
  });
  if (S.gate === undefined) fetch(S.server + '/auth/gate').then(r => r.json()).then(r => { S.gate = !!r.gate; if (S.gate) showLogin(); }).catch(() => {});
  if (S.devUi && S.devLogin === undefined) fetch(S.server + '/auth/start').then(r => r.json()).then(r => { S.devLogin = !!r.dev; if (r.dev) showLogin(); }).catch(() => {});
}

async function login() {
  const q = new URLSearchParams();
  if (S.gate) {
    const key = ($('#akey')?.value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!key) throw new Error(t('keyNeeded'));
    const a = await fetch(S.server + '/auth/key', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ key, hwid: S.hwid }) }).then(r => r.json()).catch(() => { throw new Error(t('serverDown')); });
    if (a.error) throw new Error(tErr(a.error));
    S.cfg.accessKey = a.key; await K.saveSettings({ accessKey: a.key });
    q.set('key', a.key); q.set('hwid', S.hwid);
  }
  if (!q.has('hwid') && S.hwid) q.set('hwid', S.hwid);
  const r = await fetch(S.server + '/auth/start?' + q).then(r => r.json()).catch(() => { throw new Error(t('serverDown')); });
  if (r.error) throw new Error(tErr(r.error));
  K.open(r.url);
  $('#login-wait').hidden = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
    await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 2000));
    const p = await fetch(S.server + '/auth/poll?state=' + r.state).then(r => r.json());
    if (p.error) throw new Error(tErr(p.error));
    if (p.token) return setToken(p.token);
    if (p.tfa && window.KZ2fa) return setToken(await KZ2fa.login(r.state, p.tfa));
  }
  throw new Error(t('loginTimeout'));
}

async function setToken(token) {
  S.token = token;
  await K.saveSettings({ token });
  S.me = await api('/api/me');
  sfx('login');
  afterLogin();
}

function logout() {
  if (S.token) fetch(S.server + '/api/logout', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + S.token } }).catch(() => {});
  S.token = ''; S.me = null; S.live = null;
  K.saveSettings({ token: '' });
  if (S.ws) { S.ws.onclose = null; S.ws.close(); S.ws = null; }
  $('#online').textContent = '';
  showLogin();
}

function afterLogin() {
  if (!S.me.gameId) return showRegister();
  if (S.me.legal?.need?.length) return showLegalGate(S.me.legal);
  loadSupport();
  $('#nav').hidden = false;
  renderMe();
  connect();
  go('play');
  setTimeout(checkNotices, 1500);
  if (K.cm && !S.cmAutoLink) {
    S.cmAutoLink = true;
    const tryLink = st => {
      if (!st?.connected || !st.me?.id || !S.me?.gameId || S.me.cmId === st.me.id || S.cmLinking) return;
      if (S.me.cmId) return;
      S.cmLinking = true;
      api('/api/cm/link', { cm: { id: st.me.id, nick: st.me.nick } }).then(me => { S.me = me; }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => { S.cmLinking = false; });
    };
    K.cm.state().then(tryLink).catch(() => {}); K.cm.onState(tryLink);
  }
  setTimeout(showWhatsNew, 2500);
}

    <input id="r-ref" placeholder="${t('refCodePh')}" maxlength="6" style="text-transform:uppercase">

    ${legalCheck('r-agree', S.me?.legal)}
    <div class="err" id="r-err"></div>
    <button class="btn big">${t('submit')}</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="r-out">${t('logout')}</button>
    ${langButtons()}
  </form></div>`);
  let cmMe = null;
  const showCm = st => {

  };
```
