```js
  function myReqCard(mine) {
    const reqs = mine.myRequests || [], res = (mine.reqResults || []).filter(r => !reqs.some(x => x.id === r.clan));
    if (!reqs.length && !res.length) return '';
    const R = mine.reqRules || { max: 3, cooldownH: 24 };
    return `<div class="card cl3-invs cl3-myreq"><div class="cl3-h"><span>${t('cl3MyReqH')} <b>${reqs.length} / ${R.max}</b></span><small class="mute">${t('cl3MyReqRule', { n: R.max, h: R.cooldownH })}</small></div>
      ${reqs.map(x => `<div class="cl3-inv" data-clopen="${x.id}">${clanIcon(x, 'big')}<div class="grow"><b>${clanName(x)}</b><small>${t('cl3MyReqSent', { t: fmtDT(x.reqAt) })} · ${x.members}/${x.max}</small></div>
        ${clanLvlIcon(lvlOf(x.cw), 30)}<button class="btn ghost sm" data-cl3rx="${x.id}">${ic('x')}${t('cl3ReqCancel')}</button></div>`).join('')}
      ${res.map(r => `<div class="cl3-inv dim"><div class="grow"><b><span class="ctag big">${esc(r.tag)}</span> ${esc(r.name)}</b><small>${fmtDT(r.at)}</small></div><span class="cl3-res ${r.ok ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${r.ok ? t('cl3MyReqOk') : t('cl3MyReqNo')}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function header(c, isMine) {
    const my = S.cl.mine?.clan, role = isMine ? my.myRole : null, owner = role === 'owner', officer = owner || role === 'officer';
    const iCanChallenge = !isMine && ['owner', 'officer'].includes(my?.myRole);
    const rk = warRank(c.id), on = c.members.filter(m => m.online).length;
    const kick = [isMine ? t('cl3YourClan') : t('cl3Clan'), cwCal(c.cw) ? t('cl3Cal', { n: c.cw.cal }) : `LVL ${c.cw.lvl}`, rk.place ? t('cl3InTop', { n: rk.place }) : ''].filter(Boolean);
    const acts = [];
    if (iCanChallenge) acts.push(`<button class="btn cl3-cta" id="cl-chal">${ic('swords')}${t('clChallenge')}</button>`);
    if (!isMine && !my) { const jb = joinBtn(c, true); if (jb) acts.push(jb); }
    if (isMine && officer) acts.push(`<button class="btn cl3-cta" id="cl3-chgo">${ic('swords')}${t('cl3WarGo')}</button>`);
    if (owner) acts.push(`<button class="btn ghost cl3-cta2" id="cl-set">${ic('gear')}${t('clSettings')}</button>`);
    if (isMine && !owner) acts.push(`<button class="btn ghost cl3-cta2" id="cl-leave">${ic('exit')}${t('clLeave')}</button>`);
    return `<div class="card cl3-head">${bannerHtml(c.banner, 'cl3-ban')}
      <div class="cl3-logo">${clanIcon(c, 'big')}</div>
      <div class="cl3-hm"><div class="cl3-kick">${kick.map(esc).join('<i></i>')}</div>
        <h1 class="cl3-name">${clanName(c)}</h1>
        <div class="cl3-desc">${c.desc ? esc(c.desc) : `<span class="mute">${t('clNoDesc')}</span>`}</div>
        <div class="cl3-meta">${role ? `${roleChip(role)}<span class="mute">${t('cl3You')}</span>` : ''}
          ${c.partner ? `<span class="cl3-badge gold"><i class="ctag-p">${PARTNER_SVG}</i>${t('clPartner')}</span>` : ''}${c.reward ? `<span class="cl3-badge">${t('clFoundersTag')}</span>` : ''}
          <span>${ic('users')}<b>${c.members.length}</b> / ${c.max}</span><span class="cl3-jmode jm-${c.joinMode || 'invite'}">${t('cl3Mode_' + (c.joinMode || 'invite'))}${c.minElo ? ` · ${c.minElo}+ ELO` : ''}</span><span><i class="cl3-dot${on ? ' on' : ''}"></i>${t('cl3Online', { n: `<b>${on}</b>` })}</span>
          <span class="mute">${t('clSince', { d: fmtDate(c.created) })}</span></div></div>
      <div class="cl3-acts">${acts.join('')}</div></div>`;
  }
  function tiles(c) {
    const rk = warRank(c.id), cal = cwCal(c.cw), on = c.members.filter(m => m.online).length, g = c.cw.w + c.cw.l;
    const tl = (k, v, s, cls = '') => `<div class="cl3-st ${cls}"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b><small>${s}</small></div>`;
    return `<div class="cl3-sts${c.points ? ' pts8' : ''}">
      ${tl(t('cl3Place'), rk.place ? '#' + rk.place : '—', rk.place ? t('cl3PlaceSub', { n: rk.total }) : t('cl3PlaceCal'), 'hot')}
      ${tl(t('clWarRating'), cal ? '?' : c.cw.elo, cal ? t('cl3Cal', { n: c.cw.cal }) : `${c.cw.w}–${c.cw.l}`)}
      ${tl(t('cl3Lvl'), `<span class="cl3-lv">${clanLvlIcon(lvlOf(c.cw), 26)}${cal ? '?' : 'LVL ' + c.cw.lvl}</span>`, cal ? t('clCalHint').split('—')[0] : c.cw.next ? t('cl3ToLvl', { n: c.cw.next - c.cw.elo, l: c.cw.lvl + 1 }) : t('cl3LvlMax'))}
      ${tl(t('cl3Wins'), c.cw.w, g ? t('cl3Wr', { n: Math.round(c.cw.w / g * 100), l: c.cw.l }) : '—')}
      ${tl(t('clMembers'), `${c.members.length}<em> / ${c.max}</em>`, t('cl3FreeSlots', { n: Math.max(0, c.max - c.members.length) }))}
      ${tl(t('cl3OnlineH'), `<span class="cl3-lv"><i class="cl3-dot${on ? ' on' : ''}"></i>${on}</span>`, t('cl3OnlineSub'))}
      ${tl(t('clPower'), c.power, t('clPowerSub'))}
      ${c.points ? tl(t('cl3PtsTile'), c.points.total, ptsRank(c.id) ? t('cl3PtsRank', { p: ptsRank(c.id) }) + ' · ' + t('cl3Season', { n: c.points.season.n }) : t('cl3Season', { n: c.points.season.n }), 'pts') : ''}</div>`;
  }

  function progress(c) {
    const cw = c.cw, modes = (c.warModes || ['5v5']).map(modeT).join(' · ');
    const hints = `<div class="cl3-hints"><span>${ic('swords')}${t('cl3H1')}</span><span>${ic('star')}${t('cl3H2')}</span><span>${ic('users')}${t('cl3H3', { m: modes })}</span><span>${ic('trend')}${t('cl3H4')}</span></div>`;
    if (cwCal(cw)) return `<div class="card cl3-prog">${head(t('cl3ProgH'), `<span class="mute">${t('cl3Cal', { n: cw.cal })}</span>`)}
      <div class="cl3-pm">${clanLvlIcon(0, 64)}<div class="grow"><div class="cl3-pips">${[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `<i class="${i < cw.cal ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</div>
        <div class="cl3-pt"><b>${t('cl3CalLeft', { n: 5 - cw.cal })}</b><span class="mute">${t('clCalHint')}</span></div></div><div class="cl3-big"><span>${t('cl3ColWL')}</span><b>${cw.w}–${cw.l}</b></div></div>${hints}</div>`;
    const lo = cw.min ?? 0, hi = cw.next, p = hi ? Math.max(2, Math.min(100, (cw.elo - lo) / (hi - lo) * 100)) : 100;
    return `<div class="card cl3-prog">${head(t('cl3ProgH'), `<span class="mute">${hi ? t('cl3LvlsTo', { l: cw.lvl + 1, n: hi - cw.elo }) : t('cl3LvlMax')}</span>`)}
      <div class="cl3-pm"><div class="cl3-big">${clanLvlIcon(cw.lvl, 56)}<b>LVL ${cw.lvl}</b></div>
        <div class="grow"><div class="cl3-pv"><b>${cw.elo}</b><span class="mute">/ ${hi || cw.elo} ELO</span></div><div class="cl3-bar"><i style="width:${p}%"></i></div>
          <div class="cl3-pt">${hi ? t('cl3ProgTo', { n: hi - cw.elo, l: cw.lvl + 1 }) : t('cl3ProgMax')}</div></div>
        <div class="cl3-big dim">${hi ? clanLvlIcon(cw.lvl + 1, 56) : clanLvlIcon(10, 56)}<b>${hi ? 'LVL ' + (cw.lvl + 1) : 'MAX'}</b></div></div>${hints}</div>`;
  }
  function levels(c) {
    const cur = lvlOf(c.cw);
    return `<div class="card cl3-lvls">${head(t('cl3LvlsH'), c.cw.next ? `<span class="mute">${t('cl3LvlsTo', { l: cur + 1, n: c.cw.next - c.cw.elo })}</span>` : '')}
      <div class="cl3-lrow">${CW_LV.map((min, i) => { const l = i + 1; return `<div class="cl3-lc ${l < cur ? 'past' : l === cur ? 'cur' : ''}">${clanLvlIcon(l, 34)}<b>LVL ${l}</b><span>${min ? min + '+' : '<' + CW_LV[1]}</span></div>`; }).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }
  const memLine = (m, i) => `<div class="cl3-mr" data-prof="${m.id}"><span class="cl3-n">${i + 1}</span>${avaF(m, 'sm')}<span class="cl3-nk"><span class="nkl">${nickHtml(m)}</span>${roleChip(m.role)}</span>
    <span class="cl3-wl5">${m.r5 ? wlT(m.r5.w, m.r5.l) : '<span class="mute">—</span>'}</span><b class="num">${m.elo}<small> ELO</small></b></div>`;
  function best(c, isMine) {
    const top = [...c.members].sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo).slice(0, isMine ? 5 : 20);
    return `<div class="card cl3-best">${head(isMine ? t('cl3BestH') : `${t('clMembers')} <b>${c.members.length}</b>`, isMine ? link('data-cl3sub="members"', t('cl3AllMembers')) : '')}${top.map(memLine).join('')}</div>`;
  }
  const nickBy = (c, uid) => esc(c.members.find(m => m.id === uid)?.nick || c.invites?.find(m => m.id === uid)?.nick || '—');
  function logLine(c, x) {
    const d = x.details || {}, by = `<b>${esc(x.byNick || 'Konzte')}</b>`, u = `<b>${nickBy(c, d.uid)}</b>`, a = x.action;
    let txt, k = 'edit', cls = '';
    if (a.startsWith('staff-')) txt = t('cl3L_staff', { a: esc(a.slice(6)) });
    else if (I18N.en['cl3L_' + a]) txt = t('cl3L_' + a, { by, u, r: d.role ? ROLE_T(d.role) : '', c: esc(d.clan || d.vs || ''), m: d.mode ? modeT(d.mode) : '', l: d.lvl, e: d.elo, d: d.d > 0 ? '+' + d.d : d.d ?? '' });
    else txt = `${by} ${esc(a)}`;
    if (['create', 'join', 'invite'].includes(a)) k = 'plus';
    else if (['leave', 'kick'].includes(a)) { k = 'x'; cls = 'neg'; }
    else if (a === 'challenge') k = 'swords';
    else if (a === 'war-win') { k = 'swords'; cls = 'pos'; } else if (a === 'war-loss') { k = 'swords'; cls = 'neg'; }
    else if (['reward', 'calibrated'].includes(a)) { k = 'star'; cls = 'gold'; }
    return `<div class="cl3-ev">${ic(k, cls)}<span class="grow">${txt}</span><span class="mute">${fmtDT(x.at)}</span></div>`;
  }
  function warEvents(c) {
    return (c.wars || []).filter(w => w.state === 'done').map(w => {
      const won = w.winner === c.id, vs = w.from.id === c.id ? w.to : w.from, d = w.delta?.[c.id];
      return { at: w.at, action: won ? 'war-win' : 'war-loss', details: { vs: vs.tag, d } };
    });
  }
  function events(c, isMine, n = 6) {
    const officer = isMine && c.log;
    const list = (officer ? c.log : warEvents(c)).slice(0, n);
    return `<div class="card cl3-evs">${head(t('cl3EventsH'), officer && c.log.length > n ? link('data-cl3sub="log"', t('cl3AllLog')) : '')}
      ${list.length ? list.map(x => logLine(c, x)).join('') : `<div class="cl3-empty">${t('cl3NoEvents')}</div>`}</div>`;
  }
  function rankCard(c, isMine) {
    const rk = warRank(c.id);
    let body;
    if (cwCal(c.cw)) body = `<div class="cl3-rk">${clanLvlIcon(0, 46)}<div><b class="cl3-rbig">—</b><span class="mute">${t('cl3RankCal', { n: c.cw.cal })}</span></div></div>`;
    else {
      const a = rk.above;
      body = `<div class="cl3-rk"><b class="cl3-rbig">#${rk.place}</b><div><b>${c.cw.elo} ELO</b><span class="mute">${t('cl3PlaceSub', { n: rk.total })}</span></div></div>
        ${a ? `<div class="cl3-rival" data-clopen="${a.id}"><span class="mute">#${rk.place - 1}</span>${clanIcon(a, '', true)}<b class="grow">${clanName(a)}</b><span class="cl3-gap"><b>+${Math.max(1, a.cw.elo - c.cw.elo)}</b><small>${t('cl3RankAbove')}</small></span>${ic('chev')}</div>`
          : `<div class="cl3-first">${ic('star', 'gold')}${isMine ? t('cl3RankTop') : t('cl3RankTopO')}</div>`}`;
    }
    return `<div class="card cl3-side">${head(t('cl3RankH'))}${body}${link('data-cl3sub="top"', t('cl3OpenTop'))}</div>`;
  }
  function meCard(c) {
    const me = c.members.find(m => m.id === S.me.id); if (!me) return '';
    const n = [...c.members].sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo).findIndex(m => m.id === me.id) + 1;
    return `<div class="card cl3-side">${head(t('cl3MeH'), roleChip(me.role))}
      <div class="cl3-me"><div><b>${me.elo}</b><span>ELO</span></div><div><b>#${n}</b><span>${t('cl3MeRank', { n }).replace(/^#\d+\s*/, '')}</span></div><div><b>${me.r5 ? `${me.r5.w}–${me.r5.l}` : '—'}</b><span>${t('cl3WL5')}</span></div></div>
      <p class="cl3-note">${t('cl3MeText')}</p></div>`;
  }
  function matesCard(c) {
    const on = c.members.filter(m => m.online && m.id !== S.me.id);
    const inParty = new Set((S.live?.party?.members || []).map(m => m.id));
    return `<div class="card cl3-side">${head(t('cl3MatesH'), `<span class="cl3-cnt"><i class="cl3-dot${on.length ? ' on' : ''}"></i>${on.length}</span>`)}
      ${on.length ? on.map(m => `<div class="cl3-mate" data-prof="${m.id}">${avaF(m, 'sm')}<span class="grow nkl">${nickHtml(m)}</span>${inParty.has(m.id) ? `<span class="mute">${t('party')}</span>` : `<button class="btn ghost xs" data-cl3inv="${m.id}">${ic('party')}${t('cl3ToParty')}</button>`}</div>`).join('')
        : `<div class="cl3-empty l">${t('cl3MatesNone')}</div>`}${link('data-cl3sub="members"', t('cl3AllMates'))}</div>`;
  }
  function warCard(c) {
    const role = c.myRole, officer = role === 'owner' || role === 'officer';
    const open = (c.wars || []).filter(w => ['pending', 'ready', 'match'].includes(w.state));
    const rows = open.map(w => {
      const inc = w.to.id === c.id, vs = inc ? w.from : w.to;
      if (w.state === 'pending' && inc) return `<div class="cl3-wi in">${clanIcon(vs, '', true)}<div class="grow"><b>${t('cl3WarIn', { c: esc(vs.tag), m: modeT(w.mode) })}</b><small>${esc(vs.name)} · ${fmtDT(w.at)}</small></div>
        ${officer ? `<div class="cl3-wb"><button class="btn green sm" data-clwar-ok="${w.id}">${t('accept')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-clwar-x="${w.id}">${t('decline')}</button></div>` : ''}</div>`;
      if (w.state === 'pending') return `<div class="cl3-wi">${clanIcon(vs, '', true)}<div class="grow"><b>${t('cl3WarOut', { c: esc(vs.tag), m: modeT(w.mode) })}</b><small>${WAR_ST(w)}${w.failed ? ' · ' + esc(w.failed) : ''}</small></div>
        ${officer ? `<button class="btn ghost xs" data-clwar-x="${w.id}">${t('cancel')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
      return `<div class="cl3-wi live">${clanIcon(vs, '', true)}<div class="grow"><b>${t('cl3WarLive', { c: esc(vs.tag), s: WAR_ST(w) })}</b><small>${modeT(w.mode)}${w.match ? ` · <a href="#" data-clmatch="${w.match}">#${w.match}</a>` : ''}</small></div>
        ${officer && w.state === 'ready' ? `<button class="btn ghost xs" data-clwar-x="${w.id}">${t('cancel')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
    }).join('');
    return `<div class="card cl3-side cl3-war">${head(t('cl3WarH'), open.length ? `<span class="cl3-cnt hot">${open.length}</span>` : '')}
      ${rows || `<div class="cl3-wnone">${ic('swords')}<div><b>${t('cl3WarNone')}</b><span class="mute">${officer ? t('cl3WarOfficer') : t('cl3WarMember')}</span></div></div>`}
      ${officer ? `<button class="btn ghost cl3-wgo" data-cl3sub="top">${t('cl3WarGo')}${ic('chev')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
  }
  function modCard(c) {
    if (!(S.me.staff || S.me.admin)) return '';
    return `<div class="card cl3-side cl3-mod">${head(t('clMod'))}
      <div class="cl3-row"><input id="clm-tag" value="${esc(c.tag)}" maxlength="5" style="width:84px;text-transform:uppercase"><input id="clm-name" value="${esc(c.name)}" maxlength="24" class="grow"></div>
      <button class="btn ghost sm" id="clm-ren">${t('clRename')}</button>
      <input id="clm-reason" placeholder="${t('clReasonPh')}" maxlength="200">
      <div class="cl3-row wrap">${S.me.admin || S.me.auditor ? `<button class="btn ${c.partner ? 'ghost' : 'gold'} sm" id="clm-partner">${c.partner ? t('clUnpartner') : t('clMakePartner')}</button>` : ''}
        ${c.avatar ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" id="clm-avx">${t('clAvatarOffStaff')}</button>` : ''}<button class="btn red sm" id="clm-dis">${t('clDisband')}</button></div></div>`;
  }

  function ptsRank(id) {
    const all = (S.cl.list?.list || []).filter(x => x.pts > 0).sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts);
    const i = all.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
    return i >= 0 ? i + 1 : null;
  }
  function contribCard(c) {
    const P = c.points; if (!P) return '';
    const all = !!S.cl.ptsAll, rows = all ? P.board : P.board.slice(0, 5), r = P.rules;
    return `<div class="card cl3-ctb">${head(`${t('cl3CtbH')} <i class="cl3-sep"></i> ${t('cl3Season', { n: P.season.n })}${P.season.name ? ' · ' + esc(P.season.name) : ''}`,
        P.board.length > 5 ? `<button class="cl3-link" id="cl3-ptsall">${all ? t('cl3Less') : t('cl3AllCtb')}${ic('chev')}</button>` : '')}
      ${P.total ? rows.map(x => `<div class="cl3-mr${x.id === S.me.id ? ' me' : ''}${x.left ? ' left' : ''}" data-prof="${x.id}"><span class="cl3-n">${x.place}</span>${avaF(x, 'sm')}<span class="cl3-nk"><span class="nkl">${nickHtml(x)}</span>${x.role ? roleChip(x.role) : `<span class="cl3-role">${t('cl3Left')}</span>`}</span>
        <span class="cl3-pbar"><i style="width:${P.board[0].pts ? Math.max(2, x.pts / P.board[0].pts * 100) : 0}%"></i></span><b class="num">${x.pts}<small> ${t('cl3PtsU')}</small></b></div>`).join('')
        : `<div class="cl3-empty">${t('cl3NoPts')}</div>`}
      <div class="cl3-ptsr">${ic('star', 'gold')}<span>${t('cl3PtsRules', { w: r.win, l: r.loss, m: r.mvp, cw: r.warWin, cl: r.warLoss })}</span><span class="mute">${t('cl3PtsNote')}</span></div></div>`;
  }
  function myPtsCard(c) {
    const P = c.points, me = P?.me; if (!me) return '';
    const share = P.total ? Math.round(me.pts / P.total * 100) : 0, r = P.rules;
    return `<div class="card cl3-side cl3-myp">${head(t('cl3MyPtsH'), `<span class="cl3-cnt">#${me.place || '—'} ${t('cl3InClan')}</span>`)}
      <div class="cl3-mypts"><b>${me.pts}</b><div class="grow"><span>${t('cl3PtsU')}</span><small class="mute">${t('cl3Season', { n: P.season.n })}${P.season.name ? ' · ' + esc(P.season.name) : ''}</small></div>
        <em>${share}%<small>${t('cl3OfClan')}</small></em></div>
      <div class="cl3-bar"><i style="width:${Math.max(share ? 2 : 0, share)}%"></i></div>
      <p class="cl3-note">${t('cl3MyPtsText', { w: r.win, l: r.loss, m: r.mvp, cw: r.warWin })}</p></div>`;
  }
  function joinModeCard(c) {
    const mode = c.joinMode || 'invite';
    return `<div class="card cl3-side">${head(t('cl3JoinH'))}
      <div class="cl3-jm">${['invite', 'request', 'open'].map(k => `<button data-cl3jm="${k}" class="${mode === k ? 'on' : ''}"><b>${t('cl3Mode_' + k)}</b><span>${t('cl3ModeH_' + k)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="cl3-minelo"><span>${t('cl3MinElo')}</span><input id="cl3-minelo" type="number" min="0" max="5000" step="50" value="${c.minElo || 0}"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="cl3-minsave">${t('save')}</button></div>
      <p class="cl3-note">${t('cl3MinEloH')}</p></div>`;
  }
  function requestsTab(c) {
    const R = c.requests || [];
    const list = `<div class="card cl3-reqs">${head(`${t('cl3TReq')} <b>${R.length}</b>`)}
      ${R.length ? R.map(r => `<div class="cl3-rq" data-prof="${r.id}">${avaF(r, 'sm')}<div class="grow"><div class="cl3-rqh"><span class="nkl">${nickHtml(r)}</span><b class="num">${r.elo}<small> ELO</small></b><span class="mute">${fmtDT(r.at)}</span></div>${r.text ? `<p>${esc(r.text)}</p>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="cl3-rqb"><button class="btn green sm" data-cl3ra="${r.id}:1">${ic('check')}${t('accept')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-cl3ra="${r.id}:0">${t('decline')}</button></div></div>`).join('')
        : `<div class="cl3-empty">${t('cl3NoReq')}</div>`}</div>`;
    return lay(list, joinModeCard(c));
  }

  function membersTab(c, isMine) {
    const role = isMine ? c.myRole : null, owner = role === 'owner', officer = owner || role === 'officer';
    const acts = m => {
      const a = [];
      if (owner && m.id !== S.me.id) {
        a.push(m.role === 'officer' ? `<button class="btn ghost xs" data-clrole="${m.id}:member">${t('clDemote')}</button>` : `<button class="btn ghost xs" data-clrole="${m.id}:officer">${t('clPromote')}</button>`);
        a.push(`<button class="btn ghost xs" data-clrole="${m.id}:owner">${t('clTransfer')}</button>`);
      }
      if (officer && m.id !== S.me.id && m.role !== 'owner' && (owner || m.role === 'member')) a.push(`<button class="btn ghost xs cl3-kickb" data-clkick="${m.id}">${t('clKick')}</button>`);
      return a.join('');
    };
    const table = `<div class="card cl3-mt${owner ? ' own' : officer ? ' off' : ''}">${head(`${t('clMembers')} <b>${c.members.length} / ${c.max}</b>`)}
      <div class="cl3-mh"><span>${t('cl3Player')}</span><span>${t('cl3Role')}</span><span>ELO</span><span>${t('cl3WL5')}</span><span>${t('cl3Joined')}</span><span></span></div>
      ${c.members.map(m => `<div class="cl3-mrow cl-mem" data-prof="${m.id}"><span class="cl3-pc"><span class="cl3-av">${avaF(m, 'sm')}<i class="cl3-dot${m.online ? ' on' : ''}"></i></span><span class="nkl">${nickHtml(m)}</span></span>
        <span>${roleChip(m.role)}</span><b class="num">${m.elo}</b><span class="num">${m.r5 ? wlT(m.r5.w, m.r5.l) : '—'}</span><span class="mute">${m.joined ? fmtDate(m.joined) : '—'}</span><span class="cl3-ma">${acts(m)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
    const invite = officer ? `<div class="card cl3-side">${head(t('clInvite'))}
      <div class="cl3-row"><input id="cl-q" class="grow" placeholder="${t('addFriendPh')}" autocomplete="off"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="cl-qgo">${t('search')}</button></div><div id="cl-qres" class="cl3-qres"></div>
      ${c.invites?.length ? `<div class="cl3-note">${t('clPending')}: ${c.invites.map(i => esc(i.nick)).join(', ')}</div>` : ''}</div>` : '';
    return lay(table, `${invite}<div class="card cl3-side">${head(t('cl3RolesH'))}<p class="cl3-note">${t('cl3RolesText')}</p></div>${isMine ? matesCard(c) : ''}`);
  }
  function warsList(c, isMine) {
    const officer = isMine && ['owner', 'officer'].includes(c.myRole);
    const row = w => {
      const inc = isMine && w.to.id === c.id;
      const res = w.state === 'done' ? (w.winner === c.id ? `<span class="cl3-res win">${t('clWon')} ${w.delta?.[c.id] > 0 ? '+' + w.delta[c.id] : ''}</span>` : `<span class="cl3-res lose">${t('clLost')} ${w.delta?.[c.id] ?? ''}</span>`) : `<span class="cl3-res">${WAR_ST(w)}</span>`;
      const b = [];
      if (officer && w.state === 'pending' && inc) b.push(`<button class="btn green xs" data-clwar-ok="${w.id}">${t('accept')}</button>`);
      if (officer && ['pending', 'ready'].includes(w.state)) b.push(`<button class="btn ghost xs" data-clwar-x="${w.id}">${inc && w.state === 'pending' ? t('decline') : t('cancel')}</button>`);
      return `<div class="cl3-wr"><span class="cl3-mode">${modeT(w.mode)}</span><div class="cl3-vs"><span>${clanIcon(w.from, '', true)}<b>${clanName(w.from)}</b></span><i>${t('vs')}</i><span>${clanIcon(w.to, '', true)}<b>${clanName(w.to)}</b></span></div>
        <span class="mute cl3-wd">${fmtDT(w.at)}${w.match ? ` · <a href="#" data-clmatch="${w.match}">#${w.match}</a>` : ''}${w.failed && w.state === 'pending' ? ' · ' + esc(w.failed) : ''}</span>${res}${b.join('')}</div>`;
    };
    return `<div class="card cl3-wars">${head(t('cl3HistH'), `<span class="mute">${c.cw.w}–${c.cw.l}</span>`)}${c.wars.length ? c.wars.map(row).join('') : `<div class="cl3-empty">${t('clNoWars')}</div>`}</div>`;
  }
  function chatTab(c) {
    return `<div class="card cl-chat cl3-chat">${head(t('clChat'))}
      <div class="log" data-scroll="clchat" id="cl-log">${c.chat.map(x => `<div class="cl3-msg${x.uid === S.me.id ? ' me' : ''}"><b>${esc(x.nick)}</b><span>${esc(x.text)}</span>${x.at ? `<small>${fmtDT(x.at)}</small>` : ''}</div>`).join('') || `<span class="mute">${t('noMsgs')}</span>`}</div>
      <form class="cl3-row" id="cl-chatf"><input id="cl-msg" class="grow" maxlength="300" placeholder="${t('clChatPh')}" autocomplete="off"><button class="btn sm">${ic('send')}</button></form></div>`;
  }
  const lay = (main, side) => `<div class="cl3-lay"><div class="cl3-main">${main}</div><div class="cl3-right">${side}</div></div>`;

  function clanPage(c, isMine) {
    const officer = isMine && ['owner', 'officer'].includes(c.myRole);
    const tabs = [['overview', t('cl3TOverview')], ['members', t('cl3TMembers'), c.members.length], ['wars', t('cl3TWars'), (c.wars || []).filter(w => w.state === 'pending' && w.to.id === c.id).length || '']];
    if (isMine && c.chat) tabs.push(['chat', t('cl3TChat')]);
    if (officer && c.log) tabs.push(['log', t('cl3TLog')]);
    if (officer && c.requests) tabs.push(['requests', t('cl3TReq'), c.requests.length || '']);
    tabs.push(['top', t('cl3TTop')]);
    let sub = S.cl.sub || 'overview';
    if (!tabs.some(x => x[0] === sub)) sub = 'overview';
    const pend = (c.wars || []).filter(w => w.state === 'pending').length;
    const strip = `<div class="cl3-strip"><span>${ic('users')}<div><b>${t('cl3Together')}</b><small>${t('cl3TogetherS', { n: c.together })}</small></div></span>
      <span>${ic('swords')}<div><b>${t('cl3Waiting')}</b><small>${t('cl3WaitingS', { n: pend })}</small></div></span>
      ${officer ? `<span>${ic('send')}<div><b>${t('cl3Invited')}</b><small>${t('cl3InvitedS', { n: c.invites?.length || 0 })}</small></div></span>` : ''}</div>`;
    const bar = `<div class="cl3-tabsrow"><div class="cl3-tabs">${tabs.map(([k, l, n]) => `<button data-cl3sub="${k}" class="${sub === k ? 'on' : ''}">${l}${n ? `<em>${n}</em>` : ''}</button>`).join('')}</div>${strip}</div>`;
    let body;
    if (sub === 'members') body = membersTab(c, isMine);
    else if (sub === 'wars') body = lay(warsList(c, isMine), `${isMine ? warCard(c) : ''}${levels(c)}`);
    else if (sub === 'chat') body = lay(chatTab(c), matesCard(c));
    else if (sub === 'log') body = `<div class="card cl3-evs">${head(t('clLog'))}${c.log.map(x => logLine(c, x)).join('') || `<div class="cl3-empty">${t('cl3NoEvents')}</div>`}</div>`;
    else if (sub === 'top') body = tableBlock();
    else if (sub === 'requests') body = requestsTab(c);
    else body = lay(`${progress(c)}${levels(c)}${contribCard(c)}${best(c, isMine)}${events(c, isMine)}`, `${rankCard(c, isMine)}${isMine ? myPtsCard(c) + meCard(c) + matesCard(c) + warCard(c) : ''}${modCard(c)}`);
    return `${header(c, isMine)}${tiles(c)}${bar}${body}`;
  }

  const _prev = renderClans;
  renderClans = function () {
    if (!window.KZ_V3?.()) return _prev.apply(this, arguments);
    const c = S.cl, mine = c.mine;
    if (!mine || !c.list) return render(`<div class="card empty-note">${t('loading')}</div>`);
    if (c.tab === 'top' || c.tab === 'partners') { if (mine.clan && !c.view) c.sub = 'top'; if (c.tab === 'partners') c.f = 'partner'; c.tab = 'mine'; }
    let body;
    if (c.view && c.other) {
      const sub = c.sub; c.sub = ['overview', 'members', 'wars', 'top'].includes(sub) ? sub : 'overview';
      body = `<div class="cl3-back"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="cl-back">${ic('back')}${t('clBack')}</button></div>${clanPage(c.other, false)}`;
    } else if (mine.clan) body = clanPage(mine.clan, true);
    else body = noClanPage(mine);
    render(`<div class="cl3">${body}</div>`);
    const cur = c.view && c.other ? c.other : mine.clan;
    if (cur && c._modId !== cur.id) { c._modId = cur.id; const a = $('#clm-tag'), b = $('#clm-name'); if (a) a.value = cur.tag; if (b) b.value = cur.name; }
    bindClans();
    bind3();
  };

  function bind3() {
    const v = $('#view');
    v.querySelectorAll('[data-cl3sub]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); S.cl.sub = b.dataset.cl3sub; refresh(); if (S.cl.sub === 'top') $('#view').scrollTop = 0; });
    v.querySelectorAll('[data-cl3f]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.cl.f = b.dataset.cl3f; refresh(); });
    const chgo = $('#cl3-chgo'); if (chgo) chgo.onclick = () => { S.cl.sub = 'top'; S.cl.f = 'all'; refresh(); };
    const back = $('#cl-back'); if (back) back.addEventListener('click', () => { S.cl.sub = 'overview'; });
    const find = $('#cl3-find'); if (find) find.onclick = () => { $('#cl3-table')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); setTimeout(() => $('#cl3-q')?.focus(), 350); };
    const tag = $('#cl-tag'); if (tag) tag.addEventListener('input', () => { const p = tag.selectionStart; tag.value = tag.value.toUpperCase(); tag.setSelectionRange(p, p); });
    const q = $('#cl3-q');
    if (q) q.oninput = () => { S.cl.q = q.value; const tb = $('#cl3-tb'); if (tb) { tb.innerHTML = rowsHtml(); bindClans(); } };
    v.querySelectorAll('.cl3-mr[data-prof], .cl3-mate[data-prof]').forEach(r => r.onclick = e => { if (!e.target.closest('button')) go('profile', r.dataset.prof); });
    const all = (sel, fn) => v.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async e => { e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault(); await fn(b); }));
    all('[data-cl3req]', b => reqModal(b.dataset.cl3req));
    all('[data-cl3join]', async b => {
      const x = clanById(b.dataset.cl3join); if (!x || !confirm(t('cl3JoinQ', { c: x.tag }))) return;
      S.cl.mine = await api('/api/clan/join', { clan: x.id }); sfx('join'); toast(t('cl3JoinedOk', { c: `[${x.tag}] ${x.name}` }));
      S.cl.view = null; S.cl.other = null; S.cl.sub = 'overview'; loadClans();
    });
    all('[data-cl3rx]', async b => { S.cl.mine = await api('/api/clan/request/cancel', { clan: b.dataset.cl3rx }); refresh(); });
    all('[data-cl3ra]', async b => { const [uid, yes] = b.dataset.cl3ra.split(':'); S.cl.mine = await api('/api/clan/request/answer', { uid, yes: yes === '1' }); if (yes === '1') sfx('join'); loadClans(); });
    const jm = body => api('/api/clan/joinmode', body).then(r => { S.cl.mine = r; toast(t('cl3JmSaved')); refresh(); });
    all('[data-cl3jm]', b => jm({ joinMode: b.dataset.cl3jm, minElo: $('#cl3-minelo')?.value }));
    const ms = $('#cl3-minsave'); if (ms) ms.onclick = run(() => jm({ minElo: $('#cl3-minelo').value }));
    const pa = $('#cl3-ptsall'); if (pa) pa.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); S.cl.ptsAll = !S.cl.ptsAll; refresh(); };
    v.querySelectorAll('.cl3-rq[data-prof]').forEach(r => r.onclick = e => { if (!e.target.closest('button')) go('profile', r.dataset.prof); });
    v.querySelectorAll('[data-cl3inv]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); wsSend({ t: 'party-invite', uid: b.dataset.cl3inv }); toast(t('inviteSent')); b.disabled = true; });
  }

  const _settings = settingsModal;
  settingsModal = function (c) {
    _settings.apply(this, arguments);
    if (!window.KZ_V3?.() || !c) return;
    const box = $('#modal'), err = box.querySelector('#cs-err'); if (!err) return;
    let sel = c.joinMode || 'invite';
    const d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'cl3-csjm';
    d.innerHTML = `<label class="mute">${t('cl3JoinH')}</label><div class="cl3-jm row3">${['invite', 'request', 'open'].map(k => `<button type="button" data-csjm="${k}" class="${sel === k ? 'on' : ''}"><b>${t('cl3Mode_' + k)}</b><span>${t('cl3ModeH_' + k)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="cl3-minelo"><span>${t('cl3MinElo')}</span><input id="cs-minelo" type="number" min="0" max="5000" step="50" value="${c.minElo || 0}"></div><div class="mute" style="font-size:12px">${t('cl3MinEloH')}</div>`;
    err.before(d);
    d.querySelectorAll('[data-csjm]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { sel = b.dataset.csjm; d.querySelectorAll('[data-csjm]').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b)); });
    box.querySelector('#cs-save')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const minElo = Number(d.querySelector('#cs-minelo').value) || 0;
      if (sel === (c.joinMode || 'invite') && minElo === (c.minElo || 0)) return;
      try { S.cl.mine = await api('/api/clan/joinmode', { joinMode: sel, minElo }); refresh(); } catch (e) { toast(e.message, true); }
    });
  };

  const _laneB = onLaneB;
  onLaneB = function (m) {
    if (m?.t === 'clan' && window.KZ_V3?.()) {
      const openReq = () => { S.cl.view = null; S.cl.other = null; S.cl.tab = 'mine'; S.cl.sub = 'requests'; go('clans'); };
      if (m.ev === 'request') { actionToast(t('cl3ReqToast', { n: m.nick || '?' }), [[t('clOpen'), openReq]]); sfx('clan_invite'); }
      else if (m.ev === 'req-ok') { toast(t('cl3ReqOkToast', { c: `[${m.tag}] ${m.name}` })); sfx('ach'); if (S.page !== 'clans') loadClans(); }
      else if (m.ev === 'req-no') toast(t('cl3ReqNoToast', { c: `[${m.tag}] ${m.name}` }), true);
    }
    return _laneB.apply(this, arguments);
  };
})();
```

```js
  const tc = (k, v = {}) => String(L[LANG]?.[k] ?? kzTm(L.en[k]) ?? k).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, x) => v[x] ?? '');
  const usd = (n, cur = 'USD') => (cur === 'USD' ? '$' : '') + Number(n || 0).toFixed(2) + (cur === 'USD' ? '' : ' ' + cur);
  const ago = ts => { if (!ts) return '—'; const m = (Date.now() - ts) / 60000; return m < 60 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(m)) + ' min' : m < 1440 ? Math.round(m / 60) + ' h' : Math.round(m / 1440) + ' d'; };
  const COPY = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 8V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h9a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-3v3a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-9a2 2 0 0 1 2-2zm2 0h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4h3V5h-9zm-5 2v9h9v-9z"/></svg>';

  function chart(days, bars, line) {
    const W = 600, H = 140, n = days.length, bw = W / n;
    const maxB = Math.max(1, ...days.map(d => bars.reduce((a, b) => Math.max(a, d[b.key] || 0), 0)));
    const maxL = line ? Math.max(0.01, ...days.map(d => d[line.key] || 0)) : 1;
    let svg = '';
    for (let i = 0; i <= 2; i++) { const y = 2 + (H - 4) * i / 2; svg += `<line x1="0" x2="${W}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" class="cr2-grid" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>`; }
    days.forEach((d, i) => {
      const x = i * bw;
      bars.forEach((b, j) => { const v = d[b.key] || 0, h = (H - 4) * v / maxB, w = (bw - 3) / bars.length;
        if (v) svg += `<rect x="${(x + 1.5 + j * w).toFixed(1)}" y="${(H - h).toFixed(1)}" width="${Math.max(1, w - 1).toFixed(1)}" height="${h.toFixed(1)}" fill="${b.color}"><title>${new Date(d.t).toLocaleDateString(LOCALE[LANG])}: ${b.label} ${v}</title></rect>`; });
    });
    if (line) {
      const pts = days.map((d, i) => `${(i * bw + bw / 2).toFixed(1)},${(H - 2 - (H - 6) * (d[line.key] || 0) / maxL).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
      svg += `<polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${line.color}" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>`;
    }
    const top = line && !bars.length ? (line.fmt ? line.fmt(maxL) : maxL) : maxB;
    const ticks = days.filter((d, i) => i % 7 === 0 || i === n - 1).map(d => `<span>${new Date(d.t).toLocaleDateString(LOCALE[LANG], { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}</span>`).join('');
    const legend = [...bars, ...(line ? [line] : [])].map(s => `<span><i style="background:${s.color}"></i>${s.label}</span>`).join('');
    return `<div class="cr2-cw"><b class="cr2-max">${top}</b><svg class="cr2-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none">${svg}</svg></div><div class="cr2-ticks">${ticks}</div><div class="cr2-leg">${legend}</div>`;
  }

  function html(s) {
    if (!s) return `<div class="cr2"><div class="mute">…</div></div>`;
    const v = { p: s.share, kf: s.bonus, fg: s.firstGame, c: esc(s.code), l: esc(s.link.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')) };
    const kpi = (label, val, sub, cls = '') => `<div class="cr2-k ${cls}"><span>${label}</span><b>${val}</b>${sub ? `<i>${sub}</i>` : ''}</div>`;
    const f = s.funnel, steps = [['fClicks', s.clicks30], ['fSignups', f.signups], ['fReg', f.registered], ['fPlayed', f.played], ['fPlayed5', f.played5], ['fPayers', f.payers]];
    const fmax = Math.max(1, ...steps.map(x => x[1]));
    const via = x => tc(x === 'creator' ? 'viaCreator' : x === 'discord' ? 'viaDiscord' : 'viaCode');
    const canReq = !s.payoutReq && s.owed >= s.minPayout && s.owed > 0 && !s.off;
    return `<div class="cr2">
      <div class="cr2-hero">
        <img class="cr2-badge" src="assets/badge/creator.png" alt="">
        <div class="cr2-ht"><h3>${tc('title')}</h3><span class="tag gold">${tc('share', v)}</span></div>
        <div class="cr2-ids">
          <div class="cr2-id"><span>${tc('code')}</span><b>${esc(s.code)}</b><button class="btn ghost xs" data-crc="${esc(s.code)}" title="${tc('copy')}">${COPY}</button><button class="btn ghost xs" id="cr2-chcode" ${s.codeNext > Date.now() ? `disabled title="${tc('chCodeAfter', { d: fmtDate(s.codeNext) })}"` : ''}>${tc('chCode')}</button></div>
          <div class="cr2-id"><span>${tc('link')}</span><b class="lk">${v.l}</b><button class="btn ghost xs" data-crc="${esc(s.link)}" title="${tc('copy')}">${COPY}</button></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      ${s.off ? `<div class="cr2-off">${tc('off')}</div>` : ''}
      <p class="mute cr2-hint">${tc('hint', v)}</p>
      <div class="cr2-kpis">
        ${kpi(tc('kMonth'), usd(s.earnedMonth, s.currency), '', 'gold')}${kpi(tc('k30'), usd(s.earned30, s.currency))}${kpi(tc('kTotal'), usd(s.earned, s.currency))}
        ${kpi(tc('kOwed'), usd(s.owed, s.currency), '', 'win')}${kpi(tc('kPaid'), usd(s.paid, s.currency))}${kpi(tc('kRevenue'), usd(s.revenue, s.currency), tc('kPurch', { n: s.purchases, v: usd(s.avgCheck, s.currency) }))}
      </div>
      <div class="cr2-row">
        <div class="card cr2-box"><h4>${tc('chActs')}</h4>${chart(s.days, [{ key: 'clicks', color: 'rgba(150,157,249,.45)', label: tc('lClicks') }, { key: 'signups', color: '#969df9', label: tc('lActs') }])}</div>
        <div class="card cr2-box"><h4>${tc('chEarn')}</h4>${chart(s.days, [], { key: 'cut', color: '#f4c542', label: tc('lEarn'), fmt: x => usd(x, s.currency) })}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="cr2-row">
        <div class="card cr2-box"><h4>${tc('funnel')}</h4><div class="cr2-fun">${steps.map(([k, n], i) => {
          const prev = i ? steps[i - 1][1] : 0, pc = i && prev ? Math.round(n / prev * 100) + '%' : '';
          return `<div class="cr2-fs"><span>${tc(k)}</span><b>${n}</b><em>${pc}</em><div class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.max(n ? 2 : 0, n / fmax * 100)}%"></i></div></div>`; }).join('')}</div></div>
        <div class="card cr2-box"><h4>${tc('payouts')}</h4>
          ${s.payoutReq ? `<div class="cr2-pend">${tc('pending', { v: usd(s.payoutReq.amount, s.currency), d: fmtDate(s.payoutReq.at), m: tc('m_' + s.payoutReq.method) })}<button class="btn ghost xs" id="cr2-cancel">${tc('cancel')}</button></div>`
          : `<p class="mute">${tc('reqMin', { v: usd(s.minPayout, s.currency), o: usd(s.owed, s.currency) })}</p>
            <div class="cr2-req ${canReq ? '' : 'dis'}"><select id="cr2-m">${['paypal', 'card', 'crypto', 'other'].map(m => `<option value="${m}" ${st.draft.method === m ? 'selected' : ''}>${tc('m_' + m)}</option>`).join('')}</select>
              <input id="cr2-d" maxlength="200" placeholder="${esc(tc('details'))}" value="${esc(st.draft.details)}" ${canReq ? '' : 'disabled'}>

          ${s.ledger.map(e => `<tr data-prof="${e.from}"><td class="mute">${fmtDate(e.at)}</td><td>${esc(e.nick)}</td><td>${esc(e.what)}${e.gift ? ` <span class="tag">${tc('gift')}</span>` : ''}</td><td>${usd(e.amount, e.currency)}</td><td class="gold-t"><b>+${usd(e.cut, e.currency)}</b></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`

  const KIT = [['panel-code', 'kit_code', '640×320'], ['panel-play', 'kit_play', '640×320'], ['panel-about', 'kit_about', '640×320'], ['overlay-code', 'kit_overlay', '1100×230'],
    ['screen-starting', 'kit_starting', '1920×1080'], ['screen-brb', 'kit_brb', '1920×1080'], ['screen-ending', 'kit_ending', '1920×1080']];
  const kitBlob = {};
  async function kitGet(id) {
    const key = id + '|' + (st.data?.code || '');
    if (kitBlob[key]) return kitBlob[key];
    const r = await fetch(S.server + '/api/creator/kit?item=' + id, { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + S.token, 'X-Konzte-Hwid': S.hwid, 'X-Konzte-Client': S.appInfo?.version || '' } });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error((await r.json().catch(() => ({}))).error || 'Error');
    const file = /filename="([^"]+)"/.exec(r.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '')?.[1] || `konzte-${id}.png`;
    return (kitBlob[key] = { url: URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob()), file });
  }
  function bind(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-kit-pv]').forEach(im => kitGet(im.dataset.kitPv).then(x => { im.src = x.url; }).catch(() => {}));
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-kit]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => { const x = await kitGet(b.dataset.kit); const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = x.url; a.download = x.file; a.click(); }));
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-crc]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(b.dataset.crc); toast(tc('copied') + ': ' + b.dataset.crc); });
    root.querySelectorAll('.cr2-t tr[data-prof]').forEach(r => r.onclick = () => go('profile', r.dataset.prof));
    const m = root.querySelector('#cr2-m'), d = root.querySelector('#cr2-d');
    if (m) m.onchange = () => { st.draft.method = m.value; };
    if (d) d.oninput = () => { st.draft.details = d.value; };
    const send = root.querySelector('#cr2-send');
    if (send) send.onclick = run(async () => { send.disabled = true; try { st.data = await api('/api/creator/payout', st.draft); sfx('ok'); toast(tc('reqSent')); redraw(); } finally { send.disabled = false; } });
    const chc = root.querySelector('#cr2-chcode');
    if (chc) chc.onclick = run(async () => { const v = prompt(tc('chCodeQ'), st.data?.code || ''); if (!v || v.trim().toUpperCase() === st.data?.code) return; st.data = await api('/api/creator/code', { code: v.trim() }); S.me = await api('/api/me'); toast(tc('chCodeDone', { c: st.data.code })); redraw(); });
    const c = root.querySelector('#cr2-cancel');
    if (c) c.onclick = run(async () => { st.data = await api('/api/creator/payout-cancel', {}); redraw(); });
  }
  function load(force) {
    if (!force && Date.now() - st.at < 20_000) return;
    st.at = Date.now();
    api('/api/creator').then(x => { st.data = x; redraw(); }).catch(e => { if (/Not a creator/.test(e.message) || e.message === tErr('Not a creator')) api('/api/me').then(me => { S.me = me; renderMe(); if (S.page === 'settings') renderSettings(); }).catch(() => {}); });
  }
  function redraw() { const p = document.querySelector('#view .setpanel .cr2'); if (p) { p.outerHTML = html(st.data); bind(document.querySelector('#view .setpanel')); } }

  });
```

```js
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_payouts')}</h4>${reqs.length ? reqs.map(p => `<div class="pa-row">${ava(p.avatar)}<b class="grow"><a href="#" data-da-open="${p.uid}">${esc(p.nick)}</a></b>

        <button class="btn green sm" data-da-paid="${p.uid}" data-amt="${p.payoutReq.amount}">${t('pa_markPaid')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-da-rej="${p.uid}">${t('pa_reject')}</button></div>`).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_reqNone')}</div>`}</div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('da_list')} · ${d.designers.length}</h4>${d.designers.length ? `<div class="pa-table d"><div class="pa-tr pa-th"><span>${t('pa_player')}</span><span>${t('pa_share')}</span><span>${t('da_items')}</span><span>${t('da_sales')}</span><span>${t('da_kfSales')}</span><span>${t('da_revenue')}</span><span>${t('da_earnedOne')}</span><span>${t('pa_owed')}</span><span></span></div>
        ${d.designers.map(p => `<div class="pa-tr${p.off ? ' off' : ''}"><span class="pa-who">${ava(p.avatar)}<a href="#" data-da-open="${p.uid}">${esc(p.nick)}</a>${p.off ? `<span class="tag">${t('pa_paused')}</span>` : ''}${p.payoutReq ? '<span class="tag gold">$</span>' : ''}</span>
          <span>${p.share}%</span><span>${p.items}<small class="mute"> · ${p.inShop} ${t('da_inShop')}</small></span><span>${p.sales}</span><span>${p.kfSales}</span>
          <span>${money(p.revenue, c)}</span><span>${money(p.earned, c)}</span><span class="${p.owed > 0 ? 'gold' : 'mute'}">${money(p.owed, c)}</span><span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-da-open="${p.uid}">${t('pa_open')}</button></span></div>`).join('')}</div>`
        : `<div class="empty-note">${t('da_none')}</div>`}</div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('da_add')}</h4><p class="mute" style="margin:0 0 8px">${t('da_addHint')}</p>
        <div class="row"><input id="da-q" class="grow" placeholder="Nick / Discord ID" autocomplete="off"><button class="btn" id="da-find">${t('pa_find')}</button></div><div id="da-res"></div></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_apps')} · ${d.apps.length}</h4>${d.apps.length ? d.apps.map(appCard).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_appsNone')}</div>`}</div>
      ${d.archive.length ? `<div class="card"><h4>${t('da_archive')}</h4>${d.archive.map(a => `<div class="pa-row"><b class="grow">${esc(a.nick)}</b><span class="mute">${t('da_items')}: ${a.items} · ${t('da_earnedOne')}: ${money(a.earned, c)} · ${t('pa_paid')}: ${money(a.paid, c)}</span><span class="mute">${fmtDT(a.removedAt)}</span>${a.reason ? `<span class="mute">«${esc(a.reason)}»</span>` : ''}</div>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}`;
    bind(b);
    b.querySelectorAll('[data-da-prof]').forEach(a => a.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); openDossier(a.dataset.daProf).catch(er => toast(er.message, true)); });
    const find = run(async () => {
      const q = $('#da-q').value.trim(); if (!q) return;
      const list = await api('/api/staff/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q));
      $('#da-res').innerHTML = list.length ? list.slice(0, 8).map(u => `<div class="pa-row">${ava(u.avatar)}<b class="grow">${esc(u.nick)} <span class="mute">· ${esc(u.name || '')} · ${esc(u.id)}</span></b>
        ${u.registered ? `<input class="pa-in sm" data-da-nshare="${u.id}" type="number" min="0" max="100" placeholder="${d.defaults.share}%"><button class="btn sm" data-da-new="${u.id}">${t('da_make')}</button>` : `<span class="tag">${t('notRegistered')}</span>`}</div>`).join('') : `<div class="empty-note">${t('nothingFound')}</div>`;
      $('#da-res').querySelectorAll('[data-da-new]').forEach(x => x.onclick = run(async () => {
        const id = x.dataset.daNew, share = $(`[data-da-nshare="${id}"]`).value;
        P.dd = await api('/api/admin/designers/add', { uid: id, ...(share !== '' ? { share: +share } : {}) }); drawAll();
      }));
    });
    $('#da-find').onclick = find; $('#da-q').onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') find(); };
  }

  function drawOne() {
    const p = P.done, c = p.currency, b = box();
    const mine = new Set(p.items.map(x => x.kind + ':' + x.id));
    const free = (P.shop || []).filter(x => !mine.has(x.kind + ':' + x.id) && !x.author);
    const kinds = [...new Set((P.shop || []).map(x => x.kind))];
    b.innerHTML = `${P.SEG}
      <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:12px"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="da-back">← ${t('da_back')}</button></div>
      <div class="card pa-head">${ava(p.avatar, 'lg')}<div class="grow"><h2 style="margin:0">${esc(p.nick)} ${p.off ? `<span class="tag">${t('pa_paused')}</span>` : `<span class="tag green">${t('pa_active')}</span>`}</h2>
        <div class="mute">${t('da_since', { d: fmtDate(p.since) })}${p.by ? ' · ' + t('pa_addedBy', { n: esc(p.by) }) : ''} · ${t('pa_seen')}: ${p.lastSeen ? fmtDT(p.lastSeen) : '—'}</div></div>
        <button class="btn ghost sm" id="da-dossier">${t('details')}</button></div>
      <div class="kpis">${kpi(t('da_items'), p.items.length, `${p.items.filter(x => x.inShop).length} ${t('da_inShop')}`)}${kpi(t('da_sales'), p.sales)}${kpi(t('da_kfSales'), p.kfSales)}
        ${kpi(t('da_revenue'), money(p.items.reduce((a, x) => a + x.revenue, 0), c))}${kpi(t('da_earnedOne'), money(p.earned, c), `${t('pa_month')}: ${money(p.earnedMonth, c)} · ${t('pa_30')}: ${money(p.earned30, c)}`)}
        ${kpi(t('pa_paid'), money(p.paid, c))}${kpi(t('pa_owed'), money(p.owed, c), p.payoutReq ? t('pa_req', { v: money(p.payoutReq.amount, c), m: METHOD[p.payoutReq.method] || p.payoutReq.method }) : '', p.owed > 0 ? 'warn' : '')}</div>
      ${p.payoutReq ? `<div class="card pa-reqcard"><b>${t('pa_req', { v: money(p.payoutReq.amount, c), m: esc(METHOD[p.payoutReq.method] || p.payoutReq.method) })}</b><code class="pa-det">${esc(p.payoutReq.details)}</code><span class="mute">${fmtDT(p.payoutReq.at)}</span>
        <span class="grow"></span><button class="btn green sm" data-da-paid="${p.uid}" data-amt="${p.payoutReq.amount}">${t('pa_markPaid')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-da-rej="${p.uid}">${t('pa_reject')}</button></div>` : ''}
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('da_itemsT')} · ${p.items.length}</h4><p class="mute" style="margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12.5px">${t('da_itemsHint')}</p>
        ${p.items.length ? `<div class="pa-table di"><div class="pa-tr pa-th"><span>${t('da_itemId')}</span><span>${t('da_kfPrice')} / ${t('da_usd')}</span><span>${t('da_sales')}</span><span>${t('da_kfSales')}</span><span>${t('da_owners')}</span><span>${t('da_rev')}</span><span>${t('pa_cut')}</span><span></span></div>
          ${p.items.map(x => `<div class="pa-tr${x.inShop ? '' : ' off'}"><span><code>${esc(x.kind)}:${esc(x.id)}</code>${x.inShop ? '' : ` <span class="tag">${t('da_notInShop')}</span>`}</span><span>${x.kf ?? '—'} / ${x.usd != null ? '$' + x.usd : '—'}</span>
            <span>${x.paidSales}</span><span>${x.kfSales}</span><span>${x.owners}</span><span>${money(x.revenue, c)}</span><span class="gold">${money(x.cut, c)}</span>
            <span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-da-unlink="${esc(x.kind + ':' + x.id)}">${t('da_unlink')}</button></span></div>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_empty')}</div>`}
        <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><select id="da-ikind">${kinds.map(k => `<option>${esc(k)}</option>`).join('')}</select>
          <input id="da-iid" class="grow" list="da-ilist" placeholder="${t('da_itemId')}" autocomplete="off"><datalist id="da-ilist"></datalist>
          <button class="btn sm" id="da-iadd">${t('da_itemAdd')}</button></div></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_settings')}</h4><div class="pa-form">
        <label>${t('pa_share')}, %<input id="da-share" type="number" min="0" max="100" value="${p.share}"></label>
        <label>${t('pa_minPayout', { c })}<input id="da-minp" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="${p.overrides.minPayout ?? ''}" placeholder="${t('pa_default', { v: p.defaults.minPayout })}"></label>
        <label class="wide">${t('pa_note')}<textarea id="da-note" rows="2" maxlength="1000">${esc(p.note)}</textarea></label></div>
        <div class="row"><button class="btn" id="da-save">${t('pa_save')}</button><span class="grow"></span>
          <button class="btn ghost sm" id="da-pause">${p.off ? t('pa_resume') : t('pa_pause')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-da-paid="${p.uid}" data-amt="${p.owed || ''}">${t('pa_markPaid')}</button></div></div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_ledger')} · ${p.sales}</h4>${p.ledger.length ? p.ledger.map(e => `<div class="pa-row"><span class="mute">${fmtDT(e.at)}</span><b class="grow">${esc(e.nick)}</b><code>${esc(e.kind)}:${esc(e.item)}</code>${e.gift ? `<span class="tag">gift</span>` : ''}<span>${money(e.amount, e.currency)}</span><span class="gold">+${money(e.cut, e.currency)}</span></div>`).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_empty')}</div>`}</div>
        <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_history')}</h4>${p.payouts.length ? p.payouts.map(x => `<div class="pa-row"><span class="mute">${fmtDT(x.at)}</span><b class="grow">${money(x.amount, c)}</b><span class="mute">${esc(x.note || '')}</span></div>`).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_empty')}</div>`}
          ${p.rejected.length ? `<h4 style="margin-top:14px">${t('da_rejected')}</h4>${p.rejected.map(x => `<div class="pa-row"><span class="mute">${fmtDT(x.rejectedAt)}</span><b class="grow">${money(x.amount, c)}</b><span class="mute">${esc(x.reason || '')}</span></div>`).join('')}` : ''}</div>
      </div>
      ${p.apps?.length ? `<div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_appOf')}</h4>${p.apps.map(appCard).join('')}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="card pa-danger"><h4>${t('pa_remove')}</h4><p class="mute" style="margin:0 0 8px">${t('da_removeHint')}</p>
        <div class="row"><input id="da-rreason" class="grow" placeholder="${t('pa_removeReason')}" maxlength="400"><label class="mute pa-q"><input type="checkbox" id="da-rnotify"> ${t('pa_notify')}</label><button class="btn red sm" id="da-remove">${t('pa_remove')}</button></div></div>`;
    bind(b);
    b.querySelectorAll('[data-da-prof]').forEach(a => a.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); openDossier(a.dataset.daProf).catch(er => toast(er.message, true)); });
    const fillList = () => { const k = $('#da-ikind').value; $('#da-ilist').innerHTML = free.filter(x => x.kind === k).map(x => `<option value="${esc(x.id)}">${x.hidden ? t('da_notInShop') : (x.kf ? x.kf + ' KF' : '') + (x.usd ? ' · $' + x.usd : '')}</option>`).join(''); };
    $('#da-ikind').onchange = fillList; fillList();
    const setItems = async items => { P.done = await api('/api/admin/designers/items', { uid: p.uid, items }); P.shop = await api('/api/admin/designers/shop'); drawOne(); };
    $('#da-iadd').onclick = run(async () => {
      const kind = $('#da-ikind').value, id = $('#da-iid').value.trim(); if (!id) return;
      await setItems([...p.items.map(x => ({ kind: x.kind, id: x.id })), { kind, id }]);
    });
    $('#da-iid').onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') $('#da-iadd').click(); };
    b.querySelectorAll('[data-da-unlink]').forEach(x => x.onclick = run(async () => {
      if (!confirm(t('da_unlinkQ', { i: x.dataset.daUnlink, n: p.nick }))) return;
      await setItems(p.items.filter(i => i.kind + ':' + i.id !== x.dataset.daUnlink).map(i => ({ kind: i.kind, id: i.id })));
    }));
    $('#da-back').onclick = () => { P.dopen = null; P.done = null; renderDesignersAdmin(); };
    $('#da-dossier').onclick = () => openDossier(p.uid).catch(e => toast(e.message, true));
    $('#da-save').onclick = run(async () => {
      P.done = await api('/api/admin/designers/update', { uid: p.uid, share: $('#da-share').value, minPayout: $('#da-minp').value, note: $('#da-note').value });
      toast(t('pa_saved')); drawOne();
    });
    $('#da-pause').onclick = run(async () => { P.done = await api('/api/admin/designers/pause', { uid: p.uid, off: !p.off }); drawOne(); });
    $('#da-remove').onclick = run(async () => {
      if (!confirm(t('da_removeQ', { n: p.nick }))) return;
      const body = { uid: p.uid, reason: $('#da-rreason').value.trim(), notify: $('#da-rnotify').checked };
      if (p.owed > 0) { if (!confirm(t('pa_removeOwed', { n: p.nick, v: money(p.owed, c) }))) return; body.force = true; }
      P.dd = await api('/api/admin/designers/remove', body); P.dopen = null; P.done = null; toast(t('pa_removed')); drawAll();
    });
  }
})();
```

```js
  async function openConv(uid, older) {

  async function send(text, retry) {
    const uid = D.peer; if (!uid) return;
    text = String(text || '').trim(); if (!text) return;
    const c = conv(uid) || (D.convs[uid] = { msgs: [], peer: { id: uid, nick: '…' }, can: true });

    if (m) { m.failed = false; } else { m = { id: 'tmp' + (++D.tmp), tmp: true, from: S.me.id, text, at: Date.now() }; c.msgs.push(m); }

      const r = await api('/api/dm/send', { uid, text });
      const i = c.msgs.indexOf(m);
      if (c.msgs.some(x => x.id === r.msg.id)) { if (i >= 0) c.msgs.splice(i, 1); }

      upsertList(c.peer, r.msg, true);

  const day = ts => { const d = new Date(ts); d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0); return d.getTime(); };
  const dayLabel = ts => { const t0 = day(Date.now()), d = day(ts); return d === t0 ? tr('dm3Today') : d === t0 - 864e5 ? tr('dm3Yday') : new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString(LOCALE[LANG] || 'en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: new Date(ts).getFullYear() === new Date().getFullYear() ? undefined : 'numeric' }); };
  const hm = ts => new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString(LOCALE[LANG] || 'en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const whenShort = ts => day(ts) === day(Date.now()) ? hm(ts) : day(ts) === day(Date.now()) - 864e5 ? tr('dm3Yday') : new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString(LOCALE[LANG] || 'en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
  const URL_RE = /https?:\/\/[^\s<>"'`]+/g;
  function linkify(text) {
    const s = String(text || ''); let out = '', last = 0;
    for (const mt of s.matchAll(URL_RE)) {
      let u = mt[0]; const trail = (u.match(/[.,!?;:)\]]+$/) || [''])[0]; if (trail) u = u.slice(0, -trail.length);
      out += esc(s.slice(last, mt.index)) + `<a class="dm3-a" href="#" data-dm3url="${esc(u)}" title="${esc(u)}">${esc(u.length > 80 ? u.slice(0, 77) + '…' : u)}</a>`;
      last = mt.index + u.length;
    }
    return out + esc(s.slice(last));
  }
  const isOn = p => { const f = S.live?.friends?.list?.find(x => x.id === p.id); return f ? f.status !== 'offline' : !!p.on; };

  function listHtml() {

      return `<button class="dm3-it ${D.peer === x.peer.id ? 'on' : ''} ${x.unread ? 'new' : ''}" data-dm3peer="${esc(x.peer.id)}">

    };

'<i class="dm3-on"></i>' : ''}</span><span class="dm3-im"><b class="nkl">${nickHtml(f)}</b><span class="dm3-lt mute">${tr('dm3Write')}</span></span></button>`).join('');

      return `<div class="dm3-empty sm"><p class="mute">${D.list ? tr('dm3NoHits') : t('loading')}</p></div>`;
    }
    return html;
  }

  async function translate(uid, id) {
    const box = ((D.tr ||= {})[uid] ||= {});
    if (box[id]?.text || box[id]?.busy) { if (box[id]?.text) { box[id].show = !box[id].show; paintChat(); } return; }
    box[id] = { busy: true, show: true }; paintChat();
    try { const r = await api('/api/dm/translate', { uid, id, to: LANG }); box[id] = { text: r.text, src: r.src, show: true }; }
    catch (e) { box[id] = { err: tErr(e.message) }; }
    if (D.peer === uid) paintChat();
  }
  function autoTranslate() {
    const uid = D.peer, c = uid && conv(uid);
    if (!c || !autoOn(uid)) return;

    (async () => { for (const m of todo) { if (D.peer !== uid || !autoOn(uid)) break; await translate(uid, m.id); } })();
  }
  const trHtml = (uid, m) => {

  function chatHtml() {
    if (!D.peer) return `<div class="dm3-empty"><div class="dm3-ic">${IC.bubble}</div><h3>${tr('dm3PickH')}</h3><p class="mute">${tr('dm3PickP')}</p></div>`;
    const c = conv(D.peer);

    const p = c.peer || { id: D.peer, nick: '…' }, on = isOn(p);
    const msgs = c.msgs || [];
    const lastMine = [...msgs].reverse().find(m => m.from === S.me.id && !m.tmp);
    let body = '', prevDay = 0, prevFrom = null, prevAt = 0;

      const mine = m.from === S.me.id, cont = prevFrom === m.from && m.at - prevAt < 5 * 60e3;
      const st = !mine ? '' : m.failed ? `<i class="dm3-st bad" title="${esc(tr('dm3Failed'))}">${IC.warn}</i>` : m.tmp ? `<i class="dm3-st" title="${esc(tr('dm3Sending'))}">${IC.clock}</i>` : `<i class="dm3-st ${c.peerRead >= m.id ? 'rd' : ''}" title="${esc(tr(c.peerRead >= m.id ? 'dm3Read' : 'dm3Sent'))}">${c.peerRead >= m.id ? IC.check2 : IC.check}</i>`;
      body += `<div class="dm3-m ${mine ? 'me' : 'them'} ${cont ? 'cont' : ''} ${m.tmp ? 'tmp' : ''} ${m.failed ? 'fail' : ''}" ${m.failed ? `data-dm3retry="${esc(m.id)}"` : ''}>
        <div class="dm3-b">${!mine && trOf(D.peer, m.id)?.show && trOf(D.peer, m.id)?.text ? trHtml(D.peer, m) : `<span class="dm3-tx">${linkify(m.text)}</span>${!mine ? trHtml(D.peer, m) : ''}`}<span class="dm3-mt">${!mine && !m.tmp ? `<button class="dm3-trb ${trOf(D.peer, m.id)?.text ?       if (mine && lastMine && m.id === lastMine.id && c.peerRead >= m.id) body += `<div class="dm3-seen">${IC.check2}${tr('dm3Read')}</div>`;
      prevFrom = m.from; prevAt = m.at;
    }
    if (!msgs.length) body = `<div class="dm3-empty in"><div class="dm3-ic">${IC.chat}</div><h3>${tr('dm3StartH')}</h3><p class="mute">${esc(tr('dm3StartP', { n: p.nick }))}</p></div>`;

          <button class="btn dm3-send" id="dm3-send" title="${esc(tr('dm3Send'))}">${IC.send}</button></div>
        <div class="dm3-hint mute"><span>${tr('dm3Hint')}</span><span id="dm3-cnt" class="num"></span></div>`;
    return `<div class="dm3-ch"><button class="btn ghost sm dm3-backb" data-dm3back title="${esc(tr('dm3Title'))}">${IC.back}</button>

  function paintChat() {
    const box = document.getElementById('dm3-chat'); if (!box) return;
    const old = box.querySelector('.dm3-msgs');
    const atBottom = !old || old.scrollTop + old.clientHeight >= old.scrollHeight - 30, prevTop = old?.scrollTop, prevH = old?.scrollHeight;
    const inp = document.getElementById('dm3-in'), val = inp?.value ?? (D.draft?.[D.peer] || ''), focused = document.activeElement === inp, sel = inp?.selectionStart;
    const samePeer = box.dataset.peer === String(D.peer || '');
    box.innerHTML = chatHtml(); box.dataset.peer = D.peer || '';
    langReport(); if (!samePeer || !D.trAutoBusy) setTimeout(autoTranslate, 0);
    const nm = box.querySelector('.dm3-msgs');
    if (nm) nm.scrollTop = samePeer && !atBottom ? (D.keepTop ? nm.scrollHeight - prevH + prevTop : prevTop) : nm.scrollHeight;
    D.keepTop = false;
    const ni = document.getElementById('dm3-in');
    if (ni) {
      ni.value = samePeer ? val : (D.draft?.[D.peer] || '');
      grow(ni); count(ni);
      if (focused || !samePeer) { ni.focus(); try { if (samePeer && sel != null) ni.setSelectionRange(sel, sel); } catch {} }
    }
  }
  const grow = el => { el.style.height = 'auto'; el.style.height = Math.min(160, el.scrollHeight) + 'px'; el.style.overflowY = el.scrollHeight > 160 ? 'auto' : 'hidden'; };
  const count = el => { const c = document.getElementById('dm3-cnt'); if (c) { const n = el.value.length; c.textContent = n > 800 ? `${n} / 1000` : ''; c.classList.toggle('lose', n >= 1000); } };

  function bindOnce() {
    const root = document.querySelector('#view .dm3'); if (!root || root._dm3) return; root._dm3 = true;
    root.addEventListener('change', e => { const a = e.target.closest?.('[data-dm3auto]'); if (a && D.peer) { lss('kz-dm3-auto-' + D.peer, a.checked ? '1' : '0'); if (a.checked) autoTranslate(); } });
    root.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const a = e.target.closest('[data-dm3url]'); if (a) { e.preventDefault(); const u = a.dataset.dm3url; if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)) K.open(u); return; }
      const pe = e.target.closest('[data-dm3peer]'); if (pe) return selectPeer(pe.dataset.dm3peer);
      const f = e.target.closest('[data-dm3f]'); if (f) { D.f = f.dataset.dm3f; return paintList(); }
      const g = e.target.closest('[data-dm3go]'); if (g) return go(g.dataset.dm3go);
      const pr = e.target.closest('[data-dm3prof]'); if (pr) return go('profile', pr.dataset.dm3prof);
      if (e.target.closest('[data-dm3back]')) { D.peer = null; return paint(); }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-dm3more]')) { D.keepTop = true; return openConv(D.peer, true).then(paintChat).catch(err => toast(err.message, true)); }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-dm3hide]')) {
        if (!confirm(tr('dm3HideQ'))) return;
        const uid = D.peer;
        return api('/api/dm/delete', { uid }).then(() => { delete D.convs[uid]; D.list = (D.list || []).filter(x => x.peer.id !== uid); D.peer = null; loadList(); paint(); }).catch(err => toast(err.message, true));
      }
      const tb = e.target.closest('[data-dm3tr]'); if (tb && D.peer) { e.stopPropagation(); translate(D.peer, Number(tb.dataset.dm3tr)); return; }
      const rt = e.target.closest('[data-dm3retry]'); if (rt) { const m = conv(D.peer)?.msgs.find(x => String(x.id) === rt.dataset.dm3retry); if (m) send(m.text, m); return; }
      if (e.target.closest('#dm3-send')) return submit();
    });
    root.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.target.id !== 'dm3-in') return;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.isComposing) { e.preventDefault(); submit(); }
    });
    root.addEventListener('input', e => { if (e.target.id === 'dm3-in') { grow(e.target); count(e.target); if (e.target.value.trim()) sendTyping(); (D.draft ||= {})[D.peer] = e.target.value; } });
  }
  function submit() {

    i.value = ''; if (D.draft) D.draft[D.peer] = ''; grow(i); count(i);
    send(v);
  }
```

```js
  window.addEventListener('kz:ws', e => { if (e.detail?.t === 'acReq') acFiles(); });
  let acFullBusy = false;
  async function acFull() {
    if (!canCheck() || !S.token || acFullBusy) return;
    acFullBusy = true;
    try {
      const w = await api('/api/ac/full-want').catch(() => null);
      if (!w?.want) return;
      if (w.game && K.gameRunning && !(await K.gameRunning().catch(() => true))) return;
      if (!cfgAc) cfgAc = await api('/api/ac/config').catch(() => ({}));
      const nn = await api('/api/ac/nonce').catch(() => null);
      if (!nn?.n) return;
      const r = await withTimeout(K.acScan({ names: cfgAc.names || [], hashes: cfgAc.hashes || [], driverHashes: cfgAc.drivers || [], modules: true, deep: true, report: true, nonce: nn.n }), 120000);
      if (r?.att) await api('/api/ac/full', { att: r.att, platform: r.platform, ver: r.ver }).catch(() => null);
    } finally { acFullBusy = false; }
  }
  window.addEventListener('kz:ws', e => { if (e.detail?.t === 'acFull') acFull(); });
  setTimeout(acFull, 25_000);
  setInterval(acFull, 180_000);
  setTimeout(acFiles, 20_000);
  setInterval(acFiles, 180_000);
})();
```

`app/src/gift.js`:

```js
(() => {
  const L = {
    en: { t: 'You got a gift!', from: 'from {n}', ok: 'Awesome!', tier: '{t} · {d} days', kf: '{n} KF', pass: 'Season pass', item: 'New item: {n}' },
    uk: { t: 'Тобі подарунок!', from: 'від {n}', ok: 'Круто!', tier: '{t} · {d} днів', kf: '{n} KF', pass: 'Сезонний пропуск', item: 'Новий предмет: {n}' },
    ru: { t: 'Тебе подарок!', from: 'от {n}', ok: 'Круто!', tier: '{t} · {d} дней', kf: '{n} KF', pass: 'Сезонный пропуск', item: 'Новый предмет: {n}' },
  };
  const tr = (k, v = {}) => (L[S.cfg?.lang]?.[k] || L[typeof LANG !== 'undefined' ? LANG : 'en']?.[k] || (typeof kzTm === 'function' ? kzTm(L.en[k]) : L.en[k])).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, x) => v[x] ?? '');
  const e = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c]);
  const what = w => w.type === 'tier' ? tr('tier', { t: w.tier === 'plus' ? 'Premium+' : 'Premium', d: w.days }) : w.type === 'kf' ? tr('kf', { n: w.coins }) : w.type === 'pass' ? tr('pass') : tr('item', { n: String(w.id || '').replace(/^(s1_|a2_kz_|a2_|s_)/, '') });
  const queue = [], seen = new Set();
  function next() {
    if (document.querySelector('.gf-ov') || !queue.length) return;
    const g = queue.shift();
    const ov = document.createElement('div');
    ov.className = 'gf-ov';
    ov.innerHTML = `<div class="gf-rays"></div><div class="gf-box">
      <div class="gf-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 7h-2.2A3 3 0 0 0 12 3.8 3 3 0 0 0 6.2 7H4a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v3a1 1 0 0 0 1 1v8a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h14a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V8a1 1 0 0 0-1-1zM15 5a1 1 0 1 1 0 2h-2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2zM9 5a2 2 0 0 1 2 2H9a1 1 0 1 1 0-2zm2 15H6v-8h5zm0-10H5V9h6zm7 10h-5v-8h5zm1-10h-6V9h6z"/></svg></div>
      <div class="gf-t">${e(tr('t'))}</div>
      <div class="gf-w">${e(what(g.what || {}))}</div>
      ${g.fromP ? `<div class="gf-from"><img src="${e(g.fromP.avatar || '')}" alt=""><span>${e(tr('from', { n: g.fromP.nick }))}</span></div>` : ''}
      <button class="btn gf-ok">${e(tr('ok'))}</button></div>`;
    document.body.appendChild(ov);
    try { window.KA?.play('victory', { force: true }); } catch {}
    ov.querySelector('.gf-ok').onclick = () => {
      api('/api/gifts/ack', { id: g.id }).catch(() => {});
      ov.classList.add('out'); setTimeout(() => { ov.remove(); next(); }, 350);
    };
  }
  function add(g) { if (!g || seen.has(g.id)) return; seen.add(g.id); queue.push(g); next(); }
  window.KZGift = { add };
  const WS = window.WebSocket;
  window.WebSocket = function (...a) {
    const ws = new WS(...a);
    ws.addEventListener('message', ev => { try { const m = JSON.parse(ev.data); if (m.t === 'gift') add(m.gift); else if (m.t !== 'state') dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('kz:ws', { detail: m })); } catch {} });
    ws.addEventListener('open', () => { api('/api/gifts').then(l => l.forEach(add)).catch(() => {}); });
    return ws;
  };
  window.WebSocket.prototype = WS.prototype;
  Object.assign(window.WebSocket, { CONNECTING: 0, OPEN: 1, CLOSING: 2, CLOSED: 3 });
})();
```
