      sticker: cat.STICKERS || [], ncolor: [...Object.keys(cat.NCOLORS || {}), ...Object.keys(cat.NGRADS || {})], vfx: cat.VFX || [],
    }[k] || [];
  };
  const shopIt = (k, id) => S.shop?.items?.find(x => x.kind === k && x.id === id);
  const premSet = k => {
    const T = S.premInfo?.tiers || {}, out = new Set();
    for (const tier of Object.values(T)) for (const id of tier?.[S2_OWNK[k]] || []) out.add(id);
    if (k === 'ncolor') for (const id of Object.keys(s2Cat().NGRADS || {})) out.add(id);
    return out;
  };
  const worn = (k, id) => s2Worn(k, id);
  const wornId = k => {
    const c = S.myProfile?.cosmetics || {}, pr = S.me?.prem || {}, lc = s2LC()?.cos;
    if (k === 'banner' || k === 'frame' || k === 'emblem') return c[k] ?? pr[k] ?? '';
    if (k === 'ncolor' || k === 'vfx') return lc?.[k] || '';
    if (k === 'theme') return c.theme || '';
    if (k === 'music') return c.music || '';
    if (k === 'avatar') return ids('avatar').find(id => s2Worn('avatar', id)) || '';
    return '';
  };
  const src = (k, id) => {
    if (k === 'banner' || k === 'frame' || k === 'emblem') return cosmeticSource(k + 's', id) || t('s2_k_' + k);
    if (k === 'avatar' && /^av_(an|df)_/.test(id)) return s2Name('kit', id.replace(/^av_an_/, 'kit4_').replace(/^av_df_/, 'kit5_'));
    if (k === 'avatar' && typeof XMAS !== 'undefined' && XMAS.AVATARS.includes(id)) return cosmeticSource('avatars', id);
    if (k === 'avatar') return t('iv3_free');
    if (k === 'theme') return kzThemeT('usdShort');
    if (k === 'music') return t('s2_k_music');
    if (k === 'ncolor' && s2Cat().NGRADS?.[id]) return 'Premium+';
    return t('s2_k_' + k);
  };
  const priceHtml = it => !it ? '' : it.usdOnly ? `<b class="iv3-pr usd">$${s2UsdNow(it)}</b>` : `<b class="iv3-pr">${s2Now(it)} <i>KF</i></b>`;

  function playerCard(sel, bg) {
    const f = s2Fake(sel, !S.s2.cmp);
    f.pbg = S.myProfile?.pbg; f.id = S.me.id;
    const tryBg = bg;
    return window.kzCard3 ? kzCard3(f, { mode: S.me.r2v2 ? '2v2' : undefined, bg: tryBg }) : '';
  }
  function side(tab, sel) {
    if (tab === 'pbg') return pbgSide(sel);
    const isSel = sel && tab !== 'badge';
    const has = isSel && s2Has(tab, sel), w = isSel && worn(tab, sel), it = isSel && shopIt(tab, sel);
    const pv = isSel && !['theme', 'vfx', 'music'].includes(tab) ? { kind: tab, id: sel } : null;
    let body;
    if (tab === 'theme' && sel) body = kzThemeTry(sel, has);
    else if (tab === 'music') body = sel ? kzMusTry(sel) : `${kzMusTry(wornId('music'))}<p class="mute iv3-note">${esc(kzMusT('invHint'))}</p>`;
    else body = playerCard(pv) + (tab === 'vfx' && sel ? `<div class="iv3-vfx">${s2Thumb('vfx', sel)}<button class="btn ghost sm" data-iv3vfx="${esc(sel)}">${IC.play}${t('iv3_vfxPlay')}</button></div>` : '')
      + `<div class="iv3-ctx">${s2TryHtml(pv, false)}</div>`;
    const act = !isSel ? `<p class="mute iv3-note">${t('iv3_pick')}</p>`
      : w ? `<div class="iv3-sact"><span class="iv3-ok">${IC.check}${t('iv3_worn')}</span><span class="grow"></span>${tab === 'sticker' ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-iv3eq="${esc(sel)}">${t('iv3_place')}</button>` : `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-iv3eq="">${t('iv3_take')}</button>`}</div>`
      : has ? `<button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3eq="${esc(sel)}">${tab === 'sticker' ? t('iv3_place') : t('iv3_wear')}</button>`
      : it ? `<button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3shop="${esc(sel)}">${IC.cart}${t('iv3_buy')} · ${it.usdOnly ? '$' + s2UsdNow(it) : s2Now(it) + ' KF'}</button>`
      : premSet(tab).has(sel) && !S.me.premium?.tier ? `<button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3go="premium">${IC.crown}${t('iv3_get')}</button>`
      : `<div class="iv3-sact mute">${IC.lock}<span>${esc(src(tab, sel))}</span></div>`;
    return `<div class="card iv3-side s2-try">
      <div class="iv3-sh"><div><span class="p3-h">${isSel ? t('iv3_trying') : t('iv3_card')}</span><b>${isSel ? esc(s2Name(tab, sel)) : t('iv3_cardSub')}</b></div><span class="grow"></span>
        ${isSel ? `<button class="iv3-x" data-iv3unsel title="✕">${IC.x}</button>` : ''}</div>
      ${body}${act}</div>`;
  }

  function art(tab, id) {
    const me = S.me;
    if (tab === 'banner') return `<div class="iv3-bn">${bannerHtml(id, 'iv3-bimg')}<div class="iv3-bnin">${avaF(me, '', me.prem?.frame)}<b>${nickHtml({ ...me, badges: [], prem: { ...(me.prem || {}), tier: '' } })}</b></div></div>`;
    if (tab === 'theme') return kzThemeThumb(id);
    if (tab === 'music') return kzMusThumb(id);
    return s2Thumb(tab, id);
  }
  function card(tab, id, sel) {
    const has = s2Has(tab, id), w = has && worn(tab, id), it = shopIt(tab, id);
    const prem = !has && premSet(tab).has(id) && !S.me.premium?.tier;
    const act = w ? `<div class="iv3-st on">${IC.check}<span>${t('iv3_worn')}</span>${tab === 'sticker' ? '' : `<button class="iv3-mini" data-iv3eq="">${t('iv3_take')}</button>`}</div>`
      : has ? `<button class="btn sm iv3-wear" data-iv3eq="${esc(id)}">${tab === 'sticker' ? t('iv3_place') : t('iv3_wear')}</button>`
      : it ? `<div class="iv3-st buy">${priceHtml(it)}<button class="btn sm" data-iv3shop="${esc(id)}">${t('iv3_buy')}${IC.arrow}</button></div>`
      : prem ? `<button class="btn ghost sm iv3-prem" data-iv3go="premium">${IC.crown}Premium</button>`
      : `<div class="iv3-st lk">${IC.lock}<span>${t('iv3_locked')}</span></div>`;
    return `<div class="iv3-it ${has ? 'own' : 'lock'} ${w ? 'worn' : ''} ${id === sel ? 'sel' : ''}" data-iv3sel="${esc(id)}">
      <div class="iv3-art">${art(tab, id)}${has ? '' : `<i class="iv3-lki">${IC.lock}</i>`}${w ? `<i class="iv3-wi">${IC.check}</i>` : ''}</div>
      <div class="iv3-nm"><b title="${esc(s2Name(tab, id))}">${esc(s2Name(tab, id))}</b><span>${esc(src(tab, id))}</span></div>
      <div class="iv3-ft">${act}</div></div>`;
  }

  function current(tab, noShopBtn) {
    const me = S.myProfile, st = s2LC();
    if (tab === 'sticker') {
      const on = st?.cos?.stickers || [], own = st?.owned?.stickers || [];
      return `<div class="card iv3-cur"><div class="iv3-curart stk">${on.map(s => stickerImg(s.id)).join('') || IC.box}</div>
        <div class="grow"><span class="p3-h">${t('iv3_stkCur')}</span><h3>${on.length ? on.map(s => esc(s2Name('sticker', s.id))).join(' · ') : t('iv3_stkNone')}</h3><p class="mute">${t('s2_stkNote')}</p></div>
        ${own.length ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" data-iv3eq="x">${IC.edit}${t('iv3_edit')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
    }
    const id = wornId(tab);
    const thumb = tab === 'avatar' ? `<div class="s2-sq">${ava(S.me, 'lg')}</div>` : tab === 'music' ? kzMusThumb(id) : id ? art(tab, id) : `<div class="iv3-curnone">${IC.box}</div>`;
    const name = tab === 'avatar' && me.customAvatar ? t('iv3_avOwn') : id ? esc(s2Name(tab, id)) : tab === 'theme' || tab === 'music' ? 'Konzte' : t('iv3_none');
    const extra = tab === 'avatar' ? `${S.me.premium?.tier ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" id="iv3-avup">${IC.up}${t('iv3_avUp')}</button>` : `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" data-iv3go="premium">${IC.crown}${t('iv3_avPrem')}</button>`}
        ${me.customAvatar ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" id="iv3-avreset">${t('iv3_avReset')}</button>` : ''}<input type="file" id="iv3-avfile" accept="image/gif,image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" hidden>`
      : id && tab === 'music' ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" data-iv3eq="">${IC.x}${kzMusT('toDef')}</button>`
      : id && tab !== 'theme' ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" data-iv3eq="">${IC.x}${t('iv3_take')}</button>`
      : id && tab === 'theme' ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" data-iv3eq="">${IC.x}${kzThemeT('default')}</button>` : '';
    return `<div class="card iv3-cur k-${tab}"><div class="iv3-curart">${thumb}</div>
      <div class="grow"><span class="p3-h">${t('iv3_cur')} · ${t('s2_k_' + tab)}</span><h3>${name}</h3><p class="mute">${tab === 'avatar' && me.customAvatar ? t('iv3_avOwnD') : id ? esc(src(tab, id)) : tab === 'theme' ? kzThemeT('default') : tab === 'music' ? kzMusT('d_def') : t('iv3_noneD')}</p></div>
      ${extra}${shopCount(tab) && !noShopBtn ? `<button class="btn iv3-cbtn" data-iv3shop="">${IC.cart}${t('iv3_toShop')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
  }
  const shopCount = tab => (S.shop?.items || []).filter(x => x.kind === tab).length;

  function badgeList() {
    const all = S.me?.badgesAll || S.me?.badges || [], out = [];
    if (S.me?.premium) out.push('premium');
    for (const k of ['owner', 'dev', 'creator']) if (all.includes(k)) out.push(k);
    const hid = S.me.hideBadges || {};
    const icon = k => k === 'premium' ? `<img src="assets/crown-${S.me.premium?.tier === 'plus' ? 'plus' : 'premium'}.png" alt="">` : badgeIcon(k);
    const rows = out.map(k => `<div class="iv3-bdg ${hid[k] ? 'off' : ''}"><i class="iv3-bic bdg bdg-${k}">${icon(k)}</i><div class="grow"><b>${t('iv3_b_' + k)}</b><span>${hid[k] ? t('iv3_hidden') : t('iv3_shown')}</span></div>
      <button class="switch ${hid[k] ? '' : 'on'}" data-iv3bh="${k}"></button></div>`);
    if (all.includes('verified')) rows.push(`<div class="iv3-bdg"><i class="iv3-bic bdg bdg-verified">${badgeIcon('verified')}</i><div class="grow"><b>${t('iv3_b_verified')}</b><span>${t('iv3_always')}</span></div><span class="iv3-ok">${IC.check}</span></div>`);
    return `<div class="card iv3-bdgs"><p class="mute">${t('iv3_bHint')}</p>${rows.join('') || `<div class="iv3-emp mini">${IC.eye}<span>${t('iv3_noBadges')}</span></div>`}</div>`;
  }

  const pbgCur = () => S.myProfile?.pbg || null;
  const pbgKey = b => !b ? '' : b.type === 'banner' ? b.banner : b.type === 'image' ? '@img' : '';
  const pbgBg = id => !id ? { auto: 1 } : id === '@img' ? { url: (S.server || '') + pbgCur()?.url } : { banner: id };
  const pbgName = id => !id ? t('iv3_pbgNone') : id === '@img' ? t('iv3_pbgImg') : s2Name('banner', id);
  const PBG_ALLOW = ['gas_visor', ...SHOP4.PBG()];
  function pbgList() {
    const own = S.myProfile?.available?.banners;
    return ['', ...PBG_ALLOW.filter(id => !/^(b[45]_|a3_snow_rig$)/.test(id) || (own || []).includes(id))];
  }
  const meCard = (bg, cls) => { const f = { ...S.me, pbg: bg?.auto ? null : S.myProfile?.pbg }; if (bg?.auto) bg = undefined; return window.kzCard3 ? kzCard3(f, { mode: S.me.r2v2 ? '2v2' : undefined, bg, cls }) : ''; };
  function pbgMain(sel) {
    const prem = !!S.me.premium?.tier, cur = pbgCur(), ck = pbgKey(cur), list = pbgList();
    const curCard = `<div class="card iv3-cur k-pbg"><div class="iv3-curart pbgc">${ck === '@img' ? `<div class="iv3-bimg" style="background-image:url('${esc((S.server || '') + pbgCur().url)}')"></div>` : ck ? bannerHtml(ck, 'iv3-bimg') : `<div class="kc3 topo iv3-kmini"><div class="kc3-bg">${kzCard3.topo(S.me.id)}</div></div>`}</div>
      <div class="grow"><span class="p3-h">${t('iv3_cur2')}</span><h3>${esc(pbgName(ck))}</h3><p class="mute">${ck ? t('iv3_pbgHint') : t('iv3_pbgNoneD')}</p></div>
      ${ck ? `<button class="btn ghost iv3-cbtn" data-iv3pbg="">${IC.x}${t('iv3_take')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
    const up = prem ? '' : `<div class="card iv3-up"><i class="iv3-upic">${IC.crown}</i><div class="grow"><b>${t('iv3_pbgPrem')}</b><span class="mute">${t('iv3_pbgPremD')}</span></div>
      <button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3go="premium">${t('iv3_get')}</button></div>`;
    const card = id => {
      const on = id === ck;
      const act = on ? `<div class="iv3-st on">${IC.check}<span>${t('iv3_using')}</span></div>`
        : !prem && id ? `<button class="btn ghost sm iv3-prem" data-iv3go="premium">${IC.crown}Premium</button>`
        : id === '@img' ? '' : `<button class="btn sm iv3-wear" data-iv3pbg="${esc(id)}">${t('iv3_set')}</button>`;
      return `<div class="iv3-it iv3-bgc ${on ? 'worn' : ''} ${id === sel ? 'sel' : ''} ${!prem && id ? 'lock' : 'own'}" data-iv3sel="${esc(id)}">
        ${meCard(pbgBg(id), 'sm')}${!prem && id ? `<i class="iv3-lki">${IC.lock}</i>` : ''}
        <div class="iv3-nm"><b title="${esc(pbgName(id))}">${esc(pbgName(id))}</b><span>${id ? (id === '@img' ? 'Premium' : esc(src('banner', id))) : t('iv3_pbgLines')}</span></div>
        <div class="iv3-ft">${act}</div></div>`;
    };
    return curCard + up + `<div class="iv3-filt"><span class="iv3-cnt">${t('iv3_avail', { n: list.length })}</span></div><div class="iv3-grid g-pbg">${list.map(card).join('')}</div>`;
  }
  function pbgSide(sel) {
    const isSel = sel != null, ck = pbgKey(pbgCur()), prem = !!S.me.premium?.tier;
    const act = !isSel ? `<p class="mute iv3-note">${t('iv3_pick')}</p>`
      : sel === ck ? `<div class="iv3-sact"><span class="iv3-ok">${IC.check}${t('iv3_using')}</span></div>`
      : !prem && sel ? `<button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3go="premium">${IC.crown}${t('iv3_get')}</button>`
      : `<button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3pbg="${esc(sel)}">${t('iv3_set')}</button>`;
    return `<div class="card iv3-side s2-try">
      <div class="iv3-sh"><div><span class="p3-h">${isSel ? t('iv3_trying') : t('iv3_card')}</span><b>${isSel ? esc(pbgName(sel)) : t('iv3_cardSub')}</b></div><span class="grow"></span>
        ${isSel ? `<button class="iv3-x" data-iv3unsel>${IC.x}</button>` : ''}</div>
      ${meCard(isSel ? pbgBg(sel) : undefined)}${act}</div>`;
  }

  function page() {
    const st = s2LC();
    if (!TABS.includes(ST.tab)) ST.tab = 'banner';
    const tab = ST.tab;
    const ownN = k => ids(k).filter(id => s2Has(k, id)).length;
    const tabs = `<div class="iv3-tabs">${TABS.map(k => `<button class="iv3-tab ${k === tab ? 'on' : ''}" data-iv3tab="${k}">${tabName(k)}${k !== 'badge' && k !== 'pbg' && (!['sticker', 'ncolor', 'vfx'].includes(k) || st) ? `<i>${ownN(k)}</i>` : ''}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
    const head = `<i class="lc-inv" hidden></i><div class="iv3-head"><div><h1>${t('inventory')}</h1><div class="mute">${t('iv3_sub')}</div></div><span class="grow"></span>
      <button class="btn ghost iv3-shopbtn" data-iv3go="shop">${IC.cart}${t('shop')}${IC.arrow}</button></div>${tabs}`;
    let main, sel = null;
    if (tab === 'badge') main = badgeList();
    else if (tab === 'pbg') { sel = ST.sel.pbg ?? null; main = pbgMain(sel); }
    else if (['sticker', 'ncolor', 'vfx'].includes(tab) && !st) main = `<div class="card iv3-emp">${t('loading')}</div>`;
    else {
      const all = ids(tab), ps = premSet(tab);
      const F = { all: () => true, mine: id => s2Has(tab, id), prem: id => ps.has(id), shop: id => !!shopIt(tab, id) };
      const cnt = Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(F).map(k => [k, all.filter(F[k]).length]));
      let f = ST.f[tab] || 'all'; if (!F[f]) f = 'all';
      const rank = id => worn(tab, id) ? 0 : s2Has(tab, id) ? 1 : shopIt(tab, id) ? 2 : ps.has(id) ? 3 : 4;
      const list = all.filter(F[f]).map((id, i) => [id, i, rank(id)]).sort((a, b) => a[2] - b[2] || a[1] - b[1]).map(x => x[0]);
      sel = ST.sel[tab] && all.includes(ST.sel[tab]) ? ST.sel[tab] : null;
      const chips = `<div class="iv3-filt">${Object.keys(F).filter(k => k === 'all' || k === 'mine' || cnt[k]).map(k => `<button class="iv3-chip ${f === k ? 'on' : ''}" data-iv3f="${k}">${t('iv3_f_' + k)}<i>${cnt[k]}</i></button>`).join('')}
        <span class="grow"></span><span class="iv3-cnt">${t('iv3_owned', { n: cnt.mine, of: all.length })}</span></div>`;
      const upsell = !cnt.mine ? `<div class="card iv3-up"><i class="iv3-upic">${IC.box}</i><div class="grow"><b>${t('iv3_noneT', { k: tabName(tab).toLowerCase() })}</b><span class="mute">${t('iv3_noneTxt')}</span></div>
        <button class="btn iv3-cta" data-iv3shop="">${t('iv3_toShop')}</button></div>` : '';
      const pc = tab === 'ncolor' && (S.premInfo?.colors || []).length ? (() => {
        const av = S.myProfile.available?.colors || [], cur = S.myProfile.cosmetics?.color;
        return `<div class="card iv3-pcol"><div><span class="p3-h">${t('iv3_premCol')}</span><p class="mute">${t('iv3_premColS')}</p></div><div class="iv3-cdots">${S.premInfo.colors.map(c => `<button class="iv3-cdot ${cur === c ? 'on' : ''} ${av.includes(c) ? '' : 'lock'}" style="--c:${c}" data-iv3col="${av.includes(c) ? (cur === c ? '' : c) : '-'}" title="${c}"><span style="color:${c}">${esc(S.me.nick)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
      })() : '';
      const grid = list.length ? `<div class="iv3-grid g-${tab}">${list.map(id => card(tab, id, sel)).join('')}</div>` : `<div class="card iv3-emp">${IC.box}<span>${t('iv3_empty')}</span></div>`;
      main = current(tab, !cnt.mine) + upsell + pc + chips + grid;
    }
    return `<div class="iv3">${head}<div class="iv3-lay"><div class="iv3-main">${main}</div><div class="iv3-right">${side(tab, sel)}</div></div></div>`;
  }

  function toShop(kind, id) {
    if (kind && S2_ITEM_TABS.includes(kind)) { S.s2.tab = kind; S.s2.filter = 'all'; if (id) S.s2.sel[kind] = id; }
    go('shop');
    let n = 0; const tick = () => { const el = document.getElementById('sh3-' + kind); if (el && S.page === 'shop') el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); else if (++n < 20 && S.page === 'shop') setTimeout(tick, 150); };
    if (kind) setTimeout(tick, 60);
  }
  function bind() {
    const view = $('#view'), tab = ST.tab;
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3tab]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { ST.tab = b.dataset.iv3tab; view.scrollTop = 0; renderInventory(); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3f]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { ST.f[tab] = b.dataset.iv3f; renderInventory(); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3sel]').forEach(c => c.onclick = e => { if (e.target.closest('button')) return; ST.sel[tab] = ST.sel[tab] === c.dataset.iv3sel ? null : c.dataset.iv3sel; S.s2.cmp = false; renderInventory(); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3unsel]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { ST.sel[tab] = null; S.s2.cmp = false; renderInventory(); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3eq]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); s2Equip(tab, b.dataset.iv3eq); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3shop]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); toShop(tab, b.dataset.iv3shop); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3go]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); go(b.dataset.iv3go); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3vfx]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => typeof lcPlayVfx === 'function' && lcPlayVfx(b.dataset.iv3vfx));
    const sd = view.querySelector('.iv3-side');
    if (sd) {
      sd.querySelectorAll('.iv3-ctx .s2-ctx').forEach((c, i) => { if (tab !== 'sticker' && c.querySelector('.pbanner')) c.remove(); });
      sd.querySelectorAll('.iv3-ctx [data-s2cmp]').forEach(b => { b.textContent = S.s2.cmp ? t('iv3_new') : t('iv3_cmp'); if (!ST.sel[tab]) b.remove(); });
      s2BindTry(sd, renderInventory);
    }
    const setPbg = run(async id => {
      const cur = pbgCur() || {};
      applyMe(await api('/api/premium/profilebg', id ? { type: 'banner', banner: id, opacity: cur.opacity ?? 0.25, blur: !!cur.blur } : { reset: true }));
      S.profCache = null; toast(t('saved'));
    });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3pbg]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); setPbg(b.dataset.iv3pbg); });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3pbgdlg]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => typeof openProfileBg === 'function' && openProfileBg(S.myProfile));
    const save = run(async body => applyMe(await api('/api/premium/cosmetics', body)));
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3col]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => b.dataset.iv3col !== '-' ? save({ color: b.dataset.iv3col }) : go('premium'));
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-iv3bh]').forEach(el => el.onclick = run(async () => {
      const show = !el.classList.contains('on'); el.disabled = true;
      try { S.me = await api('/api/me/badges', { [el.dataset.iv3bh]: !show }); sfx(show ? 'toggle_on' : 'toggle_off'); renderMe(); renderInventory(); } finally { el.disabled = false; }
    }));
    if ($('#iv3-avup')) $('#iv3-avup').onclick = () => $('#iv3-avfile').click();
    if ($('#iv3-avfile')) $('#iv3-avfile').onchange = run(async e => {
      const fl = e.target.files[0]; if (!fl) return;
      const data = await new Promise((ok, bad) => { const r = new FileReader(); r.onload = () => ok(r.result); r.onerror = bad; r.readAsDataURL(fl); });
      applyMe(await api('/api/premium/avatar', { data })); toast(t('avatarSaved'));
    });
    if ($('#iv3-avreset')) $('#iv3-avreset').onclick = run(async () => applyMe(await api('/api/premium/avatar', { reset: true })));
  }

  const _prev = renderInventory;
  renderInventory = function () {
    if (!window.KZ_V3?.()) return _prev.apply(this, arguments);
    if (!S.premInfo || !S.myProfile) return render(`<i class="lc-inv" hidden></i><div class="card iv3-emp">${t('loading')}</div>`);
    render(page());
    bind();
  };
})();

  const fmtWhen = ts => new Date(ts).toLocaleString(LOCALE[LANG], { weekday: 'short', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const safe = fn => function (...a) { try { return fn.apply(this, a); } catch (e) { console.error('[lane-a]', e); } };
  const stars = (n, cls = '') => `<span class="la-stars ${cls}">${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => `<i class="${i <= n ? 'on' : ''}">${IC.star}</i>`).join('')}</span>`;

  setInterval(() => {

  }, 1000);

  function etaLine(mode) {
    const e = L()?.eta?.[mode];
    if (!e || e.ms == null) return t('la_etaNone');
    return e.ms < 60_000 ? t('la_etaFast') : t('la_eta', { n: Math.max(1, Math.round(e.ms / 60_000)) });
  }

    if (!q || document.querySelector('.la-qinfo')) return;

    </div>`;
    q.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', html);
    const r = S.me?.['r' + mode];
    if (r?.cal != null) {

    <span class="la-dots">${[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `<i class="${i < n ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</span>${big ? `<span class="mute">${t('la_calHint')}</span>` : ''}</div>`;

  function slaCard(m) {

    const head = st === 'resolved' ? (s.byNick ? t('la_slaResolved', { n: esc(s.byNick) }) : t('la_slaResolvedAnon')) : st === 'taken' ? t('la_slaTaken', { n: esc(s.claimedNick || '?') }) : t('la_slaWaiting');

      : `${t('la_slaElapsed', { t: `<b data-la-el="${s.at}">${fmtLeft(Date.now() - s.at)}</b>` })} · ${t('la_slaTarget', { n: s.targetMin })}`;
    const rate = s.canRate ? (s.myRate != null ? `<span class="la-rated">${s.myRate > 0 ? IC.up : s.myRate < 0 ? IC.down : ''}${t('la_rateThanks')}</span>`

    return `<div class="card la-sla ${st} ${late ? 'late' : ''}"><div class="la-slah">${IC.shield}<div class="grow"><b>${head}</b><div class="mute">${sub}</div></div>

  function matchRateInline(m) {
    if (!m.me || m.state !== 'done') return '';
    if (m.test && !m.myRating && L()?.fb?.match?.id !== m.id) return '';
    if (m.myRating) return m.myRating.s ? `<div class="la-myrate mute">${t('la_myRating', { n: m.myRating.s })} ${stars(m.myRating.s, 'sm')}</div>` : '';
    if (Date.now() - (m.finishedAt || 0) > 7 * 864e5) return '';
    return `<div class="card la-rate inline" data-rate-id="${m.id}">${rateBody(m.id)}</div>`;
  }
  const rateBody = id => {
    const sel = (LA.sel[id] ||= { s: 0, tags: [] });
    return `<div class="la-rh"><b>${t('la_rateMatch', { id })}</b></div>
      <div class="la-starsel">${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => `<button class="${i <= sel.s ? 'on' : ''}" data-la="star" data-id="${id}" data-s="${i}" title="${i}">${IC.star}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="la-tags"><span class="mute">${t('la_tagsQ')}</span>${TAGS.map(x => `<button class="la-tg ${sel.tags.includes(x) ? 'on' : ''}" data-la="tag" data-id="${id}" data-tag="${x}">${t('la_tag_' + x)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="row la-ract"><button class="btn sm" data-la="rate-send" data-id="${id}" ${sel.s ? '' : 'disabled'}>${t('la_rateSend')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-la="rate-skip" data-id="${id}">${t('la_rateSkip')}</button></div>`;
  };
  function finishedBalance(m) {
    const b = m.balance;
    if (!b) return '';
    return `<div class="card la-balcard"><div class="card-h"><h4 style="margin:0">${t('la_bal')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="mute">${t('la_balDiff', { n: b.diff })}</span></div>
      <div class="la-balrow"><span class="alfa">Alfa · ${t('la_balAvg', { n: b.A })} · ${t('la_balWin', { n: b.pA })}</span><span class="bravo">${t('la_balWin', { n: 100 - b.pA })} · ${t('la_balAvg', { n: b.B })} · Bravo</span></div>
      <div class="la-prob"><i style="width:${b.pA}%"></i><i style="width:${100 - b.pA}%"></i></div>
      <p class="mute" style="margin:8px 0 0;font-size:12.5px">${t('la_balText')}${b.parties ? ' ' + t('la_balParties', { n: b.parties }) + '.' : ''}</p></div>`;
  }

  const LA = window.LA = { sel: {}, notes: [], fbKey: '' };
  function dock() {
    let d = document.getElementById('la-dock');
    if (!d) { d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = 'la-dock'; document.body.append(d); }
    return d;
  }
  const renderDock = safe(() => {
    const lane = L(), d = dock();
    const fb = lane?.fb || {};
    const shownId = S.page === 'play' && S.finishedMatch ? S.finishedMatch.id : null;
    let key = '', html = '';
    const busy = !!S.live?.match || S.live?.ready || S.page === 'staff';
    if (busy) {  } else if (fb.decision && fb.decision.id !== shownId) {
      key = 'd' + fb.decision.id;
      html = `<div class="card la-rate dock"><div class="la-rh"><b>${t('la_rateDecision')}</b><button class="uinote-x" data-la="dec" data-id="${fb.decision.id}" data-v="0" title="${t('close')}">${IC.x}</button></div>
        <div class="mute">${t('la_rateDecisionSub', { id: fb.decision.id, by: esc(fb.decision.by || '') })}${fb.decision.outcome ? ' · ' + t('la_outcome_' + fb.decision.outcome) : ''}</div>
        <div class="la-thumbs"><button class="la-th up" data-la="dec" data-id="${fb.decision.id}" data-v="1">${IC.up}</button><button class="la-th down" data-la="dec" data-id="${fb.decision.id}" data-v="-1">${IC.down}</button></div></div>`;
    } else if (fb.match && fb.match.id !== shownId) {
      key = 'm' + fb.match.id;
      html = `<div class="card la-rate dock" data-rate-id="${fb.match.id}"><div class="la-sub mute">${esc(mapName(fb.match.map || ''))} · ${modeName(fb.match.mode)}</div>${rateBody(fb.match.id)}</div>`;
    }
    let fbEl = d.querySelector('.la-fb');
    if (!fbEl) { fbEl = document.createElement('div'); fbEl.className = 'la-fb'; d.append(fbEl); }
    if (key !== LA.fbKey) { LA.fbKey = key; fbEl.innerHTML = html; bindLa(fbEl); }
  });
  function note(html, { ttl = 25_000, id } = {}) {
    const d = dock();
    if (id) d.querySelector(`[data-note="${id}"]`)?.remove();
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'card la-note';
    if (id) el.dataset.note = id;
    el.innerHTML = html + `<button class="uinote-x la-nx" title="${t('close')}">${IC.x}</button>`;
    el.querySelector('.la-nx').onclick = () => el.remove();
    d.prepend(el);
    bindLa(el);
    if (ttl) setTimeout(() => el.remove(), ttl);
    return el;
  }

  function onLaneMsg(m) {
    if (m.k === 'call') {
      note(`${IC.call}<div class="grow"><b>${t('la_callTitle', { n: esc(m.from.nick), mode: modeName(m.mode) })}</b><div class="mute">${t('la_callText', { q: m.n, m: m.need })}</div></div>
        <button class="btn sm" data-la="go-play" data-mode="${m.mode}">${t('la_callJoin')}</button>`, { id: 'call' + m.from.id });
      K.attention?.(t('la_callTitle', { n: m.from.nick, mode: modeName(m.mode) }));
      if (S.sound) beep();
    } else if (m.k === 'fivesSoon' || m.k === 'fivesOpen' || m.k === 'fivesClosed') {
    }
    else if (m.k === 'sla') {
      note(`${IC.shield}<div class="grow"><b>${t(m.level === 2 ? 'la_slaPing2' : 'la_slaPing1', { id: m.id, n: m.mins })}</b></div><button class="btn sm" data-la="open-review" data-id="${m.id}">${t('la_open')}</button>`, { ttl: 5 * 60_000, id: 'sla' + m.id });
      K.attention?.(t(m.level === 2 ? 'la_slaPing2' : 'la_slaPing1', { id: m.id, n: m.mins })); sfx('staff_alert');
    } else if (m.k === 'resolved' || m.k === 'claimed') {
      toast(t(m.k === 'resolved' ? 'la_resolvedToast' : 'la_claimedToast', { id: m.id }));
      if (S.finishedMatch?.id === m.id) api('/api/match?id=' + m.id).then(x => { if (S.finishedMatch?.id === m.id) { S.finishedMatch = x; if (S.page === 'play') refresh(); } }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }
  const hookWs = ws => { if (!ws || ws.__la) return; ws.__la = true; ws.addEventListener('message', e => { try { const m = JSON.parse(e.data); if (m.t === 'laneA') onLaneMsg(m); } catch {} }); };

  async function refreshFinished(id) {
    if (S.finishedMatch?.id == id) { S.finishedMatch = await api('/api/match?id=' + id); if (S.page === 'play') refresh(); }
  }
  function bindLa(root) {
    if (!root) return;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-la]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async e => {
      e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault?.();
      const a = b.dataset.la, id = b.dataset.id;
      if (a === 'rsvp') { await api('/api/fives/rsvp', { on: b.dataset.on === '1' }); }
      else if (a === 'fives-open') { await api('/api/staff/fives', { open: true, minutes: +(document.getElementById('la-fmin')?.value) || 60 }); toast(t('la_fivesOpened')); if (S.page === 'staff') renderStaff(); }
      else if (a === 'fives-close') { await api('/api/staff/fives', { open: false }); if (S.page === 'staff') renderStaff(); }
      else if (a === 'call') {
        const r = await api('/api/queue/call', {});
        toast(t('la_callSent', { f: r.friends, d: r.discord ? t('la_callDiscord') : '' }));
        if (S.live?.lane) S.live.lane.callCd = r.cd;
        refresh();
      } else if (a === 'go-play') { S.mode = b.dataset.mode || S.mode; b.closest('.la-note')?.remove(); go('play'); }
      else if (a === 'star') { (LA.sel[id] ||= { s: 0, tags: [] }).s = +b.dataset.s; redrawRate(id); }
      else if (a === 'tag') { const s = (LA.sel[id] ||= { s: 0, tags: [] }); s.tags = s.tags.includes(b.dataset.tag) ? s.tags.filter(x => x !== b.dataset.tag) : [...s.tags, b.dataset.tag]; redrawRate(id); }
      else if (a === 'rate-send' || a === 'rate-skip') {
        const s = LA.sel[id] || { s: 0, tags: [] };
        try { await api('/api/match/rate', { id: +id, s: a === 'rate-skip' ? 0 : s.s, tags: a === 'rate-skip' ? [] : s.tags }); }
        catch (err) { if (![tErr('Already rated'), tErr('Nothing to rate')].includes(err?.message)) throw err; }
        if (a === 'rate-send') toast(t('la_rateThanks'));
        delete LA.sel[id]; LA.fbKey = null;
        b.closest('.la-rate.dock')?.remove();
        await refreshFinished(id);
      } else if (a === 'dec') {
        await api('/api/match/rate-decision', { id: +id, v: +b.dataset.v });
        if (+b.dataset.v) toast(t('la_rateThanks'));
        LA.fbKey = null;
        b.closest('.la-rate.dock')?.remove();
        await refreshFinished(id);
      } else if (a === 'open-review') {
        b.closest('.la-note')?.remove();
        S.staffTab = 'matches'; S.staffMatch = await api('/api/staff/match?id=' + id).catch(() => null);
        if (S.page === 'staff') renderStaff(); else go('staff');
      } else if (a === 'claim' || a === 'unclaim') { await api('/api/staff/claim', { id: +id, off: a === 'unclaim' }); renderStaff(); }
      else if (a === 'duty') { await api('/api/staff/duty', { on: b.dataset.on === '1' }); renderStaff(); }
      else if (a === 'sched-add') { LA.sched = [...(LA.sched || []), { d: 5, from: '18:00', to: '22:00', uid: S.me.id }]; drawSched(); }
      else if (a === 'sched-rm') { LA.sched.splice(+b.dataset.i, 1); drawSched(); }
      else if (a === 'sched-save') { readSched(); LA.sched = await api('/api/staff/duty-schedule', { list: LA.sched }); toast(t('la_schedSaved')); drawSched(); }
      else if (a === 'qdays') { LA.qDays = +b.dataset.d; renderDutyTab(); }
    }));
  }
  function redrawRate(id) {
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-rate-id="${id}"]`).forEach(el => {
      const sub = el.querySelector('.la-sub')?.outerHTML || '';
      el.innerHTML = sub + rateBody(+id);
      bindLa(el);
    });
  }

  const dayName = d => t('la_d' + d);
  function ratingsSection(r, days) {
    if (!r || !r.n) return `<div class="card la-sec"><h3 style="margin:0 0 6px">${t('la_ratings', { n: days })}</h3><div class="empty-note">${t('la_noRatings')}</div></div>`;
    const rows = (o, lab = k => k) => Object.entries(o).sort((a, b) => a[1].avg - b[1].avg).map(([k, v]) => ({ label: lab(k), v: v.avg, tip: `${lab(k)}: ${v.avg} / 5 · ${t('la_ratingsN')}: ${v.n}` }));
    const days7 = Object.entries(r.byDay).sort((a, b) => a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : 1).slice(-14);
    const one = x => (Math.round(x * 10) / 10).toFixed(1);
    return `<div class="card la-sec"><h3 style="margin:0 0 10px">${t('la_ratings', { n: days })}</h3>
      <div class="kpis">${kpi(t('la_ratingsAvg'), `${one(r.avg)} <small style="font-size:13px">/ 5</small>`)}${kpi(t('la_ratingsN'), r.n)}${kpi(t('la_ratingsSkipped'), r.skipped)}</div>
      <div class="grid2"><div><h4>${t('la_byMode')}</h4>${hBars(rows(r.byMode, modeName), { fmt: one })}<h4 style="margin-top:12px">${t('la_byMap')}</h4>${hBars(rows(r.byMap, mapName), { fmt: one })}</div>
      <div><h4>${t('la_tagsTop')}</h4>${hBars(TAGS.map(x => ({ label: t('la_tag_' + x), v: r.tags[x] || 0 })).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v))}
        <h4 style="margin-top:12px">${t('la_byDay')}</h4>${hBars(days7.map(([k, v]) => ({ label: shortDay(k), v: v.avg, tip: `${shortDay(k)}: ${v.avg} / 5 · ${t('la_ratingsN')}: ${v.n}` })), { fmt: one })}</div></div>
      <h4 style="margin-top:14px">${t('la_worst')}</h4>
      <div class="la-worst">${r.worst.map(w => `<div class="la-wr" data-la-match="${w.id}"><b>#${w.id}</b><span class="tag">${modeName(w.mode)}</span><span>${esc(mapName(w.map || ''))}</span>${stars(Math.round(w.avg), 'sm')}<b class="num">${one(w.avg)}</b><span class="mute">· ${w.n}</span>
        <span class="grow"></span>${Object.entries(w.tags || {}).map(([k, n]) => `<span class="tag ${k === 'great' ? '' : 'red'}">${t('la_tag_' + k)}${n > 1 ? ' ×' + n : ''}</span>`).join('')}<span class="mute">${fmtDT(w.at)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }
  const bindWorst = root => root?.querySelectorAll('[data-la-match]').forEach(el => el.onclick = run(async () => { S.staffTab = 'matches'; S.staffMatch = await api('/api/staff/match?id=' + el.dataset.laMatch); renderStaff(); }));

    LA.duty = d; LA.sched = d.schedule.map(x => ({ ...x }));

        <p class="mute" style="margin:10px 0 0;font-size:12.5px">${t('la_dutyHint', { a: q.sla.dutyMin, b: q.sla.targetMin, h: d.hours || 6 })}</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('la_dutyTitle')} · ${d.onDuty.length}</h4><div class="la-duty-list">${d.staff.map(x => `<span class="la-st ${d.onDuty.includes(x.id) ?       <div class="card"><h4>${t('la_fivesStaff')}</h4>${f.always ? `<p class="mute" style="margin:0">${t('la_fivesAlways')}</p>`

      <div class="row" style="margin:18px 0 10px"><h2 style="margin:0" class="grow">${t('la_slaStats', { n: days })}</h2><div class="seg sm">${[7, 30, 90].map(n => `<button data-la="qdays" data-d="${n}" class="${n === days ? 'on' : ''}">${n}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>

'—' : t('la_min', { m: one(q.sla.medMin) }))}${kpi(t('la_slaWithin', { n: q.sla.targetMin }), q.sla.within == null ? '—' : q.sla.within + '%', '', q.sla.within != null && q.sla.within < 80 ? 'bad' : '')}</div>

'late' : ''}"><b>#${o.id}</b><span class="tag">${modeName(o.mode)}</span>${o.disputed ? `<span class="tag red">${t('dispute')}</span>` : ''}

          ${o.claimedBy === S.me.id ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-la="unclaim" data-id="${o.id}">${t('la_unclaim')}</button>` : o.claimedBy ? '' : `<button class="btn sm" data-la="claim" data-id="${o.id}">${t('la_claim')}</button>`}
          <button class="btn ghost sm" data-la="open-review" data-id="${o.id}">${t('la_open')}</button></div>`).join('') || `<div class="empty-note">${t('la_slaNone')}</div>`}</div>

  function drawSched() {
    const box = document.getElementById('la-sched'); if (!box) return;
    const list = LA.sched || [], edit = !!S.me.auditor, staff = LA.duty?.staff || [];
    const nick = id => staff.find(x => x.id === id)?.nick || id;
    if (!list.length) { box.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-note">${t('la_schedEmpty')}</div>`; return; }
    box.innerHTML = edit ? list.map((s, i) => `<div class="la-srow" data-i="${i}">
        <select data-k="d">${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0].map(d => `<option value="${d}" ${d === s.d ? 'selected' : ''}>${dayName(d)}</option>`).join('')}</select>
        <input data-k="from" value="${esc(s.from)}" maxlength="5" style="width:70px"><span class="mute">–</span><input data-k="to" value="${esc(s.to)}" maxlength="5" style="width:70px">
        <select data-k="uid" class="grow">${staff.map(x => `<option value="${x.id}" ${x.id === s.uid ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(x.nick)}</option>`).join('')}</select>
        <button class="btn ghost sm" data-la="sched-rm" data-i="${i}">${IC.x}</button></div>`).join('')
      : `<div class="la-week">${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0].map(d => `<div><b>${dayName(d)}</b>${list.filter(s => s.d === d).sort((a, b) => a.from < b.from ? -1 : 1).map(s => `<span class="tag">${esc(s.from)}–${esc(s.to)} · ${esc(nick(s.uid))}</span>`).join('') || '<span class="mute">—</span>'}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;
    bindLa(box);
  }
  function readSched() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#la-sched .la-srow').forEach(r => {
      const s = LA.sched[+r.dataset.i]; if (!s) return;
      r.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(i => { s[i.dataset.k] = i.dataset.k === 'd' ? +i.value : i.value.trim(); });
    });
  }
  async function decorateReviews() {
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('[data-rv],[data-rvl]');
    if (!cards.length) return;
    const q = await api('/api/staff/quality?days=7').catch(() => null);
    if (!q) return;
    const open = Object.fromEntries(q.sla.open.map(o => [String(o.id), o]));
    S.laneDutyOpen = q.sla.open.filter(o => !o.claimedBy).length;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-rv],[data-rvl]').forEach(c => {
      const o = open[c.dataset.rv || c.dataset.rvl];
      if (!o || c.querySelector('.la-claim')) return;
      const late = Date.now() - o.at > q.sla.targetMin * 60e3;
      c.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `<div class="la-claim ${late ? 'late' : ''} ${o.claimedBy ? 'taken' : ''}">${IC.shield}
        <span>${o.claimedBy ? t('la_claimedBy', { n: esc(o.claimedNick || '?') }) : t('la_unclaimed')}</span><span class="mute">· ${t('la_slaElapsed', { t: `<b data-la-el="${o.at}"></b>` })}</span><span class="grow"></span>
        ${o.claimedBy === S.me.id ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-la="unclaim" data-id="${o.id}">${t('la_unclaim')}</button>` : o.claimedBy && !S.me.auditor ? '' : `<button class="btn sm" data-la="claim" data-id="${o.id}">${t('la_claim')}</button>`}</div>`);
      bindLa(c.querySelector('.la-claim'));
    });
    tickNow();
  }

  const renderDutyChip = safe(() => {
    const lane = L(); if (!lane) return;
    let el = document.getElementById('la-duty');
    if (!el) {
      const sup = document.querySelector('.side [data-go="support"]'); if (!sup) return;
      el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'la-duty'; el.className = 'la-duty';
      el.onclick = () => go('support');
      sup.before(el);
    }
    const n = lane.duty || 0;
    el.classList.toggle('on', n > 0);
    el.title = n ? t('la_dutySupport', { n }) : t('la_dutyNone');
    el.innerHTML = `${IC.shield}<b>${n}</b><span>${t('la_dutyN', { n: '' }).replace(/[:\s]+$/, '').replace(/^[:\s]+/, '')}</span>`;
  });

  const wrap = (name, after) => {
    const orig = window[name];
    if (typeof orig !== 'function') return console.warn('[lane-a] немає функції', name);
    window[name] = function (...a) {
      const r = orig.apply(this, a);
      if (r && typeof r.then === 'function') return r.then(v => { safe(after).call(this, a, v); return v; });
      safe(after).call(this, a, r);
      return r;
    };
  };
  { const o = window.matchBar; if (o) window.matchBar = function (m) { return o.apply(this, arguments) + safe(balanceStrip)(m); }; }
  { const o = window.playerRow; if (o) window.playerRow = function (p) {
    const h = o.apply(this, arguments);
    return p?.cal != null ? h.replace('<div class="sub">', `<div class="sub"><span class="tag la-cal sm" title="${esc(t('la_calHint'))}">${t('la_calShort', { n: p.cal })}</span> `) : h;
  }; }
  wrap('renderPlay', () => decoratePlay());
  wrap('renderMatch', ([m]) => {
    if (m?.state === 'disputed' && m.sla) { const c = document.querySelector('.center-col'); if (c && !c.querySelector('.la-sla')) { c.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', slaCard(m)); bindLa(c); tickNow(); } }
  });
  wrap('renderFinished', ([m]) => {
    const fin = document.querySelector('.card.final'); if (!fin || !m) return;
    fin.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', `${slaCard(m)}${matchRateInline(m)}${finishedBalance(m)}`);
    bindLa(document.querySelector('#view')); tickNow();
    LA.fbKey = null; renderDock();
  });
  wrap('drawLeaderboard', () => {
    const rows = S.lbRows || []; let any = false;
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (r.cal == null) continue;
      const el = document.querySelector(`.lbr[data-uid="${CSS.escape(r.id)}"]`); if (!el) continue;
      any = true; el.classList.add('la-uncal');
      el.querySelector('.lb-nick')?.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<span class="tag la-cal sm" title="${esc(t('la_calHint'))}">${t('la_calShort', { n: r.cal })}</span>`);
    }
    if (any && !document.querySelector('.la-legend')) document.querySelector('.lbt')?.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', `<p class="mute la-legend">${t('la_calLegend')}</p>`);
  });
  wrap('renderProfile', () => {
    const p = S.profCache; if (!p || S.page !== 'profile') return;
    const r = p['r' + S.profMode]; if (r?.cal == null || document.querySelector('.la-calbar')) return;
    const lv = document.querySelector('.plevel');
    document.querySelector('.phead .tags')?.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', calBar(r.cal));
  });
  wrap('renderStaff', () => {
    if (S.page !== 'staff') return;
    if (S.staffTab === 'duty') renderDutyTab(); else if (S.staffTab === 'matches') decorateReviews();
  });
  wrap('renderStaffStats', () => {
    const box = document.getElementById('st-stats'); if (!box || box.querySelector('.la-sec')) return;
    api('/api/staff/quality?days=30').then(q => { const b = document.getElementById('st-stats'); if (!b || b.querySelector('.la-sec')) return; b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ratingsSection(q.ratings, 30)); bindWorst(b); vizTips(b); }).catch(() => {});
  });
  wrap('renderSupport', () => {
    const n = L()?.duty; if (n == null || S.page !== 'support' || document.querySelector('.la-supduty')) return;
    document.querySelector('#view .page')?.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `<div class="la-supduty ${n ? 'on' : ''}">${IC.shield}<span>${n ? t('la_dutySupport', { n }) : t('la_dutyNone')}</span></div>`);
  });
  wrap('onState', () => { renderDutyChip(); renderDock(); hookWs(S.ws); });
  wrap('connect', () => hookWs(S.ws));
  const sync = () => { hookWs(S.ws); renderDutyChip(); renderDock(); };
  sync(); setInterval(sync, 3000);
})();

  kf: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="lc-ic"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="#f4c542"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6.6" fill="none" stroke="#1a1300" stroke-width="1.4" opacity=".5"/><path d="M9.2 7.8v8.4M9.2 12l4.6-4.2M10.8 10.6l3.2 5.6" stroke="#1a1300" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>',
  xp: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="lc-ic"><path d="M12 2.8l2.6 5.6 6.1.7-4.5 4.1 1.2 6-5.4-3.1-5.4 3.1 1.2-6-4.5-4.1 6.1-.7z" fill="#969df9"/></svg>',
  spark: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="lc-ic"><path d="M12 2l1.8 6.2L20 10l-6.2 1.8L12 18l-1.8-6.2L4 10l6.2-1.8zM19 15l.8 2.2L22 18l-2.2.8L19 21l-.8-2.2L16 18l2.2-.8z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
};
const LCAT = typeof LANEC !== 'undefined' ? LANEC : { STICKERS: [], NCOLORS: {}, NGRADS: {}, VFX: [], PRICE: {} };
const lcColorCss = id => LCAT.NGRADS[id] ? `background:linear-gradient(90deg,${LCAT.NGRADS[id][0]},${LCAT.NGRADS[id][1]});-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent` : LCAT.NCOLORS[id] ? `color:${LCAT.NCOLORS[id]}` : '';
const lcSwatch = id => LCAT.NGRADS[id] ? `background:linear-gradient(90deg,${LCAT.NGRADS[id][0]},${LCAT.NGRADS[id][1]})` : `background:${LCAT.NCOLORS[id] || '#888'}`;
function lcNickAttr(p) { return `style="${lcColorCss(p.lc.nc)}"`; }
function lcNickTail(p) { return p.lc?.fl >= 3 ? `<i class="lc-flame" title="${esc(t('lcWinStreakN', { n: p.lc.fl }))}">${LCI.flame}<b>${p.lc.fl}</b></i>` : ''; }
const stickerImg = (id, cls = '') => `<img class="lc-stk ${cls}" src="assets/sticker/${esc(id)}.svg" alt="" draggable="false">`;
const lcFmtLeft = ts => { const s = Math.max(0, ts - Date.now()) / 1000, d = Math.floor(s / 86400), h = Math.floor(s % 86400 / 3600), m = Math.floor(s % 3600 / 60); return d ? `${d}${t('lcD')} ${h}${t('lcH')}` : h ? `${h}${t('lcH')} ${m}${t('lcM')}` : `${m}${t('lcM')}`; };

function lcRewardHtml(r, big) {
  if (!r) return '';
  if (r.kind === 'kf') return `<div class="lc-rw kf">${LCI.kf}<b>${r.amount}</b></div>`;
  if (r.kind === 'sticker') return `<div class="lc-rw">${stickerImg(r.id)}</div>`;
  if (r.kind === 'ncolor') return `<div class="lc-rw"><i class="lc-sw" style="${lcSwatch(r.id)}"></i></div>`;
  if (r.kind === 'vfx') return `<div class="lc-rw"><i class="lc-vfxic v-${esc(r.id)}">${LCI.spark}</i></div>`;
  if (r.kind === 'emblem') return `<div class="lc-rw">${emblemHtml(r.id, big ? 'big' : '')}</div>`;
  if (r.kind === 'banner') return `<div class="lc-rw ban">${bannerHtml(r.id, 'lc-bimg')}</div>`;
  if (r.kind === 'frame') return `<div class="lc-rw">${avaF(S.me, 'sm', r.id)}</div>`;
  if (r.kind === 's2') return `<div class="lc-rw"><img class="lc-s2" src="assets/lanec/s2_polaris.png" alt=""></div>`;
  return '';
}
const lcRewardName = r => r.kind === 'kf' ? `${r.amount} KF` : r.kind === 's2' ? t('lcS2Reward') : `${t('lcKind_' + r.kind)} · ${r.kind === 'ncolor' || r.kind === 'vfx' || r.kind === 'sticker' ? t(`lc_${r.kind}_${r.id}`) : t('cos_' + r.id) !== 'cos_' + r.id ? t('cos_' + r.id) : r.id.replace(/_/g, ' ')}`;

async function lcLoad(silent) {
  if (!S.token || !S.me?.gameId || LC.loading) return;
  LC.loading = true;
  try {
    const st = await api('/api/lc');
    LC.st = st;
    if (typeof st.coins === 'number' && S.me) { S.me.coins = st.coins; renderMe(); }
    if (st.gift) { toast(t('lcGift', { n: st.gift.day, kf: st.gift.kf }) + (st.gift.xp ? ` +${st.gift.xp} XP` : '')); sfx('coin'); }
    lcPopups();
    if (['play', 'pass', 'shop', 'inventory'].includes(S.page)) refresh();
  } catch {} finally { LC.loading = false; }
}

function lcPopups() {
  const st = LC.st;
  if (!st || $('#modal').innerHTML || S.live?.match || S.live?.ready) return;
  if (st.lost && LC.shownLost !== st.lost.at) { LC.shownLost = st.lost.at; return lcLostModal(st.lost); }
  if (st.starter?.prompt && !LC.shownStarter && !S.finishedMatch) { LC.shownStarter = true; return lcStarterModal(true); }
}
function lcLostModal(l) {
  const name = l.tier === 'plus' ? 'Premium+' : 'Premium';
  const src = { promo: t('lcSrcPromo'), booster: t('lcSrcBooster'), staff: t('lcSrcStaff') }[l.src] || t('lcSrcPaid');
  const rows = l.had.map(k => `<li>${LCI.minus}<span>${t('lcLost_' + k, l.counts || {})}</span></li>`).join('');
  const eq = (l.equipped || []).map(e => `<span class="tag">${esc(t('lcKind_' + e.kind))}: ${esc(e.kind === 'ncolor' ? t('lc_ncolor_' + e.id) : e.id.replace(/_/g, ' '))}</span>`).join(' ');
  modal(`<div class="card accent col modal lc-lost"><img class="lc-crown" src="assets/crown-${l.tier === 'plus' ? 'plus' : 'premium'}.png" alt="">
    <h2>${t('lcLostTitle', { n: name })}</h2><p class="mute">${t('lcLostSub', { s: src })}</p>
    <ul class="lc-lostl">${rows}</ul>${eq ? `<div class="lc-eq"><span class="mute">${t('lcLostEquipped')}</span> ${eq}</div>` : ''}
    <p class="mute" style="font-size:12.5px">${t('lcLostKeep')}</p>
    <div class="row" style="justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:14px"><button class="btn ghost" data-lc="later">${t('lcLater')}</button><button class="btn gold" data-lc="renew">${t('lcRenew', { p: '$' + l.price })}</button></div></div>`, box => {
    const ack = () => api('/api/lc/lost-ack', {}).catch(() => {});
    box.querySelector('[data-lc="later"]').onclick = () => { ack(); closeModal(); };
    box.querySelector('[data-lc="renew"]').onclick = run(async () => { ack(); const r = await api('/api/premium/buy', { tier: l.priceTier }); K.open(r.url); toast(t('payOpened')); closeModal(); });
    box.querySelector('.overlay').onclick = e => { if (e.target.classList.contains('overlay')) { ack(); closeModal(); } };
  });
}
function lcStarterHtml(s, compact) {
  if (!s || s.bought) return '';
  const items = s.items.map(it => it.kind === 'banner' ? `<div class="lc-st-b">${bannerHtml(it.id, 'lc-bimg')}</div>` : it.kind === 'emblem' ? `<div class="lc-st-e">${emblemHtml(it.id, 'big')}</div>` : lcRewardHtml(it)).join('');
  return `<div class="card lc-starter ${compact ? 'compact' : ''}"><div class="lc-st-art">${items}<div class="lc-st-kf">${LCI.kf}<b>+${s.kf} KF</b></div></div>
    <div class="lc-st-txt"><span class="tag gold">${t('lcOnce')}</span><h3>${t('lcStarterTitle')}</h3><p class="mute">${t('lcStarterSub', { v: s.value })}</p>
    <button class="btn gold" data-lc-starter>${t('lcBuyFor', { p: '$' + s.usd })}</button></div></div>`;
}
function lcStarterModal() {
  const s = LC.st.starter;
  api('/api/lc/starter-seen', {}).catch(() => {});
  modal(`<div class="card accent col modal lc-stm"><h2>${t('lcStarterAfter')}</h2>${lcStarterHtml(s)}<div class="row" style="justify-content:flex-end"><button class="btn ghost" data-close>${t('lcLater')}</button></div></div>`, box => lcBindStarter(box));
}
function lcBindStarter(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-starter]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => { const r = await api('/api/lc/starter/buy', {}); K.open(r.url); toast(t('payOpened')); }));
}

function lcQuestText(q) {
  const mode = q.mode ? q.mode.replace('v', '×') : '';
  return t('lcQ_' + q.type + (q.mode ? '_m' : '') + (q.map ? '_map' : ''), { n: q.n, m: mode, map: q.map ? mapName(q.map) : '' });
}
function lcQuestsHtml(qs) {
  const row = q => {
    const done = q.p >= q.n, pct = Math.min(100, q.p / q.n * 100);
    return `<div class="lc-q ${q.claimed ? 'claimed' : done ? 'done' : ''}"><div class="grow"><div class="lc-qt">${esc(lcQuestText(q))}</div>
      <div class="lc-bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div><div class="lc-qm"><span class="num">${q.p} / ${q.n}</span><span class="lc-qr">${LCI.kf}${q.kf} ${LCI.xp}${q.xp} XP</span></div></div>
      ${q.claimed ? `<span class="win lc-qok">${LCI.check}</span>` : done ? `<button class="btn sm gold" data-lc-q="${q.id}">${t('lcClaim')}</button>` : ''}</div>`;
  };
  return `<div class="lc-qs"><div class="lc-qh"><b>${t('lcDaily')}</b><span class="mute">${LCI.clock}${lcFmtLeft(qs.d.reset)}</span></div>${qs.d.list.map(row).join('')}
    <div class="lc-qh"><b>${t('lcWeekly')}</b><span class="mute">${LCI.clock}${lcFmtLeft(qs.w.reset)}</span></div>${qs.w.list.map(row).join('')}</div>`;
}
function lcStreakHtml(sk) {
  const n = sk.login.cycleDay;
  const dots = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map(d => `<i class="${d <= n ? 'on' : ''} ${d === 3 || d === 7 ? 'gift' : ''}" title="${d === 3 ? sk.login.kf[0] + ' KF' : d === 7 ? sk.login.kf[1] + ' KF + ' + sk.login.xp + ' XP' : ''}">${d === 3 || d === 7 ? LCI.gift : d}</i>`).join('');
  return `<div class="lc-sk"><div class="lc-skl"><span class="mute">${t('lcLoginStreak')}</span><b>${t('lcDays', { n: sk.login.n })}</b></div><div class="lc-dots">${dots}</div></div>
    <div class="lc-sk"><div class="lc-skl"><span class="mute">${t('lcWinStreak')}</span><b class="${sk.win.n >= 3 ? 'lc-hot' : ''}">${sk.win.n >= 3 ? LCI.flame : ''}${sk.win.n}</b></div>
      <span class="mute lc-skh">${sk.win.n >= 5 ? t('lcWinHot') : t('lcWinHint', { kf: sk.win.kf })} · ${t('lcBest', { n: sk.win.best })}</span></div>`;
}
function lcPassMini(p) {
  const pct = p.level >= p.levels ? 100 : (p.xp % p.xpLevel) / p.xpLevel * 100, ready = p.ready.f + p.ready.p;
  return `<div class="lc-pm" data-go3="pass"><div class="lc-pml"><span class="lc-lv">${p.level}</span><div class="grow"><b>${t('lcPass')}</b> ${p.prem ? '<span class="tag gold">PREMIUM</span>' : ''}
    <div class="lc-bar xp"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div><span class="mute" style="font-size:12px">${p.level >= p.levels ? t('maxLevel') : t('lcXpTo', { x: p.xp % p.xpLevel, n: p.xpLevel, l: p.level + 1 })}</span></div></div>
    ${ready ? `<span class="tag gold">${t('lcReady', { n: ready })}</span>` : `<span class="mute">${t('lcOpen')}</span>`}</div>`;
}
function lcRecapHtml(r, compact) {
  if (!r) return '';
  const tile = (cls, title, p, big, sub) => `<div class="lc-rt ${cls}"><span class="lc-rtt">${title}</span>${p ? `<b class="lc-rtn" data-lc-prof="${esc(p.id)}">${esc(p.nick)}</b><span class="lc-rtb">${big}</span><span class="mute">${sub}</span>` : `<span class="mute">${t('lcNobody')}</span>`}</div>`;
  const d = ts => new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString(LOCALE[LANG], { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
  return `<div class="card lc-recap ${compact ? 'compact' : ''}"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('lcRecap')}</h4><span class="mute">${d(r.from)} – ${d(r.to - 7 * 3600e3)} · ${t('lcMatchesN', { n: r.matches })}</span></div>
    <div class="lc-rts">${tile('mvp', t('lcMvp'), r.mvp?.p, r.mvp ? `+${r.mvp.elo} ELO` : '', r.mvp ? `${r.mvp.w}/${r.mvp.g}` : '')}
    ${tile('kd', t('lcBestKd'), r.kd?.p, r.kd ? `${Number(r.kd.kd).toFixed(2)} K/D` : '', r.kd ? t('lcGamesN', { n: r.kd.g }) : '')}
    ${tile('act', t('lcActive'), r.active?.p, r.active ? t('lcGamesN', { n: r.active.g }) : '', r.active ? t('lcWinsN', { n: r.active.w }) : '')}
    ${r.duo ? `<div class="lc-rt duo"><span class="lc-rtt">${t('lcDuo')}</span><b class="lc-rtn"><span data-lc-prof="${esc(r.duo.pa.id)}">${esc(r.duo.pa.nick)}</span> + <span data-lc-prof="${esc(r.duo.pb.id)}">${esc(r.duo.pb.nick)}</span></b><span class="lc-rtb">${t('lcWinsN', { n: r.duo.w })}</span><span class="mute">${t('lcGamesN', { n: r.duo.g })}</span></div>` : tile('duo', t('lcDuo'), null)}</div></div>`;
}
function lcHomeInject() {
  const st = LC.st, home = document.querySelector('#view .home');
  if (!st || !home || document.querySelector('#view .lc-home')) return;
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'lc-home';
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="card lc-hc"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('lcQuests')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-go3="pass">${LCI.pass.replace('<svg', '<svg class="lc-ic"')}${t('lcPass')}</button></div>${lcQuestsHtml(st.quests)}</div>
    <div class="col" style="gap:16px"><div class="card lc-hc">${lcPassMini(st.pass)}${lcStreakHtml(st.streak)}</div>${lcRecapHtml(st.recap, true)}</div>`;
  const left = home.querySelector(':scope > .col');
  if (left) {
    el.classList.add('in-col');
    const how = [...left.children].find(c => c.querySelector('h4') && c !== left.firstElementChild && !c.classList.contains('lc-home'));
    left.insertBefore(el, how || null);
  } else home.after(el);
  lcBind(el);
}
function lcBind(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-go3]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => go(b.dataset.go3));
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-prof]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); go('profile', b.dataset.lcProf); });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-q]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
    b.disabled = true;
    const r = await api('/api/lc/claim', { kind: 'quest', id: b.dataset.lcQ });
    LC.st = r.state; S.me = r.me || S.me; S.me.coins = r.state.coins; renderMe(); sfx('coin'); toast(t('lcGot', { s: `${r.got.kf} KF · ${r.got.xp} XP` })); refresh();
  }));
  lcBindStarter(root);
}

function renderPass() {
  const st = LC.st;
  if (!st) { lcLoad(); return render(`<div class="card empty-note">${t('loading')}</div>`); }
  const p = st.pass, pct = p.level >= p.levels ? 100 : (p.xp % p.xpLevel) / p.xpLevel * 100;
  const cell = (tr, r) => {
    const claimed = p.claimed[tr].includes(r.n), reached = p.level >= r.n, locked = tr === 'p' && !p.prem;
    const can = reached && !claimed && !locked;
    return `<div class="lc-cell ${tr} ${claimed ? 'claimed' : ''} ${can ? 'ready' : ''} ${locked ? 'locked' : ''} ${reached ? 'reached' : ''}" title="${esc(lcRewardName(r))}">
      ${lcRewardHtml(r)}<span class="lc-cn">${r.kind === 'kf' ? '' : esc(lcRewardName(r))}</span>
      ${claimed ? `<span class="lc-cs win">${LCI.check}</span>` : can ? `<button class="btn sm ${tr === 'p' ? 'gold' : ''}" data-lc-claim="${tr}:${r.n}">${t('lcClaim')}</button>` : locked ? `<span class="lc-cs">${LCI.lock}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
  };
  const cols = p.track.f.map((r, i) => `<div class="lc-col ${p.level >= r.n ? 'reached' : ''} ${p.level + 1 === r.n ? 'next' : ''}"><span class="lc-ln">${r.n}</span>${cell('f', r)}${cell('p', p.track.p[i])}</div>`).join('');
  const ready = p.ready.f + p.ready.p;
  render(`<div class="lbhead"><div><h1>${t('lcPassTitle', { n: p.sid.replace(/^S/, '') })}</h1><div class="mute">${t('lcPassSub')}</div></div><span class="grow"></span>
      ${ready ? `<button class="btn gold" id="lc-all">${t('lcClaimAll', { n: ready })}</button>` : ''}</div>
    <div class="card lc-ph"><div class="lc-lvbig"><span>${t('lcLevel')}</span><b>${p.level}</b><small>/ ${p.levels}</small></div>
      <div class="grow"><div class="lc-bar xp big"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div>
        <div class="row mute" style="font-size:12.5px;margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap"><span>${p.level >= p.levels ? t('maxLevel') : t('lcXpTo', { x: p.xp % p.xpLevel, n: p.xpLevel, l: p.level + 1 })}</span><span class="grow"></span>
        <span>${t('lcXpHow', { w: p.xpMatch.win, l: p.xpMatch.loss, c: p.xpMatch.cap })}</span><span>· ${t('lcToday', { n: p.todayMatches, c: p.xpMatch.cap })}</span></div></div>
      ${p.prem ? `<div class="lc-premok"><span class="tag gold">PREMIUM</span><span class="mute">${t('lcPremOwned')}</span></div>`
        : `<div class="lc-buy"><b>${t('lcUnlockPrem')}</b><span class="mute">${t('lcUnlockHint')}</span><div class="row"><button class="btn gold" data-lc-pass="usd">${'$' + p.price.usd}</button><button class="btn ghost" data-lc-pass="kf" ${st.coins < p.price.kf ? 'disabled' : ''}>${p.price.kf} KF</button></div>
          ${st.firstBonus && !st.firstBonus.used && st.firstBonus.kf ? `<span class="lc-fb">${LCI.gift}${t('lcFirstBonus', { n: st.firstBonus.kf })}</span>` : ''}</div>`}</div>
    <div class="card lc-track"><div class="lc-trk-l"><span>${t('lcFree')}</span><span class="gold">${t('lcPremium')}</span></div><div class="lc-cols" data-scroll="lcpass">${cols}</div></div>
    ${p.s2Pending?.length ? `<div class="card lc-s2n"><img src="assets/lanec/s2_polaris.png" alt=""><div><b>${t('lcS2Reward')}</b><div class="mute">${t('lcS2Hint')}</div></div></div>` : ''}
    <div class="grid2" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('lcQuests')}</h4></div>${lcQuestsHtml(st.quests)}</div>
      <div class="col" style="gap:16px"><div class="card lc-hc">${lcStreakHtml(st.streak)}</div><div class="card"><h4>${t('lcNoP2W')}</h4><p class="mute" style="margin:0;font-size:13px">${t('lcNoP2WText')}</p></div></div></div>`);
  const sc = document.querySelector('.lc-cols');
  if (sc && !LC.passScrolled) { LC.passScrolled = true; const nx = sc.querySelector('.lc-col.next') || sc.querySelector('.lc-col.reached:last-of-type'); if (nx) sc.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, nx.offsetLeft - 160); }
  if (sc) sc.onwheel = e => { if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > Math.abs(e.deltaX)) { sc.scrollLeft += e.deltaY; e.preventDefault(); } };
  lcBind(document.querySelector('#view'));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-claim]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
    const [track, level] = b.dataset.lcClaim.split(':');
    b.disabled = true;
    const r = await api('/api/lc/claim', { track, level: +level });
    LC.st = r.state; S.me = r.me || S.me; S.me.coins = r.state.coins; renderMe(); sfx('coin'); toast(t('lcGot', { s: lcRewardName(r.got) })); refresh();
  }));
  if ($('#lc-all')) $('#lc-all').onclick = run(async () => {
    const r = await api('/api/lc/claim', { all: true });
    LC.st = r.state; S.me = r.me || S.me; S.me.coins = r.state.coins; renderMe(); sfx('coin'); toast(t('lcGotN', { n: r.got.length })); refresh();
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lc-pass]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
    if (b.dataset.lcPass === 'kf') {
      if (!confirm(t('lcPassKfConfirm', { n: p.price.kf }))) return;
      const r = await api('/api/lc/pass/buy', { via: 'kf' }); LC.st = r.state; S.me.coins = r.state.coins; renderMe(); sfx('coin'); toast(t('bought')); return refresh();
    }
    const r = await api('/api/lc/pass/buy', { via: 'usd' }); K.open(r.url); toast(t('payOpened'));
  }));
}

function lcShopInject() {
  const sh = S.shop, page = document.querySelector('#view .page');
  if (!sh || !page || page.querySelector('.lc-shop')) return;
  const own = (k, id) => (sh.owned?.[{ sticker: 'stickers', ncolor: 'ncolors', vfx: 'vfx' }[k]] || []).includes(id);
  const card = (it, prev) => `<div class="inv shopi ${own(it.kind, it.id) ? 'on' : ''}">${prev}<div class="lc-iname">${esc(t(`lc_${it.kind}_${it.id}`))}</div>
    <div class="inv-f">${own(it.kind, it.id) ? `<span class="win">${t('owned')}</span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-go3="inventory">${t('inventory')}</button>`
      : `<span class="kf price">${it.price} KF</span><div class="buy2"><button class="btn sm" data-lcb-k="${it.kind}" data-lcb-id="${it.id}" ${sh.coins < it.price ? 'disabled' : ''}>${t('buy')}</button>${sh.pay?.enabled && it.usd ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-lcu-k="${it.kind}" data-lcu-id="${it.id}">$${it.usd}</button>` : ''}</div>`}</div></div>`;
  const by = k => sh.items.filter(x => x.kind === k);

    S.shop = { ...S.shop, coins: r.coins, owned: r.owned }; S.me = r.me; renderMe(); sfx('coin'); toast(t('bought')); lcLoad(true); refresh();
  }));
  page.querySelectorAll('[data-lcu-k]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => { const r = await api('/api/shop/buy-usd', { kind: b.dataset.lcuK, id: b.dataset.lcuId }); K.open(r.url); toast(t('payOpened')); }));

function lcInvInject() {
  const st = LC.st, page = document.querySelector('#view .page');
  if (!st || !page || page.querySelector('.lc-inv') || !S.premInfo || !S.myProfile) return;

      ${colors.map(id => { const lock = id in LCAT.NGRADS && !plus; return `<button class="lc-swb ${st.cos.ncolor === id ? 'on' : ''} ${lock ? 'locked' : ''}" data-lc-nc="${id}" ${lock ?     <div class="lc-invrow"><span class="mute">${t('lcVfx')}</span><div class="lc-sws"><button class="lc-swb ${!st.cos.vfx ? 'on' : ''}" data-lc-vfx="">${t('lcNone')}</button>

function lcStickerEditor() {
  const st = LC.st;
  let list = st.cos.stickers.map(s => ({ ...s })), sel = list.length ? 0 : -1;
  const banner = S.me.prem?.banner;
  const draw = box => {
    const area = box.querySelector('.lc-ed-b');
    area.querySelectorAll('.lc-ed-s').forEach(x => x.remove());
    list.forEach((s, i) => {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'lc-ed-s' + (i === sel ? ' sel' : '');
      d.style.cssText = `left:${s.x}%;top:${s.y}%;height:${s.s * 100}%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${s.r || 0}deg)`;
      d.innerHTML = stickerImg(s.id);
      d.onpointerdown = e => {
        sel = i; e.preventDefault(); const rc = area.getBoundingClientRect();
        const mv = ev => { s.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (ev.clientX - rc.left) / rc.width * 100)); s.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (ev.clientY - rc.top) / rc.height * 100)); d.style.left = s.x + '%'; d.style.top = s.y + '%'; };
        const up = () => { window.removeEventListener('pointermove', mv); window.removeEventListener('pointerup', up); draw(box); };
        window.addEventListener('pointermove', mv); window.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
      };
      area.append(d);
    });
    box.querySelector('#lc-ed-size').value = sel >= 0 ? list[sel].s : 0.3;
    box.querySelector('#lc-ed-rot').value = sel >= 0 ? list[sel].r || 0 : 0;
    box.querySelector('.lc-ed-ctl').style.visibility = sel >= 0 ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
    box.querySelector('.lc-ed-cnt').textContent = `${list.length} / 3`;
  };
  modal(`<div class="card accent col modal lc-ed"><h2>${t('lcStickersEdit')}</h2><p class="mute" style="margin-top:0">${t('lcEdHint')}</p>
    <div class="lc-ed-b pbanner has-b">${bannerHtml(banner, 'pb-art')}<div class="lc-ed-nick">${nickHtml({ ...S.me, prem: S.me.prem && { ...S.me.prem, emblem: '' } })}</div></div>
    <div class="row lc-ed-ctl"><label class="mute">${t('lcSize')} <input type="range" id="lc-ed-size" min="0.15" max="0.45" step="0.01"></label><label class="mute">${t('lcRotate')} <input type="range" id="lc-ed-rot" min="-45" max="45" step="1"></label><button class="btn ghost sm" id="lc-ed-del">${t('lcRemove')}</button></div>
    <div class="row" style="margin:10px 0 6px"><b>${t('lcStickers')}</b><span class="mute lc-ed-cnt"></span></div>
    <div class="lc-ed-pal">${st.owned.stickers.map(id => `<button data-add="${id}" title="${esc(t('lc_sticker_' + id))}">${stickerImg(id)}</button>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="row" style="justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:14px"><button class="btn ghost" data-close>${t('cancel')}</button><button class="btn" id="lc-ed-save">${t('save')}</button></div></div>`, box => {
    draw(box);
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-add]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { if (list.length >= 3) return toast(t('lcMax3'), true); list.push({ id: b.dataset.add, x: 70 + list.length * 8, y: 50, s: 0.3, r: 0 }); sel = list.length - 1; draw(box); });
    box.querySelector('#lc-ed-size').oninput = e => { if (sel >= 0) { list[sel].s = +e.target.value; draw(box); } };
    box.querySelector('#lc-ed-rot').oninput = e => { if (sel >= 0) { list[sel].r = +e.target.value; draw(box); } };
    box.querySelector('#lc-ed-del').onclick = () => { if (sel >= 0) { list.splice(sel, 1); sel = list.length - 1; draw(box); } };
    box.querySelector('#lc-ed-save').onclick = run(async () => {
      const r = await api('/api/lc/cosmetics', { stickers: list });
      LC.st = r.state; S.profCache = null; closeModal(); toast(t('lcSaved')); refresh();
    });
  });
}

function lcProfileInject() {
  const p = S.profCache, pb = document.querySelector('#view .pbanner');
  if (!p?.lc?.st || !pb || pb.querySelector('.lc-pst')) return;
  const layer = document.createElement('div');
  layer.className = 'lc-pst';
  layer.innerHTML = p.lc.st.map(s => `<div class="lc-ps" style="left:${s.x}%;top:${s.y}%;height:${s.s * 100}%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${s.r || 0}deg)">${stickerImg(s.id)}</div>`).join('');
  const art = pb.querySelector('.pb-art');
  if (art) art.after(layer); else pb.prepend(layer);
}

const LC_VFX = {
  gold: { cols: ['#f4c542', '#ffd977', '#ff9f3a', '#fff3c4'], n: 140, shape: 'dot', mode: 'burst', ring: '#f4c542' },
  polaris: { cols: ['#e8eaff', '#969df9', '#b6bbff', '#ffffff'], n: 90, shape: 'star', mode: 'twinkle', ring: '#b6bbff' },
  violet: { cols: ['#969df9', '#7d84ec', '#c79bff', '#e8eaff'], n: 110, shape: 'shard', mode: 'burst', ring: '#969df9' },
  ember: { cols: ['#ff8a3d', '#f4c542', '#ff5f3a', '#ffd9a0'], n: 150, shape: 'dot', mode: 'rise', ring: '#ff8a3d' },
};
function lcPlayVfx(id) {
  const V = LC_VFX[id];
  if (!V || document.querySelector('.lc-vfx')) return;
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas'), dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1, W = innerWidth, H = innerHeight;
  cv.className = 'lc-vfx'; cv.width = W * dpr; cv.height = H * dpr;
  document.body.append(cv);
  const g = cv.getContext('2d'); g.scale(dpr, dpr);
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H * 0.42, P = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < V.n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, sp = 3 + Math.random() * 9;
    P.push(V.mode === 'rise' ? { x: Math.random() * W, y: H + Math.random() * 80, vx: (Math.random() - .5) * 1.5, vy: -(4 + Math.random() * 7), s: 2 + Math.random() * 3.5, c: V.cols[i % V.cols.length], d: Math.random() * 20 }
      : V.mode === 'twinkle' ? { x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H * 0.85, vx: 0, vy: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.8, s: 3 + Math.random() * 7, c: V.cols[i % V.cols.length], d: Math.random() * 60, ph: Math.random() * 6 }
      : { x: cx, y: cy, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 2, s: 2.5 + Math.random() * 4, c: V.cols[i % V.cols.length], d: Math.random() * 6, rot: Math.random() * 6, vr: (Math.random() - .5) * .3 });
  }
  const star = (x, y, r) => { g.beginPath(); for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const rr = k % 2 ? r * 0.28 : r, a = k * Math.PI / 4; g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y + Math.sin(a) * rr); } g.closePath(); g.fill(); };
  const t0 = performance.now(), DUR = 2600;
  const frame = now => {
    const tt = now - t0, k = tt / DUR;
    g.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (V.mode !== 'rise' && k < 0.5) { g.globalAlpha = (0.5 - k) * 1.6; g.strokeStyle = V.ring; g.lineWidth = 6 * (1 - k); g.beginPath(); g.arc(cx, cy, 30 + k * 900, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.stroke(); }
    if (id === 'polaris' && k < 0.9) { g.globalAlpha = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 2.2) * Math.PI) * 0.95; g.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; g.shadowColor = '#969df9'; g.shadowBlur = 40; star(cx, cy, 70 + k * 30); g.shadowBlur = 0; }
    for (const p of P) {
      if (tt / 16 < p.d) continue;
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      if (V.mode === 'burst') { p.vy += 0.16; p.vx *= 0.985; p.rot += p.vr; }
      g.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - k * (V.mode === 'twinkle' ? 1.05 : 1.15)) * (V.mode === 'twinkle' ? 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(tt / 120 + p.ph) : 1);
      g.fillStyle = p.c;
      if (V.shape === 'star') star(p.x, p.y, p.s);
      else if (V.shape === 'shard') { g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(p.rot); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -p.s * 2.2); g.lineTo(p.s, p.s); g.lineTo(-p.s, p.s); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }
      else { g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.fill(); }
    }
    g.globalAlpha = 1;
    if (tt < DUR) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else cv.remove();
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function lcFinishedInject(m) {
  if (!m || m.state !== 'done' || !m.result?.winner) return;
  const win = m.teams[m.result.winner] || [];
  for (const p of win) if (p.lc?.vfx) document.querySelectorAll(`#view tr[data-uid="${CSS.escape(p.id)}"]`).forEach(tr => tr.classList.add('lc-wfx', 'v-' + p.lc.vfx));
  const mine = win.find(p => p.id === S.me.id);
  if (mine?.lc?.vfx && !LC.vfxShown[m.id]) { LC.vfxShown[m.id] = 1;
    const fx = () => lcPlayVfx(mine.lc.vfx); if (window.UIS) UIS.when('victory', UIS.T.victory.chord, fx, 250); else setTimeout(fx, 250); }
}

{
  const _refresh = refresh;
  refresh = function () {
    if (!S.me?.gameId) return;
    if (S.page === 'pass') return renderPass();
    return _refresh();

    if (S.finishedMatch && !S.live?.match) lcFinishedInject(S.finishedMatch);

  const _connect = connect;

    if (S.ws && S.ws !== had) S.ws.addEventListener('message', e => {
      let m; try { m = JSON.parse(e.data); } catch { return; }
      if (m.t !== 'lc') return;
      if (m.winBonus) { toast(t('lcWinBonus', { n: m.winBonus.n, kf: m.winBonus.kf })); sfx('coin'); }
      clearTimeout(LC.pingT); LC.pingT = setTimeout(() => lcLoad(), 600);
    });
    return r;
  };
  const _afterLogin = afterLogin;
  afterLogin = function () { const r = _afterLogin.apply(this, arguments); setTimeout(() => lcLoad(), 1200); return r; };
  const nb = document.createElement('button');
  nb.className = 'nav-btn'; nb.dataset.go = 'pass';
  nb.innerHTML = `${LCI.pass}<span>${t('lcPass')}</span><i class="dot" id="lc-dot" hidden></i>`;
  nb.onclick = () => go('pass');
  document.querySelector('#nav [data-go="play"]')?.after(nb);
  const _applyStatic = typeof applyStatic === 'function' ? applyStatic : null;
  if (_applyStatic) applyStatic = function () { const r = _applyStatic.apply(this, arguments); const s = nb.querySelector('span'); if (s) s.textContent = t('lcPass'); return r; };
  setInterval(() => {
    if (!LC.st && !LC.tried && S.token && S.me?.gameId) { LC.tried = true; lcLoad(); }
    if (LC.st) { const d = $('#lc-dot'); if (d) d.hidden = !(LC.st.pass.ready.f + LC.st.pass.ready.p + LC.st.quests.d.list.filter(q => q.p >= q.n && !q.claimed).length + LC.st.quests.w.list.filter(q => q.p >= q.n && !q.claimed).length); }
    lcPopups();
  }, 3000);
  setInterval(() => { if (S.token && S.me?.gameId && !S.live?.match) lcLoad(true); }, 5 * 60_000);
}
