```js
function hover(el) {
  const svg = el.querySelector('svg'), tip = el.querySelector('.ldtip');
  let pts = []; try { pts = JSON.parse(svg?.dataset.pts || '[]'); } catch {}
  if (!svg || !pts.length) return;
  const cx = svg.querySelector('.ldcx'), dot = svg.querySelector('.lddot');
  svg.onmousemove = e => {
    const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(), vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal, x = (e.clientX - r.left) * vb.width / r.width;
    let b = pts[0]; for (const p of pts) if (Math.abs(p.x - x) < Math.abs(b.x - x)) b = p;
    cx.setAttribute('x1', b.x); cx.setAttribute('x2', b.x); cx.style.opacity = 1;
    dot.setAttribute('cx', b.x); dot.setAttribute('cy', b.y); dot.setAttribute('fill', b.c || dot.getAttribute('fill')); dot.style.opacity = 1;
    tip.innerHTML = b.tip; tip.hidden = false;
    const px = b.x * r.width / vb.width;
    tip.style.left = Math.min(r.width - tip.offsetWidth - 2, Math.max(2, px - tip.offsetWidth / 2)) + 'px';
    tip.style.top = Math.max(0, b.y * r.height / vb.height - tip.offsetHeight - 12) + 'px';
  };
  svg.onmouseleave = () => { cx.style.opacity = 0; dot.style.opacity = 0; tip.hidden = true; };
}
function mount(el, draw) {
  if (!el) return;
  let lastW = 0;
  const paint = () => { const w = Math.max(260, Math.floor(el.clientWidth || 500)); if (w === lastW) return; lastW = w; el.innerHTML = draw(w); hover(el); };
  paint();
  if (window.ResizeObserver) { const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => { if (!document.body.contains(el)) return ro.disconnect(); paint(); }); ro.observe(el); }
}
const ticksFor = (lo, hi) => { const st = Math.max(5, Math.ceil((hi - lo) / 3 / 5) * 5); const a = Math.floor(lo / st) * st, out = []; for (let v = a; v <= hi + st / 2; v += st) out.push(v); return out; };
const tail = (w, H, P, c) => `<line class="ldcx" x1="0" x2="0" y1="${P.t}" y2="${H - P.b}" style="opacity:0"/><circle class="lddot" r="5" fill="${c}" stroke="var(--panel)" stroke-width="2" style="opacity:0"/><rect width="${w}" height="${H}" fill="transparent"/></svg><div class="ldtip" hidden></div>`;

const eloDraw = (pts0, mode) => w => {
  const H = 180, P = { l: 38, r: 10, t: 12, b: 22 }, n = pts0.length;
  const vals = pts0.map(p => p.elo), pad = Math.max(10, (Math.max(...vals) - Math.min(...vals)) * .15);
  const tk = ticksFor(Math.min(...vals) - pad, Math.max(...vals) + pad), lo = tk[0], hi = tk[tk.length - 1];
  const x = i => P.l + (n > 1 ? i / (n - 1) : .5) * (w - P.l - P.r), y = v => P.t + (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (H - P.t - P.b);
  const c = MODE_COLOR[mode], d = pts0.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(p.elo).toFixed(1)}`).join('');
  const short = pts0[n - 1].t - pts0[0].t < 2 * 864e5;
  const fd = t => new Date(t).toLocaleString(LOCALE[LANG], short ? { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' } : { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  const pts = pts0.map((p, i) => ({ x: +x(i).toFixed(1), y: +y(p.elo).toFixed(1), tip: `<b>${p.elo} ELO</b>${p.id ? ` <span class="${p.delta >= 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${sgn(p.delta)}</span><br>${t('ld_match', { n: p.id })}` : ''}<br><span class="mute">${fd(p.t)}</span>` }));
  const xt = n > 2 ? [0, (n - 1) >> 1, n - 1] : [0, n - 1];
  return `<svg class="ldsvg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${H}" width="${w}" height="${H}" data-pts='${esc(JSON.stringify(pts))}'>
    ${tk.map(v => `<line class="g" x1="${P.l}" x2="${w - P.r}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}"/><text x="${P.l - 7}" y="${y(v) + 3.5}" text-anchor="end">${v}</text>`).join('')}
    ${xt.map((k, i) => `<text x="${x(k)}" y="${H - 5}" text-anchor="${i === 0 ? 'start' : i === xt.length - 1 ? 'end' : 'middle'}">${fd(pts0[k].t)}</text>`).join('')}
    <path d="${d}L${x(n - 1)},${H - P.b}L${x(0)},${H - P.b}Z" fill="${c}" opacity=".13"/><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    ${n <= 40 ? pts0.map((p, i) => p.id ? `<circle cx="${x(i)}" cy="${y(p.elo)}" r="3.5" fill="${c}" stroke="var(--panel)" stroke-width="2"/>` : '').join('') : ''}${tail(w, H, P, c)}`;
};
const kdDraw = (rows, mode) => w => {
  const H = 180, P = { l: 30, r: 8, t: 12, b: 16 }, n = rows.length;
  const max = Math.max(2, ...rows.map(r => r.kd), ...rows.map(r => r.avg));
  const tk = max <= 2 ? [0, 1, 2] : max <= 4 ? [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] : ticksFor(0, max), hi = tk[tk.length - 1];
  const bw = Math.max(4, Math.min(20, (w - P.l - P.r) / n - 4)), cx = i => P.l + (i + .5) * (w - P.l - P.r) / n, y = v => P.t + (1 - v / hi) * (H - P.t - P.b);
  const c = MODE_COLOR[mode], line = rows.map((r, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${cx(i).toFixed(1)},${y(r.avg).toFixed(1)}`).join('');
  const bar = (x0, top) => { const h = H - P.b - top; return h <= 0 ? '' : `<path class="kb" d="M${x0},${H - P.b}V${top + Math.min(4, h)}q0,-4 4,-4h${bw - 8}q4,0 4,4V${H - P.b}Z"/>`; };
  const pts = rows.map((r, i) => ({ x: +cx(i).toFixed(1), y: +y(r.avg).toFixed(1), tip: `<b>${t('ld_match', { n: r.id })}</b><br>${r.k} / ${r.d} · ${t('ld_kdMatch')} ${kdf(r.kd)}<br>${t('ld_kdAvg')} ${kdf(r.avg)}` }));
  return `<svg class="ldsvg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${H}" width="${w}" height="${H}" data-pts='${esc(JSON.stringify(pts))}'>
    ${tk.map(v => `<line class="g ${v === 1 ? 'one' : ''}" x1="${P.l}" x2="${w - P.r}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}"/><text x="${P.l - 7}" y="${y(v) + 3.5}" text-anchor="end">${v}</text>`).join('')}
    ${rows.map((r, i) => bar(cx(i) - bw / 2, y(Math.min(r.kd, hi)))).join('')}<path d="${line}" fill="none" stroke="${c}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>${tail(w, H, P, c)}`;
};
const cmpDraw = (A, B) => w => {
  const H = 190, P = { l: 38, r: 10, t: 12, b: 22 }, now = Date.now();
  const firsts = [A, B].map(s => s.stats.elo30.find(x => x.id)?.t).filter(Boolean);
  const first = firsts.length ? Math.min(...firsts) : now - 30 * 864e5, t0 = first - Math.max(3600e3, (now - first) * .05);
  const line = s => { const p = s.elo30.map(x => ({ t: Math.max(t0, x.t), elo: x.elo, id: x.id, delta: x.delta })); if (p[p.length - 1].t < now) p.push({ t: now, elo: s.elo }); return p; };
  const a = line(A.stats), b = line(B.stats), all = [...a, ...b].map(p => p.elo);
  const pad = Math.max(10, (Math.max(...all) - Math.min(...all)) * .12), tk = ticksFor(Math.min(...all) - pad, Math.max(...all) + pad), lo = tk[0], hi = tk[tk.length - 1];
  const x = tt => P.l + (tt - t0) / (now - t0) * (w - P.l - P.r), y = v => P.t + (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (H - P.t - P.b);
  const path = p => p.map((q, i) => i ? `H${x(q.t).toFixed(1)}V${y(q.elo).toFixed(1)}` : `M${x(q.t).toFixed(1)},${y(q.elo).toFixed(1)}`).join('');
  const short = now - t0 < 2 * 864e5;
  const fd = tt => new Date(tt).toLocaleString(LOCALE[LANG], short ? { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' } : { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  const tipOf = (q, who, c) => ({ x: +x(q.t).toFixed(1), y: +y(q.elo).toFixed(1), c, tip: `<b style="color:${c}">${esc(who.nick)}</b><br><b>${q.elo} ELO</b>${q.id ? ` <span class="${q.delta >= 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${sgn(q.delta)}</span>` : ''}<br><span class="mute">${fd(q.t)}</span>` });
  const pts = [...a.filter(q => q.id).map(q => tipOf(q, A, CMP.a)), ...b.filter(q => q.id).map(q => tipOf(q, B, CMP.b))];
  const dots = (p, c) => p.length <= 60 ? p.filter(q => q.id).map(q => `<circle cx="${x(q.t)}" cy="${y(q.elo)}" r="3" fill="${c}" stroke="var(--panel)" stroke-width="1.5"/>`).join('') : '';
  return `<svg class="ldsvg" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${H}" width="${w}" height="${H}" data-pts='${esc(JSON.stringify(pts))}'>
    ${tk.map(v => `<line class="g" x1="${P.l}" x2="${w - P.r}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}"/><text x="${P.l - 7}" y="${y(v) + 3.5}" text-anchor="end">${v}</text>`).join('')}
    ${[t0, (t0 + now) / 2, now].map((tt, i) => `<text x="${x(tt)}" y="${H - 5}" text-anchor="${['start', 'middle', 'end'][i]}">${fd(tt)}</text>`).join('')}
    <path d="${path(b)}" fill="none" stroke="${CMP.b}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="${path(a)}" fill="none" stroke="${CMP.a}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    ${dots(b, CMP.b)}${dots(a, CMP.a)}${tail(w, H, P, CMP.a)}`;
};

const statCache = {};
async function stats(id, mode) {
  const k = id + '|' + mode, c = statCache[k];
  if (c && Date.now() - c.at < 30_000) return c.data;
  const data = await api(`/api/stats/player?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}&mode=${mode}`);
  statCache[k] = { at: Date.now(), data };
  return data;
}

let acCfg = null, acBusy = false, acLast = 0, acMatch = null, acFilesFull = false;
async function acTick() {
  const m = S.live?.match;
  if (!K.acScan || !S.token || !m || m.state !== 'live' || m.test || acBusy) return;
  if (acMatch !== m.id) { acMatch = m.id; acLast = Date.now() - (acCfg?.interval || 60) * 1000 + 30_000; }
  if (!acCfg) { try { acCfg = await api('/api/ac/config'); } catch { return; } }
  if (Date.now() - acLast < (acCfg.interval || 60) * 1000) return;
  acBusy = true; acLast = Date.now();
  try {
    const nn = acCfg.att ? await api('/api/ac/nonce').catch(() => null) : null;
    const r = await K.acScan({ names: acCfg.names || [], hashes: acCfg.hashes || [], files: !!acCfg.files, modules: !!acCfg.modules, filesFull: acFilesFull, deep: !!acCfg.deep, driverHashes: acCfg.drivers || [], nonce: nn?.n || '' });
    acFilesFull = false;
    if (r) { const res = await api('/api/ac/client', { match: m.id, ...r }); if (res?.needFiles) { acFilesFull = true; acLast = Date.now() - (acCfg.interval || 60) * 1000 + 5000; } }
  } catch (e) { console.warn('[ac]', e.message); }
  finally { acBusy = false; }
}
setInterval(acTick, 5000);
})();
```

```js
      <div class="lb3-hl">
        <span class="lb3-k"><i></i>${isClans() ? tr('lb3TabC') : tr('lb3Kicker')}</span>
        <h1>${isClans() ? tr('lb3TabC') : modeName(mode)}<span class="lb3-cnt">${total}</span></h1>
        <p class="mute">${isClans() ? tr('lb3IntroClan') : tr('lb3Intro', { m: se?.minMatches ?? 10 })}${!isClans() && lad ? ` <button class="lb3-a" data-lb3-rew>${tr('lb3Rewards')}${IC.chev}</button>` : ''}</p>
      </div>
      ${se ? `<div class="lb3-sbox ${isClans() ? 'one' : ''}"><div class="lb3-s1"><span class="lb3-k sm">${IC.clock}${tr('lb3Season', { n })} · <em>${esc(se.name || '')}</em>${warm ? ` <u>${tr('lb3Warm')}</u>` : ''}</span>${countdown(se)}</div>
        ${isClans() ? '' : `<div class="lb3-s2">${pool ? `<span class="mute">${tr('lb3Pool')} · ${modeName(mode)}</span><b class="lb3-pool num">$${pool}</b>` : ''}<span class="mute">${tr('lb3MinM', { n: se.minMatches ?? 10 })}</span></div>`}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="lb3-tabs">
        ${PUB_MODES.map(m => tab(m, modeName(m), `${cnt(m) != null ? tr('lb3Players', { n: N(cnt(m)) }) + ' · ' : ''}${m === '2v2' ? tr('lb3Tab2') : tr('lb3Tab1')}`, m === '1v1' ? IC.user : IC.users, !isClans() && mode === m, !!myIn(m))).join('')}
        ${tab('clans', tr('lb3TabC'), `${clans ? tr('lb3Clans', { n: N(clans.length) }) + ' · ' : ''}${tr('lb3TabCs')}`, IC.swords, isClans(), !!S.me.clan)}
      </div></div>`;
  }

  const stat = (h, v, cls = '') => `<div class="lb3-st ${cls}"><span>${h}</span><b class="num">${v}</b></div>`;
  function meCard(mode, rows) {
    const { r, place, of, lad } = meInfo(mode, rows);
    const cal = isCal(r), g = r.w + r.l, lvl = levelOf(r.elo);
    const top = rows.length;
    let prog = '';
    if (cal) {
      prog = `<span class="lb3-pl">${tr('lb3CalBar')}</span><b class="num">${r.cal}/5</b><div class="lb3-cbar">${[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `<i class="${i < r.cal ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</div><span class="mute">${tr('lb3CalLeft', { n: 5 - r.cal })}</span>`;
    } else if (!place) {
      prog = `<span class="mute">${tr('lb3Hidden')}</span>`;
    } else if (place === 1) {
      const gap = rows[1] ? r.elo - rows[1].elo : null;
      prog = `<span class="lb3-pl">${tr('lb3Leader')}</span>${gap != null ? `<b class="num win">+${gap} ELO</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3Lead')}</span>` : ''}`;
    } else {
      const T = [100, 10, 5, 3, 1].find(x => x < place), tgt = rows[T - 1];
      if (tgt) {
        const need = Math.max(1, tgt.elo - r.elo + 1), pct = Math.max(3, Math.min(100, r.elo / (tgt.elo + 1) * 100));
        prog = `<span class="lb3-pl">${T === 1 ? tr('lb3ToPlace', { n: 1 }) : tr('lb3ToTop', { n: T })}</span><b class="num">+${need} <small>ELO</small></b>
          <span class="num mute">${r.elo}</span><div class="lb3-bar"><i style="width:${pct}%"></i></div><span class="num mute">${tgt.elo + 1}</span>`;
      }
    }
    const se = S.season, rw = place ? rewardOf(lad, place) : null, sm = lad?.me?.matches ?? 0, min = se?.minMatches ?? 10;
    const hint = lad && se ? `<div class="lb3-hint"><i>${IC.gift}</i><div>
        ${rw ? `<b>${tr('lb3PrizeNow', { r: rewardTxt(rw) })}</b>` : lad.me?.toPrize ? `<b>${tr('lb3ToPrize', { n: lad.me.toPrize })}</b>` : `<b>${poolOf(lad) ? tr('lb3Pool') + ' · $' + poolOf(lad) : tr('lb3Rewards')}</b>`}
        <span class="mute">${sm >= min ? tr('lb3SeasonOk', { n: sm }) : tr('lb3SeasonM', { n: sm, m: min })}</span></div>
        <button class="btn ghost sm" data-lb3-rew>${tr('lb3Rewards')}</button></div>` : '';
    const where = cal ? `<b class="lb3-big">—</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3Out')}</span>`
      : place ? `<b class="lb3-big num">#${N(place)}</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3Of', { n: N(of) })}${place > top ? ' · ' + tr('lb3Out100') : ''}</span>`
      : `<b class="lb3-big">—</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3Out')}</span>`;
    return `<div class="card lb3-me">
      <div class="lb3-mt">
        <div class="lb3-who" data-uid="${esc(S.me.id)}">${avaF(S.me, 'lb3-mav')}<div><div class="lb3-nk">${nickHtml(S.me)}</div><span class="mute">${modeName(mode)} · ${cal ? tr('lb3Cal', { n: r.cal }) : `LVL ${lvl}`}</span></div></div>
        <div class="lb3-where"><span class="lb3-k sm">${tr('lb3Place')}</span>${where}</div>
        <div class="lb3-sts">
          ${stat('ELO', cal ? '—' : r.elo, 'acc')}
          <div class="lb3-st"><span>${tr('lb3Lvl')}</span><b class="num"><img class="lvl" src="${lvlIc(r, lvl)}">${cal ? '?' : lvl}</b></div>
          ${stat(tr('lb3Kd'), g ? kd(r.k, r.d) : '—')}${stat(tr('lb3Matches'), g)}${stat(tr('lb3Wr'), g ? wrNum(r) + '%' : '—')}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="lb3-mb"><div class="lb3-prog">${prog}</div>${hint}</div></div>`;
  }

  function podCard(r, i, rows, lad) {
    const p = i + 1;
    if (!r) return `<div class="lb3-pod p${p} free"><span class="lb3-pp">${IC.crown}${tr('lb3PlaceN', { n: p })}</span><div class="lb3-pc"><div class="lb3-pa empty">${IC.user}</div><b>${tr('lb3Free')}</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3FreeSub')}</span></div></div>`;
    const g = r.w + r.l, rw = rewardOf(lad, p);
    const above = rows[i - 1], below = rows[i + 1];
    const foot = p === 1 ? (below ? tr('lb3GapLead', { n: r.elo - below.elo }) : tr('lb3Alone')) : tr('lb3GapUp', { n: above.elo - r.elo + 1, p: p - 1 });
    return `<div class="lb3-pod p${p} click ${r.id === S.me.id ? 'me' : ''}" data-uid="${esc(r.id)}">
      <span class="lb3-pp">${IC.crown}${tr('lb3PlaceN', { n: p })}</span>
      <div class="lb3-pc">${window.kzCard3?.bg ? `<div class="lb3-pban lb3-pbg">${kzCard3.bg({ id: r.id, pbg: r.pbg })}</div>` : ''}
        <div class="lb3-ptop"><span class="lb3-plv"><img class="lvl" src="${lvlIc(r, r.lvl)}">${r.lvl}</span>${rw ? `<span class="lb3-prw" title="${esc(tr('lb3Rewards'))}">${IC.gift}${rewardTxt(rw)}</span>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="lb3-pa">${avaF(r, 'lb3-pav')}</div>
        <div class="lb3-pn">${nickHtml(r)}</div>
        <div class="lb3-pe"><b class="num">${r.elo}</b><span>ELO</span></div>
        <div class="lb3-pg"><span><i>${tr('lb3Kd')}</i><b class="num">${kd(r.k, r.d)}</b></span><span><i>${tr('lb3Matches')}</i><b class="num">${g}</b></span>
          <span><i>${tr('lb3Wl')}</i><b class="num"><em class="win">${r.w}</em>/<em class="lose">${r.l}</em></b></span><span><i>WR</i><b class="num">${wrNum(r)}%</b></span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="lb3-pf">${foot}</div></div>`;
  }
  function clanPod(c, i, list) {
    const p = i + 1;
    if (!c) return `<div class="lb3-pod p${p} free"><span class="lb3-pp">${IC.crown}${tr('lb3PlaceN', { n: p })}</span><div class="lb3-pc"><div class="lb3-pa empty">${IC.swords}</div><b>${tr('lb3Free')}</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3FreeSubC')}</span></div></div>`;
    const cw = c.cw, g = cw.w + cw.l, above = list[i - 1], below = list[i + 1]?.cw?.cal == null ? list[i + 1] : null;
    const foot = p === 1 ? (below ? tr('lb3GapLead', { n: cw.elo - below.cw.elo }) : tr('lb3Alone')) : tr('lb3GapUp', { n: above.cw.elo - cw.elo + 1, p: p - 1 });
    return `<div class="lb3-pod p${p} click ${S.me.clan?.id === c.id ? 'me' : ''}" data-cid="${esc(c.id)}">
      <span class="lb3-pp">${IC.crown}${tr('lb3PlaceN', { n: p })}</span>
      <div class="lb3-pc">${c.banner ? bannerHtml(c.banner, 'lb3-pban') : ''}
        <div class="lb3-ptop"><span class="lb3-plv">${clanLvlIcon(cw.lvl, 22)}${cw.lvl}</span><span class="lb3-prw">${IC.users}${c.members}/${c.max}</span></div>
        <div class="lb3-pa cl">${clanIcon(c, 'lb3-cav')}</div>
        <div class="lb3-pn">${clanName(c)}</div>
        <div class="lb3-pe"><b class="num">${cw.elo}</b><span>ELO</span></div>
        <div class="lb3-pg"><span><i>${tr('lb3Wars')}</i><b class="num">${g}</b></span><span><i>WR</i><b class="num">${g ? Math.round(cw.w / g * 100) : 0}%</b></span>
          <span><i>${tr('lb3Wl')}</i><b class="num"><em class="win">${cw.w}</em>/<em class="lose">${cw.l}</em></b></span><span><i>${tr('lb3Power')}</i><b class="num">${c.power}</b></span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="lb3-pf">${foot}</div></div>`;
  }
  const podium = (cards, title) => `<div class="card lb3-podw"><span class="lb3-k">${title}</span><div class="lb3-pods">${[cards[1], cards[0], cards[2]].join('')}</div></div>`;

  function thresholds(list, eloOf, myPlace, myElo, total, foot) {
    const tiers = [1, 3, 5, 10, 25, 100].filter(n => n <= Math.max(10, total || 0) || n <= 10);
    const row = n => { const x = list[n - 1]; return `<div class="lb3-th ${myPlace && myPlace <= n ? 'in' : ''}"><span>TOP-${n}</span>${x ? `<b><small>${tr('lb3From', { n: '' })}</small><span class="num">${eloOf(x)}</span> <small>ELO</small></b>` : `<b class="free">${tr('lb3FreeTh')}</b>`}</div>`; };
    return `<div class="card lb3-thr"><span class="lb3-k">${tr('lb3Thr')}</span>
      ${tiers.map(row).join('')}
      ${myPlace || myElo != null ? `<div class="lb3-th you"><span>${tr('lb3You')}${myPlace ? ' · #' + N(myPlace) : ''}</span><b>${myElo != null ? `<span class="num">${myElo}</span> <small>ELO</small>` : '—'}</b></div>` : ''}
      <p class="mute lb3-tf">${foot}</p></div>`;
  }

  function records(mode) {
    const R = ST.rec[mode]?.data; if (!R) return '';
    const card = (title, x, line, ic) => `<div class="lb3-rc ${x ? 'click' : ''}" ${x ? `data-uid="${esc(x.uid)}"` : ''}><span class="lb3-rt">${ic}${title}</span>
      ${x ? `<div class="lb3-rw">${avaF(x.player)}<div><div class="lb3-rn">${nickHtml(x.player)}</div><small class="mute">${line(x)}</small></div></div>` : `<small class="mute">${t('ld_recNone')}</small>`}</div>`;
    const kdv = v => (+v || 0).toFixed(2);
    return `<div class="lb3-recs"><span class="lb3-k">${t('ld_records')}</span><div class="lb3-rg">
      ${card(t('ld_recKills'), R.kills, x => t('ld_killsIn', { k: x.v, map: mapName(x.map) }), IC.target)}
      ${card(t('ld_recStreak'), R.streak, x => t('ld_winsRow', { n: x.v }), IC.flame)}
      ${card(t('ld_recGain'), R.gain, x => t('ld_eloIn', { n: x.v, g: x.games }), IC.trend)}
      ${card(t('ld_recKd'), R.kd, x => t('ld_kdIn', { v: kdv(x.v), g: x.games }), IC.star)}</div></div>`;
  }

  function slice(list, myIdx) {
    const q = (S.lbSearch || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q) return { items: list.filter(ST.match(q)), paged: false };
    if (ST.view === 'around' && myIdx >= 0) return { items: list.slice(Math.max(0, myIdx - 7), myIdx + 8), paged: false };
    const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(list.length / ST.size));
    ST.page = Math.min(ST.page, pages - 1);
    return { items: list.slice(ST.page * ST.size, (ST.page + 1) * ST.size), paged: list.length > ST.size, pages };
  }
  function pRow(r, rows) {
    const g = r.w + r.l, above = rows[r.place - 2], cal = r.cal != null;
    return `<div class="lb3-tr click ${r.id === S.me.id ? 'me' : ''} ${r.place <= 3 ? 't' + r.place : ''} ${cal ? 'cal' : ''}" data-uid="${esc(r.id)}" data-place="${r.place}">
      ${bannerHtml(r.prem?.banner, 'lb3-rb')}
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cn num">#${r.place}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cpl">${avaF(r)}<div class="lb3-tn"><span class="lb3-nk">${nickHtml(r)}</span><small class="mute">${r.id === S.me.id ? `<em class="lb3-you">${tr('lb3You2')}</em>` : ''}${cal ? `<em class="lb3-calt">${t('la_calShort', { n: r.cal })}</em>` : ''}<span class="win">${r.w}W</span> · <span class="lose">${r.l}L</span></small></div></div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-clv"><img class="lvl" src="${lvlIc(r, r.lvl)}"><span class="num">${cal ? '?' : r.lvl}</span></div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-celo num">${r.elo}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c num">${kd(r.k, r.d)}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c num">${g}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cwr"><span class="num">${wrNum(r)}%</span><div class="lb3-wb"><i style="width:${wrNum(r)}%"></i></div></div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cgap num">${above ? `<span class="mute">+${above.elo - r.elo}</span>` : `<span class="lb3-crown">${IC.crown}</span>`}</div></div>`;
  }
  function cRow(c, list) {
    const cw = c.cw, cal = cw.cal != null, g = cw.w + cw.l, above = list[c.place - 2];
    return `<div class="lb3-tr click ${S.me.clan?.id === c.id ? 'me' : ''} ${!cal && c.place <= 3 ? 't' + c.place : ''} ${cal ? 'cal' : ''}" data-cid="${esc(c.id)}" data-place="${c.place}">
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cn num">${cal ? '—' : '#' + c.place}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cpl">${clanIcon(c, 'lb3-tcav', true)}<div class="lb3-tn"><span class="lb3-nk">${clanName(c)}</span><small class="mute">${esc(c.owner)}</small></div></div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-clv">${clanLvlIcon(cal ? 0 : cw.lvl, 22)}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-celo num">${cal ? `<em class="lb3-calt">${tr('lb3ClanCal', { n: cw.cal })}</em>` : cw.elo}</div>
      <div class="lb3-c num"><span class="win">${cw.w}</span>/<span class="lose">${cw.l}</span></div>
      <div class="lb3-c num">${c.members}<span class="mute">/${c.max}</span></div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cwr"><span class="num">${g ? Math.round(cw.w / g * 100) : 0}%</span><div class="lb3-wb"><i style="width:${g ? cw.w / g * 100 : 0}%"></i></div></div>
      <div class="lb3-c lb3-cgap num">${cal ? '' : above && above.cw.cal == null ? `<span class="mute">+${above.cw.elo - cw.elo}</span>` : `<span class="lb3-crown">${IC.crown}</span>`}</div></div>`;
  }
  function tableHtml(mode, list, total) {
    const clans = isClans();
    const myIdx = clans ? list.findIndex(c => c.id === S.me.clan?.id) : list.findIndex(r => r.id === S.me.id);
    const { items, paged, pages } = slice(list, myIdx);
    const head = clans ? [tr('lb3Clan'), tr('lb3Lvl'), 'ELO', tr('lb3Wl'), tr('lb3Members'), tr('lb3Wr'), tr('lb3Gap')]
      : [tr('lb3Player'), tr('lb3Lvl'), 'ELO', tr('lb3Kd'), tr('lb3Matches'), tr('lb3Wr'), tr('lb3Gap')];
    const a = ST.page * ST.size + 1, b = Math.min(list.length, (ST.page + 1) * ST.size);
    return `<div class="lb3-th2 lb3-tr"><div class="lb3-c lb3-cn">#</div>${head.map((h, i) => `<div class="lb3-c ${['lb3-cpl', 'lb3-clv', 'lb3-celo', '', '', 'lb3-cwr', 'lb3-cgap'][i]}">${h}</div>`).join('')}</div>
      ${items.length ? items.map(x => clans ? cRow(x, list) : pRow(x, list)).join('') : `<div class="lb3-none mute">${list.length ? tr('lb3None') : clans ? tr('lb3EmptyC') : tr('lb3Empty')}</div>`}
      ${paged ? `<div class="lb3-pg2"><span class="mute num">${tr('lb3PageOf', { a, b, n: list.length })}</span><span class="grow"></span>
        <button class="lb3-pb" data-lb3-pg="-1" ${ST.page ? '' : 'disabled'}>${IC.left}${tr('lb3Prev')}</button>
        ${Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => `<button class="lb3-pb n ${i === ST.page ? 'on' : ''}" data-lb3-pgn="${i}">${i + 1}</button>`).join('')}
        <button class="lb3-pb" data-lb3-pg="1" ${ST.page < pages - 1 ? '' : 'disabled'}>${tr('lb3Next')}${IC.chev}</button></div>` : ''}`;
  }
  function tableCard(mode, list, total) {
    const clans = isClans();
    const myIdx = clans ? list.findIndex(c => c.id === S.me.clan?.id) : list.findIndex(r => r.id === S.me.id);
    const myPlace = myIdx >= 0 ? list[myIdx].place : null;
    const max = list.length;
    return `<div class="card lb3-tbl">
      <div class="lb3-tb">
        <div class="lb3-tt2"><b>${clans ? tr('lb3TabC') : tr('lb3Table', { m: modeName(mode) })}</b><span class="mute">${clans ? tr('lb3TableSubC', { n: N(max) }) : tr('lb3TableSub', { s: max, n: N(total) })}</span></div>
        <label class="lb3-srch">${IC.search}<input id="lb-search" placeholder="${esc(clans ? tr('lb3SearchC') : tr('lb3Search'))}" autocomplete="off"></label>
        <div class="lb3-seg"><button data-lb3-view="top" class="${ST.view === 'top' ? 'on' : ''}">${tr('lb3Leaders')}</button><button data-lb3-view="around" class="${ST.view === 'around' ? 'on' : ''}" ${myIdx < 0 ? `disabled title="${esc(clans ? tr('lb3NoClan') : tr('lb3NotIn', { s: max }))}"` : ''}>${tr('lb3Around')}</button></div>
        <div class="lb3-jump"><span class="mute">${tr('lb3Jump')}</span><input id="lb3-jump" type="number" min="1" max="${max || 1}" placeholder="# 1–${max || 1}" ${max ? '' : 'disabled'}><button class="lb3-pb" data-lb3-jump ${max ? '' : 'disabled'}>${tr('lb3Go')}</button></div>
        ${myPlace ? `<button class="lb3-mine" data-lb3-mine>${tr('lb3Mine', { n: myPlace })}</button>` : ''}
        <div class="lb3-seg sz">${[25, 50, 100].map(z => `<button data-lb3-size="${z}" class="${ST.size === z ? 'on' : ''}">${z}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      </div>
      <div id="lb3-rows" class="lb3-rows ${clans ? 'cl' : ''}">${tableHtml(mode, list, total)}</div></div>`;
  }

  function draw(mode) {
    const clans = isClans(), list = clans ? (ST.clans || []) : (S.lbRows || []);
    ST.match = clans ? q => c => c.tag.toLowerCase().includes(q) || c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) : q => r => r.nick.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    let body;
    if (clans) {
      const ranked = list.filter(c => c.cw?.cal == null);
      const mine = S.me.clan ? list.find(c => c.id === S.me.clan.id) : null;
      const myCard = mine ? (() => {
        const cw = mine.cw, cal = cw.cal != null, g = cw.w + cw.l;
        return `<div class="card lb3-me"><div class="lb3-mt">
          <div class="lb3-who" data-cid="${esc(mine.id)}"><span class="lb3-cbig">${clanIcon(mine, 'lb3-mcav', true)}</span><div><div class="lb3-nk">${clanName(mine)}</div><span class="mute">${tr('lb3TabC')}</span></div></div>
          <div class="lb3-where"><span class="lb3-k sm">${tr('lb3Place')}</span>${cal ? `<b class="lb3-big">—</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3ClanCal', { n: cw.cal })}</span>` : `<b class="lb3-big num">#${mine.place}</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3Of', { n: ranked.length })}</span>`}</div>
          <div class="lb3-sts">${stat('ELO', cal ? '—' : cw.elo, 'acc')}<div class="lb3-st"><span>${tr('lb3Lvl')}</span><b class="num">${clanLvlIcon(cal ? 0 : cw.lvl, 22)}${cal ? '?' : cw.lvl}</b></div>
            ${stat(tr('lb3Wars'), g)}${stat(tr('lb3Wr'), g ? Math.round(cw.w / g * 100) + '%' : '—')}${stat(tr('lb3Members'), `${mine.members}/${mine.max}`)}</div></div>
          ${cal ? `<div class="lb3-mb"><div class="lb3-prog"><span class="lb3-pl">${tr('lb3CalBar')}</span><b class="num">${cw.cal}/5</b><div class="lb3-cbar">${[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `<i class="${i < cw.cal ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</div></div></div>` : ''}</div>`;
      })() : `<div class="card lb3-me lb3-noclan"><i>${IC.swords}</i><div><b>${tr('lb3NoClan')}</b><span class="mute">${tr('lb3NoClanSub')}</span></div><span class="grow"></span><button class="btn" data-lb3-clans>${tr('lb3ToClans')}</button></div>`;
      body = `${myCard}<div class="lb3-mid">${podium([0, 1, 2].map(i => clanPod(ranked[i], i, ranked)), tr('lb3Leaders') + ' · ' + tr('lb3TabC'))}
        ${thresholds(ranked, c => c.cw.elo, mine && mine.cw.cal == null ? mine.place : null, mine && mine.cw.cal == null ? mine.cw.elo : null, ranked.length, tr('lb3TotalC', { n: N(list.length), c: N(ranked.length) }))}</div>
        ${tableCard(mode, list, list.length)}`;
    } else {
      const lad = ladOf(mode), me = meInfo(mode, list);
      const total = lad?.me?.of ?? list.length;
      body = `${meCard(mode, list)}<div class="lb3-mid">${podium([0, 1, 2].map(i => podCard(list[i], i, list, lad)), tr('lb3Leaders') + ' · ' + modeName(mode))}
        ${thresholds(list, r => r.elo, me.place, isCal(me.r) ? null : me.r.elo, total, tr('lb3Total', { n: N(total), s: list.length }))}</div>
        ${records(mode)}${tableCard(mode, list, total)}`;
    }
    render(`<div class="lb3">${hero(mode, S.lbRows || [], ST.clans)}${body}</div>`);
    bind(mode);
  }

  function redrawRows(mode) {
    const box = $('#lb3-rows'); if (!box) return;
    const list = isClans() ? (ST.clans || []) : (S.lbRows || []);
    box.innerHTML = tableHtml(mode, list, ladOf(mode)?.me?.of ?? list.length);
    bindRows(box);
  }
  function bindRows(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-uid]').forEach(el => el.onclick = () => go('profile', el.dataset.uid));
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-cid]').forEach(el => el.onclick = () => go('clans', el.dataset.cid));
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-pg]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { ST.page += +b.dataset.lb3Pg; redrawRows(S.lbMode); $('.lb3-tbl')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' }); });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-pgn]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { ST.page = +b.dataset.lb3Pgn; redrawRows(S.lbMode); $('.lb3-tbl')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' }); });
  }
  function jumpTo(place) {
    const list = isClans() ? (ST.clans || []) : (S.lbRows || []);
    const idx = list.findIndex(x => x.place === place); if (idx < 0) return;
    S.lbSearch = ''; const s = $('#lb-search'); if (s) s.value = '';
    ST.view = 'top'; ST.page = Math.floor(idx / ST.size);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-view]').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.lb3View === 'top'));
    redrawRows(S.lbMode);
    const el = document.querySelector(`#lb3-rows [data-place="${place}"]`);
    if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }); el.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('flash'), 1800); }
  }
  function bind(mode) {
    const view = $('#view'); if (!view) return;
    bindRows(view);
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-tab]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      const id = b.dataset.lb3Tab; ST.page = 0; ST.view = 'top'; S.lbSearch = '';
      if (id === 'clans') { ST.tab = 'clans'; ls('kz-lb3-tab', 'clans'); } else { ST.tab = null; ls('kz-lb3-tab', ''); S.lbMode = id; }
      renderLeaderboard();
    });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-view]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      if (b.disabled) return;
      ST.view = b.dataset.lb3View; ST.page = 0; S.lbSearch = ''; const s = $('#lb-search'); if (s) s.value = '';
      view.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-view]').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b)); redrawRows(mode);
      if (ST.view === 'around') setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('#lb3-rows .lb3-tr.me')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }), 30);
    });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-size]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      ST.size = +b.dataset.lb3Size; ST.page = 0; ls('kz-lb3-size', String(ST.size));
      view.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-size]').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b)); redrawRows(mode);
    });
    const s = $('#lb-search');
    if (s) { s.value = S.lbSearch || ''; s.oninput = () => { S.lbSearch = s.value; ST.page = 0; redrawRows(mode); }; }
    const j = $('#lb3-jump');
    const doJump = () => { const n = parseInt(j?.value, 10); if (n > 0) jumpTo(n); };
    if (j) j.onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') doJump(); };
    view.querySelector('[data-lb3-jump]')?.addEventListener('click', doJump);
    view.querySelector('[data-lb3-mine]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const list = isClans() ? (ST.clans || []) : (S.lbRows || []);
      const me = isClans() ? list.find(c => c.id === S.me.clan?.id) : list.find(r => r.id === S.me.id);
      if (me) jumpTo(me.place);
    });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-lb3-rew]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => {
      e.stopPropagation(); ls('kz-season-open', '1'); S.seasonLad = mode; ls('kz-season-lad', mode); go('play');
      setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('#view .srew')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 350);
    });
    view.querySelector('[data-lb3-clans]')?.addEventListener('click', () => go('clans'));
  }

  const _prev = renderLeaderboard;
  renderLeaderboard = async function () {
    if (!window.KZ_V3?.()) return _prev.apply(this, arguments);
    const mode = S.lbMode = pubMode(S.lbMode), tab = ST.tab;
    const fresh = isClans() ? !!ST.clans : S.lbRows && S.lbRowsMode === mode;
    if (fresh) draw(mode); else render(`<div class="lb3"><div class="card lb3-hero lb3-load"><span class="lb3-k"><i></i>${t('leaderboard')}</span><p class="mute">${t('loading')}</p></div></div>`);
    const [rows, se] = await Promise.all([
      isClans() ? null : api('/api/leaderboard?mode=' + mode).catch(e => (toast(e.message, true), null)),
      api('/api/season').catch(() => null),
      loadClans(isClans()),
      isClans() ? null : loadRecords(mode),
    ]);
    if (S.page !== 'leaderboard' || S.lbMode !== mode || ST.tab !== tab) return;
    if (se) S.season = se;
    if (rows) { S.lbRows = rows; S.lbRowsMode = mode; } else if (!isClans() && S.lbRowsMode !== mode) { S.lbRows = []; S.lbRowsMode = mode; }
    const f = document.activeElement;
    if (fresh && f && (f.id === 'lb-search' || f.id === 'lb3-jump')) { redrawRows(mode); return; }
    const y = $('#view')?.scrollTop;
    draw(mode);
    if (fresh && y != null && $('#view')) $('#view').scrollTop = y;
  };
})();
```

```js
      m2_confirm: 'Всё верно — отправить', m2_after: 'ELO начислится сразу. 30 минут игроки могут оспорить результат, стафф сверит со скриншотом.',
      m2_nickMissing: 'ник не найден', m2_nickExcl: 'методом исключения', m2_digitsQ: 'проверь цифры', m2_boxCols: 'Score · K · D',
      m2_noRows: 'Konzte не смог сопоставить строки — введи K и D вручную или замени скриншот.', m2_sendingT: 'Отправляем результат…',
    },
  };
  for (const l of Object.keys(TX)) if (I18N[l]) Object.assign(I18N[l], TX[l]);

  const M2 = window.M2 = { over: {} };
  const CHECK = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg>';
  const PAD = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 11h4M8 9v4M15 12h.01M18 10h.01"/><path d="M17.3 5H6.7a4 4 0 0 0-4 3.6l-.7 6.2A3 3 0 0 0 5 18c1 0 1.5-.5 2-1l1.4-1.4A2 2 0 0 1 9.8 15h4.4a2 2 0 0 1 1.4.6L17 17c.5.5 1 1 2 1a3 3 0 0 0 3-3.2l-.7-6.2A4 4 0 0 0 17.3 5z"/></svg>';
  const tt = (k, v = {}) => t(k, v);
  const all = m => [...m.teams.A, ...m.teams.B];
  const byId = (m, id) => all(m).find(p => p.id === id);
  const sideOf = (m, id) => m.teams.A.some(p => p.id === id) ? 'A' : 'B';
  const lobbyOn = m => Array.isArray(m.lobbyIn);
  const seenOn = m => Array.isArray(m.gameSeen);
  const inLobby = (m, id) => lobbyOn(m) && m.lobbyIn.includes(id);
  const seen = (m, id) => seenOn(m) && m.gameSeen.includes(id);
  const myCapOf = m => Object.keys(m.captains).find(k => m.captains[k] === S.me.id);
  const nick = p => esc(p?.nick || '?');

  function stepOf(m) {
    if (m.state === 'pick' || m.state === 'ban') return 1;
    if (m.state === 'live') {
      if (M2.over[m.id]) return 4;
      if (lobbyOn(m) && m.me && !inLobby(m, S.me.id)) return 2;
      return 3;
    }
    return 5;
  }

  function stepper6(m, cur) {
    const tot = all(m).length, nIn = lobbyOn(m) ? m.lobbyIn.length : 0;
    const subs = [`${tot} / ${tot}`, m.map ? mapName(m.map) : m.state === 'pick' ? t('m2_sPick') : tt('m2_mapsLeft', { n: m.mapsLeft?.length ?? '' }),
      lobbyOn(m) && m.state === 'live' ? tt('m2_inLobbyN', { a: nIn, b: tot }) : tt('m2_hostIs', { n: nick(m.host) }), t('m2_rounds'), t('m2_captain'), t('m2_eloKf')];
    return `<div class="stepper m2-steps">${subs.map((s, i) => { const st = i < cur ? 'done' : i === cur ? 'cur' : '';
      return `<div class="${st}"><i>${i < cur ? '✓' : i + 1}</i><span class="m2-st"><b>${t('m2_s' + (i + 1))}</b><small>${s}</small></span></div>`; }).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function nowBanner(m, cur) {
    const myCap = myCapOf(m), myTurn = m.turn && myCap === m.turn, iHost = m.host.id === S.me.id;
    const tot = all(m).length, nIn = lobbyOn(m) ? m.lobbyIn.length : 0, missing = lobbyOn(m) ? all(m).filter(p => !m.lobbyIn.includes(p.id)) : [];
    const capT = s => byId(m, m.captains[s]);
    const hostSide = sideOf(m, m.host.id);
    let h = '', sub = '', timer = '', tone = '';
    if (m.state === 'pick' || m.state === 'ban') {
      const k = m.mapsLeft?.length || 0, other = { n: `${nick(capT(m.turn))} (${TEAM[m.turn]})`, t: TEAM[m.turn], k };
      if (m.state === 'pick') { h = myTurn ? t('m2_nowPickMine') : tt('m2_nowPickOther', other); sub = myTurn ? t('m2_nowPickSub') : tt('m2_nowPickSubOther', other); }
      else { h = myTurn ? t('m2_nowBanMine') : tt('m2_nowBanOther', other); sub = myTurn ? tt('m2_nowBanSub', { k }) : tt('m2_nowBanSubOther', other); }
      tone = myTurn ? 'mine' : 'other ' + (m.turn === 'A' ? 'ta' : 'tb');
      timer = `<b data-m2cd="${m.deadline}">--:--</b><small>${t('m2_tTurn')}</small>`;
    } else if (m.state === 'live') {
      const v = { h: nick(m.host), t: TEAM[hostSide], k: missing.length, a: nIn, b: tot, m: mapName(m.map), c: nick(capT(m.me || 'A')) };
      if (cur === 2) {
        if (iHost) { h = t('m2_nowHost'); sub = tt('m2_nowHostSub', v); }
        else { h = t('m2_nowJoin'); sub = tt(missing.length > 1 ? 'm2_nowJoinSub' : 'm2_nowJoinSubAll', { ...v, k: missing.length - 1 }); }
        timer = `<b data-m2cd="${(m.liveAt || Date.now()) + 10 * 60e3}" data-late="${t('m2_tLate')}">--:--</b><small>${t('m2_tLobby')}</small>`; tone = 'mine';
      } else if (cur === 3) {
        if (iHost && lobbyOn(m) && missing.length) { h = tt('m2_nowWait', { k: missing.length }); sub = tt('m2_nowWaitSub', { n: missing.map(p => `<b>${nick(p)}</b>`).join(', ') }); }
        else { h = tt('m2_nowPlay', v); sub = tt(myCap ? 'm2_nowPlaySubMe' : 'm2_nowPlaySub', v); }
        if (!lobbyOn(m)) sub = sub.replace(/^[^.]*\.\s*/, '');
        timer = `<b data-m2up="${m.liveAt || Date.now()}">0:00</b><small>${t('m2_tPlaying')}</small>`; tone = 'mine';
      } else {
        if (myCap) { h = t('m2_nowShot'); sub = t('m2_nowShotSub'); tone = 'mine'; }
        else { h = tt('m2_nowShotOther', { n: nick(capT(m.me || 'A')) }); sub = t('m2_nowShotOtherSub'); tone = 'other'; }
        timer = `<b data-m2up="${m.liveAt || Date.now()}">0:00</b><small>${t('m2_tPlaying')}</small>`;
      }
    } else if (m.state === 'disputed') { h = t('m2_nowDisp'); sub = t('m2_nowDispSub'); tone = 'warn'; }
    else { h = t('m2_nowSent'); sub = t('m2_nowSentSub'); if (m.disputeUntil > Date.now()) timer = `<b data-m2cd="${m.disputeUntil}">--:--</b><small>${t('m2_tDispute')}</small>`; }
    const live = m.state === 'live' && m.map;
    return `<div class="m2-now ${tone} ${live ? 'bigmap' : ''}" ${live ? `style="--m2-map:url(${mapImg(m.map)})"` : ''}>
      ${live ? `<span class="m2-map">${mapName(m.map)}</span>` : ''}
      <div class="m2-now-tx"><div class="m2-lbl">${t('m2_now')} · ${t('match', { n: m.id })} · ${m.mode.replace('v', '×')}</div><h2>${h}</h2><div class="m2-sub">${sub}</div></div>
      ${timer ? `<div class="m2-timer">${timer}</div>` : ''}</div>`;
  }

  const li = (n, ok, title, sub, extra = '') => `<div class="m2-li ${ok ? 'ok' : ''}"><i>${ok ? '✓' : n}</i><div class="tx"><b>${title}</b>${sub ? `<small>${sub}</small>` : ''}</div>${extra}</div>`;
  const RULES = m => [['rMode', 'Search & Destroy'], ['rServer', t('europe')], ['rZip', t('off')], ['rMarker', t(m?.mode === '5v5' ? 'off' : 'on')], ['rBots', t('off')], ['rPara', t('off')]];

  function minorRow(m) {
    if (!m.me || m.state !== 'live') return '';
    const n = m.drawVotes?.length || 0, mine = m.drawVotes?.includes(S.me.id);
    return `<div class="m2-minor"><span>${t('m2_trouble')} <a href="#" data-m2="chat">${t('m2_writeChat')}</a></span><span class="grow"></span>
      ${inLobby(m, S.me.id) ? `<a href="#" data-m2="unlobby">${t('m2_leaveLobby')}</a>` : ''}
      <a href="#" data-act="dispute">${t('m2_problem')}</a>
      <a href="#" data-act="draw" data-on="${mine ? 0 : 1}" class="${mine ? 'on' : ''}">${tt(mine ? 'm2_drawOff' : 'm2_draw', { n, need: m.drawNeed })}</a></div>`;
  }

  function lobbyBar(m) {
    if (!lobbyOn(m)) return '';
    const tot = all(m).length, n = m.lobbyIn.length;
    return `<div class="m2-prog"><span>${t('m2_inLobby')}</span><div class="m2-bar"><i style="width:${Math.round(100 * n / tot)}%"></i></div><b class="num">${n} / ${tot}</b></div>`;
  }

  function todoCard(m, cur) {
    const myCap = myCapOf(m), myTurn = m.turn && myCap === m.turn, iHost = m.host.id === S.me.id;
    const missing = lobbyOn(m) ? all(m).filter(p => !m.lobbyIn.includes(p.id)) : [];
    const launch = (n) => li(n, seen(m, S.me.id), t('m2_launch'), seenOn(m) ? (seen(m, S.me.id) ? t('m2_launchSeen') : t('m2_launchAuto')) : t('m2_launchPlain'));
    const idbox = `<div class="m2-idbox"><code class="gid">${esc(m.host.gameId)}</code><button class="btn sm" data-act="copy" data-text="${esc(m.host.gameId)}">${t('copyId')}</button></div>`;
    if (m.state === 'pick') {
      return `<div class="card m2-todo"><div class="m2-todo-h"><h4>${t('stepPick')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="timer" data-deadline="${m.deadline}"></span></div>
        ${m.pool.map(p => { const can = !m.canPick || m.canPick.includes(p.id); return `<div class="${can ? '' : 'nopick'}">${playerRow(p, null, { pick: myTurn && can, groups: m.groups })}</div>`; }).join('')}</div>`;
    }
    if (m.state === 'ban') {
      const banned = Object.fromEntries(m.bans.map(b => [b.map, b.by]));
      return `<div class="card m2-todo"><div class="m2-todo-h"><h4>${t('mapVeto')} · ${tt('m2_mapsLeft', { n: m.mapsLeft.length })}</h4><span class="grow"></span>
        <span class="mute" style="font-size:12px">${myTurn ? t('m2_nowBanMine') : tt('m2_nowBanOther', { n: `${nick(byId(m, m.captains[m.turn]))} (${TEAM[m.turn]})` })}</span></div>
        <div class="maps ${myTurn ? 'm2-myturn' : ''}">${matchMaps(m).map(x => banned[x]
          ? `<div class="map banned" data-banned="${t('bannedMap')}" style="background-image:url(${mapImg(x)})"><span>${mapName(x)}</span><em class="by tag m2-t${banned[x]}">${TEAM[banned[x]]}</em></div>`
          : `<div class="map ${myTurn ? 'can' : ''}" style="background-image:url(${mapImg(x)})" ${myTurn ? `data-act="ban" data-map="${x}"` : ''}><span>${mapName(x)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
    }
    if (m.state !== 'live') return '';
    let items = '', cta = '', head = '';
    if (cur === 2) {
      head = `<h4>${tt('m2_todo', { n: 3 })}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="mute" style="font-size:12px">${t('m2_noCode')}</span>`;
      items = iHost
        ? launch(1) + li(2, false, t('m2_mkLobby'), '', `<div class="m2-rules">${RULES(m).map(([k, v]) => `<span>${t(k)}: <b class="${v === t('off') ? 'lose' : ''}">${v}</b></span>`).join('')}</div>`)
          + li(3, !missing.filter(p => p.id !== S.me.id).length, t('m2_inviteAll'), missing.filter(p => p.id !== S.me.id).length ? tt('m2_waitFor', { n: missing.filter(p => p.id !== S.me.id).map(nick).join(', ') }) : t('m2_allIn'))
        : launch(1) + li(2, false, t('m2_addHost'), t('m2_addHostSub'), idbox) + li(3, false, t('m2_acceptInv'), t('m2_acceptInvSub'));
      cta = `<button class="btn big m2-cta" data-m2="lobby">${t('m2_btnLobby')}</button>`;
    } else if (cur === 3) {
      head = `<h4>${tt('m2_todo', { n: 3 })}</h4><span class="grow"></span>${iHost ? '' : `<span class="mute m2-hostid">${t('lobbyHost')}: <b>${nick(m.host)}</b> <code class="gid">${esc(m.host.gameId)}</code><button class="btn ghost xs" data-act="copy" data-text="${esc(m.host.gameId)}">${t('copyId')}</button></span>`}`;
      items = (lobbyOn(m) ? li(1, !missing.length, t('m2_pl1'), missing.length ? tt('m2_waitFor', { n: missing.map(nick).join(', ') }) : '') : launch(1))
        + li(2, false, t('m2_pl2'), tt('m2_pl2s', { m: mapName(m.map) }), iHost ? `<div class="m2-rules">${RULES(m).map(([k, v]) => `<span>${t(k)}: <b class="${v === t('off') ? 'lose' : ''}">${v}</b></span>`).join('')}</div>` : '')
        + li(3, false, t('m2_pl3'), t('m2_pl3s'));
      cta = m.me ? `<button class="btn big m2-cta" data-m2="over">${myCap ? t('m2_btnOverCap') : t('m2_btnOver')}</button>` : '';
    } else if (cur === 4) {
      head = `<h4>${tt('m2_todo', { n: 3 })}</h4>`;
      items = li(1, false, t('m2_sh1'), '') + li(2, false, t('m2_sh2'), '') + li(3, false, t('m2_sh3'), t('m2_sh3s'));
      cta = myCap ? `<button class="btn big m2-cta" data-act="result">${t('m2_btnShot')}</button>`
        : `<div class="m2-waitcap"><div class="pulse"></div><b>${tt('m2_waitCap', { n: nick(byId(m, m.captains[m.me || 'A'])) })}</b></div>`;
      cta += `<a href="#" class="m2-backlink" data-m2="back">${t('m2_back')}</a>`;
    }
    return `<div class="card m2-todo"><div class="m2-todo-h">${head}</div>${items}${cur === 2 || cur === 3 ? lobbyBar(m) : ''}<div class="m2-ctarow">${cta}</div>${minorRow(m)}</div>`;
  }

  function nextCard(m, cur) {
    if (cur >= 5) return '';
    const cap = nick(byId(m, m.captains[m.me || 'A']));
    const n = cur + 1, desc = { 2: tt('m2_next3', { h: nick(m.host) }), 3: tt('m2_next4', { m: m.map ? mapName(m.map) : '?', c: cap }), 4: t('m2_next5'), 5: t('m2_next6') }[n] || '';
    return `<div class="card m2-next"><h4>${t('m2_next')}</h4><b>${tt('m2_step', { n: n + 1, s: t('m2_s' + (n + 1)) })}</b><span class="mute">${desc}</span></div>`;
  }

  function mark(m, p) {
    if (m.state !== 'live') return '';
    let h = '';
    if (seen(m, p.id)) h += `<span class="m2-seen" title="${t('m2_seen')}">${PAD}</span>`;
    if (lobbyOn(m)) h += inLobby(m, p.id) ? `<span class="m2-ok" title="${t('m2_lobbyOk')}">${CHECK}</span>` : `<small class="m2-wait">${t('m2_notLobby')}</small>`;
    return h ? `<span class="m2-marks">${h}</span>` : '';
  }
  function teamCol6(m, side) {
    const size = { '5v5': 5, '2v2': 2, '1v1': 1 }[m.mode] || 1, ps = m.teams[side];
    const turn = m.turn === side && ['pick', 'ban'].includes(m.state);
    const f = m.forecast, avg = Math.round(ps.reduce((s, p) => s + p.elo, 0) / (ps.length || 1));
    const rows = ps.map(p => {
      let h = playerRow(p, m);
      h = h.replace('<div class="pl ', `<div title="${esc(p.nick)}" class="pl `);
      if (m.me === side && p.id === S.me.id) h = h.replace('<div class="sub">', `<div class="sub"><span class="tag m2-youtag">${t('m2_you')}</span> `);
      const k = h.lastIndexOf('</div>');
      return h.slice(0, k) + mark(m, p) + h.slice(k);
    }).join('');
    return `<div class="card team ${side} m2-team ${turn ? 'turn' : ''}">
      <div class="card-h"><h3 class="${side === 'A' ? 'alfa' : 'bravo'}">${TEAM[side]}</h3><span class="mute m2-avg">${f ? tt('m2_avgChance', { e: avg, p: side === 'A' ? f.pA : 100 - f.pA }) : tt('m2_avg', { e: avg })}</span></div>
      ${rows}${Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, size - ps.length) }, () => '<div class="pl empty"></div>').join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function voiceCard(m) {
    if (!m.me || m.test || m.mode === '1v1') return '';
    return `<div class="card voice-card ${m.me}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z"/><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 18v3"/></svg>
      <div class="grow"><b>${t('teamVoice', { n: TEAM[m.me] })}</b><div class="mute" style="font-size:12.5px">${m.voice ? t('voiceHint') : t('voiceCreating')}</div></div>
      ${m.voice ? `<button class="btn" data-voice="${esc(m.voice)}">${t('joinVoice')}</button>` : '<div class="pulse"></div>'}</div>`;
  }

  window.renderMatch = function renderMatch(m) {
    const cur = stepOf(m), myCap = myCapOf(m);
    const center = `${todoCard(m, cur)}${cur === 5 ? resultBlock(m, myCap) : ''}${m.state === 'live' ? voiceCard(m) : ''}${nextCard(m, cur)}`;
    render(`<div class="m2">${stepper6(m, cur)}${nowBanner(m, cur)}${matchBar(m)}
      <div class="room m2-room">${teamCol6(m, 'A')}<div class="center-col">${center}</div>${teamCol6(m, 'B')}</div>
      <div class="m2-chat">${chatBlock(m)}</div></div>`);
    bindPlay();
    bindM2(m);
    tick(); m2Tick();
  };

  function bindM2(m) {
    document.querySelectorAll('#view [data-m2]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const a = b.dataset.m2;
      if (a === 'lobby' || a === 'unlobby') {
        if (!lobbyOn(m)) { M2.over[m.id] = false; return refresh(); }
        b.disabled = true;
        run(async () => { try { await api('/api/match/lobby', { on: a === 'lobby' }); if (typeof sfx === 'function') sfx('ok'); } finally { b.disabled = false; } })();
      } else if (a === 'over') { M2.over[m.id] = true; refresh(); }
      else if (a === 'back') { M2.over[m.id] = false; refresh(); }
      else if (a === 'chat') { const i = $('#chat-in'); i?.focus(); i?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' }); }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#view .m2-minor a[data-act]').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', e => e.preventDefault()));
  }

  const mmss = s => `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  function m2Tick() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-m2cd]').forEach(el => {
      const s = Math.round((+el.dataset.m2cd - Date.now()) / 1000);
      if (s >= 0) { el.textContent = mmss(s); el.classList.remove('late'); }
      else if (el.dataset.late) { el.textContent = '+' + mmss(-s); el.classList.add('late'); const c = el.nextElementSibling; if (c && c.textContent !== el.dataset.late) c.textContent = el.dataset.late; }
      else el.textContent = '0:00';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-m2up]').forEach(el => { el.textContent = mmss(Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - +el.dataset.m2up) / 1000))); });
  }
  setInterval(m2Tick, 500);

  document.addEventListener('paste', e => {
    const m = S.live?.match;
    if (!m || S.page !== 'play' || m.state !== 'live' || stepOf(m) !== 4 || !myCapOf(m) || $('#modal').dataset.kind || e.target.matches?.('input, textarea')) return;
    const f = [...(e.clipboardData?.files || [])].find(f => f.type.startsWith('image/'));
    if (f) { e.preventDefault(); window.openResultForm(f); }
  });

  const imgDims = src => new Promise(res => { const i = new Image(); i.onload = () => res({ w: i.naturalWidth, h: i.naturalHeight, img: i }); i.onerror = () => res(null); i.src = src; });

  window.openResultForm = function openResultForm(initial) {
    const m = S.live.match;
    const players = ['A', 'B'].flatMap(side => m.teams[side].map(p => ({ id: p.id, nick: p.nick, side })));
    const P = Object.fromEntries(players.map(p => [p.id, p]));
    let shot = null, sending = false, R = null;
    const wiz = n => `<div class="m2-wiz">${[t('m2_w1'), t('m2_w2'), t('m2_w3')].map((s, i) => `${i ? `<div class="wl ${i <= n ? 'done' : ''}"></div>` : ''}<div class="ws ${i < n ? 'done' : i === n ? 'cur' : ''}"><i>${i < n ? '✓' : i + 1}</i>${s}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;
    const head = n => `<div class="m2-rfhead"><div><h4>${t('match', { n: m.id })} · ${m.mode.replace('v', '×')}${m.map ? ' · ' + mapName(m.map) : ''}</h4><h2>${t('m2_rfTitle')}</h2></div><span class="grow"></span>${wiz(n)}<button class="iconbtn m2-x" data-close title="✕">✕</button></div>`;
    const srcBtns = (first) => `<div class="row shot-src"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="rf-paste">${first ? t('pasteShot') : t('m2_replace')}</button>${K.latestShot ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" id="rf-steam">${t('steamShot')}</button>` : ''}<button class="btn ghost sm" id="rf-pick">${t('pickFile')}</button></div>`;
    const phase1 = () => `${head(0)}<div id="rf-body" class="m2-rf1">
      <p class="mute" style="margin:0">${t('shotOnlyHint')}</p>
      <div class="drop big" id="rf-drop">${t('dropHint')}</div>
      ${srcBtns(true)}
      <p class="mute shot-how">${t('shotHow')}</p>
      <div id="rf-auto"></div><div class="err" id="rf-err"></div></div>`;
    modal(`<div class="card accent result-form m2-rf col">${phase1()}<input type="file" id="rf-file" accept="image/*,.jfif,.webp,.bmp" hidden></div>`, box => {
      const card = box.querySelector('.m2-rf');
      const setHead = n => { card.querySelector('.m2-rfhead').outerHTML = head(n); card.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(b => b.onclick = closeModal); };
      const fail = msg => { const e = $('#rf-err'); if (e) e.textContent = msg; else toast(msg, true); };

      const setShot = async f => {
        if (sending) return;
        try {
          shot = await fileToJpeg(f);
          if (R) { card.innerHTML = phase1() + '<input type="file" id="rf-file" accept="image/*,.jfif,.webp,.bmp" hidden>'; R = null; bindSrc(); }
          $('#rf-drop').innerHTML = `<img src="${shot}"><div class="scan">${t('recognizing')}</div>`;
          fail('');
          const dim = await imgDims(shot);
          const pass = async bin => {
            const prep = await ocrPrep(shot, bin);
            const ocr = await K.ocr(prep);
            const lay = OcrParse.layout(ocr, players, m.me);
            if (lay && lay.rows.length) {
              const flat = await K.ocrDigits(prep, lay.rows.flatMap(x => x.rects));
              const n = lay.cols.length;
              return { board: true, lay, r: OcrParse.finish(lay, lay.rows.map((_, i) => flat.slice(i * n, i * n + n)), players, m.me, ocr.text) };
            }
            return { board: !!lay || /battle\s*results|scoreboard|результати\s*матчу|результаты\s*матча|search\s*(and|&)\s*destroy|\b(alfa|alpha|bravo)\b|альфа|браво/i.test(ocr.text), lay, r: OcrParse.parse(ocr, players, m.me) };
          };
          let best = await pass(false);
          if (!OcrParse.complete(best.r)) {
            const b = await pass(true);
            if (OcrParse.quality(b.r) > OcrParse.quality(best.r) || (b.board && !best.board)) best = b;
          }
          if (!OcrParse.complete(best.r)) {
            const b = await pass('adaptive');
            if (OcrParse.quality(b.r) > OcrParse.quality(best.r) || (b.board && !best.board)) best = b;
          }
          if (!best.board) toast(t('notScoreboardSoft'), true);
          R = buildCheck(best, dim);
          showCheck();
        } catch (e) {
          if (!shot) return fail(e.message);
          const dim = await imgDims(shot).catch(() => null);
          R = buildCheck({ r: { stats: {}, score: '', found: 0, total: players.length, winner: null }, lay: null }, dim);
          showCheck(); fail(e.message);
        }
      };

      function buildCheck(best, dim) {
        const r = best.r, lay = best.lay && best.lay.rows ? best.lay : null;
        const sc = dim && dim.w < 1700 ? 1.5 : 1;
        const rows = [];
        if (lay) {
          lay.rows.forEach(x => { const s = r.stats[x.id] || {}; rows.push({ game: x.game || '', box: x.box, section: x.section, k: s.k ?? 0, d: s.d ?? 0, nums: s.nums || [], ok: !!s.ok, conf: x.conf, digits: true, orig: x.id }); });
          (lay.extra || []).forEach(x => rows.push({ game: x.game || '', box: x.box, section: x.section, k: 0, d: 0, nums: [], ok: false, conf: 0, digits: false, orig: null }));
        } else {
          Object.entries(r.stats || {}).forEach(([id, s]) => rows.push({ game: '', box: null, section: null, k: s.k ?? 0, d: s.d ?? 0, nums: s.nums || [], ok: !!s.ok, conf: s.conf ?? 0.7, digits: true, orig: id }));
        }
        const map = {}, val = {};
        for (const p of players) { const i = rows.findIndex(x => x.orig === p.id); map[p.id] = i < 0 ? null : i; val[p.id] = i < 0 ? { k: 0, d: 0 } : { k: rows[i].k, d: rows[i].d }; }
        return { r, lay, rows, map, val, manual: {}, remap: {}, edit: false, winner: r.winner || null, score: r.score || '', sc, dim, auto: { found: r.found, total: r.total, winner: r.winner, checked: r.checked ?? null } };
      }

      const kdOf = row => row && row.nums && row.nums.length >= 4 && row.nums[3] != null ? row.nums[3] : null;
      const fits = (k, d, kd) => kd != null && Math.abs(k / Math.max(d, 1) - kd) < 0.06;
      const exact = (k, d, kd) => kd != null && Math.abs(k / Math.max(d, 1) - kd) < 0.0055;
      function pState(id) {
        const i = R.map[id], row = i == null ? null : R.rows[i], v = R.val[id], kd = kdOf(row);
        const how = row == null ? 'none' : R.remap[id] ? 'manual' : row.conf >= 0.85 ? 'nick' : row.conf >= 0.68 ? 'like' : 'excl';
        const kdOk = kd == null ? null : exact(v.k, v.d, kd);
        const digitsQ = !R.manual[id] && (row == null || !row.digits || (kd == null ? !row.ok : !kdOk));
        return { i, row, v, kd, kdOk, how, digitsQ, warn: how === 'none' || how === 'excl' || how === 'like' ? !R.remap[id] : false };
      }
      function recomputeWinner() {
        const secs = R.lay?.sections || [];
        if (secs.length < 2 || secs[0].rounds === secs[1].rounds) return;
        const win = secs[0].rounds > secs[1].rounds ? secs[0] : secs[1];
        const cnt = side => players.filter(p => p.side === side && R.map[p.id] != null && R.rows[R.map[p.id]].section === win.name).length;
        if (cnt('A') !== cnt('B')) R.winner = cnt('A') > cnt('B') ? 'A' : 'B';
      }
      function suggest(st) {
        const { v, kd } = st; if (kd == null || kd <= 0) return null;
        const c = [];
        for (let k = Math.max(0, v.k - 4); k <= v.k + 4; k++) for (let d = Math.max(0, v.d - 4); d <= v.d + 4; d++) {
          if ((k === v.k && d === v.d) || !exact(k, d, kd)) continue;
          c.push({ k, d, cost: (k !== v.k) + (d !== v.d) + (Math.abs(k - v.k) + Math.abs(d - v.d)) / 10 });
        }
        c.sort((a, b) => a.cost - b.cost);
        if (!c.length) return null;
        const b = c[0], f = b.k === v.k ? 'd' : b.d === v.d ? 'k' : 'kd';
        return { f, k: b.k, d: b.d, v: f === 'k' ? b.k : f === 'd' ? b.d : `${b.k}/${b.d}`, more: c.slice(1, 3) };
      }

      function showCheck() {
        const body = $('#rf-body');
        setHead(1);
        body.className = 'm2-rf2';
        body.innerHTML = `<div class="m2-rfl">
            <div class="m2-box"><div class="m2-box-h"><h4>${t('m2_yourShot')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="mute">${R.dim ? `${R.dim.w}×${R.dim.h}` : ''}</span></div>
              <div class="m2-shot" id="rf-drop"><img src="${shot}">${boxesHtml()}</div>
              <div class="m2-legend"><span><i class="ok"></i>${t('m2_legOk')}</span><span><i class="warn"></i>${t('m2_legWarn')}</span></div>
              ${srcBtns(false)}</div>
            <div class="m2-box" id="rf-zoom"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="m2-rfr m2-box" id="rf-check"></div>`;
        bindSrc();
        drawCheck(); drawZoom();
      }

      function boxesHtml() {
        if (!R.dim) return '';
        const W = R.dim.w * R.sc, H = R.dim.h * R.sc, cb = R.lay?.colBox;
        const pct = (b, x0, x1) => `left:${(x0 / W * 100).toFixed(2)}%;top:${((b.y0 - 3) / H * 100).toFixed(2)}%;width:${((x1 - x0) / W * 100).toFixed(2)}%;height:${((b.y1 - b.y0 + 6) / H * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
        const owner = i => players.find(p => R.map[p.id] === i);
        return R.rows.map((row, i) => {
          if (!row.box) return '';
          const p = owner(i), st = p ? pState(p.id) : null;
          const nickWarn = !p || st.warn, digWarn = !p || st.digitsQ;
          const nx1 = cb ? Math.max(row.box.x0 + 20, cb.x0 - 8) : row.box.x1;
          const lbl = !p ? t('m2_nickMissing') : '';
          return `<div class="m2-bx ${nickWarn ? 'w' : ''}" style="${pct(row.box, row.box.x0 - 4, nx1)}">${lbl ? `<span>${lbl}</span>` : ''}</div>`
            + (cb && row.digits ? `<div class="m2-bx ${digWarn ? 'w' : ''}" style="${pct(row.box, cb.x0, cb.x1)}"></div>` : '');
        }).join('');
      }

      async function drawZoom() {
        const el = $('#rf-zoom'); if (!el) return;
        const items = players.map(p => ({ p, st: pState(p.id) })).filter(x => x.st.row?.box && (x.st.warn || x.st.digitsQ));
        const extra = R.rows.map((row, i) => ({ row, i })).filter(x => x.row.box && !players.some(p => R.map[p.id] === x.i));
        if (!items.length && !extra.length) { el.innerHTML = ''; el.hidden = true; return; }
        el.hidden = false;
        const dim = await imgDims(shot); if (!dim || !$('#rf-zoom')) return;
        const crop = b => { const s = 1 / R.sc, x0 = Math.max(0, b.x0 * s - 8), x1 = Math.min(dim.w, (R.lay?.colBox?.x1 || b.x1) * s + 8), y0 = Math.max(0, b.y0 * s - 5), y1 = Math.min(dim.h, b.y1 * s + 5);
          const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = x1 - x0; c.height = y1 - y0; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(dim.img, x0, y0, c.width, c.height, 0, 0, c.width, c.height); return c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', .9); };
        const lab = x => { const st = x.st; if (st.digitsQ && !st.warn) { const s = suggest(st); return s ? (s.f === 'kd' ? `K/D = ${s.v}?` : `${s.f === 'k' ? 'K' : 'D'} = ${s.v}?`) : t('m2_digitsQ'); } return `→ ${nick(x.p)}${st.how === 'like' ? '?' : ''}`; };
        el.innerHTML = `<div class="m2-box-h"><h4>${t('m2_zoom')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="mute">Score · K · D · K/D</span></div>
          ${items.map(x => `<div class="m2-zm"><img src="${crop(x.st.row.box)}"><b>${lab(x)}</b></div>`).join('')}
          ${extra.map(x => `<div class="m2-zm"><img src="${crop(x.row.box)}"><b>${t('m2_nickMissing')}</b></div>`).join('')}`;
      }

      function drawCheck() {
        const el = $('#rf-check'); if (!el) return;
        const sts = Object.fromEntries(players.map(p => [p.id, pState(p.id)]));
        const matched = players.filter(p => ['nick', 'like', 'manual'].includes(sts[p.id].how)).length;
        const toCheck = players.filter(p => sts[p.id].warn || sts[p.id].digitsQ).length;
        const [ws, ls] = (R.score || '').split('-');
        const sA = R.winner ? (R.winner === 'A' ? ws : ls) : '?', sB = R.winner ? (R.winner === 'B' ? ws : ls) : '?';
        const rowOpts = id => `<select class="m2-sel" data-map="${id}"><option value="">${t('m2_optNone')}</option>${R.rows.map((r, i) => `<option value="${i}" ${R.map[id] === i ? 'selected' : ''}>${esc(r.game ? t(r.digits ? 'm2_optRow' : 'm2_optRowNoDigits', { n: r.game.slice(0, 22), k: r.k, d: r.d }) : tt('m2_rowN', { n: i + 1 }) + (r.digits ? ` · ${r.k}/${r.d}` : ''))}</option>`).join('')}</select>`;
        const howTxt = st => ({ nick: `<span class="m2-okc">✓ ${t('m2_mNick')}</span>`, like: `<span class="m2-wn">${t('m2_mLike')}</span>`, excl: `<span class="m2-wn">${t('m2_mExcl')}</span>`, none: `<span class="m2-bad">${t('m2_mNone')}</span>`, manual: `<span class="m2-okc">${t('m2_mManual')}</span>` })[st.how];
        const num = (id, f, st) => {
          const s = st.digitsQ ? suggest(st) : null, q = st.digitsQ && (!s || s.f === f || s.f === 'kd' || st.row == null || !st.row.digits);
          return R.edit || q ? `<input class="m2-num ${q ? 'q' : ''}" type="number" min="0" max="150" data-pid="${id}" data-f="${f}" value="${st.v[f]}">` : `<span class="num">${st.v[f]}</span>`;
        };
        const fixRow = (p, st) => {
          if (!st.digitsQ) return '';
          const s = suggest(st);
          if (s) {
            const pairs = [{ k: s.k, d: s.d }, ...s.more, { k: st.v.k, d: st.v.d, cur: true }];
            const chip = x => s.f === 'kd' ? `${x.k}/${x.d}` : s.f === 'k' ? x.k : x.d;
            const seenC = new Set();
            const chips = pairs.filter(x => (s.f === 'kd' ? true : s.f === 'k' ? x.d === st.v.d : x.k === st.v.k) && !seenC.has(chip(x)) && seenC.add(chip(x)))
              .map(x => `<button class="m2-chip ${x.cur ? 'cur' : ''}" data-fix="${p.id}" data-k="${x.k}" data-d="${x.d}">${chip(x)}</button>`).join('');
            const msg = s.f === 'kd' ? tt('m2_kdPair', { n: nick(p), kd: st.kd.toFixed(2), a: `${st.v.k}/${st.v.d}`, v: s.v }) : tt('m2_kdBad', { f: s.f === 'k' ? t('m2_kills') : t('m2_deaths'), n: nick(p), kd: st.kd.toFixed(2), v: s.v });
            return `<tr class="m2-fix"><td colspan="7"><div class="m2-fixin"><span>${msg}</span><span class="grow"></span>${chips}<button class="m2-chip" data-other="${p.id}" data-f="${s.f === 'd' ? 'd' : 'k'}">${t('m2_other')}</button></div></td></tr>`;
          }
          return `<tr class="m2-fix"><td colspan="7"><div class="m2-fixin"><span>${st.row == null || !st.row.digits ? tt('m2_kdNone', { n: nick(p) }) : tt('m2_kdBadNo', { n: nick(p) })}</span></div></td></tr>`;
        };
        const section = side => `<tr class="m2-sec ${side}"><td colspan="7">${TEAM[side]}${R.winner === side ? ' · ' + t('m2_winnerL') : ''}</td></tr>`
          + players.filter(p => p.side === side).map(p => { const st = sts[p.id], w = st.warn || st.digitsQ, sc = st.row?.nums?.[0];
            const kdc = st.kd != null ? `<span class="${st.kdOk ? '' : 'm2-wn'}">${st.kd.toFixed(2)}</span>` : `<span class="mute">${kd(st.v.k, st.v.d)}</span>`;
            return `<tr class="${w ? 'w' : ''}"><td class="nk">${nick(p)}${st.row?.game ? `<small>${tt('m2_inGame', { n: esc(st.row.game.slice(0, 26)) })}</small>` : ''}</td>
              <td>${howTxt(st)}${R.edit || st.warn || st.how === 'none' || st.how === 'manual' ? rowOpts(p.id) : ''}</td>
              <td class="r num">${sc ?? '—'}</td><td class="r">${num(p.id, 'k', st)}</td><td class="r">${num(p.id, 'd', st)}</td><td class="r num">${kdc}</td>
              <td class="r">${st.kdOk === true || st.v.k + st.v.d === 0 && !w ? `<span class="m2-okc">✓</span>` : w ? '<span class="m2-wn">!</span>' : ''}</td></tr>${fixRow(p, st)}`; }).join('');
        el.innerHTML = `<div class="m2-box-h"><h4>${t('m2_read')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="m2-pill">${tt('m2_nicksOk', { a: matched, b: players.length })}</span>${toCheck ? `<span class="m2-pill w">${tt('m2_toCheck', { n: toCheck })}</span>` : `<span class="m2-pill">${t('m2_allOk')}</span>`}</div>
          <div class="m2-score">
            <button class="m2-tm A ${R.winner === 'A' ? 'won' : ''}" data-win="A"><b>${TEAM.A}</b><small>${m.me === 'A' ? t('m2_yourTeam') : ''}${R.winner === 'A' ? (m.me === 'A' ? ' · ' : '') + t('m2_winnerL') : ''}</small></button>
            <div class="m2-big"><span class="alfa">${sA ?? '?'}</span><i>:</i><span class="bravo">${sB ?? '?'}</span></div>
            <button class="m2-tm B ${R.winner === 'B' ? 'won' : ''}" data-win="B"><b>${TEAM.B}</b><small>${m.me === 'B' ? t('m2_yourTeam') : ''}${R.winner === 'B' ? (m.me === 'B' ? ' · ' : '') + t('m2_winnerL') : ''}</small></button>
          </div>
          ${R.winner ? '' : `<p class="m2-wn" style="text-align:center;margin:8px 0 0">${t('m2_pickWinner')}</p>`}
          ${R.rows.length ? '' : `<p class="m2-wn">${t('m2_noRows')}</p>`}
          <table class="m2-tbl"><thead><tr><th>${t('m2_colPlayer')}</th><th>${t('m2_colMap')}</th><th class="r">${t('m2_colScore')}</th><th class="r">K</th><th class="r">D</th><th class="r">K/D</th><th></th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>${section('A')}${section('B')}</tbody></table>
          <div class="m2-act"><button class="btn big m2-cta" id="rf-confirm" ${R.winner ? '' : 'disabled'}>${t('m2_confirm')}</button><button class="btn ghost" id="rf-edit">${R.edit ? t('m2_doneManual') : t('m2_fixManual')}</button></div>
          <p class="mute m2-after">${t('m2_after')}</p><div class="err" id="rf-err"></div>`;
        bindCheck();
      }
      const redraw = () => { drawCheck(); const s = card.querySelector('.m2-shot'); if (s) { s.querySelectorAll('.m2-bx').forEach(b => b.remove()); s.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', boxesHtml()); } drawZoom(); };

      function bindCheck() {
        const el = $('#rf-check');
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-win]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { R.winner = b.dataset.win; drawCheck(); });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-map]').forEach(s => s.onchange = () => {
          const id = s.dataset.map, i = s.value === '' ? null : +s.value;
          const prev = players.find(p => p.id !== id && R.map[p.id] === i && i != null);
          if (prev) { R.map[prev.id] = R.map[id]; R.remap[prev.id] = true; const pr = R.map[prev.id] == null ? null : R.rows[R.map[prev.id]]; R.val[prev.id] = pr ? { k: pr.k, d: pr.d } : { k: 0, d: 0 }; }
          R.map[id] = i; R.remap[id] = true; R.val[id] = i == null ? { k: 0, d: 0 } : { k: R.rows[i].k, d: R.rows[i].d };
          delete R.manual[id];
          recomputeWinner(); redraw();
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('input[data-pid]').forEach(inp => {
          inp.oninput = () => { const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(150, parseInt(inp.value, 10) || 0)); R.val[inp.dataset.pid][inp.dataset.f] = v; };
          inp.onchange = () => { R.manual[inp.dataset.pid] = true; redraw(); };
        });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-fix]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { R.val[b.dataset.fix] = { k: +b.dataset.k, d: +b.dataset.d }; R.manual[b.dataset.fix] = true; redraw(); });
        el.querySelectorAll('[data-other]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { R.edit = true; drawCheck(); el.querySelector(`input[data-pid="${CSS.escape(b.dataset.other)}"][data-f="${b.dataset.f}"]`)?.focus(); });
        $('#rf-edit').onclick = () => { R.edit = !R.edit; drawCheck(); };
        $('#rf-confirm').onclick = send;
      }

      async function send() {
        if (sending || !R?.winner) return;
        sending = true;
        const btn = $('#rf-confirm'); if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = t('m2_sendingT'); }
        setHead(2);
        const stats = Object.fromEntries(players.map(p => [p.id, { k: R.val[p.id].k | 0, d: R.val[p.id].d | 0 }]));
        const edited = Object.keys(R.manual).length, remapped = Object.keys(R.remap).length;
        try {
          await api('/api/match/result', { winner: R.winner, score: R.score, stats, shot, auto: { ...R.auto, ...(edited ? { edited } : {}), ...(remapped ? { remapped } : {}), ...(R.winner !== R.auto.winner ? { winnerSet: true } : {}) } });
          closeModal();
        } catch (e) {
          sending = false; setHead(1);
          if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = t('m2_confirm'); }
          fail(e.message);
        }
      }

      const fromUrl = async url => {
        try { const r = await fetch(url); const b = r.ok ? await r.blob() : null; if (!b || !b.type.startsWith('image/')) throw 0; setShot(b); }
        catch { fail(t('shotUrlFail')); }
      };
      const urlIn = text => (String(text || '').match(/https?:\/\/\S+?\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp|gif|bmp)(?:\?\S*)?(?=\s|$|")/i) || String(text || '').match(/https?:\/\/(?:cdn|media)\.discordapp\.(?:com|net)\/attachments\/\S+/i) || [])[0];
      const fromData = dt => {
        const f = [...(dt.files || [])].find(f => f.type.startsWith('image/') || /\.(png|jpe?g|jfif|webp|bmp|gif)$/i.test(f.name));
        if (f) return setShot(f), true;
        const item = [...(dt.items || [])].find(i => i.kind === 'file' && i.type.startsWith('image/'));
        if (item?.getAsFile()) return setShot(item.getAsFile()), true;
        const html = dt.getData?.('text/html') || '', img = html.match(/<img[^>]+src="([^"]+)"/i)?.[1];
        const url = img || urlIn(dt.getData?.('text/uri-list')) || urlIn(dt.getData?.('text/plain'));
        if (url) return fromUrl(url.replace(/&amp;/g, '&')), true;
        return false;
      };
      function bindSrc() {
        const drop = $('#rf-drop');
        if (drop && !R) drop.onclick = () => $('#rf-file').click();
        $('#rf-pick').onclick = () => $('#rf-file').click();
        $('#rf-file').onchange = e => { e.target.files[0] && setShot(e.target.files[0]); e.target.value = ''; };
        $('#rf-paste').onclick = async () => {
          try {
            for (const it of await navigator.clipboard.read()) {
              const type = it.types.find(x => x.startsWith('image/'));
              if (type) return setShot(await it.getType(type));
              if (it.types.includes('text/plain')) { const u = urlIn(await (await it.getType('text/plain')).text()); if (u) return fromUrl(u); }
            }
            fail(t('clipEmpty'));
          } catch { fail(t('clipEmpty')); }
        };
        if ($('#rf-steam')) $('#rf-steam').onclick = async () => {
          const r = await K.latestShot().catch(() => null);
          if (!r?.dataUrl) return fail(t('steamNone'));
          setShot(await (await fetch(r.dataUrl)).blob());
          const min = Math.round((Date.now() - r.mtime) / 60000);
          if (min > 30) toast(t('steamOld', { n: min < 120 ? min + ' ' + t('minShort') : Math.round(min / 60) + ' ' + t('hShort') }), true);
        };
        card.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(b => b.onclick = closeModal);
      }
      bindSrc();
      const onPaste = e => {
        if (!$('#rf-drop') || S.rfPaste !== onPaste) return document.removeEventListener('paste', onPaste);
        if (e.target.matches?.('input, textarea, select')) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!fromData(e.clipboardData)) fail(t('clipEmpty'));
      };
      if (S.rfPaste) document.removeEventListener('paste', S.rfPaste);
      S.rfPaste = onPaste;
      document.addEventListener('paste', onPaste);
      box.ondragover = e => e.preventDefault();
      box.ondrop = e => { e.preventDefault(); if (!fromData(e.dataTransfer)) fail(t('notImage')); };
      if (initial instanceof Blob) setShot(initial);
    });
  };
})();
```

```js
(() => {
  const mq = matchMedia('(max-width: 760px)');
  const L = {
    en: { play: 'Play', leaderboard: 'Ranking', profile: 'Profile', shop: 'Store', menu: 'Menu' },
    uk: { play: 'Грати', leaderboard: 'Рейтинг', profile: 'Профіль', shop: 'Магазин', menu: 'Меню' },
    ru: { play: 'Играть', leaderboard: 'Рейтинг', profile: 'Профиль', shop: 'Магазин', menu: 'Меню' },
  };
  const tm = k => (L[typeof LANG !== 'undefined' ? LANG : 'en']?.[k] ?? (typeof kzTm === 'function' ? kzTm(L.en[k]) : L.en[k]));
  const IC = {
    play: '<path d="M7 4.5v15l12-7.5z"/>',
    leaderboard: '<path d="M4 20V11h4v9M10 20V5h4v15M16 20v-6h4v6"/>',
    profile: '<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21c1-4.5 4.5-6.5 8-6.5s7 2 8 6.5"/>',
    shop: '<path d="M4 8h16l-1.5 12h-13z"/><path d="M8.5 8a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 7 0"/>',
    menu: '<path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/>',
  };
  const TABS = ['play', 'leaderboard', 'profile', 'shop', 'menu'];
  let bar = null, back = null;

  function build() {
    if (bar || !document.body) return;
    bar = document.createElement('nav'); bar.className = 'mtab';
    back = document.createElement('div'); back.className = 'mback';
    document.body.append(back, bar);
    back.onclick = () => menu(false);
    draw();
    document.getElementById('nav')?.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.closest('[data-go]')) menu(false); });
  }
  function draw() {
    if (!bar) return;
    const cnt = Number(document.querySelector('#nav .n2-cnt:not([hidden])')?.textContent || 0);
    bar.innerHTML = TABS.map(k => `<button data-mt="${k}" class="${typeof S !== 'undefined' && S.page === k ? 'on' : ''}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">${IC[k]}</svg>${tm(k)}${k === 'menu' && cnt ? `<i>${cnt}</i>` : ''}</button>`).join('');
    bar.querySelectorAll('[data-mt]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const k = b.dataset.mt; if (k === 'menu') return menu(!document.body.classList.contains('m-menu')); menu(false); go(k); });
  }
  const menu = on => document.body.classList.toggle('m-menu', !!on);

  const px = v => parseFloat(v) || 0;
  function fit() {
    if (!mq.matches) return;
    const root = document.getElementById('view'), modal = document.getElementById('modal');
    for (const r of [root, modal]) {
      if (!r) continue;
      for (const el of r.querySelectorAll('*')) {
        const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
        const w = el.clientWidth;
        if (!w) continue;
        if (cs.display === 'grid' || cs.display === 'inline-grid') {
          const tracks = cs.gridTemplateColumns.split(' ').filter(Boolean);
          if (tracks.length < 1) continue;
          const sum = tracks.reduce((a, t) => a + px(t), 0), gap = px(cs.columnGap) * (tracks.length - 1);
          const narrow = tracks.length > 1 && w / tracks.length < 95;
          if (sum + gap > w + 3 || narrow) {
            const k = Math.max(1, Math.min(tracks.length, Math.floor((w + px(cs.columnGap)) / 165)));
            el.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${k}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;
            for (const c of el.children) { const gc = getComputedStyle(c).gridColumnEnd; if (/span\s+\d+/.test(gc) || /^-1$/.test(gc)) c.style.gridColumn = '1 / -1'; }
          }
        } else if ((cs.display === 'flex' || cs.display === 'inline-flex') && cs.flexDirection.startsWith('row') && cs.flexWrap === 'nowrap'
          && el.scrollWidth > w + 4 && !/auto|scroll/.test(cs.overflowX) && !el.closest('table, .mtab, #nav')) {
          el.style.flexWrap = 'wrap';
        }
      }
    }
  }
  let t = null;
  const soon = () => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => { fit(); draw(); }, 90); };

  function start() {
    build();
    const v = document.getElementById('view'), m = document.getElementById('modal');
    const mo = new MutationObserver(soon);
    if (v) mo.observe(v, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    if (m) mo.observe(m, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    addEventListener('resize', soon);
    if (typeof go === 'function') { const _go = go; go = function () { const r = _go.apply(this, arguments); menu(false); soon(); return r; }; }
    soon();
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();
})();
```
