function kzMusThumb(id) {
  const on = kzMusOn(id), m = KZ_MUS[id];
  return `<div class="th-thumb mu-thumb ${on ? 'on' : ''}" data-mu="${esc(id)}"><img src="assets/music/${esc(m?.cover || 'konzte')}.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy">
    <span class="mu-eq"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>
    <button class="mu-play" data-mupl="${esc(id)}|menu" title="${esc(on ? kzMusT('stop') : kzMusT('listen'))}">${on ? KZ_MUS_IC.stop : KZ_MUS_IC.play}</button>
    <span class="th-sw">${(m?.sw || []).map(c => `<i style="background:${c}"></i>`).join('')}</span></div>`;
}
function kzMusTry(id) {
  const tr = ['menu', 'queue', 'lobby'], fx = ['click', 'coin', 'match_found', 'level_up', 'victory', 'defeat'];
  const p = window.KA?.packPlaying?.();
  return `<div class="th-try mu-try">${kzMusThumb(id)}
    <p class="th-desc">${esc(kzMusDesc(id))}</p>
    <div class="mu-row"><span>${KZ_MUS_IC.note}${kzMusT('music')}</span><div class="seg sm">${tr.map(k => `<button data-mupl="${esc(id)}|${k}" class="${p && p.id === id && p.track === k ? 'on' : ''}">${kzMusOn(id, k) ? KZ_MUS_IC.stop : KZ_MUS_IC.play}${kzMusT(k)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
    <div class="mu-row"><span>${kzMusT('sounds')}</span><div class="mu-fx">${fx.map(k => `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-musfx="${esc(id)}|${k}">${kzMusT('fx_' + k)}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
    <p class="mute th-note">${esc(kzMusT('whole'))}</p></div>`;
}
function kzMusSync() {
  const p = window.KA?.packPlaying?.();
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-mupl]').forEach(b => {
    const [id, tr] = b.dataset.mupl.split('|'), round = b.classList.contains('mu-play');
    const on = !!p && p.id === id && (round || p.track === tr);
    b.classList.toggle('on', on);
    if (round) { b.innerHTML = on ? KZ_MUS_IC.stop : KZ_MUS_IC.play; b.title = on ? kzMusT('stop') : kzMusT('listen'); }
    else b.innerHTML = (on ? KZ_MUS_IC.stop : KZ_MUS_IC.play) + kzMusT(tr);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.mu-thumb[data-mu]').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('on', !!p && p.id === el.dataset.mu));
}
document.addEventListener('kz:packpreview', kzMusSync);
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('[data-mupl],[data-musfx]');
  if (!b || !window.KA?.packPreview) return;
  e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
  if (b.dataset.mupl != null) {
    const [id, tr] = b.dataset.mupl.split('|');
    const round = b.classList.contains('mu-play');
    KA.packPreview(kzMusOn(id, round ? null : tr) ? null : id, tr || 'menu');
  } else {
    const [id, fx] = b.dataset.musfx.split('|');
    if (!kzMusOn(id)) KA.packPreview(id, 'menu');
    KA.play(fx, { force: true });
  }
}, true);

  ];
  const LABEL = { referrals: 'n2_refLabel', pass: 'lcPass', onboarding: 'n2_onb' };
  const label = k => t(LABEL[k] || k);
  const btn = k => nav.querySelector(`.nav-btn[data-go="${k}"]`);

  if (!btn('friends')) {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'nav-btn'; b.dataset.go = 'friends';
    b.innerHTML = `${sv('friends')}<span></span>`;

    nav.appendChild(b);
  }
  if (!btn('onboarding')) {

    b.innerHTML = `${sv('steps')}<span></span>`;
    b.onclick = () => go('onboarding');
    nav.appendChild(b);
  }
  const scroll = document.createElement('div'); scroll.className = 'n2-scroll';
  const foot = document.createElement('div'); foot.className = 'n2-foot';
  for (const [g, keys] of GROUPS) {

    for (const k of keys) { const b = btn(k); if (b) scroll.appendChild(b); }
  }
  const staffH = document.createElement('div'); staffH.className = 'n2-grp n2-staffg'; staffH.dataset.g = 'n2_gStaff';
  scroll.appendChild(staffH);
  if (btn('staff')) scroll.appendChild(btn('staff'));

    for (const [k, tab] of SET_ROWS) if (m(t(k))) add('n2_pSettings', { ic: sv('gear'), label: t(k), sub: t('n2_pSetSub', { s: t(SET_TABS.find(x => x[0] === tab)[1]) }), run: () => openSet(tab) });
    const own = (k, id) => (P.shop?.owned?.[k + 's'] || []).includes(id);
    for (const it of (P.shop?.items || []).filter(it => m(prettyId(it.id)) || m(it.id)).slice(0, 5))
      add('n2_pItems', { ic: iconOf('shop'), label: prettyId(it.id), sub: own(it.kind, it.id) ? `${t(KIND[it.kind] || it.kind)} · ${t('n2_pOwned')}` : t('n2_pItemSub', { k: t(KIND[it.kind] || it.kind), p: it.price }), run: () => openItem(it) });
    return out;
  }
  function openItem(it) {
    go('shop');
    let n = 0; const tm = setInterval(() => {
      const b = document.querySelector(`[data-buy-id="${CSS.escape(it.id)}"], [data-usd-id="${CSS.escape(it.id)}"]`)?.closest('.inv');
      if (b || ++n > 25) { clearInterval(tm); if (b) { b.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); b.classList.add('n2-flash'); setTimeout(() => b.classList.remove('n2-flash'), 2200); } }
    }, 150);
  }
  function draw() {
    const q = pq.value.trim();
    P.items = build();
    if (P.sel >= P.items.length) P.sel = Math.max(0, P.items.length - 1);
    if (P.items[P.sel]?.dead) P.sel = P.items.findIndex(x => !x.dead);
    let g = null;
    pres.innerHTML = P.items.map((it, i) => `${it.g !== g ? `<div class="n2-pg">${t((g = it.g))}</div>` : ''}<div class="n2-pr ${i === P.sel ? 'on' : ''} ${it.dead ? 'dead' : ''}" data-i="${i}">
      <span class="ic">${it.ic}</span><b>${hl(it.label, q)}</b>${it.sub ? `<span class="s">${esc(it.sub)}</span>` : ''}${i === P.sel ? '<i class="n2-kbd">Enter</i>' : ''}</div>`).join('')
      || `<div class="n2-pnone">${sv('search')}<span>${esc(t('n2_pNothing', { q }))}</span></div>`;
    pres.querySelectorAll('.n2-pr').forEach(r => {
      r.onmousemove = () => { const i = +r.dataset.i; if (i !== P.sel && !P.items[i].dead) { P.sel = i; pres.querySelectorAll('.n2-pr').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', +x.dataset.i === i)); } };
      r.onclick = () => pick(+r.dataset.i);
    });
    pres.querySelector('.n2-pr.on')?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }
  function pick(i) { const it = P.items[i]; if (!it || it.dead) return; closePal(); it.run(); }
  let pT = 0;
  pq.oninput = () => {
    P.sel = 0; draw();
    const q = pq.value.trim(); clearTimeout(pT);
    if (q.length >= 2 && P.pq !== q) pT = setTimeout(() => api('/api/players/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q)).then(l => { P.players = l; P.pq = q; if (!pal.hidden && pq.value.trim() === q) draw(); }).catch(() => { P.players = []; P.pq = q; draw(); }), 220);
  };
  pq.onkeydown = e => {
    const live = P.items.map((x, i) => x.dead ? -1 : i).filter(i => i >= 0);
    const pos = live.indexOf(P.sel);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); P.sel = live[(pos + 1) % live.length] ?? 0; draw(); }
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); P.sel = live[(pos - 1 + live.length) % live.length] ?? 0; draw(); }
    else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); pick(P.sel); }
    else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const groups = [...new Set(P.items.map(x => x.g))], cg = groups.indexOf(P.items[P.sel]?.g);
      const ng = groups[(cg + (e.shiftKey ? groups.length - 1 : 1)) % groups.length];
      const i = P.items.findIndex(x => x.g === ng && !x.dead); if (i >= 0) { P.sel = i; draw(); }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); closePal(); }
  };
  pal.onmousedown = e => { if (e.target === pal) closePal(); };
  function openPal(q = '') {
    if (!S.me?.gameId || nav.hidden) return;
    pal.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(el => { el.textContent = t(el.dataset.t); });
    pq.placeholder = t('n2_searchPh');
    pal.hidden = false; pq.value = q; P.sel = 0; draw(); pq.focus();
    if (q) pq.oninput();
    if (!P.clans) api('/api/clans?sort=power').then(r => { P.clans = r.list || []; if (!pal.hidden) draw(); }).catch(() => {});
    if (!P.shop) (S.shop ? Promise.resolve(S.shop) : api('/api/shop')).then(r => { P.shop = r; if (!pal.hidden) draw(); }).catch(() => {});
  }
  function closePal() { pal.hidden = true; pq.blur(); P.clans = null; P.shop = null; }
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey && (e.code === 'KeyK' || e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K')) {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      if (pal.hidden) openPal(); else closePal();
    }
  }, true);
  window.N2 = { openPal, closePal, setRail, counts };
})();

`app/src/ocr-parse.js`:

```js
(function (root) {
  const LOOK = { '0': 'o', '1': 'l', '|': 'l', 'i': 'l', '5': 's', '$': 's', '8': 'b', 'а': 'a', 'в': 'b', 'е': 'e', 'к': 'k', 'м': 'm', 'н': 'h', 'о': 'o', 'р': 'p', 'с': 'c', 'т': 't', 'у': 'y', 'х': 'x', 'і': 'l' };
  const norm = s => String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/\[bot\]/g, '').split('').map(c => LOOK[c] || c).join('').replace(/[^a-z0-9а-яґєії]/g, '');

  function lev(a, b) {
    const d = Array.from({ length: a.length + 1 }, (_, i) => [i]);
    for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) d[0][j] = j;
    for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++)
      d[i][j] = Math.min(d[i - 1][j] + 1, d[i][j - 1] + 1, d[i - 1][j - 1] + (a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1));
    return d[a.length][b.length];
  }
  const sim = (a, b) => (!a || !b ? 0 : 1 - lev(a, b) / Math.max(a.length, b.length));

  function matchNick(words, nick) {
    const n = norm(nick);
    let best = { score: 0, end: -1 };
    for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
      let acc = '';
      for (let j = i; j < Math.min(words.length, i + 4); j++) {
        acc += norm(words[j]);
        const sc = acc.includes(n) && n.length >= 3 ? 1 : sim(acc, n);
        if (sc > best.score) best = { score: sc, end: j + 1 };
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  const WIN = /(victory|victorious|you\s*win|winner|\bwon\b|перемог|победа|победил|виграл|выиграл)/i;
  const LOSE = /(defeat|you\s*lose|lost|поразк|поражени|програл|проиграл)/i;

  function parse(ocr, players, mySide) {
    const lines = ocr.lines.map(l => ({ ...l, words: l.words.map(w => w.text).filter(Boolean) }));
    const stats = {};
    const used = new Set();
    for (const p of players) {
      let best = null;
      lines.forEach((l, li) => {
        if (used.has(li)) return;
        const m = matchNick(l.words, p.nick);
        if (m.score >= 0.72 && (!best || m.score > best.score)) best = { ...m, li };
      });
      if (!best) continue;
      used.add(best.li);
      const rr = readRow(lines[best.li].words.slice(best.end).join(' '));
      const sane = v => v != null && v <= 150 ? v : 0;
      stats[p.id] = { k: sane(rr.k), d: sane(rr.d), ok: rr.ok, nums: rr.nums, conf: +best.score.toFixed(2) };
    }
    const left = players.filter(p => !stats[p.id]);
    const freeRows = lines.map((l, li) => ({ l, li })).filter(({ l, li }) => !used.has(li) && !isSection(l.text) && readRow(l.text).ok);
    if (left.length === 1 && freeRows.length === 1) { const rr = readRow(freeRows[0].l.text); stats[left[0].id] = { k: rr.k, d: rr.d, ok: true, nums: rr.nums, conf: 0.5 }; used.add(freeRows[0].li); }
    const text = ocr.text || lines.map(l => l.text).join('\n');
    let winner = null;
    const secs = ocr.lines.map((l, li) => { const m = isSection(l.text); return m ? { li, rounds: +m[1], name: secName(m[2]) } : null; }).filter(Boolean).filter((x, i, a) => a.findIndex(y => y.name === x.name) === i);
    const rowLi = Object.fromEntries(players.filter(p => stats[p.id]).map(p => [p.id, lines.findIndex((l, li) => used.has(li) && matchNick(l.words, p.nick).score >= 0.5)]));
    const sideOfSec = (i) => { const from = secs[i].li, to = secs[i + 1]?.li ?? 1e9; const ps = players.filter(p => rowLi[p.id] > from && rowLi[p.id] < to); const a = ps.filter(p => p.side === 'A').length, b = ps.length - a; return a === b ? null : a > b ? 'A' : 'B'; };
    const secSide = secs.map((_, i) => sideOfSec(i));
    for (let i = 0; i < secs.length; i++) if (!secSide[i] && secs.length === 2 && secSide[1 - i]) secSide[i] = secSide[1 - i] === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
    if (secs.length === 2 && secs[0].rounds !== secs[1].rounds) { const wi = secs[0].rounds > secs[1].rounds ? 0 : 1; winner = secSide[wi]; }
    else if (secs.length === 1 && secSide[0] && secs[0].rounds) winner = secs[0].rounds >= 6 ? secSide[0] : secSide[0] === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
    const w = WIN.test(text), l = LOSE.test(text);
    const firstSide = secSide[0] || null;
    if (!winner && w !== l && (firstSide || mySide)) { const base = firstSide || mySide; winner = w ? base : base === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A'; }
    const sm = text.match(/(?:^|\D)(\d{1,2})\s*[:\-–—]\s*(\d{1,2})(?:\D|$)/);
    const okScore = sm && +sm[1] <= 13 && +sm[2] <= 13;
    return { winner, score: okScore ? `${sm[1]}-${sm[2]}` : '', stats, found: Object.keys(stats).length, total: players.length };
  }

  const SECTION = /^\W{0,4}(\d{1,2})(?:\s*\/\s*\d{1,2})?.{0,10}?(alfa|alpha|bravo|ал\s?ь\s?фа|бра\s?во)/i;
  const isSection = text => { const m = text.match(SECTION); return m && +m[1] <= 13 && (text.slice(m.index + m[0].length).match(/\d+/g) || []).length < 2 ? m : null; };
  const secName = s => { const x = s.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, ''); return ({ alpha: 'alfa', альфа: 'alfa', браво: 'bravo' })[x] || x; };

  function lineInfo(l, x) {
    let ws = l.words.filter(w => w.x1 < x && w.text).map(w => w.text);
    const lv = ws.findIndex((w, i) => /^\d{1,3}$/.test(w) && i < ws.length - 1);
    if (lv >= 0 && lv <= 3) ws = ws.slice(lv + 1);
    while (ws.length > 1 && /^[\d\W]{1,3}$/.test(ws[ws.length - 1])) ws.pop();
    const nick = ws.join(' ').trim();
    const all = l.words.filter(w => w.x1 != null);
    return { game: nick, box: all.length ? { x0: Math.min(...all.map(w => w.x0)), y0: l.y0, x1: Math.max(...all.map(w => w.x1)), y1: l.y1 } : null };
  }

  function layout(ocr, players, mySide) {
    const lines = ocr.lines;
    const COLS = [['score', /^s[cс][o0о]r|score|очк|рахун/i], ['k', /^[kк][iіl1|][lі1|]?[lsзz]|kill|убив|вбив/i], ['d', /^d[eе][aаs][tт]?[hнn]|death|смерт/i], ['kd', /^[kк]\s*\/\s*[dдoо0]/i]];
    let head = null;
    for (const l of lines) {
      const found = COLS.map(([, re]) => l.words.find(w => re.test(w.text)) || null);
      if (found.filter(Boolean).length >= 3 && (found[1] || found[2])) { head = { y: l.y1, found }; break; }
    }
    if (!head) return null;
    const ctr = head.found.map(w => w ? (w.x0 + w.x1) / 2 : null);
    const known = ctr.map((c, i) => c == null ? null : i).filter(i => i != null);
    const stepAvg = (ctr[known[known.length - 1]] - ctr[known[0]]) / (known[known.length - 1] - known[0]);
    for (let i = 0; i < ctr.length; i++) if (ctr[i] == null) {
      const lo = known.filter(j => j < i).pop(), hi = known.find(j => j > i);
      ctr[i] = lo != null && hi != null ? ctr[lo] + (ctr[hi] - ctr[lo]) * (i - lo) / (hi - lo) : lo != null ? ctr[lo] + stepAvg * (i - lo) : ctr[hi] - stepAvg * (hi - i);
    }
    const step = (ctr[ctr.length - 1] - ctr[0]) / Math.max(1, ctr.length - 1);
    const edges = [ctr[0] - step / 2, ...ctr.slice(1).map((c, i) => (c + ctr[i]) / 2), ctr[ctr.length - 1] + step / 2];
    const colNames = COLS.map(([n]) => n);
    const sections = lines.map(l => { const m = isSection(l.text); return m ? { y: l.y0, rounds: +m[1], name: secName(m[2]) } : null; }).filter(Boolean)
      .filter((x, i, all) => all.findIndex(y => y.name === x.name) === i);
    if (sections.length === 1) {
      const other = sections[0].name === 'alfa' ? 'bravo' : 'alfa';
      const l = lines.find(l => Math.abs(l.y0 - sections[0].y) > (l.y1 - l.y0) * 2 && /^\W{0,4}(\d{1,2})(?:\s*\/\s*\d{1,2})?\s*\S{0,3}\s*[a-zа-яёіїєґ]{3,6}\W*$/i.test(l.text.trim()) && +l.text.match(/\d+/)[0] <= 13);
      if (l) { sections.push({ y: l.y0, rounds: +l.text.match(/\d+/)[0], name: other }); sections.sort((x, y) => x.y - y.y); }
    }
    const cand = lines.map((l, li) => ({ l, li })).filter(({ l }) => l.y0 > head.y && !isSection(l.text)
      && l.words.filter(w => w.x0 > edges[0] && /\d/.test(w.text)).length >= 2);
    const secOf = l => sections.filter(x => x.y < l.y0).pop()?.name || null;
    const rows = [], left = new Set(cand.map(c => c.li)), unmatched = [];
    for (const p of players) {
      let best = null;
      for (const { l, li } of cand) {
        if (!left.has(li)) continue;
        const m = matchNick(l.words.filter(w => w.x1 < edges[0]).map(w => w.text), p.nick);
        if (m.score >= 0.68 && (!best || m.score > best.score)) best = { score: m.score, l, li };
      }
      if (best) { left.delete(best.li); rows.push({ p, l: best.l, conf: +best.score.toFixed(2) }); } else unmatched.push(p);
    }
    for (const sec of new Set(cand.filter(c => left.has(c.li)).map(c => secOf(c.l)))) {
      const free = cand.filter(c => left.has(c.li) && secOf(c.l) === sec);
      const sideIn = x => { const m = rows.filter(r => secOf(r.l) === x).map(r => r.p.side); const a = m.filter(v => v === 'A').length, b = m.length - a; return a === b ? null : a > b ? 'A' : 'B'; };
      let side = sideIn(sec);
      if (!side) { const other = sections.map(x => x.name).find(x => x !== sec && sideIn(x)); side = other ? (sideIn(other) === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A') : null; }
      if (!side && mySide && sections.length >= 2 && sec) side = sec === sections[0].name ? mySide : mySide === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
      const who = unmatched.filter(p => p.side === side);
      if (!side || !free.length || free.length !== who.length) continue;
      const pairs = [];
      for (const p of who) for (const f of free) pairs.push({ p, f, sc: matchNick(f.l.words.filter(w => w.x1 < edges[0]).map(w => w.text), p.nick).score });
      pairs.sort((x, y) => y.sc - x.sc);
      for (const { p, f } of pairs) {
        if (!left.has(f.li) || !unmatched.includes(p)) continue;
        rows.push({ p, l: f.l, conf: 0.5 }); left.delete(f.li); unmatched.splice(unmatched.indexOf(p), 1);
      }
    }
    return {
      cols: colNames, sections,
      rows: rows.map(({ p, l, conf }) => {
        const h = l.y1 - l.y0, top = Math.max(0, Math.round(l.y0 - h * 0.3)), height = Math.round(h * 1.6);
        return { id: p.id, side: p.side, conf, section: secOf(l), ...lineInfo(l, edges[0]),
          rects: colNames.map((_, i) => ({ left: Math.max(0, Math.round(edges[i])), top, width: Math.round(edges[i + 1] - edges[i]), height })) };
      }),
      extra: cand.filter(c => left.has(c.li)).map(c => ({ section: secOf(c.l), ...lineInfo(c.l, edges[0]) })),
      colBox: { x0: Math.round(edges[0]), x1: Math.round(edges[edges.length - 1]) },
    };
  }

  const CONFUSE = { 0: '8', 1: '7', 3: '8', 5: '86', 6: '58', 7: '1', 8: '0356', 9: '8' };
  function variants(n) {
    const s = String(n), out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) for (const c of CONFUSE[s[i]] || '') out.push(+(s.slice(0, i) + c + s.slice(i + 1)));
    return out;
  }

  function readCols(cols, texts) {
    const v = {};
    cols.forEach((c, i) => {
      const m = (texts[i] || '').match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/);
      if (!m) return;
      v[c] = c === 'kd' ? (m[0].includes('.') ? +m[0] : +m[0] / 100) : parseInt(m[0], 10);
    });
    let k = v.k ?? 0, d = v.d ?? 0;
    const fits = (k, d) => v.kd != null && Math.abs(k / Math.max(d, 1) - v.kd) < 0.06;
    let ok = fits(k, d);
    if (!ok && v.kd != null) {
      for (const [field, val] of [['d', d], ['k', k]]) {
        const alt = variants(val).find(x => field === 'd' ? fits(k, x) : fits(x, d));
        if (alt != null) { if (field === 'd') d = alt; else k = alt; ok = true; break; }
      }
      if (!ok && v.kd > 0 && d > 0 && fits(Math.round(v.kd * d), d)) { k = Math.round(v.kd * d); ok = true; }
      else if (!ok && v.kd > 0 && k > 0 && fits(k, Math.round(k / v.kd))) { d = Math.round(k / v.kd); ok = true; }
    }
    return { k, d, ok, nums: cols.map(c => v[c] ?? null) };
  }

  function readRow(text) {
    const t = (text.match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g) || []);
    const ints = t.map(Number);
    for (let i = 0; i + 2 < t.length; i++) {
      const k = ints[i], d = ints[i + 1], kd = t[i + 2].includes('.') ? +t[i + 2] : +t[i + 2] / 100;
      if (!t[i].includes('.') && !t[i + 1].includes('.') && Math.abs(k / Math.max(d, 1) - kd) < 0.06) return { k, d, ok: true, nums: ints };
    }
    const n = t.filter(x => !x.includes('.')).map(Number);
    return n.length >= 3 ? { k: n[1], d: n[2], ok: false, nums: ints } : { k: n[0] ?? 0, d: n[1] ?? 0, ok: false, nums: ints };
  }

  function finish(lay, texts, players, mySide, fullText) {
    const stats = {};
    lay.rows.forEach((r, i) => { const v = readCols(lay.cols, texts[i] || []); const bad = v.k > 150 || v.d > 150; stats[r.id] = { k: bad ? 0 : v.k, d: bad ? 0 : v.d, ok: v.ok && !bad, nums: v.nums, conf: r.conf }; });
    let winner = null, score = '';
    const secs = lay.sections;
    if (secs.length >= 2 && secs[0].rounds !== secs[1].rounds) {
      const win = secs[0].rounds > secs[1].rounds ? secs[0] : secs[1];
      const lose = win === secs[0] ? secs[1] : secs[0];
      score = `${win.rounds}-${lose.rounds}`;
      const cnt = side => lay.rows.filter(r => r.side === side && r.section === win.name).length;
      if (cnt('A') !== cnt('B')) winner = cnt('A') > cnt('B') ? 'A' : 'B';
    }
    if (!winner && secs.length === 1 && secs[0].rounds) {
      const cnt = side => lay.rows.filter(r => r.side === side && r.section === secs[0].name).length;
      const side = cnt('A') !== cnt('B') ? (cnt('A') > cnt('B') ? 'A' : 'B') : null;
      if (side) winner = secs[0].rounds >= 6 ? side : side === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
    }
    if (!winner && (mySide || secs.length)) {
      const w = WIN.test(fullText), l = LOSE.test(fullText);
      const cnt = side => lay.rows.filter(r => r.side === side && r.section === secs[0]?.name).length;
      const first = secs.length && cnt('A') !== cnt('B') ? (cnt('A') > cnt('B') ? 'A' : 'B') : null;
      const base = first || mySide;
      if (w !== l && base) winner = w ? base : base === 'A' ? 'B' : 'A';
    }
    return { winner, score, stats, found: lay.rows.length, total: players.length, checked: Object.values(stats).filter(x => x.ok).length, sections: secs.length };
  }

  const quality = r => !r ? 0 : (r.found || 0) * 10 + (r.checked || 0) * 6 + (r.sections >= 2 ? 8 : 0) + (r.winner ? 4 : 0) + (r.score ? 2 : 0);
  const complete = r => !!r && r.found === r.total && r.checked === r.found && r.sections >= 2 && !!r.winner;
  const api = { parse, layout, finish, readRow, readCols, norm, sim, quality, complete };
  if (typeof module !== 'undefined') module.exports = api; else root.OcrParse = api;
})(this);

      send.disabled = true;
      try { st.me = await api('/api/partner/apply', st.draft); st.draft = {}; sfx('ok'); toast(tp('sent')); renderSettings(); }

  renderSettings = async function () {
    const r = await _rs.apply(this, arguments);
    if (S.page !== 'settings') return r;
    const nav = document.querySelector('#view .setnav'), panel = document.querySelector('#view .setpanel');
    if (!nav || !panel || nav.querySelector('[data-ppt]')) return r;

    btn.dataset.ppt = '1'; btn.className = 'pp-nav';
    const isCr = !!S.me?.creator && !!window.KZCreator;

    nav.prepend(btn);
    nav.querySelectorAll('[data-stt],[data-ksnd]').forEach(b => b.addEventListener('click', () => { st.open = false; }, true));
    btn.onclick = () => { st.open = true; renderSettings(); };
    if (st.open) {
      nav.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('on')); btn.classList.add('on');

      panel.innerHTML = panelHtml(); bind(panel);
      if (!st.me) api('/api/partner/me').then(m => { st.me = m; if (st.open && S.page === 'settings' && (m?.next > Date.now() || m?.last?.state === 'accepted')) renderSettings(); }).catch(() => {});
    }
    return r;
  };
  window.KZPartnerClose = () => { st.open = false; };
  window.KZPartnerOpen = () => { st.open = true; if (S.page === 'settings') renderSettings(); else go('settings'); };
  const _go = go;
  go = function (page) { if (page !== 'settings') st.open = false; return _go.apply(this, arguments); };
})();

  for (const l of Object.keys(L)) Object.assign(I18N[l] ||= {}, L[l]);

  const money = (v, c) => `${(+v || 0).toFixed(2)} ${c || ''}`.trim();
  const METHOD = { paypal: 'PayPal', card: 'Card', crypto: 'Crypto', other: 'Other' };
  const ava = (url, cls = '') => url ? `<img class="pa-av ${cls}" src="${esc(url)}" alt="">` : `<i class="pa-av ${cls}"></i>`;
  const P = (S.pa ||= { open: null, data: null, one: null });

  window.partnersAdminCount = () => (P.data ? P.data.totals.newApps + P.data.totals.payoutReqs : 0) + (P.dd ? P.dd.totals.newApps + P.dd.totals.payoutReqs : 0) || null;

  window.renderPartnersAdmin = async function renderPartnersAdmin() {
    const box = $('#st-partners'); if (!box) return;
    if (!S.me?.admin) { box.innerHTML = `<div class="card empty-note">${t('pa_ownerOnly')}</div>`; return; }
    if (P.mode === 'designers') return window.renderDesignersAdmin();
    api('/api/admin/designers').then(x => { P.dd = x; segBar(); }).catch(() => {});
    try {
      if (P.open) { P.one = await api('/api/admin/partners/one?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(P.open)); if ($('#st-partners')) drawOne(); }
      else { P.data = await api('/api/admin/partners'); if ($('#st-partners')) drawAll(); }
    } catch (e) { box.innerHTML = `<div class="card empty-note">${esc(e.message)}</div>`; if (P.open) { P.open = null; } }
  };

  const SEG = '<div class="pa-seg-wrap"><div class="seg" id="pa-seg"></div></div>';
  function segBar() {
    const el = $('#pa-seg'); if (!el) return;
    const n = d => d ? d.totals.newApps + d.totals.payoutReqs : 0;
    const cnt = v => v ? `<span class="cnt">${v}</span>` : '';
    el.innerHTML = `<button data-pam="partners" class="${P.mode !== 'designers' ? 'on' : ''}">${t('pa_list')}${cnt(n(P.data))}</button><button data-pam="designers" class="${P.mode === 'designers' ? 'on' : ''}">${t('da_list')}${cnt(n(P.dd))}</button>`;
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-pam]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { if ((P.mode || 'partners') === b.dataset.pam) return; P.mode = b.dataset.pam; renderPartnersAdmin(); });
  }
  P.segBar = segBar; P.SEG = SEG; P.bindCommon = bindCommon;

  function drawAll() {
    const d = P.data, c = d.currency, T = d.totals, box = $('#st-partners');
    const reqs = d.partners.filter(p => p.payoutReq);
    box.innerHTML = `${SEG}
      <div class="kpis">${kpi(t('pa_partners'), T.partners, T.paused ? `${t('pa_paused')}: ${T.paused}` : '')}${kpi(t('pa_signups'), T.signups, `${t('pa_payers')}: ${T.payers}`)}${kpi(t('pa_clicks'), T.clicks)}
        ${kpi(t('pa_revenue'), money(T.revenue, c))}${kpi(t('pa_earned'), money(T.earned, c), `${t('pa_paid')}: ${money(T.paid, c)}`)}${kpi(t('pa_owed'), money(T.owed, c), '', T.owed > 0 ? 'warn' : '')}
        ${kpi(t('pa_reqs'), T.payoutReqs, '', T.payoutReqs ? 'warn' : '')}${kpi(t('pa_newApps'), T.newApps, '', T.newApps ? 'warn' : '')}</div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_payouts')}</h4>${reqs.length ? reqs.map(p => `<div class="pa-row">${ava(p.avatar)}<b class="grow"><a href="#" data-pa-open="${p.uid}">${esc(p.nick)}</a></b>
        <span>${money(p.payoutReq.amount, c)} · ${esc(METHOD[p.payoutReq.method] || p.payoutReq.method)}</span><code class="pa-det">${esc(p.payoutReq.details)}</code><span class="mute">${fmtDT(p.payoutReq.at)}</span>
        <button class="btn green sm" data-pa-paid="${p.uid}" data-amt="${p.payoutReq.amount}">${t('pa_markPaid')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-pa-rej="${p.uid}">${t('pa_reject')}</button></div>`).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_reqNone')}</div>`}</div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_list')} · ${d.partners.length}</h4>${d.partners.length ? `<div class="pa-table"><div class="pa-tr pa-th"><span>${t('pa_player')}</span><span>${t('pa_code')}</span><span>${t('pa_share')}</span><span>${t('pa_signups')}</span><span>${t('pa_payers')}</span><span>${t('pa_clicks')}</span><span>${t('pa_revenue')}</span><span>${t('pa_earned')}</span><span>${t('pa_owed')}</span><span></span></div>
        ${d.partners.map(p => `<div class="pa-tr${p.off ? ' off' : ''}"><span class="pa-who">${ava(p.avatar)}<a href="#" data-pa-open="${p.uid}">${esc(p.nick)}</a>${p.off ? `<span class="tag">${t('pa_paused')}</span>` : ''}${p.payoutReq ? '<span class="tag gold">$</span>' : ''}</span>
          <span><code>${esc(p.code)}</code></span><span>${p.share}%</span><span>${p.signups}<small class="mute"> / ${p.registered}</small></span><span>${p.payers}</span><span>${p.clicks}<small class="mute"> · ${p.clicks30}</small></span>
          <span>${money(p.revenue, c)}</span><span>${money(p.earned, c)}</span><span class="${p.owed > 0 ? 'gold' : 'mute'}">${money(p.owed, c)}</span><span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-pa-open="${p.uid}">${t('pa_open')}</button></span></div>`).join('')}</div>`
        : `<div class="empty-note">${t('pa_none')}</div>`}</div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_add')}</h4><p class="mute" style="margin:0 0 8px">${t('pa_addHint')}</p>
        <div class="row"><input id="pa-q" class="grow" placeholder="Nick / Discord ID" autocomplete="off"><button class="btn" id="pa-find">${t('pa_find')}</button></div><div id="pa-res"></div></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_apps')} · ${d.apps.length}</h4>${d.apps.length ? d.apps.map(appCard).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_appsNone')}</div>`}</div>
      ${d.archive.length ? `<div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_archive')}</h4>${d.archive.map(a => `<div class="pa-row"><b class="grow">${esc(a.nick)}</b><code>${esc(a.code)}</code><span class="mute">${t('pa_earned')}: ${money(a.earned, c)} · ${t('pa_paid')}: ${money(a.paid, c)}</span><span class="mute">${fmtDT(a.removedAt)}</span>${a.reason ? `<span class="mute">«${esc(a.reason)}»</span>` : ''}</div>`).join('')}</div>` : ''}`;
    bindCommon(box); segBar();
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-pa-app]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
      const id = b.dataset.paApp, act = b.dataset.act, card = b.closest('.pa-app'), quiet = card.querySelector('[data-pa-quiet]')?.checked;
      const body = { id, quiet };
      if (act === 'rejected') { const r = prompt(t('pa_reasonQ')); if (r == null) return; body.state = 'rejected'; body.reason = r; }
      else if (act === 'creator') { body.state = 'creator'; const code = card.querySelector('[data-pa-acode]').value.trim(); const share = card.querySelector('[data-pa-ashare]').value; if (code) body.code = code; if (share !== '') body.share = +share; }
      else body.state = 'accepted';
      P.data = await api('/api/admin/partners/decide', body); drawAll();
    }));
    const find = run(async () => {
      const q = $('#pa-q').value.trim(); if (!q) return;
      const list = await api('/api/staff/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q));
      $('#pa-res').innerHTML = list.length ? list.slice(0, 8).map(u => `<div class="pa-row">${ava(u.avatar)}<b class="grow">${esc(u.nick)} <span class="mute">· ${esc(u.name || '')} · ${esc(u.id)}</span></b>
        ${u.registered ? `<input class="pa-in" data-pa-ncode="${u.id}" placeholder="${t('pa_code')}" maxlength="16"><input class="pa-in sm" data-pa-nshare="${u.id}" type="number" min="0" max="100" placeholder="${d.defaults.share}%"><button class="btn sm" data-pa-new="${u.id}">${t('pa_make')}</button>` : `<span class="tag">${t('notRegistered')}</span>`}</div>`).join('') : `<div class="empty-note">${t('nothingFound')}</div>`;
      $('#pa-res').querySelectorAll('[data-pa-new]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
        const id = b.dataset.paNew, code = $(`[data-pa-ncode="${id}"]`).value.trim(), share = $(`[data-pa-nshare="${id}"]`).value;
        P.data = await api('/api/admin/partners/add', { uid: id, ...(code ? { code } : {}), ...(share !== '' ? { share: +share } : {}) }); drawAll();
      }));
    });
    $('#pa-find').onclick = find; $('#pa-q').onkeydown = e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') find(); };
  }

  const appCard = a => `<div class="pa-app ${a.state}"><div class="pa-row">${ava(a.avatar)}<b class="grow">${esc(a.nick)} <span class="mute">· ${esc(a.name)}</span></b>
      <span class="tag ${a.state === 'new' ? 'gold' : a.state === 'rejected' ? 'red' : ''}">${t('pa_app' + a.state[0].toUpperCase() + a.state.slice(1))}</span><span class="mute">${fmtDT(a.at)}</span></div>
    <div class="pa-app-b"><span>${esc(a.type)} · ${esc(a.platform)} · ${esc(a.audience)} · ${esc(a.region)} · ${esc(a.freq)}${a.lang ? ' · ' + esc(a.lang) : ''}</span>
      ${a.links ? `<div class="pa-links">${esc(a.links).replace(/(https?:\/\/[^\s<]+)/g, '<a href="#" data-ext="$1">$1</a>')}</div>` : ''}
      ${a.offer ? `<p>${esc(a.offer)}</p>` : ''}${a.why ? `<p class="mute">${esc(a.why)}</p>` : ''}${a.contact ? `<div class="mute">${esc(a.contact)}</div>` : ''}${a.reason ? `<div class="mute">✕ ${esc(a.reason)}</div>` : ''}</div>
    ${a.state === 'new' || (a.state === 'accepted' && !a.creator) ? `<div class="row pa-acts"><input class="pa-in" data-pa-acode placeholder="${t('pa_code')}" maxlength="16"><input class="pa-in sm" data-pa-ashare type="number" min="0" max="100" placeholder="${P.data?.defaults.share ?? 20}%">
      <button class="btn green sm" data-pa-app="${a.id}" data-act="creator">${t('pa_makeCreator')}</button>${a.state === 'new' ? `<button class="btn sm" data-pa-app="${a.id}" data-act="accepted">${t('pa_accept')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-pa-app="${a.id}" data-act="rejected">${t('pa_reject')}</button>` : ''}
      <label class="mute pa-q"><input type="checkbox" data-pa-quiet> ${t('pa_quiet')}</label></div>` : ''}</div>`;

  function bindCommon(box) {
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-pa-open]').forEach(a => a.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); P.open = a.dataset.paOpen; renderPartnersAdmin(); });
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-ext]').forEach(a => a.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); K.open(a.dataset.ext); });
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-pa-paid]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
      const c = P.data?.currency || P.one?.currency || '', v = prompt(t('pa_paidQ', { c }), b.dataset.amt || ''); if (!v) return;
      const r = await api('/api/admin/partners/paid', { uid: b.dataset.paPaid, amount: +String(v).replace(',', '.') });
      if (P.open) { P.one = r; drawOne(); } else renderPartnersAdmin();
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-pa-rej]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => {
      const r = prompt(t('pa_rejectQ')); if (r == null) return;
      const x = await api('/api/admin/partners/payout-reject', { uid: b.dataset.paRej, reason: r });
      if (P.open) { P.one = x; drawOne(); } else renderPartnersAdmin();
    }));
  }

  function drawOne() {
    const p = P.one, c = p.currency, box = $('#st-partners'), F = p.funnel || {};
    const keys = p.days.map(x => new Date(x.t).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
    const fun = [[t('pa_fClicks'), p.clicks30], [t('pa_fSign'), F.signups], [t('pa_fReg'), F.registered], [t('pa_fPlayed'), F.played], [t('pa_fPlayed5'), F.played5], [t('pa_fPay'), F.payers]];
    box.innerHTML = `${SEG}
      <div class="row" style="margin-bottom:12px"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="pa-back">← ${t('pa_back')}</button></div>
      <div class="card pa-head">${ava(p.avatar, 'lg')}<div class="grow"><h2 style="margin:0">${esc(p.nick)} <code>${esc(p.code)}</code> ${p.off ? `<span class="tag">${t('pa_paused')}</span>` : `<span class="tag green">${t('pa_active')}</span>`}</h2>
        <div class="mute">${t('pa_since', { d: fmtDate(p.since) })}${p.by ? ' · ' + t('pa_addedBy', { n: esc(p.by) }) : ''} · ${t('pa_seen')}: ${p.lastSeen ? fmtDT(p.lastSeen) : '—'} · <a href="#" data-ext="${esc(p.link)}">${esc(p.link)}</a></div></div>
        <button class="btn ghost sm" id="pa-dossier">${t('details')}</button></div>
      <div class="kpis">${kpi(t('pa_clicks'), p.clicks, `${t('pa_30')}: ${p.clicks30}`)}${kpi(t('pa_signups'), p.signups, `${t('pa_fReg')}: ${p.registered}`)}${kpi(t('pa_fPlayed'), p.active, `${t('pa_matches')}: ${p.matches}`)}
        ${kpi(t('pa_payers'), p.payers, `${t('pa_avg')}: ${money(p.avgCheck, c)}`)}${kpi(t('pa_revenue'), money(p.revenue, c), `${p.purchases}×`)}${kpi(t('pa_earned'), money(p.earned, c), `${t('pa_month')}: ${money(p.earnedMonth, c)}`)}
        ${kpi(t('pa_paid'), money(p.paid, c))}${kpi(t('pa_owed'), money(p.owed, c), p.payoutReq ? t('pa_req', { v: money(p.payoutReq.amount, c), m: METHOD[p.payoutReq.method] || p.payoutReq.method }) : '', p.owed > 0 ? 'warn' : '')}</div>
      ${p.payoutReq ? `<div class="card pa-reqcard"><b>${t('pa_req', { v: money(p.payoutReq.amount, c), m: esc(METHOD[p.payoutReq.method] || p.payoutReq.method) })}</b><code class="pa-det">${esc(p.payoutReq.details)}</code><span class="mute">${fmtDT(p.payoutReq.at)}</span>
        <span class="grow"></span><button class="btn green sm" data-pa-paid="${p.uid}" data-amt="${p.payoutReq.amount}">${t('pa_markPaid')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-pa-rej="${p.uid}">${t('pa_reject')}</button></div>` : ''}
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_chart')}</h4>${vBars(keys, [{ key: 's', label: t('pa_chSign'), color: VZ.one, data: p.days.map(x => x.signups) }])}${vBars(keys, [{ key: 'c', label: t('pa_chCut') + ', ' + c, color: VZ['2v2'], data: p.days.map(x => x.cut) }], { h: 110, fmt: v => (+v).toFixed(2) })}</div>
        <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_funnel')}</h4>${hBars(fun.map(([label, v]) => ({ label, v: v || 0 })))}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_settings')}</h4><div class="pa-form">
        <label>${t('pa_code')}<input id="pa-code" value="${esc(p.code)}" maxlength="16"></label>
        <label>${t('pa_share')}, %<input id="pa-share" type="number" min="0" max="100" value="${p.share}"></label>
        <label>${t('pa_bonus')}<input id="pa-bonus" type="number" min="0" value="${p.overrides.bonus ?? ''}" placeholder="${t('pa_default', { v: p.defaults.bonus })}"></label>
        <label>${t('pa_minPayout', { c })}<input id="pa-minp" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="${p.overrides.minPayout ?? ''}" placeholder="${t('pa_default', { v: p.defaults.minPayout })}"></label>
        <label class="wide">${t('pa_note')}<textarea id="pa-note" rows="2" maxlength="1000">${esc(p.note)}</textarea></label></div>
        <div class="row"><button class="btn" id="pa-save">${t('pa_save')}</button><span class="grow"></span>
          <button class="btn ghost sm" id="pa-pause">${p.off ? t('pa_resume') : t('pa_pause')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-pa-paid="${p.uid}" data-amt="${p.owed || ''}">${t('pa_markPaid')}</button></div>
        <p class="mute" style="margin:8px 0 0;font-size:12.5px">${t('pa_pauseHint')}</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_refs')} · ${p.list.length}</h4>${p.list.length ? `<div class="pa-table r"><div class="pa-tr pa-th"><span>${t('pa_player')}</span><span>${t('pa_date')}</span><span>${t('pa_via')}</span><span>${t('pa_matches')}</span><span>${t('pa_spent')}</span><span>${t('pa_cut')}</span><span>${t('pa_seen')}</span></div>
        ${p.list.map(x => `<div class="pa-tr"><span class="pa-who">${ava(x.avatar)}<a href="#" data-pa-prof="${x.id}">${esc(x.nick)}</a>${x.registered ? '' : `<span class="tag">${t('notRegistered')}</span>`}</span><span>${fmtDate(x.at)}</span><span>${t(x.via === 'creator' ? 'pa_viaCreator' : 'pa_viaCode')}</span><span>${x.matches}</span><span>${money(x.spent, c)}</span><span>${money(x.cut, c)}</span><span class="mute">${x.seen ? fmtDT(x.seen) : '—'}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>` : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_empty')}</div>`}</div>
      <div class="grid2">
        <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_ledger')} · ${p.purchases}</h4>${p.ledger.length ? p.ledger.map(e => `<div class="pa-row"><span class="mute">${fmtDT(e.at)}</span><b class="grow">${esc(e.nick)}</b><span>${esc(e.what)}${e.gift ? ' 🎁' : ''}</span><span>${money(e.amount, e.currency)}</span><span class="gold">+${money(e.cut, e.currency)}</span></div>`).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_empty')}</div>`}</div>
        <div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_history')}</h4>${p.payouts.length ? p.payouts.map(x => `<div class="pa-row"><span class="mute">${fmtDT(x.at)}</span><b class="grow">${money(x.amount, c)}</b><span class="mute">${esc(x.note || '')}</span></div>`).join('') : `<div class="mute">${t('pa_empty')}</div>`}</div>
      </div>
      ${p.apps?.length ? `<div class="card"><h4>${t('pa_appOf')}</h4>${p.apps.map(appCard).join('')}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="card pa-danger"><h4>${t('pa_remove')}</h4><p class="mute" style="margin:0 0 8px">${t('pa_removeHint')}</p>
        <div class="row"><input id="pa-rreason" class="grow" placeholder="${t('pa_removeReason')}" maxlength="400"><label class="mute pa-q"><input type="checkbox" id="pa-rnotify"> ${t('pa_notify')}</label><button class="btn red sm" id="pa-remove">${t('pa_remove')}</button></div></div>`;
    vizTips(box);
    bindCommon(box); segBar();
    $('#pa-back').onclick = () => { P.open = null; P.one = null; renderPartnersAdmin(); };
    $('#pa-dossier').onclick = () => openDossier(p.uid).catch(e => toast(e.message, true));
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-pa-prof]').forEach(a => a.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); openDossier(a.dataset.paProf).catch(er => toast(er.message, true)); });
    $('#pa-save').onclick = run(async () => {
      P.one = await api('/api/admin/partners/update', { uid: p.uid, code: $('#pa-code').value.trim(), share: +$('#pa-share').value, bonus: $('#pa-bonus').value, minPayout: $('#pa-minp').value, note: $('#pa-note').value });
      toast(t('pa_saved')); drawOne();
    });
    $('#pa-pause').onclick = run(async () => { P.one = await api('/api/admin/partners/pause', { uid: p.uid, off: !p.off }); drawOne(); });
    $('#pa-remove').onclick = run(async () => {
      if (!confirm(t('pa_removeQ', { n: p.nick }))) return;
      const body = { uid: p.uid, reason: $('#pa-rreason').value.trim(), notify: $('#pa-rnotify').checked };
      if (p.owed > 0) { if (!confirm(t('pa_removeOwed', { n: p.nick, v: money(p.owed, c) }))) return; body.force = true; }
      P.data = await api('/api/admin/partners/remove', body); P.open = null; P.one = null; toast(t('pa_removed')); drawAll();
    });
  }
})();

    }).catch(() => {}).finally(() => { P2.busy = false; });
  }
  const onbMark = step => { if (P2.onb && !P2.onb.steps.find(s => s.id === step)?.done) api('/api/onb/mark', { step }).then(s => { P2.onb = s; }).catch(() => {}); };
  const onbVisible = () => { const o = P2.onb; return !!o && o.isNew && !o.hidden && !o.complete; };

  function stepAction(id) {
    if (id === 'gameid') { S.setTab = 'account'; go('settings'); }
    else if (id === 'notif') run(async () => {
      S.sound = true; await setCfg({ sound: true, notify: true });
      beep('match');
      P2.onb = await api('/api/onb/mark', { step: 'notif' }); refresh();
    })();
    else if (id === 'calib') { if (S.page !== 'play') go('play'); setTimeout(() => focusEl('[data-act="queue"]', '.pl2-go'), 80); }
    else if (id === 'party') {
      if (S.page !== 'play') go('play');
      if (!S.live?.party) wsSend({ t: 'party-create' });
      setTimeout(() => focusEl('.pl2-party'), 120);
    }
    else if (id === 'clan') go('clans');
    else if (id === 'pass') go('pass');
    else if (id === 'friend') { if (S.page !== 'play') go('play'); setTimeout(() => focusEl('#fr-q', '.friends-card'), 120); }
  }
  function focusEl(sel, flashSel) {
    const el = document.querySelector(sel), box = document.querySelector(flashSel || sel) || el;
    if (!box) return;
    box.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: 'smooth' });
    box.classList.remove('pl2-flash'); void box.offsetWidth; box.classList.add('pl2-flash');
    if (el?.tagName === 'INPUT') el.focus();
  }
  const claimStep = run(async step => {
    const r = await api('/api/onb/claim', step === 'all' ? { all: true } : { step });
    P2.onb = r.state;
    if (r.me) { S.me = { ...S.me, ...r.me }; renderMe(); }
    sfx('coin');
    toast(step === 'all' ? t('obGotAll', { kf: r.got.kf, xp: r.got.xp }) : t('obGot', { n: r.got.kf }));
    if (typeof lcLoad === 'function' && step === 'all') lcLoad(true);
    refresh();
  });

  const ring = (n, m, size = 76) => {
    const R = size / 2 - 7, C = 2 * Math.PI * R, pct = m ? n / m : 0;
    return `<div class="ob-ring ${size < 60 ? 'sm' : ''}" style="width:${size}px;height:${size}px"><svg viewBox="0 0 ${size} ${size}"><circle cx="${size / 2}" cy="${size / 2}" r="${R}" class="bg"/>
      <circle cx="${size / 2}" cy="${size / 2}" r="${R}" class="fg" stroke-dasharray="${C}" stroke-dashoffset="${C * (1 - pct)}" transform="rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})"/></svg>
      <div><b>${n}/${m}</b><span>${t('obDone')}</span></div></div>`;
  };
  const calDots = (n, m) => `<span class="ob-dots">${Array.from({ length: m }, (_, i) => `<i class="${i < n ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</span>`;
  function stepRow(s, cur) {
    const o = P2.onb;
    const sub = s.id === 'gameid' && S.me.gameId ? `<span class="gid">${esc(S.me.gameId)}</span> — ${t('ob_gameid_d')}` : t(`ob_${s.id}_d`);
    const extra = s.id === 'calib' && !s.claimed ? `<div class="ob-cal">${PUB_MODES.map(m => `<span>${modeName(m)} ${calDots(o.cal[m] || 0, o.cal.need)} <b class="num">${o.cal[m] || 0}/${o.cal.need}</b></span>`).join('')}</div>` : '';
    const btn = s.claimed ? '' : s.done ? `<button class="btn sm gold" data-ob-claim="${s.id}">${t('obClaim', { n: s.kf })} KF</button>`
      : `<button class="btn sm ${cur ? '' : 'ghost'}" data-ob-go="${s.id}">${t(`ob_${s.id}_b`)}</button>`;
    return `<div class="ob-step ${s.claimed ? 'claimed' : ''} ${s.done && !s.claimed ? 'ready' : ''} ${cur ? 'cur' : ''}">
      <i class="ob-n">${s.claimed ? IC.check : STEP_ORDER.indexOf(s.id) + 1}</i>
      <div class="grow"><b>${t('ob_' + s.id)}${s.optional ? ` <span class="mute ob-opt">· ${t('obOptional')}</span>` : ''}</b><span class="mute">${sub}</span>${extra}</div>
      <span class="ob-kf ${s.claimed ? 'got' : ''}"><i class="coin"></i>+${s.kf}</span>${btn}</div>`;
  }
  const curStep = o => o.steps.find(s => s.done && !s.claimed) || o.steps.find(s => !s.done && !s.optional) || o.steps.find(s => !s.claimed);
  function allCard(o) {
    const left = o.steps.filter(s => !s.optional && !s.claimed).length;
    return `<div class="ob-all ${o.all.ready ? 'ready' : ''} ${o.all.claimed ? 'claimed' : ''}"><span class="h4l">${t('obAllTitle')}</span>
      <div class="ob-gift">${IC.gift}</div><b>${t('obAllSub', { kf: o.all.kf, xp: o.all.xp })}</b><span class="mute">${t('obTotal', { n: o.sum })}</span>
      <div class="ob-bar"><i style="width:${(o.of - left) / o.of * 100}%"></i></div>
      ${o.all.claimed ? `<span class="win">${t('obAllDone')}</span>` : o.all.ready ? `<button class="btn gold" data-ob-claim="all">${t('obAllReady')}</button>` : `<span class="mute">${t('obAllLeft', { n: left })}</span>`}</div>`;
  }
  const faqHtml = () => `<div class="ob-faq"><span class="h4l">${t('obFaq')}</span>${[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(i => `<div class="ob-q ${P2.faq === i ? 'open' : ''}"><button data-ob-faq="${i}"><span>${t('obQ' + i)}</span>${IC.chev}</button><p>${t('obA' + i)}</p></div>`).join('')}</div>`;

  function onbBlock(full) {
    const o = P2.onb;
    if (!o) return '';
    const min = !full && ls('kz-onb-min') === '1';
    const cur = curStep(o);
    const allChip = !full ? `<span class="ob-allchip ${o.all.ready ? 'ready' : ''}">${IC.gift}${t('obAllSub', { kf: o.all.kf, xp: o.all.xp })}</span>` : '';
    const head = `<div class="ob-head">${ring(o.done, o.of, full ? 92 : min ? 52 : 64)}<div class="grow"><h2>${t('obTitle')}</h2><span class="mute">${t('obSub', { n: o.steps.length })}</span></div>
      <div class="ob-hb">${full ? `${o.hidden ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-ob-hide="0">${t('obShowPlay')}</button>` : ''}`
        : `${allChip}${o.all.ready ? `<button class="btn sm gold" data-ob-claim="all">${t('obAllReady')}</button>` : ''}<button class="btn ghost sm" data-ob-page>${t('obOpen')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-ob-min>${min ? t('obExpand') : t('obMin')}</button><button class="btn ghost sm" data-ob-hide="1">${t('obHide')}</button>`}</div></div>`;
    if (!full) {
      const pills = `<div class="ob-pills">${o.steps.map((s, i) => `<button class="ob-pill ${s.claimed ? 'claimed' : s.done ? 'ready' : ''} ${s === cur ? 'cur' : ''}" ${s.claimed ? 'disabled' : s.done ? `data-ob-claim="${s.id}"` : `data-ob-go="${s.id}"`} title="${esc(t('ob_' + s.id))}">
        <i>${s.claimed ? IC.check : i + 1}</i><span>${t('obs_' + s.id)}</span><em>+${s.kf}</em></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
      return `<div class="card ob-card ${min ? 'min' : ''}">${head}${min ? '' : pills}${cur ? `<div class="ob-list">${stepRow(cur, true)}</div>` : ''}</div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="card ob-card ${full ? 'full' : ''}">${head}${full && o.hidden ? `<p class="mute" style="margin:0 0 10px">${t('obHidden')}</p>` : ''}
      <div class="ob-body"><div class="ob-list">${o.steps.map(s => stepRow(s, s === cur)).join('')}</div>
      <div class="ob-side">${allCard(o)}${faqHtml()}</div></div></div>`;
  }
  function bindOnb(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-ob-go]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); stepAction(b.dataset.obGo); });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-ob-claim]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.stopPropagation(); b.disabled = true; claimStep(b.dataset.obClaim); });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-ob-min]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { ls('kz-onb-min', ls('kz-onb-min') === '1' ? '0' : '1'); refresh(); });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-ob-hide]').forEach(b => b.onclick = run(async () => { P2.onb = await api('/api/onb/hide', { on: b.dataset.obHide === '1' }); refresh(); }));
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-ob-faq]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { const i = +b.dataset.obFaq; P2.faq = P2.faq === i ? -1 : i; b.parentElement.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.ob-q').forEach((q, k) => q.classList.toggle('open', k + 1 === P2.faq)); });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-ob-page]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => go('onboarding'));
  }
  function renderOnb() {
    if (!P2.onb) { onbLoad(true); return render(`<div class="card empty-note">${t('loading')}</div>`); }
    render(`<div class="pl2 ob-page">${onbBlock(true)}</div>`);
    bindOnb($('#view'));
    onbLoad();
  }

  const _orig = renderPlay;
  const etaTxt = (mode, short) => {
    const e = S.live?.lane?.eta?.[mode];
    if (!e || e.ms == null) return short ? t('pl2WaitNa') : t('la_etaNone');
    if (short) return e.ms < 60_000 ? '< 1 ' + (LANG === 'uk' ? 'хв' : LANG === 'ru' ? 'мин' : 'min') : '≈ ' + Math.max(1, Math.round(e.ms / 60_000)) + ' ' + (LANG === 'uk' ? 'хв' : LANG === 'ru' ? 'мин' : 'min');
    return e.ms < 60_000 ? t('la_etaFast') : t('la_eta', { n: Math.max(1, Math.round(e.ms / 60_000)) });
  };

  function seasonStrip(st, ss) {
    const se = S.season, n = ss?.season ?? se?.season ?? 1;
    const name = se?.name || ({ 1: 'Relic', 2: 'Polaris' })[n] || '';
    const w = se?.warmup && !se.warmup.started ? se.warmup : null;
    const prize = (se?.ladders || (se ? [se] : [])).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.places || []).reduce((b, p) => b + (p.cash || 0), 0), 0);
    const qTotal = Object.values(st.queues).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const chip = (v, l) => `<span class="pl2-chip"><b class="num">${v}</b>${l}</span>`;
    const o = P2.onb, obChip = o && !o.complete && (!onbVisible()) && o.isNew ? `<button class="pl2-chip ob-chip" data-ob-page>${t('obChip', { n: o.done, m: o.of })}</button>` : '';
    return `<div class="pl2-strip"><img class="pl2-slogo" src="assets/${S.seasonLogo || 'season1_logo.png'}" alt="">
      <div class="pl2-sname"><b>${t('pl2Season', { n })} · <em>${esc(name)}</em></b>${se?.status === 'beta' || se?.status === 'warmup' ? `<span class="tag gold">${t(se.status === 'warmup' ? 'seasonWarm' : 'seasonBeta')}</span>` : ''}</div>
      ${w ? `<div class="pl2-wu" title="${esc(t('wuGoal', { n: w.players, g: w.goal }))}"><div class="pl2-wbar"><i style="width:${Math.min(100, w.players / w.goal * 100)}%"></i></div><span class="num">${w.players} / ${w.goal}</span></div>` : ''}
      <div class="pl2-chips">${chip(st.online, t('online', { n: '' }).trim())}${chip(qTotal, t('pl2Queue'))}${chip(ss?.live ?? '–', t('pl2Live'))}${chip(ss?.today ?? '–', t('pl2Today'))}${chip(ss?.players ?? '–', t('pl2Players'))}${obChip}</div>
      <span class="grow"></span>
      ${prize ? `<span class="pl2-prize"><span class="mute">${t('pl2Prize')}</span><b>$${prize}</b></span>` : ''}
      ${se ? `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-pl2-season>${t('pl2More')}</button>` : ''}
      <div class="pl2-when">${seasonWhen()}</div></div>`;
  }
  function modeCards(st, mode) {
    return `<div class="pl2-modes">${PUB_MODES.map(m => `<button class="pl2-mode ${mode === m ? 'on' : ''}" data-mode="${m}" ${st.myQueue ? 'disabled' : ''} style="background-image:url(${mapImg(m === '1v1' ? 'Highrise' : 'Museum')})">
        ${mode === m ? `<span class="pl2-chk">${IC.check}</span>` : ''}<div class="pl2-mi"><div class="pl2-mt">${modeName(m)}</div><div class="pl2-md">${t(m === '1v1' ? 'pl2D1' : 'pl2D2')}</div>
        <div class="pl2-mm"><span>${t('pl2Wait')} <b>${etaTxt(m, true)}</b></span><span>${t('pl2InQ')} <b class="num">${st.queues[m] ?? 0} / ${sizeOf(m)}</b></span><span>${t('pl2Match')} <b>${t(m === '1v1' ? 'pl2MatchLen1' : 'pl2MatchLen2')}</b></span></div></div></button>`).join('')}</div>`;
  }
  function partyBar(st, mode) {
    const p = st.party, lead = p ? p.leader === S.me.id : true;
    const members = p ? p.members : [S.me];
    const max = Math.max(partyMax(mode), members.length);
    const slots = members.map(m => `<div class="pl2-slot ${m.id === S.me.id ? 'me' : 'f'}" title="${esc(m.nick)}">${avaF(m, 'pl2a')}
        <span class="pl2-sl">${m.id === S.me.id ? t('pl2You') : esc(m.nick)}</span>${p && m.id === p.leader ? '<i class="pl2-crown">★</i>' : ''}
        ${p && lead && m.id !== S.me.id ? `<button class="pl2-kick" data-kick="${m.id}" title="✕">${IC.x}</button>` : ''}</div>`).join('')
      + Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, max - members.length) }, () => `<button class="pl2-slot add" data-pl2-add title="${esc(t('pl2Invite'))}">${IC.plus}</button>`).join('');
    return `<div class="card pl2-party ${p ? 'on' : ''}"><div class="pl2-pl"><span class="h4l">${t('pl2Party')}${p ? ` · ${p.members.length}/${Math.max(2, p.members.length)}` : ''}</span><span class="mute">${t('pl2PartySub')}</span></div>
      <div class="pl2-slots">${slots}</div><span class="grow"></span>
      <div class="pl2-pr">${p ? `<span class="mute">${t('pl2Code')}: <code class="pcode" data-party="copy" title="${t('copyId')}">${esc(p.code)}</code></span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-party="leave">${t('leaveParty')}</button>`
        : `<div class="row"><input id="party-code" placeholder="${t('partyCodePh')}" maxlength="6"><button class="btn ghost sm" data-party="join">${t('join')}</button></div><button class="btn ghost sm" data-party="create">${t('createParty')}</button>`}</div></div>`;
  }
  function goBlock(st, mode, r, ban) {
    const inQ = st.myQueue === mode;
    const lvl = levelOf(r.elo);
    const stake = isCal(r) ? t('pl2StakeCal', { n: r.cal, m: 5, w: 75, l: 50 }) : t('pl2Stake', { lvl, elo: r.elo });
    const body = inQ
      ? `<div class="searching"><div class="pulse"></div><b>${t('searching')} <span data-since="${S.queuedAt}"></span></b><span class="mute">${modeName(mode)} · ${st.queues[mode] ?? 0} / ${sizeOf(mode)}</span><button class="btn ghost sm" data-act="leave" style="margin-left:auto">${t('cancel')}</button></div>`
      : st.party && st.party.leader !== S.me.id ? `<div class="searching"><b>${t('leaderStarts')}</b></div>`
      : mode === '1v1' && st.party?.members.length > 1 ? `<div class="searching"><b>${t('noParty1v1')}</b><button class="btn ghost sm" data-party="leave" style="margin-left:auto">${t('leaveParty')}</button></div>`
      : mode === '2v2' && st.party?.members.length > 2 ? `<div class="searching"><b>${t('noPartyDuel')}</b></div>`
      : `<button class="btn big pl2-find" data-act="queue" data-mode="${mode}" ${st.myQueue || ban ? 'disabled' : ''}><span>${st.party?.members.length > 1 ? t('findMatchParty', { n: st.party.members.length }) : t('findMatch')} ${modeName(mode).replace(/ /g, '')}</span><small>${stake}</small></button>`;
    return `<div class="pl2-go">${body}</div><div class="queue pl2-qanchor"></div>`;
  }
  function nextSteps(mode) {
    const s = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
    return `<div class="card pl2-next"><div class="row"><span class="h4l">${t('pl2Next')}</span><span class="grow"></span><button class="pl2-link" data-pl2-guide>${t('pl2How')}</button></div>
      <div class="pl2-steps">${s.map(i => `<div class="pl2-st"><i>${i}</i><b>${t('pl2S' + i)}</b><span>${i === 1 && S.live?.lane?.eta?.[mode]?.ms == null ? t('pl2S1d0') : t('pl2S' + i + 'd', { eta: etaTxt(mode, true) })}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }
  function tiles(myM) {
    const st = typeof LC !== 'undefined' ? LC.st : null;
    const tile = (cls, h, v, s, attr) => `<button class="card pl2-tile ${cls}" ${attr}><span class="h4l">${h}</span><b class="pl2-tv">${v}</b><span class="mute">${s}</span></button>`;
    const out = [];
    if (st) {
      const d = st.quests.d.list, doneN = d.filter(q => q.p >= q.n).length, claim = [...d, ...st.quests.w.list].filter(q => q.p >= q.n && !q.claimed).length;
      out.push(tile(claim ? 'hot' : '', t('pl2Quests'), `${doneN} / ${d.length}`, claim ? t('pl2QSub', { n: claim }) : t('pl2QSub0'), 'data-pl2-go="pass"'));
      const p = st.pass, ready = p.ready.f + p.ready.p;
      out.push(tile(ready ? 'gold' : '', t('pl2Pass'), `${t('pl2Lvl', { n: p.level })}${ready ? ` <span class="tag gold">${t('lcReady', { n: ready })}</span>` : ''}`, ready ? t('pl2PassSub') : t('pl2PassOpen'), 'data-pl2-go="pass"'));
      out.push(tile('', t('pl2Streak'), t('lcDays', { n: st.streak.login.n }), t('pl2StreakSub', { n: st.streak.win.n }), 'data-pl2-go="pass"'));
    }
    const h = myM[0];
    out.push(h ? tile('', t('pl2Last'), `<span class="${h.delta > 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${sign(h.delta)} ELO</span>`, `${esc(mapName(h.map))} · ${h.score ? esc(h.score) + ' · ' : ''}${h.mode}`, `data-mid="${h.id}"`)
      : tile('', t('pl2Last'), '—', t('pl2LastNone'), 'disabled'));
    if (st?.recap) out.push(tile('', t('pl2Recap'), st.recap.mvp?.p ? esc(st.recap.mvp.p.nick) : '—', st.recap.mvp ? t('pl2RecapSub', { n: '+' + st.recap.mvp.elo + ' ELO' }) : t('lcMatchesN', { n: st.recap.matches }), 'data-pl2-recap'));
    return `<div class="lc-home pl2-tiles">${out.join('')}</div>`;
  }
  function rankCard(r, mode) {
    const lvl = levelOf(r.elo), nx = LEVELS[lvl + 1];

    return `<div class="card pl2-rank"><div class="row"><span class="h4l">${t('pl2Rating')} · ${modeName(mode)}</span></div>

        : `<div><span class="mute">${t('level', { n: lvl })}</span><b class="pl2-rv">${r.elo} <small class="mute">ELO</small></b></div>`}</div>
      ${cal ? `<div class="pl2-cbar">${[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `<i class="${i < r.cal ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</div>`
        : `<div class="bar"><i style="width:${levelPct(r.elo)}%"></i></div><div class="mute" style="font-size:12px;margin-top:5px">${nx ? t('toNext', { n: nx - r.elo, l: lvl + 1 }) : t('maxLevel')}</div>`}
      <div class="pl2-kv"><div><b>${r.w + r.l}</b><span>${t('games')}</span></div><div><b>${wrNum(r)}%</b><span>${t('winrate')}</span></div><div><b>${kd(r.k, r.d)}</b><span>${t('kd')}</span></div><div><b class="win">${r.w}</b><span>${t('wins')}</span></div></div></div>`;
  }
  function matchesCard(myM, ss) {
    return `<div class="card pl2-ml"><div class="row"><span class="h4l">${t('myMatches')}</span><span class="grow"></span><button class="pl2-link" data-pl2-prof>${t('pl2All')}</button></div>

'alfa' : 'bravo'}">${TEAM[m.winner]}</span> · ${esc(mapName(m.map))}</b><span class="mute">#${m.id}${m.score ? ' · ' + esc(m.score) : ''} · ${m.mode} · ${fmtDT(m.at)}</span></div></div>`).join('')
        : `<div class="empty-note">${t('noMatches')}</div>`}</div>`;
  }

  window.PL2 = { onbBlock, onbVisible, bindOnb, onbLoad, focusEl, etaTxt, seasonStrip };
  renderPlay = function () {
    const st = S.live;
    if (!st || st.match || S.finishedMatch || !S.me?.gameId) return _orig.apply(this, arguments);
    onbLoad();
    const pn = st.party?.members.length || 0;
    if (pn !== P2.party) { P2.party = pn; if (pn >= 2) onbLoad(true); }
    const mode = S.mode = pubMode(S.mode), r = S.me['r' + mode] || { elo: 1000, w: 0, l: 0, k: 0, d: 0, cal: 0 };
    const ban = S.me.ban && (S.me.ban.until === 0 || S.me.ban.until > Date.now()) ? S.me.ban : null;
    const ss = S.stats, myM = (S.myProfile?.matches || []).slice(0, 5);
    render(`<div class="pl2">
      ${seasonStrip(st, ss)}
      ${onbVisible() ? onbBlock(false) : ''}
      ${ban ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--lose)"><h3 class="lose">${t('banned')}</h3>${esc(ban.reason)} · ${ban.until ? t('until', { d: fmtDT(ban.until) }) : t('forever')}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="pl2-lay">
        <div class="col pl2-main">${modeCards(st, mode)}${partyBar(st, mode)}${goBlock(st, mode, r, ban)}${nextSteps(mode)}${tiles(myM)}</div>
        <div class="col pl2-side">${friendsCard(st)}${rankCard(r, mode)}${matchesCard(myM, ss)}</div>
      </div>
      ${seasonRewards()}</div>`);
    const view = $('#view');
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b => { if (!b.dataset.act) b.onclick = () => { S.mode = b.dataset.mode; refresh(); }; });
    bindPlay();
    bindParty();
    bindOnb(view);
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-pl2-add]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      const canInvite = !st.party || st.party.leader === S.me.id;
      if (!canInvite) return;
      focusEl('#fr-q', '.friends-card');
    });
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-pl2-go]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => go(b.dataset.pl2Go));
    const pr = view.querySelector('[data-pl2-prof]'); if (pr) pr.onclick = () => go('profile', S.me.id);
    const gd = view.querySelector('[data-pl2-guide]'); if (gd) gd.onclick = () => K.open('https://konzte.online/#guide');
    const sb = view.querySelector('[data-pl2-season]'); if (sb) sb.onclick = () => {
      ls('kz-season-open', '1'); refresh();
      setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('#view .srew')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 60);
    };
    const rc = view.querySelector('[data-pl2-recap]'); if (rc && typeof lcRecapHtml === 'function') rc.onclick = () => modal(`<div class="pl2-recapm">${lcRecapHtml(LC.st.recap)}</div>`, box => { if (typeof lcBind === 'function') lcBind(box); });
    tick();
  };

  const _refresh = refresh;
  refresh = function () {
    if (S.page === 'onboarding' && S.me?.gameId) return renderOnb();
    return _refresh.apply(this, arguments);
  };
  const _go = go;
  go = function (page) {
    if (page === 'pass') onbMark('pass');
    if (page === 'play' || page === 'onboarding') onbLoad(true);
    return _go.apply(this, arguments);
  };
  const _rs = renderSettings;
  renderSettings = async function () {
    const r = await _rs.apply(this, arguments);
    const panel = document.querySelector('#view .setpanel');
    if (S.page === 'settings' && S.setTab === 'game' && panel && !panel.querySelector('[data-ob-page]')) {
      const o = P2.onb;
      panel.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div class="srow"><div><b>${t('obSetRow')}</b><span>${t('obSetRowH')}${o ? ` · ${o.done}/${o.of}` : ''}</span></div><div><button class="btn ghost sm" data-ob-page>${t('sOpen')}</button></div></div>`);
      panel.querySelector('[data-ob-page]').onclick = () => go('onboarding');
    }
    return r;
  };
})();

  for (const k of Object.keys(L)) Object.assign(I18N[k], L[k]);
  const tr = k => (I18N[LANG] || I18N.en)[k] ?? I18N.en[k];

  const IC = {
    lock: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="5" y="10.5" width="14" height="10" rx="2"/><path d="M8 10.5V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v2.5"/></svg>',
    plus: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>',
    check: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg>',
    chev: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>',
    x: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18"/></svg>',
    target: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 1.5v4M12 18.5v4M1.5 12h4M18.5 12h4"/></svg>',
    users: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3.5"/><path d="M2.5 19.5c.6-3.4 3.2-5.5 6.5-5.5s5.9 2.1 6.5 5.5"/><path d="M16 4.8a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 6.4M18 14.4c1.9.8 3.1 2.5 3.5 5.1"/></svg>',
    exit: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 4.5H6.5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v11a2 2 0 0 0 2 2H14M10 12h10.5M17 8.5l3.5 3.5-3.5 3.5"/></svg>',
    shield: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3l7.5 3v5.5c0 4.7-3.2 8.2-7.5 9.5-4.3-1.3-7.5-4.8-7.5-9.5V6z"/></svg>',
    crown: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3.5 8l4.5 4 4-6.5 4 6.5 4.5-4-1.8 10.5H5.3z"/></svg>',

  const sizeOf = m => ({ '1v1': 2, '2v2': 4 })[m] || 10;
  const partyMax = m => ({ '1v1': 1, '2v2': 2 })[m] || 5;
  const modeName = m => m.replace('v', ' × ');
  const DAY = 86_400_000;

  function league(st, mode) {
    const tab = m => `<button class="p3-lg ${mode === m ? 'on' : ''}" data-mode="${m}" ${st.myQueue ? 'disabled' : ''}>${modeName(m)}${mode === m ? IC.check : ''}</button>`;
    return `<span class="p3-h">${tr('p3League')}</span><div class="p3-league">${PUB_MODES.map(tab).join('')}
      <button class="p3-lg lock" data-p3-clans title="${esc(tr('p3ClanWarL'))}">${tr('p3ClanWar')} 5×5${IC.lock}</button></div>`;
  }
  function counters(st, mode, ss) {
    const q = Object.values(st.queues).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const eta = window.PL2 ? PL2.etaTxt(mode, true) : '—';
    const c = (h, v, cls = '') => `<div class="p3-ct ${cls}"><span>${h}</span><b class="num">${v}</b></div>`;
    const inQ = st.myQueue === mode;
    return `<div class="p3-cts">${c(tr('p3Online'), st.online)}${c(tr('p3Searching'), q)}${c(tr('p3Live'), ss?.live ?? '–')}
      ${inQ ? `<div class="p3-ct hot"><span>${tr('p3Search')}</span><b class="num" data-since="${S.queuedAt}"></b></div>` : c(tr('p3Wait'), eta)}
      ${c(tr('p3Today'), ss?.today ?? '–')}${c(tr('p3Region'), tr('p3Europe'))}</div>`;
  }
  function slotMe(m, p, r) {
    const mode = S.mode, lvl = levelOf(r.elo), me = m.id === S.me.id;
    const rr = me ? r : null;
    const bgp = me ? { ...m, pbg: S.myProfile?.pbg } : m;
    const bgl = window.kzCard3?.bg ? `<div class="p3-sbg">${kzCard3.bg(bgp)}</div>` : '';
    return `<div class="p3-slot ${me ? 'me' : 'f'}">${bgl}${p && m.id === p.leader ? `<i class="p3-crown" title="${esc(t('leader'))}">${IC.crown}</i>` : ''}
      ${p && p.leader === S.me.id && !me ? `<button class="p3-kick" data-kick="${m.id}" title="✕">${IC.x}</button>` : ''}
      <div class="p3-ava">${avaF(m, 'p3a')}</div><b class="p3-nick" title="${esc(m.nick)}">${esc(m.nick)}</b>
      ${rr ? `<span class="p3-elo"><img src="${lvlIc(rr, lvl)}">${isCal(rr) ? tr('p3Cal').replace('{n}', rr.cal) : `<b class="num">${rr.elo}</b> ELO`}</span>
        <span class="p3-mini"><span>K/D ${rr.w + rr.l ? kd(rr.k, rr.d) : '—'}</span><span>WR ${rr.w + rr.l ? wrNum(rr) + '%' : '—'}</span></span>`
        : `<span class="p3-elo f">${m.online === false ? `<i class="dot"></i>${t('offline')}` : `<i class="dot on"></i>${modeName(mode)}`}</span>`}</div>`;
  }
  function slots(st, mode, r) {
    const p = st.party, members = p ? p.members : [S.me];
    const max = partyMax(mode), lead = !p || p.leader === S.me.id;
    const others = members.filter(m => m.id !== S.me.id);
    const free = Math.max(0, max - members.length);
    const lockTxt = mode === '1v1' ? tr('p3Lock1') : mode === '2v2' ? tr('p3Lock2') : tr('p3Lock5');
    const me = members.find(m => m.id === S.me.id) || S.me;
    const side = [...others.map(m => slotMe(m, p, r)),
      ...Array.from({ length: free }, () => `<button class="p3-slot add" data-p3-call ${lead ? '' : 'disabled'}><i>${IC.plus}</i><span>${tr('p3Call')}</span></button>`)];
    while (side.length < 4) side.push(`<div class="p3-slot lock" data-tip="${esc(lockTxt)}"><i>${IC.lock}</i></div>`);
    const order = [side[3], side[1], slotMe(me, p, r), side[0], side[2]];
    return `<div class="p3-ph"><span class="p3-h">${tr('p3Party')} <b class="num">${members.length} / ${max}</b></span>
      ${p ? `<span class="p3-code">${tr('p3Code')}: <code class="pcode" data-party="copy" title="${esc(t('copyId'))}">${esc(p.code)}</code></span>`
        : max > 1 ? `<span class="p3-join"><input id="party-code" placeholder="${esc(t('partyCodePh'))}" maxlength="6"><button class="btn ghost sm" data-party="join">${t('join')}</button></span>` : ''}</div>
      <div class="p3-slots">${order.join('')}</div>`;
  }
  function goRow(st, mode, r, ban) {
    const inQ = st.myQueue === mode, p = st.party;
    let main;
    if (inQ) main = `<button class="p3-find on" data-act="leave"><span class="searching"><span class="pulse"></span></span><span>${tr('p3Search')} <b data-since="${S.queuedAt}"></b> · ${st.queues[mode] ?? 0}/${sizeOf(mode)}</span><small>${tr('p3Cancel')}</small></button>`;
    else if (p && p.leader !== S.me.id) main = `<div class="p3-find off"><span>${t('leaderStarts')}</span></div>`;
    else if (mode === '1v1' && p?.members.length > 1) main = `<div class="p3-find off"><span>${t('noParty1v1')}</span></div>`;
    else if (mode === '2v2' && p?.members.length > 2) main = `<div class="p3-find off"><span>${t('noPartyDuel')}</span></div>`;
    else main = `<button class="p3-find" data-act="queue" data-mode="${mode}" ${st.myQueue || ban ? 'disabled' : ''}>${IC.target}<span>${p?.members.length > 1 ? t('findMatchParty', { n: p.members.length }) : tr('p3Find')} ${modeName(mode).replace(/ /g, '')}</span>
      <small>${isCal(r) ? tr('p3Cal').replace('{n}', r.cal) + ' · +75 / −50' : `±5–30 ELO`}</small></button>`;
    const fr = (st.friends?.list || []).filter(x => x.status !== 'offline').length;
    return `<div class="p3-go"><button class="p3-rb" data-p3-call title="${esc(tr('p3Friends'))}">${IC.users}${fr ? `<em>${fr}</em>` : ''}</button>${main}
      <button class="p3-rb" data-party="${p ? 'leave' : 'create'}" title="${esc(p ? tr('p3Leave') : t('createParty'))}" ${p ? '' : 'data-p3-new'}>${p ? IC.exit : IC.plus}</button></div>
      <div class="queue p3-qanchor"></div>
      <button class="p3-rules" data-p3-rules>${IC.shield}${tr('p3Rules')}</button>`;
  }
  function maps(mode) {
    const pool = mode === '1v1' ? ['Egypt', 'Subway', 'TrainYard', 'Caribbean', 'Highrise', 'Museum', 'Warehouse']
      : ['Egypt', 'Subway', 'TrainYard', 'Caribbean', 'Highrise', 'Museum', 'Warehouse', 'Drain', 'Fuji'];
    return `<div class="card p3-maps"><div class="p3-mh"><span class="p3-h">${tr('p3Maps')} <b class="num">${pool.length}</b></span><span class="mute">${tr('p3MapsSub')}</span></div>
      <div class="p3-mrow">${pool.map(m => `<div class="p3-map" style="--mi:url(${mapImg(m)})"><b>${esc(mapName(m))}</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }
  function tiles() {
    const st = typeof LC !== 'undefined' ? LC.st : null;
    if (!st) return '<div class="lc-home" hidden></div>';
    const d = st.quests.d.list, doneN = d.filter(q => q.p >= q.n).length, claim = [...d, ...st.quests.w.list].filter(q => q.p >= q.n && !q.claimed).length;
    const ps = st.pass, ready = ps.ready.f + ps.ready.p;
    const tile = (cls, h, v, s) => `<button class="p3-tile ${cls}" data-pl2-go="pass"><span>${h}</span><b>${v}</b><small>${s}</small></button>`;
    return `<div class="lc-home p3-tiles">${tile(claim ? 'hot' : '', tr('p3Quests'), `${doneN} / ${d.length}`, claim ? t('pl2QSub', { n: claim }) : t('pl2QSub0'))}
      ${tile(ready ? 'gold' : '', tr('p3Pass'), t('pl2Lvl', { n: ps.level }), ready ? t('pl2PassSub') : t('pl2PassOpen'))}
      ${tile('', tr('p3Streak'), t('lcDays', { n: st.streak.login.n }), t('pl2StreakSub', { n: st.streak.win.n }))}</div>`;
  }

  function myStats(r, mode) {
    const g = r.w + r.l;
    const c = (v, h) => `<div><b class="num">${v}</b><span>${h}</span></div>`;
    return `<div class="card p3-side"><div class="p3-sh"><span class="p3-h">${tr('p3MyStats')}</span><span class="mute">${tr('p3ThisSeason').replace('{m}', modeName(mode))}</span></div>
      <div class="p3-grid">${c(r.w, tr('p3Wins'))}${c(r.l, tr('p3Losses'))}${c(g ? wrNum(r) + '%' : '—', tr('p3Wr'))}
        ${c(g ? kd(r.k, r.d) : '—', tr('p3Kd'))}${c(g ? (r.k / g).toFixed(1) : '—', tr('p3Kpm'))}${c(g, tr('p3Games'))}</div></div>`;
  }
  function seasonCard(r, mode) {
    const se = S.season, n = S.stats?.season ?? se?.season ?? 1;
    const name = se?.name || ({ 1: 'Relic', 2: 'Polaris' })[n] || '';
    const lvl = levelOf(r.elo), nx = LEVELS[lvl + 1], cal = isCal(r);
    const lad = (se?.ladders || (se ? [se] : [])).find(l => l.ladder === mode) || null;
    const w = se?.warmup && !se.warmup.started ? se.warmup : null;
    const when = [w ? (w.start ? t('wuStartsAt', { d: fmtDT(w.start) }) : t('wuGoal', { n: w.players, g: w.goal })) : '',
      lad?.me?.place ? t('seasonMyPlace', { p: lad.me.place, n: lad.me.of }) : '',
      se ? (se.end ? t('seasonEnds', { d: fmtDate(se.end), n: Math.max(0, Math.ceil((se.end - Date.now()) / DAY)) }) : t('seasonEndTba')) : ''].filter(Boolean);
    const prize = (se?.ladders || (se ? [se] : [])).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.places || []).reduce((b, p) => b + (p.cash || 0), 0), 0);
    return `<div class="card p3-side p3-season"><div class="p3-sl"><span class="p3-h">${t('pl2Season', { n })} · <em>${esc(name)}</em></span>
        <div class="p3-lv"><img class="lvl" src="${lvlIc(r, lvl)}">${cal ? `<b>${tr('p3Cal').replace('{n}', r.cal)}</b>` : `<b class="num">${r.elo}</b><span>ELO</span>`}</div>
        ${cal ? `<div class="p3-cbar">${[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => `<i class="${i < r.cal ? 'on' : ''}"></i>`).join('')}</div>`
          : `<div class="p3-bar"><i style="width:${levelPct(r.elo)}%"></i></div><span class="mute p3-to">${nx ? tr('p3ToLvl').replace('{n}', nx - r.elo).replace('{l}', lvl + 1) : tr('p3Max')}</span>`}</div>
      <button class="p3-sr" data-p3-season><span class="p3-h">${modeName(mode)} · ${tr('p3Ladder')}</span>${IC.chev}
        ${when.map((x, i) => `<span class="p3-when ${i === 0 && w ? 'wu' : 'mute'}">${x}</span>`).join('')}${prize ? `<span class="p3-prize"><span class="mute">${tr('p3Prize')}</span><b>$${prize}</b></span>` : ''}</button></div>`;
  }
  const modeMatches = mode => (S.myProfile?.matches || []).filter(h => h.mode === mode);
  function form(mode) {
    const ms = modeMatches(mode).slice(0, 10);
    return `<div class="card p3-side p3-form"><div class="p3-sh"><span class="p3-h">${tr('p3Form')}</span>${ms.length ? `<span class="mute num">${ms.filter(h => h.won).length}–${ms.filter(h => !h.won).length}</span>` : ''}</div>
      ${ms.length ? `<div class="p3-fr">${ms.map(h => `<i class="${h.won ? 'w' : 'l'}" data-mid="${h.id}" title="${esc(mapName(h.map))} · ${sign(h.delta)} ELO">${h.won ? 'W' : 'L'}</i>`).join('')}</div>` : `<span class="mute p3-empty">${tr('p3FormNone')}</span>`}</div>`;
  }
  function last(mode) {
    const ms = modeMatches(mode).slice(0, 3);
    return `<div class="card p3-side"><div class="p3-sh"><span class="p3-h">${tr('p3Last')}</span><button class="p3-link" data-pl2-prof>${tr('p3All')}</button></div>
      ${ms.length ? ms.map(h => `<div class="p3-lm" data-mid="${h.id}"><span class="p3-li" style="background-image:url(${mapImg(h.map)})"></span><div class="grow"><b>${esc(mapName(h.map))}</b><span class="mute">${h.score ? esc(h.score) + ' · ' : ''}${h.k}/${h.d} · ${fmtDate(h.at)}</span></div><b class="num ${h.delta > 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${sign(h.delta)}</b></div>`).join('')
        : `<span class="mute p3-empty">${tr('p3LastNone')}</span>`}</div>`;
  }
  function activity() {
    const ms = S.myProfile?.matches || [];
    const now = new Date(), today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const dow = (today.getDay() + 6) % 7;
    const start = new Date(today.getTime() - (11 * 7 + dow) * DAY);
    const cnt = {};
    for (const h of ms) { const d = new Date(h.at); const k = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()).getTime(); cnt[k] = (cnt[k] || 0) + 1; }
    const lvl = n => !n ? 0 : n < 2 ? 1 : n < 4 ? 2 : n < 7 ? 3 : 4;
    const loc = LANG === 'uk' ? 'uk-UA' : LANG === 'ru' ? 'ru-RU' : 'en-GB';
    let months = '', lastM = -1, cells = '';
    for (let w = 0; w < 12; w++) {
      const d0 = new Date(start.getTime() + w * 7 * DAY);
      months += `<span class="p3-mo" style="grid-column:${w + 2};grid-row:1">${d0.getMonth() !== lastM ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(loc, { month: 'short' }).format(d0).replace('.', '') : ''}</span>`;
      lastM = d0.getMonth();
      for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
        const day = new Date(start.getTime() + (w * 7 + d) * DAY), k = day.getTime(), n = cnt[k] || 0, fut = day > today;
        cells += `<i class="a${lvl(n)} ${fut ? 'fut' : ''}" style="grid-column:${w + 2};grid-row:${d + 2}" title="${fut ? '' : esc(tr('p3ActTip').replace('{d}', day.toLocaleDateString(loc)).replace('{n}', n))}"></i>`;
      }
    }
    const days = tr('p3Days').map((x, i) => `<span style="grid-column:1;grid-row:${i + 2}">${x}</span>`).join('');
    return `<div class="card p3-side"><div class="p3-sh"><span class="p3-h">${tr('p3Act')}</span><span class="mute">${tr('p3Weeks')}</span></div>
      <div class="p3-heat"><span style="grid-column:1;grid-row:1"></span>${months}${days}${cells}</div></div>`;
  }

  function callModal() {
    const st = S.live; if (!st) return;
    modal(`<div class="p3-callm">${friendsCard(st)}</div>`, () => { bindParty(); });
  }

  const _prev = renderPlay;
  renderPlay = function () {
    const st = S.live;
    if (!ON() || !st || st.match || S.finishedMatch || !S.me?.gameId) return _prev.apply(this, arguments);
    if (window.PL2) PL2.onbLoad();
    const mode = S.mode = pubMode(S.mode), r = S.me['r' + mode] || { elo: 1000, w: 0, l: 0, k: 0, d: 0, cal: 0 };
    const ban = S.me.ban && (S.me.ban.until === 0 || S.me.ban.until > Date.now()) ? S.me.ban : null;
    const ss = S.stats;
    render(`<div class="pl2 p3">
      ${window.PL2 && PL2.onbVisible() ? PL2.onbBlock(false) : ''}
      ${ban ? `<div class="card" style="border-color:var(--lose)"><h3 class="lose">${t('banned')}</h3>${esc(ban.reason)} · ${ban.until ? t('until', { d: fmtDT(ban.until) }) : t('forever')}</div>` : ''}
      <div class="p3-lay">
        <div class="p3-main">
          <div class="card p3-hub">${league(st, mode)}${counters(st, mode, ss)}${slots(st, mode, r)}${goRow(st, mode, r, ban)}</div>
          ${maps(mode)}${tiles()}
        </div>
        <div class="p3-right">${myStats(r, mode)}${seasonCard(r, mode)}${form(mode)}${last(mode)}${activity()}</div>
      </div>
      ${seasonRewards()}</div>`);
    const view = $('#view');
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b => { if (!b.dataset.act) b.onclick = () => { S.mode = b.dataset.mode; refresh(); }; });
    bindPlay();
    bindParty();
    if (window.PL2) PL2.bindOnb(view);
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-p3-call]').forEach(b => b.onclick = callModal);
    view.querySelectorAll('[data-pl2-go]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => go(b.dataset.pl2Go));
    const on = (sel, fn) => { const el = view.querySelector(sel); if (el) el.onclick = fn; };
    on('[data-p3-clans]', () => go('clans'));
    on('[data-pl2-prof]', () => go('profile', S.me.id));
    on('[data-p3-rules]', () => go('rules'));
    on('[data-p3-season]', () => { ls('kz-season-open', '1'); refresh(); setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('#view .srew')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }), 60); });
    tick();
  };
})();

```

  function draftOf(e) {
