```js
  const badInt = (v, max) => !Number.isFinite(v) || v < 0 || Math.round(v) !== v ? 'int' : v > max ? 'max' : '';
  function check() {
    const err = [], bad = new Set();
    const n = String(D.nick || '').trim();
    if (n.length < 2 || n.length > 25) { err.push(t('pe3_eNick')); bad.add('nick'); }
    for (const m of MODES) for (const f of RF) {
      const v = D.ratings[m][f], b = badInt(v, MAXV[f]);
      if (b) { bad.add(`r.${m}.${f}`); err.push(b === 'int' ? t('pe3_eInt', { f: `${t('pe_' + f)} ${mx(m)}` }) : t('pe3_eMax', { f: `${t('pe_' + f)} ${mx(m)}`, n: fmtN(MAXV[f]) })); }
    }
    if (E.pxp) { const b = badInt(D.pxp, 1e6); if (b) { bad.add('pxp'); err.push(t('pe3_eInt', { f: 'Premium XP' })); } }
    { const b = badInt(D.coins, MAXV.coins); if (b) { bad.add('coins'); err.push(b === 'int' ? t('pe3_eInt', { f: 'KF' }) : t('pe3_eMax', { f: 'KF', n: fmtN(MAXV.coins) })); } }
    if (D.premium.tier && !(D.premium.until > Date.now())) { bad.add('until'); err.push(t('pe3_eUntil')); }
    const pmax = E.pass.levels * E.pass.xpPerLevel, b = badInt(D.pass.xp, pmax);
    if (b) { bad.add('xp'); err.push(b === 'int' ? t('pe3_eInt', { f: 'XP' }) : t('pe3_eMax', { f: 'XP', n: fmtN(pmax) })); }
    return { err, bad };
  }

  function diff() {
    const e = E, s = {}, rows = [];
    const row = (tb, label, from, to) => rows.push({ tab: tb, label, from, to });
    const nick = String(D.nick).trim(), gid = String(D.gameId).trim();
    if (nick !== e.nick) { s.nick = nick; row('profile', t('pe_nick'), e.nick, nick); }
    if (gid !== e.gameId) { s.gameId = gid; row('profile', t('pe_gameId'), e.gameId || '—', gid || '—'); }
    if ([...D.badges].sort().join() !== [...e.badges].sort().join()) { s.badges = [...D.badges]; row('profile', t('pe_badges'), e.badges.map(b => t('pe_badge_' + b)).join(', ') || '—', D.badges.map(b => t('pe_badge_' + b)).join(', ') || '—'); }
    if (D.hideLb !== e.hideLb) { s.hideLb = D.hideLb; row('profile', t('pe_hide'), t(e.hideLb ? 'pe3_yes' : 'pe3_no'), t(D.hideLb ? 'pe3_yes' : 'pe3_no')); }
    const r = {};
    for (const m of MODES) for (const f of RF) if (D.ratings[m][f] !== e.ratings[m][f]) { (r[m] ||= {})[f] = D.ratings[m][f]; row('rating', `${t('pe_' + f)} ${mx(m)}`, fmtN(e.ratings[m][f]), fmtN(D.ratings[m][f])); }
    if (Object.keys(r).length) s.ratings = r;
    if (D.coins !== e.coins) { s.coins = D.coins; const d = D.coins - e.coins; row('eco', 'KF', fmtN(e.coins), `${fmtN(D.coins)} (${d > 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmtN(d)})`); }
    const ep = { tier: premOn(e.premium) ? e.premium.tier : '', until: premOn(e.premium) ? e.premium.until : 0 };
    if (D.premium.tier !== ep.tier || (D.premium.tier && Math.abs(D.premium.until - ep.until) > 60_000)) {
      s.premium = D.premium.tier ? { tier: D.premium.tier, until: D.premium.until } : { tier: null };
      const pf = p => p.tier ? `${tierName(p.tier)} · ${fmtDT(p.until)}` : t('pe_premNone');
      row('eco', t('pe_prem'), pf(ep), pf(D.premium));
    }
    const cs = {};
    for (const [k, , lk] of KINDS) if ((D.cosmetics[k] || '') !== (e.cosmetics[k] || '')) { cs[k] = D.cosmetics[k] || ''; row('cos', t(lk), nm(k, e.cosmetics[k]), nm(k, D.cosmetics[k])); }
    if (Object.keys(cs).length) s.cosmetics = cs;
    const add = {}, rem = {};
    for (const [k, g] of GRK) {
      const was = manual(e, g), now = D.own[g] || [];
      const a = now.filter(x => !was.includes(x)), d = was.filter(x => !now.includes(x));
      if (a.length) { add[g] = a; a.forEach(id => row('cos', t('pe3_given', { k: t('pe3_kind_' + k), v: '' }).trim(), '', nm(k, id))); }
      if (d.length) { rem[g] = d; d.forEach(id => row('cos', t('pe3_taken', { k: t('pe3_kind_' + k), v: '' }).trim(), nm(k, id), '—')); }
    }
    if (Object.keys(add).length || Object.keys(rem).length) s.grants = { add, remove: rem };
    if (e.pxp && D.pxp !== e.pxp.xp) { s.pxp = { xp: D.pxp }; row('eco', t('pe4_pxp'), `${fmtN(e.pxp.xp)} XP`, `${fmtN(D.pxp)} XP`); }
    if ((D.pbg || '') !== (e.pbg || '')) { s.pbg = D.pbg || ''; row('cos', t('pe4_pbg'), nm('pbg', e.pbg), nm('pbg', D.pbg)); }
    const p = {};
    if (D.pass.xp !== e.pass.xp) { p.xp = D.pass.xp; const lv = x => `${t('pe_level')} ${Math.min(e.pass.levels, Math.floor(x / e.pass.xpPerLevel))} · ${fmtN(x)} XP`; row('pass', t('pe3_pass'), lv(e.pass.xp), lv(D.pass.xp)); }
    if (D.pass.prem !== e.pass.prem) { p.prem = D.pass.prem; row('pass', t('pe3_ptrack'), t(e.pass.prem ? 'pe3_yes' : 'pe3_no'), t(D.pass.prem ? 'pe3_yes' : 'pe3_no')); }
    if (Object.keys(p).length) s.pass = p;
    return { set: s, rows };
  }

  function fake() {

      prem: { emblem: D.cosmetics.emblem, color: D.cosmetics.color, frame: D.cosmetics.frame, banner: D.cosmetics.banner, tier: premOn(D.premium) ? D.premium.tier : '' } };
  }

'on' : ''}" data-pe3-badge="${b}"><i class="bdg bdg-${b}">${typeof badgeIcon === 'function' ? badgeIcon(b) : ''}</i>${t('pe_badge_' + b)}<span class="pe3-tick">${IC.check}</span></button>`).join('')}</div>

'pe_on' : 'pe_off') })}</span></div>${e.tfa.totp || e.tfa.dm ? `<button class="btn red sm" id="pe-2fa">${t('pe_tfaReset')}</button>` : ''}</div>` : ''}</section>

  function ratingHtml() {

  function updRating(m) {
    const r = D.ratings[m], e = E.ratings[m], b = box(); if (!b) return;
    const games = (r.w || 0) + (r.l || 0), P = E.placement || 5, cal = games < P, lv = levelOf(r.elo || 0);
    const img = b.querySelector('#pe3-lvl-' + m); if (img) img.src = cal ? 'assets/lvl/cal.svg' : lvlImg(lv);
    const bar = b.querySelector('#pe3-bar-' + m); if (bar) bar.style.width = levelPct(r.elo || 0) + '%';
    const nx = LEVELS[lv + 1], lt = b.querySelector('#pe3-lvt-' + m);
    if (lt) lt.innerHTML = cal ? `<span>${t('pe3_calAfter', { n: lv })}</span>` : `<b>${t('pe3_lvl', { n: lv })}</b> · ${nx ? t('pe3_toNext', { n: nx - r.elo, l: lv + 1 }) : t('pe3_maxLvl')}`;
    const cb = b.querySelector('#pe3-cal-' + m); if (cb) { cb.className = 'pe3-calb ' + (cal ? 'cal' : 'ok'); cb.textContent = cal ? t('pe3_cal', { n: games, p: P }) : t('pe3_calDone'); }
    const der = b.querySelector('#pe3-der-' + m);
    if (der) der.innerHTML = `<span><i>${t('pe3_matches')}</i><b>${fmtN(games)}</b></span><span><i>${t('pe3_wr')}</i><b class="${games ? (r.w / games >= .5 ? 'win' : 'lose') : ''}">${games ? Math.round(r.w / games * 100) : 0}%</b></span><span><i>${t('pe3_kd')}</i><b>${kd(Math.max(0, r.k || 0), Math.max(0, r.d || 0))}</b></span>`;
    for (const f of RF) {
      const inp = b.querySelector(`[data-pe3-r="${m}"][data-f="${f}"]`), w = b.querySelector(`[data-was="${m}.${f}"]`), chg = r[f] !== e[f];
      inp?.classList.toggle('chg', chg); inp?.classList.toggle('bad', !!badInt(r[f], MAXV[f]));
      if (w) w.textContent = chg ? t('pe3_was', { v: fmtN(e[f]) }) : '';
    }
  }

        <div class="pe4-lvls">${e.pxp.table.map(L => `<button data-pe4-pxl="${L.min}" class="${lvOfXp(D.pxp) === L.lvl ? 'on' : ''}"><img src="assets/crown-px${L.lvl}.png" alt=""><b>${esc(window.PXP3 ? PXP3.name(L.lvl) : L.id)}</b><span>${fmtN(L.min)}+</span></button>`).join('')}</div>
        <label class="pe3-f"><span>XP</span><input type="number" min="0" max="1000000" id="pe4-pxp" value="${D.pxp}" class="${D.pxp !== e.pxp.xp ? 'chg' : ''}"></label>
        <p class="mute pe3-hint">${t('pe4_pxpHint')}</p></section>` : ''}</div>`;

  const lvOfXp = xp => { let l = 0; for (const L of E.pxp?.table || []) if (xp >= L.min) l = L.lvl; return l; };
  function updEco() {
    const b = box(); if (!b) return;
    const nb = b.querySelector('#pe3-newbal'), dl = b.querySelector('#pe3-delta'), d = D.coins - E.coins;
    if (nb) nb.innerHTML = `${fmtN(D.coins)} <small>KF</small>`;
    if (dl) { dl.textContent = Number.isFinite(d) && d ? (d > 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtN(d) : ''; dl.className = 'pe3-delta ' + (d > 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'); }
    const kf = b.querySelector('#pe3-kf'); kf?.classList.toggle('chg', D.coins !== E.coins); kf?.classList.toggle('bad', !!badInt(D.coins, MAXV.coins));
    const ps = b.querySelector('#pe3-pst'), p = D.premium;
    if (ps) ps.innerHTML = !p.tier ? `<span class="mute">${E.premium.until && !premOn(E.premium) ? t('pe3_expired', { d: fmtDT(E.premium.until) }) : t('pe3_noPrem')}</span>`
      : p.until > Date.now() ? `<img src="assets/crown-${p.tier}.png" alt=""><span>${t('pe3_active', { d: fmtDT(p.until), n: Math.ceil((p.until - Date.now()) / 864e5) })}</span>` : `<span class="lose">${t('pe3_eUntil')}</span>`;
    b.querySelector('#pe3-until')?.classList.toggle('bad', !!(p.tier && !(p.until > Date.now())));
  }

  const kitParts = id => E.catalog.kits?.[id] || [];
  function hasItem(k, id) {
    if (k === 'kit') return kitParts(id).every(x => hasItem(x.kind, x.id));
    if (k === 'pbg') return D.pbg === id;
    const g = GK[k]; if ((D.own[g] || []).includes(id)) return true;
    return (E.avail?.[g] || []).includes(id) && !manual(E, g).includes(id);
  }
  function srcOf(k, id) {
    if (k === 'kit' || k === 'pbg') return '';
    const g = GK[k];
    if (D.own[g].includes(id)) return (E.bought?.[g] || []).includes(id) && !(E.grants?.[g] || []).includes(id) ? t('pe3_sBought') : t('pe3_sGrant');
    if (hasItem(k, id)) return t('pe3_sTier');
    return '';
  }
  function thumb(k, id) {
    const p = fake();
    if (k === 'banner') return `<div class="pe3-tb">${bannerHtml(id, 'pe3-bimg')}</div>`;
    if (k === 'frame') return `<div class="pe3-tq">${avaF({ avatar: p.avatar }, 'lg', id)}</div>`;
    if (k === 'emblem') return `<div class="pe3-tq">${emblemHtml(id, 'big')}</div>`;
    if (k === 'avatar') return `<div class="pe3-tq">${ava({ avatar: avaUrl(id) }, 'lg')}</div>`;
    if (k === 'color') return `<div class="pe3-tq"><span class="pe3-nk" style="color:${esc(id)}">${esc(p.nick)}</span></div>`;
    if (k === 'kit') { const b = kitParts(id).find(x => x.kind === 'banner'); return /^kit[45]_/.test(id) ? `<div class="pe3-tb pe4-kit"><img src="assets/kit/${esc(id)}.jpg" alt=""></div>` : `<div class="pe3-tb">${b ? bannerHtml(b.id, 'pe3-bimg') : ''}</div>`; }
    if (k === 'pbg') return `<div class="pe3-tb pe4-kit">${/^b[45]_/.test(id) ? `<img src="assets/pbg/${esc(id)}.jpg" alt="">` : bannerHtml(id, 'pe3-bimg')}</div>`;
    if (k === 'sticker') return `<div class="pe3-tq"><img class="pe4-stk" src="assets/sticker/${esc(id)}.svg" alt=""></div>`;
    if (k === 'ncolor') return `<div class="pe3-tq"><span class="pe3-nk" style="color:${esc(E.catalog.ncolorHex?.[id] || '#fff')}">${esc(p.nick)}</span></div>`;
    if (k === 'music') { const on = typeof kzMusOn === 'function' && kzMusOn(id); return `<div class="pe3-tb pe4-kit pe4-mus"><img src="assets/music/${esc(id)}.jpg" alt="" onerror="this.remove()"><button class="mu-play pe4-mpl" data-mupl="${esc(id)}|menu" title="${esc(typeof kzMusT === 'function' ? kzMusT(on ? 'stop' : 'listen') : '')}">${typeof KZ_MUS_IC !== 'undefined' ? (on ? KZ_MUS_IC.stop : KZ_MUS_IC.play) : '▶'}</button></div>`; }
    if (k === 'theme' && typeof kzThemeThumb === 'function') return `<div class="pe3-tb pe4-kit pe4-th">${kzThemeThumb(id)}</div>`;
    if (k === 'vfx') return `<div class="pe3-tq"><i class="lc-vfxic big v-${esc(id)}">${typeof LCI !== 'undefined' ? LCI.spark : '✦'}</i></div>`;
    if (k === 'theme') return `<div class="pe3-tq"><span class="pe4-tx">◧</span></div>`;
    return '';
  }
  const kitCol = id => /^kit4_/.test(id) ? 'A' : /^kit5_/.test(id) ? 'D' : 'X';
  const kitTitle = id => { const b = kitParts(id).find(x => x.kind === 'banner'); return b ? nm('banner', b.id) : id; };
  function kitGrid(items) {
    const cols = ['X', 'D', 'A'].map(c => [c, items.filter(id => kitCol(id) === c)]).filter(([, a]) => a.length);
    return cols.map(([c, ids]) => `<h5 class="pe4-colh">${t('pe4_col' + c)} <i>${ids.length}</i></h5>` + ids.map(id => {
      const ps = kitParts(id), hv = ps.filter(x => hasItem(x.kind, x.id)).length, all = hv === ps.length;
      const worn = ps.filter(x => isSlot(x.kind)).every(x => D.cosmetics[x.kind] === x.id);
      const kb = (ps.find(x => x.kind === 'banner') || {}).id;
      const chips = ps.map(x => `<span class="pe4-chip ${hasItem(x.kind, x.id) ? 'ok' : ''}">${hasItem(x.kind, x.id) ? '✓' : '·'} ${t('pe4_part_' + x.kind)}</span>`).join('')
        + ((E.catalog.pbgs || []).includes(kb) ? `<span class="pe4-chip ${D.pbg === kb ? 'ok' : ''}">${D.pbg === kb ? '✓' : '·'} ${t('pe4_part_pbg')}</span>` : '');
      return `<div class="pe3-it wide pe4-kitc ${all ? 'has' : ''} ${worn ? 'on' : ''}" title="${esc(id)}">${thumb('kit', id)}
        <div class="pe3-in"><b>${esc(kitTitle(id))}</b><span>${worn ? `<em class="on">${t('pe3_worn')}</em>` : ''}<em>${all ? t('pe4_hasAll') : t('pe4_hasN', { n: hv, m: ps.length })}</em></span></div>
        <div class="pe4-chips">${chips}</div>
        <div class="pe4-btns"><button class="pe3-gv ${all ? 'rev' : ''}" data-pe3-own="${esc(id)}">${all ? t('pe4_take') : t('pe4_give')}</button><button class="pe3-gv pe4-wear" data-pe3-eq="${esc(id)}">${t('pe4_giveWear')}</button></div></div>`;
    }).join('')).join('') || `<p class="mute pe3-empty">${t('pe3_nothingFound')}</p>`;
  }
  function cosGrid() {
    const raw = E.catalog[GK[cosK]] || [], list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : Object.keys(raw), q = cosQ.trim().toLowerCase();
    const items = list.filter(id => (!q || id.toLowerCase().includes(q) || nm(cosK, id).toLowerCase().includes(q)) && (cosF === 'all' || (cosF === 'has') === hasItem(cosK, id)));
    if (cosK === 'kit') return kitGrid(items.filter(id => !q || kitTitle(id).toLowerCase().includes(q) || id.includes(q)));
    const cur = cosK === 'pbg' ? D.pbg || '' : D.cosmetics[cosK] || '';
    const none = !q && cosF !== 'no' && (isSlot(cosK) || cosK === 'pbg') ? `<div class="pe3-it none ${!cur ? 'on' : ''}" data-pe3-eq=""><div class="pe3-tq"><span class="pe3-nn">${IC.x}</span></div><div class="pe3-in"><b>${t('pe_none')}</b></div></div>` : '';
    return none + items.map(id => {
      const own = cosK === 'kit' ? kitParts(id).every(x => (D.own[GK[x.kind]] || []).includes(x.id)) : (D.own[GK[cosK]] || []).includes(id), has = hasItem(cosK, id), src = srcOf(cosK, id), on = (isSlot(cosK) || cosK === 'pbg') && cur === id;
      return `<div class="pe3-it ${on ? 'on' : ''} ${has ? 'has' : ''} ${['banner', 'kit', 'pbg'].includes(cosK) ? 'wide' : ''}" data-pe3-eq="${esc(id)}" title="${esc(id)}">${thumb(cosK, id)}
        <div class="pe3-in"><b>${esc(nm(cosK, id))}</b><span>${on ? `<em class="on">${t('pe3_worn')}</em>` : ''}${src ? `<em>${src}</em>` : ''}</span></div>
        ${cosK === 'pbg' ? '' : `<button class="pe3-gv ${own ? 'rev' : ''}" data-pe3-own="${esc(id)}">${own ? t('pe3_revoke') : t('pe3_grant')}</button>`}</div>`;
    }).join('') || `<p class="mute pe3-empty">${t('pe3_nothingFound')}</p>`;
  }
  function cosHtml() {
    const p = fake();
    const slots = KINDS.map(([k, , lk]) => `<div class="pe3-slot ${(D.cosmetics[k] || '') !== (E.cosmetics[k] || '') ? 'chg' : ''}"><i>${t(lk)}</i><b>${k === 'color' && D.cosmetics[k] ? `<span class="pe3-sw0" style="background:${esc(D.cosmetics[k])}"></span>` : ''}${esc(nm(k, D.cosmetics[k]))}</b>${D.cosmetics[k] ? `<button class="pe3-lnk" data-pe3-off="${k}" title="${t('pe3_take')}">${IC.x}</button>` : ''}</div>`).join('');
    return `<div class="pe3-cos">
      <aside class="pe3-card pe3-pv"><h4>${t('pe3_preview')}</h4>
        <div class="pe3-pvc">${p.prem.banner ? bannerHtml(p.prem.banner, 'pe3-pvb') : ''}<div class="pe3-pvin">${avaF(p, 'lg', p.prem.frame)}<b>${nickHtml(p)}</b></div></div>

      <div class="pe3-cm">

        ${cosK === 'kit' ? `<p class="mute pe3-hint">${t('pe4_kitHint')}</p>` : cosK === 'music' ? `<p class="mute pe3-hint">${t('pe4_musHint')}</p>` : cosK === 'pbg' ? `<p class="mute pe3-hint">${t('pe4_pbgHint')}</p>` : ''}

  const rwTxt = r => !r ? '' : r.kind === 'kf' ? `${r.amount} KF` : `${t('pe3_kind_' + r.kind)}${r.id ? ' · ' + (typeof cosName === 'function' ? cosName(r.id) : r.id) : ''}`;
  function passHtml() {
    const e = E, X = e.pass.xpPerLevel, N = e.pass.levels;

  function updPass() {
    const b = box(); if (!b) return;
    const X = E.pass.xpPerLevel, N = E.pass.levels, xp = D.pass.xp, lv = Number.isFinite(xp) ? Math.min(N, Math.floor(xp / X)) : 0;
    b.querySelector('#pe3-plv').textContent = lv;
    const rg = b.querySelector('#pe3-prange'); if (rg && +rg.value !== lv) rg.value = lv;
    const xi = b.querySelector('#pe3-pxin'), xa = b.querySelector('#pe3-pxp');
    if (xi && document.activeElement !== xi) xi.value = lv >= N ? 0 : xp - lv * X;
    if (xa && document.activeElement !== xa) xa.value = xp;
    xa?.classList.toggle('bad', !!badInt(xp, N * X)); xa?.classList.toggle('chg', xp !== E.pass.xp);
    b.querySelector('#pe3-pbar').style.width = (lv >= N ? 100 : (xp - lv * X) / X * 100) + '%';
    b.querySelector('#pe3-pwas').textContent = xp !== E.pass.xp ? t('pe3_was', { v: `${E.pass.level} · ${fmtN(E.pass.xp)} XP` }) : '';
    const tr = E.passTrack, cl = E.passClaimed || { f: [], p: [] };
    if (tr) b.querySelector('#pe3-track').innerHTML = tr.f.map((f, i) => { const n = i + 1, p = tr.p[i];
      return `<div class="pe3-tl ${n <= lv ? 'got' : ''} ${n === lv ? 'cur' : ''}"><b>${n}</b><span class="${cl.f.includes(n) ? 'cl' : ''}" title="${esc(rwTxt(f))}">${esc(rwTxt(f))}</span><span class="pr ${D.pass.prem ? '' : 'lk'} ${cl.p.includes(n) ? 'cl' : ''}" title="${esc(rwTxt(p))}">${esc(rwTxt(p))}</span></div>`; }).join('');
  }

  const ROLES = ['owner', 'officer', 'member'];

  async function clanAct(el) {
    const c = E.clan, v = id => box().querySelector('#' + id)?.value ?? '', act = el.dataset.pe4c;
    const body = { uid: E.id, id: c?.id, act };
    if (act === 'add') { body.id = v('pe4-cpick'); body.member = E.id; if (!body.id) return toast(t('pe4_pick'), true); }
    else if (act === 'create') { body.name = v('pe4-cname'); body.tag = v('pe4-ctag').toUpperCase(); }
    else if (act === 'rename') { body.name = v('pe4-cname'); body.tag = v('pe4-ctag').toUpperCase(); }
    else if (act === 'desc') body.desc = v('pe4-cdesc');
    else if (act === 'cw') { body.elo = v('pe4-cwe'); body.w = v('pe4-cww'); body.l = v('pe4-cwl'); }
    else if (act === 'owner') body.member = el.dataset.m;
    else if (act === 'kick') { body.member = el.dataset.m; if (!confirm(t('pe4_kickQ', { n: el.dataset.n }))) return; }
    else if (act === 'disband') { if (!confirm(t('pe4_disbandQ', { t: c.tag }))) return; }
    else if (act === 'look') {
      if (v('pe4-cemb') !== c.emblem) { E = await api('/api/admin/clan', { ...body, act: 'emblem', value: v('pe4-cemb') }); }
      if (v('pe4-cban') !== (E.clan?.banner || '')) { E = await api('/api/admin/clan', { ...body, act: 'banner', value: v('pe4-cban') }); }
      toast(t('pe4_done')); return drawBody();
    }
    const keep = D; E = await api('/api/admin/clan', body); D = keep; toast(t('pe4_done')); drawBody();
  }

  function bodyHtml() { return tab === 'clan' ? clanHtml() : tab === 'rating' ? ratingHtml() : tab === 'eco' ? ecoHtml() : tab === 'cos' ? cosHtml() : tab === 'pass' ? passHtml() : profileHtml(); }
  function footHtml() {
    const { rows } = diff(), { err } = check(), n = rows.length;
    const st = err.length ? `<span class="pe3-st bad">${IC.warn}<b>${t('pe3_errs', { n: err.length })}</b><span class="mute">${esc(err[0])}</span></span>`
      : n ? `<span class="pe3-st dirty"><i class="pe3-pulse"></i><b>${n === 1 ? t('pe3_dirty1') : t('pe3_dirty', { n })}</b><button class="pe3-lnk" id="pe3-review">${t('pe3_show')}</button><button class="pe3-lnk" id="pe3-revert">${IC.undo}${t('pe3_revert')}</button></span>`
      : `<span class="pe3-st"><b class="mute">${t('pe3_clean')}</b></span>`;
    return `${st}<span class="grow"></span><span class="pe3-keys mute">${t('pe3_keys')}</span>
      <button class="btn ghost" id="pe3-cancel">${t('pe3_cancel')}</button>
      <button class="btn" id="pe3-save" ${!n || err.length || busy ? 'disabled' : ''}>${IC.save}${busy ? t('pe3_saving') : t('pe3_save')}${n && !busy ? `<i class="pe3-cnt">${n}</i>` : ''}</button>`;
  }
  function sheetHtml() {
    if (sheet === 'review') {
      const { rows } = diff(), money = rows.some(r => r.tab === 'eco' || r.tab === 'cos');
      const groups = TABS.map(([k, n]) => { const rs = rows.filter(r => r.tab === k); return rs.length ? `<div class="pe3-dg"><h5>${t(n)}</h5>${rs.map(r => `<div class="pe3-dr"><span class="pe3-dlab">${esc(r.label)}</span>${r.from !== '' ? `<s>${esc(String(r.from))}</s>${IC.arrow}` : ''}<b>${esc(String(r.to))}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>` : ''; }).join('');
      return `<div class="pe3-sh"><h3>${t('pe3_review')}</h3><p class="mute">${t('pe3_reviewSub', { nick: esc(E.nick) })}</p>
        <div class="pe3-diff">${groups || `<p class="mute">${t('pe3_noChanges')}</p>`}</div>
        ${money ? `<label class="pe3-f"><span>${t('pe3_reason')}</span><input id="pe3-reason2" maxlength="200" placeholder="${t('pe3_reasonPh')}" value="${esc(D.reason)}"></label>` : ''}
        ${sheetErr ? `<div class="pe3-err">${IC.warn}<span>${esc(sheetErr)}</span></div>` : ''}
        <div class="pe3-sha"><span class="mute pe3-keys">Enter / Ctrl+S</span><span class="grow"></span><button class="btn ghost" data-pe3-sh="back">${t('pe3_back')}</button><button class="btn" data-pe3-sh="go" ${busy ? 'disabled' : ''}>${IC.check}${busy ? t('pe3_saving') : t('pe3_confirm')}</button></div></div>`;
    }
    if (sheet === 'close') {
      const n = diff().rows.length, bad = check().err.length;
      return `<div class="pe3-sh sm"><h3>${t('pe3_closeQ')}</h3><p class="mute">${t('pe3_closeSub', { n })}</p>
        ${sheetErr ? `<div class="pe3-err">${IC.warn}<span>${esc(sheetErr)}</span></div>` : ''}
        <div class="pe3-sha"><button class="btn ghost" data-pe3-sh="back">${t('pe3_keep')}</button><span class="grow"></span><button class="btn red" data-pe3-sh="discard">${t('pe3_discard')}</button>${bad ? '' : `<button class="btn" data-pe3-sh="saveclose" ${busy ? 'disabled' : ''}>${busy ? t('pe3_saving') : t('pe3_saveClose')}</button>`}</div></div>`;
    }
    return '';
  }

  function refresh() {
    const b = box(); if (!b) return;
    const { rows } = diff();
    b.querySelector('#pe3-head').innerHTML = headHtml();
    b.querySelector('#pe3-tabs').innerHTML = tabsHtml(rows);
    b.querySelector('#pe3-foot').innerHTML = footHtml();
    const sh = b.querySelector('#pe3-sheet'); sh.hidden = !sheet;
    if (sheet) { const f = document.activeElement?.id; sh.innerHTML = `<div class="pe3-shbg" data-pe3-sh="back"></div>${sheetHtml()}`; if (f && sh.querySelector('#' + f)) sh.querySelector('#' + f).focus(); }
    else sh.innerHTML = '';
    if (tab === 'profile') {
      const nk = b.querySelector('#pe3-nick'); if (nk) { nk.classList.toggle('chg', String(D.nick).trim() !== E.nick); nk.classList.toggle('bad', check().bad.has('nick')); b.querySelector('#pe3-nlen').textContent = `${String(D.nick).trim().length}/25`; b.querySelector('#pe3-was-nick').textContent = String(D.nick).trim() !== E.nick ? t('pe3_was', { v: E.nick }) : ''; }
      const gi = b.querySelector('#pe3-gid'); if (gi) { gi.classList.toggle('chg', String(D.gameId).trim() !== E.gameId); b.querySelector('#pe3-was-gid').textContent = String(D.gameId).trim() !== E.gameId ? t('pe3_was', { v: E.gameId || '—' }) : ''; }
    }
    if (tab === 'rating') MODES.forEach(updRating);
    if (tab === 'eco') updEco();
    if (tab === 'pass') updPass();
  }
  function drawBody() { const b = box(); if (!b) return; const bd = b.querySelector('#pe3-body'), y = bd.scrollTop; bd.innerHTML = bodyHtml(); bd.scrollTop = y; refresh(); }
  function drawItems() { const el = box()?.querySelector('#pe3-items'); if (el) { el.innerHTML = cosGrid(); el.className = 'pe3-items ' + cosK + (['kit', 'pbg', 'music', 'theme'].includes(cosK) ? ' banner' : ''); } refresh(); }

  function open() {
    modal(`<div class="card pe3" id="pe3" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><div class="pe3-head" id="pe3-head"></div><div class="pe3-tabs" id="pe3-tabs"></div>
      <div class="pe3-body" id="pe3-body"></div><div class="pe3-foot" id="pe3-foot"></div><div class="pe3-sheet" id="pe3-sheet" hidden></div></div>`, mb => {
      mb.querySelector('.overlay').onclick = ev => { if (ev.target.classList.contains('overlay')) requestClose(); };
      const b = mb.querySelector('#pe3');
      b.addEventListener('click', onClick);
      b.addEventListener('input', onInput);
      b.addEventListener('change', onInput);
      drawBody();
    });
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }
  function shut() { sheet = null; sheetErr = ''; document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); if (box()) closeModal(); }
  function requestClose() {
    if (busy) return;
    if (diff().rows.length) { sheet = 'close'; sheetErr = ''; refresh(); return; }
    shut();
  }

  async function save(thenClose) {
    if (busy) return;
    const { set, rows } = diff(), { err } = check();
    if (!rows.length) { toast(t('pe_nothing')); sheet = null; return refresh(); }
    if (err.length) { toast(err[0], true); return; }
    busy = true; sheetErr = ''; refresh();
    try {
      const id = E.id, prevTab = tab;
      const res = await api('/api/admin/player', { uid: id, set, reason: D.reason || undefined });
      E = res; D = draftOf(res); busy = false; sheet = null; tab = prevTab;
      toast(t('pe_saved', { f: rows.length + ' · ' + [...new Set(rows.map(r => r.label))].slice(0, 4).join(', ') + (rows.length > 4 ? '…' : '') }));
      if (id === S.me?.id) { try { S.me = await api('/api/me'); renderMe(); } catch {} }
      if (S.page === 'profile' && typeof renderProfile === 'function') { S.profCache = null; try { renderProfile()?.catch?.(() => {}); } catch {} }
      if (thenClose) return shut();
      drawBody();
    } catch (er) {
      busy = false; sheetErr = er.message; if (!sheet) sheet = 'review';
      toast(t('pe3_err', { e: er.message }), true); refresh();
    }
  }

  async function copy(v) {
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(v); } catch { const ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = v; document.body.append(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove(); }
    toast(t('pe3_copied', { v }));
  }

  function onKey(ev) {
    if (!box()) { document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true); return; }
    if ((ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey) && ev.code === 'KeyS') {
      ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
      if (sheet === 'review') return save(false);
      if (diff().rows.length && !check().err.length) { sheet = 'review'; sheetErr = ''; refresh(); }
      else if (check().err.length) toast(check().err[0], true); else toast(t('pe_nothing'));
      return;
    }
    if (ev.key === 'Escape') {
      ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
      if (sheet) { if (!busy) { sheet = null; sheetErr = ''; refresh(); } return; }
      return requestClose();
    }
    if (ev.key === 'Enter' && sheet === 'review' && !busy) { ev.preventDefault(); save(false); }
  }

  const num = v => v === '' ? NaN : Number(v);
  function onInput(ev) {
    const el = ev.target;
    if (el.id === 'pe3-nick') D.nick = el.value;
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-gid') D.gameId = el.value;
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-hide') D.hideLb = el.checked;
    else if (el.dataset.pe3R) D.ratings[el.dataset.pe3R][el.dataset.f] = num(el.value);
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-kf') D.coins = num(el.value);
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-reason' || el.id === 'pe3-reason2') { D.reason = el.value; return; }
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-until') { if (ev.type !== 'change' && !el.value) return; D.premium.until = el.value ? new Date(el.value).getTime() : 0; }
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-q') { cosQ = el.value; return drawItems(); }
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-prange') { const lv = +el.value, X = E.pass.xpPerLevel; D.pass.xp = lv * X; }
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-pxin') { const X = E.pass.xpPerLevel, N = E.pass.levels, lv = Math.min(N, Math.floor((D.pass.xp || 0) / X)), v = num(el.value); D.pass.xp = Number.isFinite(v) ? lv * X + Math.max(0, Math.min(X - 1, Math.round(v))) : NaN; }
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-pxp') D.pass.xp = num(el.value);
    else if (el.id === 'pe3-pprem') D.pass.prem = el.checked;
    else if (el.id === 'pe4-pxp') { D.pxp = num(el.value); el.classList.toggle('chg', D.pxp !== E.pxp?.xp); }
    else if (el.dataset.pe4Role) { if (ev.type !== 'change') return; const keep = D; run(async () => { E = await api('/api/admin/clan', { uid: E.id, id: E.clan.id, act: 'role', member: el.dataset.pe4Role, role: el.value }); D = keep; toast(t('pe4_done')); drawBody(); })(); return; }
    else if (el.id === 'pe4-cpart') { if (ev.type !== 'change') return; const keep = D; run(async () => { E = await api('/api/admin/clan', { uid: E.id, id: E.clan.id, act: 'partner', on: el.checked }); D = keep; toast(t('pe4_done')); drawBody(); })(); return; }
    else if (/^pe4-c/.test(el.id)) return;
    else return;
    refresh();
  }

  function onClick(ev) {
    const el = ev.target.closest('button, [data-pe3-eq]'); if (!el) return;
    const d = el.dataset;
    if (el.id === 'pe3-close' || el.id === 'pe3-cancel') return requestClose();
    if (el.id === 'pe3-save') { if (diff().rows.length && !check().err.length) { sheet = 'review'; sheetErr = ''; refresh(); } return; }
    if (el.id === 'pe3-review') { sheet = 'review'; sheetErr = ''; return refresh(); }
    if (el.id === 'pe3-revert') { const r = D.reason; D = draftOf(E); D.reason = r; return drawBody(); }
    if (d.pe3Sh) {
      if (d.pe3Sh === 'back') { if (!busy) { sheet = null; sheetErr = ''; refresh(); } return; }
      if (d.pe3Sh === 'go') return save(false);
      if (d.pe3Sh === 'saveclose') return save(true);
      if (d.pe3Sh === 'discard') return shut();
    }
    if (d.pe3Copy) return copy(d.pe3Copy);
    if (d.pe3Tab) { tab = d.pe3Tab; return drawBody(); }
    if (el.id === 'pe-2fa') return run(async () => { if (!confirm(t('pe_tfaQ'))) return; const st = await api('/api/admin/2fa/reset', { uid: E.id }); E.tfa = { totp: st.totp, dm: st.dm }; toast(t('pe_tfaDone')); drawBody(); })();
    if (d.pe3Badge) { const b = d.pe3Badge; D.badges = D.badges.includes(b) ? D.badges.filter(x => x !== b) : [...D.badges, b]; el.classList.toggle('on', D.badges.includes(b)); return refresh(); }
    if (d.pe3Step) { const r = D.ratings[d.m]; r.elo = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAXV.elo, (Number.isFinite(r.elo) ? r.elo : E.ratings[d.m].elo) + +d.pe3Step)); const i = box().querySelector(`[data-pe3-r="${d.m}"][data-f="elo"]`); if (i) i.value = r.elo; return refresh(); }
    if (d.pe3Reset || d.pe3Revm) {
      const m = d.pe3Reset || d.pe3Revm;
      D.ratings[m] = d.pe3Reset ? { elo: E.startElo ?? 200, w: 0, l: 0, k: 0, d: 0 } : { ...Object.fromEntries(RF.map(f => [f, E.ratings[m][f]])) };
      for (const f of RF) { const i = box().querySelector(`[data-pe3-r="${m}"][data-f="${f}"]`); if (i) i.value = D.ratings[m][f]; }
      if (d.pe3Reset) toast(t('pe3_resetQ', { m: mx(m), e: E.startElo ?? 200 }));
      return refresh();
    }
    if (d.pe3Kf != null || d.pe3Kf0 != null || d.pe3Kfr != null) {
      D.coins = d.pe3Kf0 != null ? 0 : d.pe3Kfr != null ? E.coins : Math.max(0, Math.min(MAXV.coins, (Number.isFinite(D.coins) ? D.coins : E.coins) + +d.pe3Kf));
      const i = box().querySelector('#pe3-kf'); if (i) i.value = D.coins; return refresh();
    }
    if (d.pe3Tier != null) {
      const x = d.pe3Tier;
      D.premium = x ? { tier: x, until: D.premium.until > Date.now() ? D.premium.until : (premOn(E.premium) ? E.premium.until : Date.now() + 30 * 864e5) } : { tier: '', until: 0 };
      return drawBody();
    }
    if (d.pe3Days) {
      if (!D.premium.tier) D.premium.tier = E.catalog.tiers.includes('premium') ? 'premium' : E.catalog.tiers[0];
      D.premium.until = Math.max(Date.now(), D.premium.until || 0) + +d.pe3Days * 864e5;
      return drawBody();
    }
    if (d.pe3Kind) { if (cosK !== d.pe3Kind) cosQ = ''; cosK = d.pe3Kind; return drawBody(); }
    if (d.pe3F) { cosF = d.pe3F; box().querySelectorAll('[data-pe3-f]').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.pe3F === cosF)); return drawItems(); }
    if (d.pe3Off) { D.cosmetics[d.pe3Off] = ''; return drawBody(); }
    if (d.pe3Own != null && cosK === 'kit') {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      const ps = kitParts(d.pe3Own), all = ps.every(x => (D.own[GK[x.kind]] || []).includes(x.id));
      for (const x of ps) { const g = GK[x.kind]; D.own[g] = all ? D.own[g].filter(y => y !== x.id) : [...new Set([...(D.own[g] || []), x.id])]; }
      return drawBody();
    }
    if (d.pe3Own != null) {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      const g = GK[cosK], id = d.pe3Own;

      return drawBody();

    if (d.pe3Eq != null && cosK === 'kit') {

      const kb = kitParts(d.pe3Eq).find(x => x.kind === 'banner'); if (kb && (E.catalog.pbgs || []).includes(kb.id)) D.pbg = kb.id;
      return drawBody();
    }
    if (d.pe3Eq != null && !isSlot(cosK)) { const g = GK[cosK], id = d.pe3Eq; if (id) D.own[g] = (D.own[g] || []).includes(id) ? D.own[g].filter(x => x !== id) : [...(D.own[g] || []), id]; return drawBody(); }
    if (d.pe3Eq != null) {
      const id = d.pe3Eq; D.cosmetics[cosK] = id;
      if (id && !hasItem(cosK, id)) D.own[GK[cosK]] = [...D.own[GK[cosK]], id];
      return drawBody();
    }
    if (d.pe4Pxl != null) { D.pxp = +d.pe4Pxl; return drawBody(); }
    if (d.pe4c) return run(() => clanAct(el))();
    if (d.pe3Plv) { const X = E.pass.xpPerLevel, N = E.pass.levels, lv = Math.min(N, Math.floor((D.pass.xp || 0) / X)); D.pass.xp = Math.max(0, Math.min(N, lv + +d.pe3Plv)) * X; return refresh(); }
    if (d.pe3Prev != null) { D.pass.xp = E.pass.xp; return refresh(); }
  }

  document.addEventListener('kz:packpreview', () => { if (box() && cosK === 'music') try { drawItems(); } catch {} });
  window.openPlayerEditor = async function (uid) {
    if (!S.me?.admin) return;
    const e = await api('/api/admin/player?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(uid));
    if (E?.id !== e.id) { tab = 'profile'; cosQ = ''; cosF = 'all'; }

  const od = window.openDossier;

    }
    return r;
  };

  const rs = window.renderStaff;
  if (typeof rs === 'function') window.renderStaff = async function (...a) {
    const r = await rs.apply(this, a);
    if (S.page === 'staff' && S.staffTab === 'players' && S.me?.admin) {
      const body = document.querySelector('.stab-body');
      if (body && !body.querySelector('#pe-mecard')) {
        const me = await api('/api/admin/player?uid=' + encodeURIComponent(S.me.id)).catch(() => null);
        if (!me || !document.querySelector('.stab-body') || document.querySelector('#pe-mecard')) return r;
        const el = document.createElement('div'); el.className = 'card accent'; el.id = 'pe-mecard'; el.style.marginBottom = '18px';
        el.innerHTML = `<div class="row" style="flex-wrap:wrap"><div class="grow" style="min-width:240px"><h4 style="margin:0 0 4px">${t('pe_me')}</h4><span class="mute">${t('pe_meHint')}</span></div>
          <label class="pe-chk pe-hide"><input type="checkbox" id="pe-mehide" ${me.hideLb ? 'checked' : ''}> <b>${t('pe_hide')}</b></label><button class="btn" id="pe-meedit">✎ ${t('pe_btn')}</button></div>`;
        body.prepend(el);
        el.querySelector('#pe-meedit').onclick = () => openPlayerEditor(S.me.id).catch(e => toast(e.message, true));
        el.querySelector('#pe-mehide').onchange = run(async ev => { await api('/api/admin/player', { uid: S.me.id, set: { hideLb: ev.target.checked } }); toast(t(ev.target.checked ? 'pe_hidden' : 'pe_shown')); });
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();
```

```js
  function giftModal(pi, tier) {

  function pxSection(px) {

  function pxModal(px, pi) {
```

`app/src/presence.js`:

```js
(() => {
  const K = window.konzte;
  if (!K?.presence) return;
  const SITE = 'https://konzte.online';
  const MODE = { '2v2': '2v2', '1v1': '1v1', '5v5': '5v5' };
  const MAP_TITLE = { TrainYard: 'Train Yard' };
  const MAP_IMG = new Set(['Caribbean', 'Drain', 'Egypt', 'Fuji', 'Highrise', 'Museum', 'Subway', 'TrainYard', 'Warehouse']);
  let appId = null, lastKey = '', liveSince = {}, menuSince = Date.now(), off = false;

  async function loadApp() {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(S.server + '/public/info').then(x => x.json());
      if (r?.discordApp && r.discordApp !== appId) { appId = r.discordApp; K.presenceClient(appId); lastKey = ''; }
    } catch {}
  }

  const enabled = () => S.cfg?.discordPresence !== false && !S.cfg?.streamer;
  const lvlImg = l => `${SITE}/assets/lvl/lvl${Math.max(0, Math.min(10, l | 0))}.png`;
  const mapImg = m => MAP_IMG.has(m) ? `${SITE}/assets/rpc/${m}.jpg` : `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`;
  const mapTitle = m => MAP_TITLE[m] || m;

  const clock = () => {
    if (!S.cfg?.presenceClock) return '';
    const d = new Date(), off = -d.getTimezoneOffset(), h = Math.trunc(Math.abs(off) / 60), m = Math.abs(off) % 60;
    const tz = 'UTC' + (off >= 0 ? '+' : '-') + h + (m ? ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') : '');
    return `${d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })} local (${tz})`;
  };
  const withClock = s => { const c = clock(); return c ? (s ? `${s} · ${c}` : c).slice(0, 128) : s; };
  function rankLine(mode) {
    const r = S.me?.['r' + mode];
    if (!r) return '';
    if (isCal(r)) return `Calibration ${r.cal}/5`;
    return `Level ${levelOf(r.elo)} · ${r.elo} ELO`;
  }
  function small(mode) {
    const r = S.me?.['r' + mode];
    if (!r || isCal(r)) return { smallImage: `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`, smallText: 'Konzte Faceit' };
    return { smallImage: lvlImg(levelOf(r.elo)), smallText: rankLine(mode) };
  }
  const buttons = () => [
    { label: 'Join Konzte Discord', url: `${SITE}/discord` },
    ...(S.me?.id ? [{ label: 'View profile', url: `${SITE}/p/${encodeURIComponent(S.me.id)}` }] : []),
  ];

  function party(mode, m) {
    const max = { '1v1': 1, '2v2': 2, '5v5': 5 }[mode] || 2;
    if (m) return { partyId: 'konzte-m' + m.id + (m.me || ''), partySize: max, partyMax: max };
    const p = S.live?.party, n = p?.members?.length || 1;
    return { partyId: 'konzte-' + (p?.leader || S.me?.id || 'solo'), partySize: Math.min(n, max), partyMax: max };
  }
  function activity() {
    const st = S.live, m = st?.match, me = S.me;
    if (!me) return null;
    const base = { buttons: buttons(), largeText: 'Konzte Faceit — ranked Combat Master', ...party(m?.mode || st?.myQueue || S.mode || '2v2', m) };
    if (m || st?.myQueue || st?.ready) menuSince = null;
    if (m) {
      const mode = MODE[m.mode] || m.mode, side = m.me, team = side === 'A' ? 'Alfa' : side === 'B' ? 'Bravo' : null;
      const vs = m.clanWar?.A && m.clanWar?.B ? `[${m.clanWar.A.tag}] vs [${m.clanWar.B.tag}]` : 'Alfa vs Bravo';
      if (m.state === 'pick') return { ...base, details: `Ranked ${mode} · picking teams`, state: vs, largeImage: `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`, ...small(m.mode) };
      if (m.state === 'ban') return { ...base, details: `Ranked ${mode} · map veto`, state: `${m.mapsLeft?.length || '?'} maps left`, largeImage: `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`, ...small(m.mode) };
      const since = m.liveAt || (liveSince[m.id] ||= Date.now());
      if (m.state === 'live') return { ...base, details: `Ranked ${mode} · ${mapTitle(m.map || '')}`, state: team ? `Playing for ${team}` : 'In a match', start: since, largeImage: mapImg(m.map), largeText: mapTitle(m.map || ''), ...small(m.mode) };
      return { ...base, details: `Ranked ${mode} · ${mapTitle(m.map || '')}`, state: m.state === 'disputed' ? 'Result under review' : 'Submitting the result', largeImage: mapImg(m.map), largeText: mapTitle(m.map || ''), ...small(m.mode) };
    }
    const mode = st?.myQueue || S.mode || '2v2';
    if (st?.ready) return { ...base, details: `Ranked ${MODE[mode] || mode} · match found`, state: 'Accepting the match', largeImage: `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`, ...small(mode) };
    if (st?.myQueue) {
      const pTxt = st.party?.members?.length > 1 ? ` · party of ${st.party.members.length}` : '';
      return { ...base, details: `Searching ranked ${MODE[mode] || mode}${pTxt}`, state: rankLine(mode) || 'In queue', start: S.queuedAt || Date.now(), largeImage: `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`, ...small(mode) };
    }
    const lobby = st?.party?.members?.length > 1 ? `In a party (${st.party.members.length}/${mode === '1v1' ? 1 : 2})` : 'In the lobby';
    return { ...base, details: lobby, state: rankLine(mode) || 'Konzte Faceit', start: (menuSince ||= Date.now()), largeImage: `${SITE}/assets/rpc/logo.png`, ...small(mode) };
  }

  function update() {
    if (!appId) return;
    if (!enabled()) { if (!off) { off = true; lastKey = ''; K.presenceClear(); } return; }
    off = false;
    let a = null;
    try { a = activity(); } catch (e) { console.error('[presence]', e); return; }
    if (a && S.cfg?.presenceClock) a = { ...a, state: withClock(a.state) };
    const key = JSON.stringify(a);
    if (key === lastKey) return;
    lastKey = key;
    if (a) K.presence(a); else K.presenceClear();
  }

  loadApp();
  setInterval(loadApp, 30 * 60_000);
  setInterval(update, 3000);
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => { try { K.presenceClear(); } catch {} });
})();
```

```js
  if (!d || !$('#st-gdpr')) return;

  $('#pv7-cor-b').onclick = run(async () => { await api('/api/privacy/correct', { text: $('#pv7-cor').value }); toast(pv7('sent')); renderGdpr(); });
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-pvm]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { mode = b.dataset.pvm; box.querySelectorAll('[data-pvm]').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === b)); });

  if ($('#pv7-del')) $('#pv7-del').onclick = run(async () => { if (!confirm(pv7('r5q'))) return; await api('/api/privacy/delete', { nick: $('#pv7-nick').value }); renderGdpr(); });
  if ($('#pv7-cancel')) $('#pv7-cancel').onclick = run(async () => { await api('/api/privacy/delete-cancel', {}); renderGdpr(); });
}
```

```js
const p2q = key => `<i class="p2-q" data-tip="${esc(t(key))}">?</i>`;
{
  let box = null;
  const hide = () => { if (box) box.hidden = true; };
  document.addEventListener('mouseover', e => {
    const el = e.target.closest?.('[data-tip]');
    if (!el) return hide();
    if (!box) { box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'p2-tipbox'; document.body.append(box); }
    box.textContent = el.dataset.tip; box.hidden = false; box.__el = el;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), w = box.offsetWidth, h = box.offsetHeight;
    box.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(innerWidth - w - 8, r.left + r.width / 2 - w / 2)) + 'px';
    box.style.top = (r.bottom + h + 10 > innerHeight ? r.top - h - 8 : r.bottom + 8) + 'px';
  });
  document.addEventListener('scroll', hide, true);
  document.addEventListener('mousedown', hide, true);
  setInterval(() => { if (box && !box.hidden && !box.__el?.isConnected) hide(); }, 400);
}
const cosName = id => {
  if (!id) return '—';
  const k = 'cos_' + id, v = t(k);
  if (v !== k) return v;
  return id.replace(/^(s_|a2_kz_|a2_|a3_|c_|k_|a_|b3_|k3_|b4_|k4_|b5_|k5_|kit4_|kit5_|e3_|av_an_|av_df_|av_)(?=[a-z0-9])/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
};

function p2LvInfo(r) {
  const lvl = r.lvl ?? levelOf(r.elo), nx = r.next ?? LEVELS[lvl + 1], mn = r.min ?? LEVELS[lvl] ?? 0;
  return { lvl, nx, pct: nx ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (r.elo - mn) / (nx - mn) * 100)) : 100 };
}
function p2Graph(ms, nx, lvl) {
  const pts = ms.filter(h => h.elo != null).reverse();
  if (pts.length) pts.unshift({ id: '—', elo: pts[0].elo - pts[0].delta, delta: 0 });
  if (pts.length < 3) return `<div class="p2-gnote mute">${t('p2_one')}</div>`;
  const W = 640, H = 170, P = 22, PL = 36;
  const vals = pts.map(p => p.elo);
  let lo = Math.min(...vals), hi = Math.max(...vals);
  const showNx = nx && nx - hi <= Math.max(60, hi - lo);
  if (showNx) hi = Math.max(hi, nx);
  lo -= 8; hi += 8;
  const x = i => PL + i * (W - PL - P) / (pts.length - 1);
  const y = v => H - P - (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (H - 2 * P);
  const line = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(p.elo).toFixed(1)}`).join('');
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
  return `<svg class="p2-graph" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none"><defs><linearGradient id="p2g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4c542" stop-opacity=".28"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f4c542" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient></defs>
    ${[0, 1].map(f => { const v = Math.round(lo + 8 + (hi - lo - 16) * f); return `<line class="gl" x1="${PL}" x2="${W - P}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}"/><text x="2" y="${y(v) + 3}">${v}</text>`; }).join('')}
    ${showNx ? `<line class="nx" x1="${PL}" x2="${W - P}" y1="${y(nx)}" y2="${y(nx)}"/><text class="nxt" x="${PL + 6}" y="${y(nx) - 5}">${t('p2_nextLine', { l: lvl + 1, e: nx })}</text>` : ''}
    <path class="ar" d="${line}L${x(pts.length - 1)},${H - P}L${x(0)},${H - P}Z"/><path class="ln" d="${line}"/>
    ${pts.map((p, i) => `<circle cx="${x(i)}" cy="${y(p.elo)}" r="${p === last ? 4.5 : 2.6}" class="${p === last ? 'last' : ''}"><title>#${p.id} · ${p.elo} (${sign(p.delta)})</title></circle>`).join('')}</svg>`;
}

async function renderProfile() {
  const id = S.profileId;
  const p = S.profCache?.id === id ? S.profCache : await api('/api/profile?id=' + encodeURIComponent(id)).catch(e => (toast(e.message, true), null));
  if (!p || S.page !== 'profile' || S.profileId !== id) return;
  S.profCache = p;
  setTimeout(() => { if (S.profCache === p) S.profCache = null; }, 15_000);
  const gm = m => modeGames(p, m);
  if (!S.profMode || !profModes(p).includes(S.profMode)) S.profMode = bestProfMode(p);
  const mode = S.profMode, other = profModes(p).filter(m => m !== mode).sort((a, b) => gm(b) - gm(a))[0];
  const r = p['r' + mode] || { elo: 1000, w: 0, l: 0, k: 0, d: 0 };
  const cal = isCal(r);
  const { lvl, nx } = p2LvInfo(r);
  const ms = p.matches.filter(h => h.mode === mode);
  const st = streaks(ms);
  const games = r.w + r.l;
  const empty = !games && !ms.length;
  const maps = mapsOf(p, mode);
  const isMe = p.id === S.me.id;
  const myTier = S.me.premium?.tier;
  const banner = p.prem?.banner;
  const achs = p.achievements || { list: [] };
  const pbg = p.pbg;
  const modeL = modeX(mode).replace(/ /g, '');
  const friend = S.live?.friends?.list?.some(x => x.id === p.id);
  const canCmp = !isMe && (friend || myTier === 'plus' || S.me.staff || S.me.admin);

  };

      <button class="btn ghost sm p2-rep" id="p-report" title="${t('report')}">${IC.flag}<span>${t('report')}</span></button>`;

      ${(S.me.staff || S.me.admin) && !isMe ? (p.ban ? `<button class="btn sm" id="p-unban">${t('unban')}</button>` : `<button class="btn red sm" id="p-ban">${t('ban')}</button>`) : ''}

          <span class="plv-need">${nx ? `${nx}<small>ELO</small>` : t('maxLevel')}</span></div>`}
      </div>`;

  const kpi = (v, label, tip, sub = '') => `<div class="p2-kpi"><b>${v}${sub}${tip ? p2q(tip) : ''}</b><span>${label}</span></div>`;
  const kpis = `<div class="p2-kpis">
      ${kpi(games, t('p2_kMatches'))}${kpi(wrNum(r) + '%', t('p2_kWr'), 'p2_wrHint', `<small class="mute"> ${r.w}–${r.l}</small>`)}
      ${kpi(kd(r.k, r.d), t('p2_kKd'), 'p2_kdHint')}${kpi(games ? (r.k / games).toFixed(1) : '0', t('p2_kAvg'))}
      ${kpi(st.best, t('p2_kStreak'), '', st.now ? `<small class="win"> ${t('p2_kNow', { n: st.now })}</small>` : '')}</div>`;

  let ser = 0; const won0 = ms[0]?.won; for (const h of ms) { if (h.won === won0) ser++; else break; }
  const form = ms.slice(0, 10);
  const recent = ms.slice(0, 5);
  const mrow = h => `<div class="p2-mr" data-mid="${h.id}"><i class="th" style="background-image:url(${mapImg(h.map)})"></i><b class="${h.won ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${h.won ? t('winShort') : t('lossShort')}</b>
      <span class="p2-mn">${mapName(h.map)}</span><span class="mute">${esc(h.score || '–')} · ${h.k}/${h.d}</span><span class="grow"></span>
      <span class="mute p2-md">${fmtDT(h.at)}</span><span class="num ${h.delta > 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'} p2-dl">${sign(h.delta)}</span></div>`;
  const histTable = `<table class="hist"><thead><tr><th>${t('result')}</th><th>#</th><th>${t('map')}</th><th>${t('score', { s: '' })}</th><th>K / D</th><th>K/D</th><th>ELO</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>
      ${ms.map(h => `<tr class="${h.won ? 'w' : ''}" data-mid="${h.id}"><td class="num ${h.won ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${h.won ? t('victory') : t('defeat')}</td><td class="mute">#${h.id}</td>
        <td><div class="row" style="gap:8px"><div class="th" style="width:44px;height:26px;border-radius:5px;background:url(${mapImg(h.map)}) center/cover"></div>${mapName(h.map)}</div></td>
        <td class="num">${esc(h.score || '–')}</td><td class="num">${h.k} / ${h.d}</td><td class="num">${kd(h.k, h.d)}</td>
        <td class="num"><span class="${h.delta > 0 ? 'win' : 'lose'}">${sign(h.delta)}</span>${h.elo != null ? ` <span class="mute">${h.elo}</span>` : ''}</td><td class="mute">${fmtDT(h.at)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;

  const mapRows = MAPS.map(x => { const s = maps[x] || { w: 0, l: 0 }, n = s.w + s.l; return { x, n, w: s.w, l: s.l, wr: n ? Math.round(s.w / n * 100) : -1 }; })
    .sort((a, b) => b.wr - a.wr || b.n - a.n);
  const bestMap = mapRows.find(m => m.n);
  const mapsCard = `<div class="card p2-maps"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('p2_maps')}</h4><span class="grow"></span>${bestMap ? `<span class="mute">${t('p2_bestMap', { m: mapName(bestMap.x) })}</span>` : ''}</div>
      ${mapRows.map(m => `<div class="p2-map ${m === bestMap ? 'best' : ''} ${m.n ? '' : 'none'}"><span>${mapName(m.x)}</span><div class="p2-mb"><i style="width:${Math.max(0, m.wr)}%"></i></div>
        <b>${m.n ? m.wr + '%' : '–'}</b><small class="mute">${m.n ? `${m.w}–${m.l}` : ''}</small></div>`).join('')}</div>`;

  const got = achs.list.filter(a => a.at);
  const near = achs.list.filter(a => !a.at).sort((a, b) => b.value / b.goal - a.value / a.goal)[0];
  const achCard = `<div class="card p2-ach"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('p2_ach')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="mute">${got.length} / ${achs.list.length}</span></div>
      <div class="p2-achic">${[...got, ...achs.list.filter(a => !a.at)].map(a => `<i class="ai ai-${a.icon} ${a.at ? 'got' : ''}" data-tip="${esc(t('a_' + a.id) + ' — ' + t('m_' + a.metric, { n: a.goal }))}">${ACH_ICON[a.icon] || ''}</i>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="p2-near"><span class="mute">${near ? t('p2_nearest', { a: `<b>${esc(t('a_' + near.id))}</b>`, v: Math.round(near.value * 10) / 10, g: near.goal }) : t('p2_allDone')}</span><span class="grow"></span>
        <button class="btn ghost sm" id="p2-achall">${t('p2_allAch')}</button></div></div>`;
  const achFull = `<div class="card p2-achfull" id="p2-achfull" hidden><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('achievements')}</h4><span class="grow"></span><span class="mute">${got.length} / ${achs.list.length}</span></div>
      <div class="achgrid">${achs.list.map(a => `<div class="ach ${a.at ? 'got' : ''}">
        <div class="ai ai-${a.icon}">${ACH_ICON[a.icon]}</div>
        <div class="grow" style="min-width:0"><div class="an">${t('a_' + a.id)}</div><div class="mute ad">${t('m_' + a.metric, { n: a.goal })}</div>
          ${a.at ? `<div class="ad win">${t('unlockedAt', { d: fmtDate(a.at) })}</div>` : `<div class="bar"><i style="width:${a.value / a.goal * 100}%"></i></div><div class="ad mute">${t('progress', { v: a.value, g: a.goal })}</div>`}</div>
        ${a.reward ? `<div class="arw" title="${t('reward')}">${a.reward.banner ? `<div class="mini-b" style="${bannerCss(a.reward.banner)}"></div>` : ''}${a.reward.frame ? `<div class="mini-f fr-${a.reward.frame}"></div>` : ''}</div>` : ''}
      </div>`).join('')}</div></div>`;

  const look = `<div class="card p2-look"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('p2_look')}</h4><span class="grow"></span>${isMe ? `<a href="#" class="p2-link" data-go2="inventory">${t('inventory')}</a>` : ''}</div>
      <div class="p2-lookb">${bannerHtml(banner, 'bimg')}<span class="p2-lookn">${avaF(p, 'sm')}${nickHtml(p)}</span></div>
      <div class="p2-lookl"><span>${t('p2_banner')} <b>${esc(cosName(banner))}</b></span><span>${t('p2_frame')} <b>${esc(cosName(p.prem?.frame))}</b></span><span>${t('p2_emblem')} <b>${esc(cosName(p.prem?.emblem))}</b></span></div></div>`;

  const emptyCard = `<div class="card p2-empty"><div class="p2-emic"><img src="assets/lvl/cal.svg" alt=""></div>
      <h3>${isMe ? t('p2_emptyMeT') : t('p2_emptyT', { n: esc(p.nick), mode: modeL })}</h3>
      <p class="mute">${isMe ? t('p2_emptyMeS', { mode: modeL }) : t('p2_emptyS')}</p>
      <div class="row" style="justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap">${isMe ? `<button class="btn" data-go2="play">${t('play')}${PUB_MODES.includes(mode) ? ' ' + modeL : ''}</button>` : `<button class="btn" data-invite="${p.id}">${t('inviteParty')}</button>`}
        ${other && gm(other) ? `<button class="btn ghost" data-pm="${other}">${t('p2_otherMode', { mode: modeX(other).replace(/ /g, ''), n: gm(other) })} →</button>` : ''}</div></div>`;

  const body = empty ? `<div class="p2-grid">${emptyCard}<div class="p2-side">${achCard}${look}</div></div>${achFull}`
    : `${kpis}<div class="p2-grid">
        <div class="card p2-perf"><div class="card-h"><h4>${t('p2_form')}</h4><span class="grow"></span>${ms.length ? `<span class="mute">${t(won0 ? 'p2_seriesW' : 'p2_seriesL', { n: `<b class="${won0 ? 'gold' : 'lose'}">${ser}</b>` })}</span>` : ''}</div>
          ${ms.length ? `<div class="p2-form">${form.map(h => `<span class="p2-chip ${h.won ? 'w' : 'l'}" data-tip="${esc(`#${h.id} · ${mapName(h.map)} · ${h.k}/${h.d} · ${sign(h.delta)}`)}">${h.won ? t('winShort') : t('lossShort')}</span>`).join('')}${Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, 10 - form.length) }, () => '<span class="p2-chip e"></span>').join('')}</div>
          <h5 class="p2-h5">${t('p2_eloGraph')}</h5>${p2Graph(ms, cal ? null : nx, lvl)}` : `<div class="p2-gnote mute">${t('noMatches')}</div>`}
          ${recent.length ? `<h5 class="p2-h5">${t('p2_recent')}</h5><div class="p2-recent">${recent.map(mrow).join('')}</div>` : ''}
          ${ms.length > 5 ? `<button class="btn ghost sm p2-histbtn" id="p2-hist">${t('p2_allHist', { n: ms.length })}</button><div class="p2-hist" id="p2-histbox" hidden>${histTable}</div>` : ''}
          ${!myTier && p.matches.length >= 20 ? `<p class="mute" style="margin:10px 0 0;font-size:12.5px">👑 ${t('historyLimited')}</p>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="p2-side">${mapsCard}${achCard}${look}</div></div>
      <div class="pstats p2-ldanchor"></div>${achFull}`;

  render(`${pbgLayer(pbg)}<div class="pwrap p2 ${pbg ? 'has-pbg' : ''}"><div class="pbanner ${banner ? 'has-b' : ''}">${bannerHtml(banner, 'pb-art')}<div class="pactions"><div class="seg sm">${profModes(p).map(m => `<button data-pm="${m}" class="${mode === m ? 'on' : ''}">${modeX(m)}</button>`).join('')}</div>${extra ? `<button class="btn ghost sm pmore" id="p-more" title="${t('more')}"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.8"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.8"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.8"/></svg></button><div class="pmenu" id="p-menu" hidden>${extra}</div>` : ''}</div><div class="phead">
      <div class="pava">${p.ban && typeof banAva === 'function' ? banAva(p) : avaF(p, 'lg')}${p.prem?.emblem && !p.ban ? emblemHtml(p.prem.emblem, 'big') : ''}</div>
      <div><h1>${nickHtml({ ...p, prem: p.prem && { ...p.prem, emblem: '' } })}</h1><div class="ids">ID: <span class="gid" style="user-select:text">${esc(p.gameId)}</span> ${p.name ? `· Discord: ${esc(p.name)} ` : ''}· ${t('since', { d: fmtDate(p.created) })}</div>
        <div class="tags">${p.staff ? `<span class="tag">${t('staffTag')}</span>` : ''}${p.ban ? `<span class="tag red ban-reason" title="${esc(p.ban.reason)}">${t('bannedTag')}: ${esc(p.ban.reason)}</span>` : ''}
          <span class="tag">${mode} · ${p['rank' + mode] ? '#' + p['rank' + mode] : t('unranked')}</span></div></div>
    </div>
      ${lvBlock}
    </div>
    <div class="p2-acts">${primary}<span class="p2-helps"><span class="p2-help" data-tip="${esc(t('p2_eloHint'))}">ELO ${p2q('p2_eloHint')}</span><span class="p2-help" data-tip="${esc(t('la_calHint'))}">${t('p2_calTitle')} ${p2q('la_calHint')}</span></span></div>
    ${body}</div>`);

  if ($('#p-more')) {
    const btn = $('#p-more'), menu = $('#p-menu');
    const close = () => { menu.hidden = true; document.removeEventListener('mousedown', outside, true); window.removeEventListener('resize', close); $('#view').removeEventListener('scroll', close); };
    const outside = e => { if (!menu.contains(e.target) && !btn.contains(e.target)) close(); };
    btn.onclick = () => {
      if (!menu.hidden) return close();
      menu.hidden = false;
      const rb = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
      menu.style.left = Math.max(8, Math.min(innerWidth - menu.offsetWidth - 8, rb.left)) + 'px';
      menu.style.top = (rb.bottom + menu.offsetHeight + 6 > innerHeight ? rb.top - menu.offsetHeight - 6 : rb.bottom + 6) + 'px';
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', outside, true); window.addEventListener('resize', close); $('#view').addEventListener('scroll', close);
    };
    menu.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.closest('button')) close(); });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#view [data-go2]').forEach(b => b.onclick = e => { e.preventDefault(); go(b.dataset.go2); });
  if (banner) tintFromBanner(banner, $('.pbanner'));
  if ($('#p-bg')) $('#p-bg').onclick = () => myTier ? openProfileBg(p) : go('premium');
  if ($('#p-prem')) $('#p-prem').onclick = () => openGrant(p);
  if ($('#p-badges')) $('#p-badges').onclick = () => openBadges(p);
  if ($('#p-owner')) $('#p-owner').onclick = () => openPlayerEditor(p.id).catch(e => toast(e.message, true));
  if ($('#p-cos')) $('#p-cos').onclick = () => openGiveCosmetics(p);
  bindParty();
  if ($('#p2-cmp')) $('#p2-cmp').onclick = () => { const b = $('#ld-cmp'); if (b) b.click(); else openCompare(p); };
  if ($('#p2-share')) $('#p2-share').onclick = async () => {
    const b = $('#ld-share'); if (b) return b.click();
    const link = `${String(S.server || 'https://konzte.online/konzte').replace(/\/konzte\/?$/, '')}/p/${encodeURIComponent(p.nick || p.id)}`;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(link); } catch {}
    toast(t('p2_copied'));
  };
  if ($('#p-nick')) $('#p-nick').onclick = () => openNick();
  if ($('#p2-hist')) $('#p2-hist').onclick = () => { const b = $('#p2-histbox'); b.hidden = !b.hidden; $('#p2-hist').textContent = b.hidden ? t('p2_allHist', { n: ms.length }) : t('p2_hide'); };
  if ($('#p2-achall')) $('#p2-achall').onclick = () => { const b = $('#p2-achfull'); b.hidden = !b.hidden; if (!b.hidden) b.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); };
  document.querySelectorAll('#view [data-pm]').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { S.profMode = b.dataset.pm; renderProfile(); });
  document.querySelectorAll('#view [data-mid]').forEach(el => el.onclick = run(async () => { S.backAt = 0; S.finishedMatch = await api('/api/match?id=' + el.dataset.mid); S.page = 'play'; markNav(); refresh(); }));
  if ($('#p-report')) $('#p-report').onclick = () => openReport(p);
  if ($('#p-ban')) $('#p-ban').onclick = () => openBan(p);
  if ($('#p-unban')) $('#p-unban').onclick = run(async () => { await api('/api/staff/unban', { uid: p.id }); toast(t('unbannedOk')); S.profCache = null; renderProfile(); });
  if ($('#p-edit')) $('#p-edit').onclick = () => openEdit(p);
}
```

```js
  const kdNum = (k, d) => (d ? k / d : k);
  const dShort = ts => new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString(LOCALE?.[LANG] || undefined, { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' });
  const tShort = ts => new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString(LOCALE?.[LANG] || undefined, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

  function eloChart(ms) {
    const pts = ms.filter(h => h.elo != null).slice(0, 40).reverse();
    if (pts.length) pts.unshift({ id: null, elo: pts[0].elo - (pts[0].delta || 0), delta: 0, at: pts[0].at });
    if (pts.length < 3) return `<div class="pf3-note">${t('pf3_noGraph')}</div>`;
    const W = 320, H = 150, PL = 34, PR = 8, PT = 10, PB = 20;
    const vals = pts.map(p => p.elo);
    let lo = Math.min(...vals), hi = Math.max(...vals);
    const pad = Math.max(6, (hi - lo) * .12); lo = Math.floor(lo - pad); hi = Math.ceil(hi + pad);
    const x = i => PL + i * (W - PL - PR) / (pts.length - 1), y = v => PT + (1 - (v - lo) / (hi - lo || 1)) * (H - PT - PB);
    const d = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(p.elo).toFixed(1)}`).join('');
    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    const ticks = [hi, Math.round((hi + lo) / 2), lo];
    return `<svg class="pf3-elo-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}">
      <defs><linearGradient id="pf3g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" class="s0"/><stop offset="1" class="s1"/></linearGradient></defs>
      ${ticks.map(v => `<line class="gl" x1="${PL}" x2="${W - PR}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}"/><text x="${PL - 6}" y="${y(v) + 3.5}" text-anchor="end">${v}</text>`).join('')}
      <text x="${PL}" y="${H - 4}">${dShort(pts[1].at)}</text><text x="${W - PR}" y="${H - 4}" text-anchor="end">${dShort(last.at)}</text>
      <path class="ar" d="${d}L${x(pts.length - 1)},${H - PB}L${x(0)},${H - PB}Z"/><path class="ln" d="${d}"/>
      ${pts.map((p, i) => p.id == null ? '' : `<circle cx="${x(i)}" cy="${y(p.elo)}" r="${p === last ? 4 : 2.4}" class="${p === last ? 'last' : p.delta >= 0 ? 'w' : 'l'}" data-tip="#${p.id} · ${p.elo} ELO (${sign(p.delta)})"/>`).join('')}</svg>`;
  }

  function mapVals(maps, ms, kind) {
    const by = {};
    for (const h of ms) { const s = by[h.map] ||= { n: 0, k: 0, d: 0 }; s.n++; s.k += h.k; s.d += h.d; }
    return MAPS.map(m => {
      const s = maps[m] || { w: 0, l: 0 }, n = s.w + s.l, b = by[m];
      if (kind === 'wr') return { m, v: n ? s.w / n * 100 : 0, has: n > 0, txt: n ? `${Math.round(s.w / n * 100)}% · ${s.w}–${s.l}` : '–' };
      if (kind === 'avg') return { m, v: b ? b.k / b.n : 0, has: !!b, txt: b ? `${(b.k / b.n).toFixed(1)} · ${b.n}` : '–' };
      return { m, v: b ? kdNum(b.k, b.d) : 0, has: !!b, txt: b ? kd(b.k, b.d) : '–' };
    });
  }
  function radar(rows, kind) {
    if (!rows.some(r => r.has)) return `<div class="pf3-note pf3-radnote">${t('pf3_noMaps')}</div>`;
    const W = 320, H = 280, cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2 + 4, R = 92, n = rows.length;
    const max = kind === 'wr' ? 100 : Math.max(kind === 'kd' ? 2 : 1, ...rows.map(r => r.v));
    const ang = i => -Math.PI / 2 + i * 2 * Math.PI / n;
    const pt = (i, f) => [cx + Math.cos(ang(i)) * R * f, cy + Math.sin(ang(i)) * R * f];
    const ring = f => rows.map((_, i) => pt(i, f).map(v => v.toFixed(1)).join(',')).join(' ');
    const poly = rows.map((r, i) => pt(i, Math.max(.03, Math.min(1, r.v / max))).map(v => v.toFixed(1)).join(',')).join(' ');
    return `<svg class="pf3-radar" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}">
      ${[.25, .5, .75, 1].map(f => `<polygon class="rg" points="${ring(f)}"/>`).join('')}
      ${rows.map((_, i) => { const [x, y] = pt(i, 1); return `<line class="rx" x1="${cx}" y1="${cy}" x2="${x}" y2="${y}"/>`; }).join('')}
      <polygon class="rp" points="${poly}"/>
      ${rows.map((r, i) => { const [x, y] = pt(i, Math.max(.03, Math.min(1, r.v / max))); return r.has ? `<circle class="rd" cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="3.2" data-tip="${esc(mapName(r.m) + ' — ' + r.txt)}"/>` : ''; }).join('')}
      ${rows.map((r, i) => { const [x, y] = pt(i, 1.24), a = Math.cos(ang(i)); return `<text class="rl ${r.has ? '' : 'off'}" x="${x}" y="${y}" text-anchor="${a > .3 ? 'start' : a < -.3 ? 'end' : 'middle'}" dominant-baseline="middle" data-tip="${esc(mapName(r.m) + ' — ' + r.txt)}">${esc(mapName(r.m))}</text>`; }).join('')}
    </svg>`;
  }
```

`app/src/range-fill.js`:

```js
(() => {
  const set = el => { const min = +el.min || 0, max = +el.max || 100, v = +el.value; el.style.setProperty('--rv', ((v - min) / (max - min || 1) * 100) + '%'); };
  const all = root => root.querySelectorAll?.('input[type=range]').forEach(set);
  document.addEventListener('input', e => { if (e.target?.type === 'range') set(e.target); }, true);
  new MutationObserver(ms => { for (const m of ms) for (const n of m.addedNodes) if (n.nodeType === 1) { if (n.matches?.('input[type=range]')) set(n); else all(n); } })
    .observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value');
  Object.defineProperty(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value', { ...d, set(v) { d.set.call(this, v); if (this.type === 'range') set(this); } });
  all(document);
})();
```

```js
    if (r.spots) body += `<div class="ru3-spots">${r.spots.map(([im, name, d]) => `<div class="ru3-spot"><img src="${img(im + '.jpg')}" alt="" loading="lazy"><div><b>${esc(name)}</b><span>${T(d)}</span></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
    return `<article class="ru3-rule${r.nw ? ' nw' : ''}" id="ru3-r${id}" data-n="${id}">
      <header class="ru3-rh"><button class="ru3-num" data-ru3-go="${id}" title="${esc(tr('ru3Jump', { n: id }))}">${id}</button>
        <h3>${T(r.t)}${r.nw ? `<em class="ru3-nw">${esc(tr('ru3New'))} ${esc(r.nw)}</em>` : ''}</h3>

        <button class="ru3-cp" data-ru3-cp="${id}" title="${esc(tr('ru3Copy'))}">${IC.link}</button></header>
      <div class="ru3-body">${body}</div></article>`;
  }
  function html() {
    const UI = R.UI, pn = R.SECTIONS.length + 1;
    const secs = R.SECTIONS.map((s, si) => {
      const n = si + 1;
      return `<section class="ru3-sec" id="ru3-s${n}" data-s="${n}"><div class="ru3-sh"><span class="ru3-sn">${n}</span><div class="grow"><h2>${T(s.title)}</h2><p>${T(s.sub)}</p></div>
        <img src="${img(s.icon + '.png')}" alt=""></div>${s.rules.map((r, ri) => ruleHtml(r, `${n}.${ri + 1}`)).join('')}</section>`;
    }).join('');
    const pens = `<section class="ru3-sec ru3-psec" id="ru3-s${pn}" data-s="${pn}"><div class="ru3-sh"><span class="ru3-sn">${pn}</span><div class="grow"><h2>${T(UI.pens)}</h2><p>${T(UI.pensSub)}</p></div><i class="ru3-shi">${IC.shield}</i></div>

    const toc = R.SECTIONS.map((s, si) => `<button class="ru3-ti" data-ru3-sec="${si + 1}"><i>${si + 1}</i><span>${T(s.title)}</span><b>${s.rules.length}</b></button>`).join('')

    return `<div class="ru3" data-lang="${LANG}">

  function unmark(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('mark.ru3-hl').forEach(m => { const p = m.parentNode; p.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(m.textContent), m); p.normalize(); });
  }
  function mark(root, q) {
    const nq = norm(q), walk = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, { acceptNode: n => n.parentElement.closest('.ru3-num, .ru3-pens, .ru3-cp, .ru3-lab') ? 2 : 1 });
    const hits = [];
    for (let n; (n = walk.nextNode());) if (norm(n.nodeValue).includes(nq)) hits.push(n);
    for (const n of hits) {
      const s = n.nodeValue, ns = norm(s), f = document.createDocumentFragment();
      let i = 0, j;
      while ((j = ns.indexOf(nq, i)) >= 0) {
        if (j > i) f.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.slice(i, j)));
        const m = document.createElement('mark'); m.className = 'ru3-hl'; m.textContent = s.slice(j, j + nq.length); f.appendChild(m);
        i = j + nq.length;
      }
      if (i < s.length) f.appendChild(document.createTextNode(s.slice(i)));
      n.parentNode.replaceChild(f, n);
    }
  }
  function filter() {
    const v = $('#view'), box = v.querySelector('.ru3'); if (!box) return;
    const q = st.q.trim(), nq = norm(q), num = /^\d+(\.\d*)?$/.test(q);
    let shown = 0;
    box.querySelectorAll('.ru3-rule').forEach(r => {
      unmark(r);
      const n = r.dataset.n;
      const hit = !q || (num ? (n === q || n.startsWith(q.endsWith('.') ? q : q + '.')) : norm(r.textContent).includes(nq));
      r.hidden = !hit; r.classList.toggle('numhit', !!q && num && hit);
      if (hit) { shown++; if (q && !num) mark(r, q); }
    });
    box.querySelectorAll('.ru3-sec').forEach(s => {
      const any = !!s.querySelector('.ru3-rule:not([hidden])');
      const pen = s.classList.contains('ru3-psec');
      if (pen) { s.hidden = !!q && !(num ? q === s.dataset.s : norm(s.textContent).includes(nq)); if (!s.hidden && q && !num) { unmark(s); mark(s, q); } else unmark(s); }
      else s.hidden = !!q && !any;
      box.querySelector(`[data-ru3-sec="${s.dataset.s}"]`)?.classList.toggle('dim', s.hidden);
    });
    const empty = box.querySelector('#ru3-empty'); empty.hidden = !q || !!shown || !box.querySelector('.ru3-psec[hidden]');
    box.querySelector('.ru3-qx').hidden = !q;
    box.querySelector('#ru3-found').textContent = q ? tr('ru3Of', { n: shown, m: nRules() }) : tr('ru3Key');
  }

  function scrollTo(el, flash) {
    if (!el) return;
    const v = $('#view');
    v.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, el.getBoundingClientRect().top - v.getBoundingClientRect().top + v.scrollTop - 14), behavior: flash === 'jump' ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    if (flash) { el.classList.remove('flash'); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('flash'); setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('flash'), 2200); }
  }
  function goRule(n, how) {
    const box = $('#view .ru3'); if (!box) return;
    let el = box.querySelector(`.ru3-rule[data-n="${CSS.escape(n)}"]`);
    if (!el && /^\d+$/.test(String(n))) el = box.querySelector(`#ru3-s${n}`);
    if (el?.hidden || el?.closest('.ru3-sec')?.hidden) { st.q = ''; box.querySelector('#ru3-q').value = ''; filter(); }
    scrollTo(el, how || true);
  }
  function observe() {
    st.io?.disconnect();
    const v = $('#view'), box = v.querySelector('.ru3');
    st.io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(en => {
      if (en.isIntersecting) box.querySelectorAll('.ru3-ti').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.ru3Sec === en.target.dataset.s));
    }), { root: v, rootMargin: '-25% 0px -65% 0px' });
    box.querySelectorAll('.ru3-sec').forEach(s => st.io.observe(s));
  }

  function bind() {
    const box = $('#view .ru3');
    const q = box.querySelector('#ru3-q');
    q.value = st.q;
    q.oninput = () => { st.q = q.value; filter(); };
    q.onkeydown = e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { st.q = q.value = ''; filter(); }
      if (e.key === 'Enter') { const t = st.q.trim(); const first = box.querySelector('.ru3-rule:not([hidden])'); if (exists(t)) goRule(t); else if (first) scrollTo(first, true); }
    };
    box.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const g = e.target.closest('[data-ru3-go]'); if (g) { e.preventDefault(); goRule(g.dataset.ru3Go); return; }
      const sec = e.target.closest('[data-ru3-sec]'); if (sec) { scrollTo(box.querySelector('#ru3-s' + sec.dataset.ru3Sec)); return; }
      const cp = e.target.closest('[data-ru3-cp]');
      if (cp) {
        const url = `${SITE}#r${cp.dataset.ru3Cp}`;
        Promise.resolve(navigator.clipboard?.writeText(url)).then(() => toast(tr('ru3Copied') + ' · ' + url)).catch(() => toast(url));
        cp.innerHTML = IC.check; cp.classList.add('ok'); setTimeout(() => { cp.innerHTML = IC.link; cp.classList.remove('ok'); }, 1200);
        return;
      }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-ru3-clear]')) { st.q = q.value = ''; filter(); q.focus(); return; }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-ru3-site]')) { K.open(SITE); return; }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-ru3-ticket]')) go('support');
    });
    observe();
    filter();
  }

  function renderRules() {
    const have = $('#view .ru3');
    if (!have || have.dataset.lang !== LANG) {
      render(html());
      bind();
    } else { const q = have.querySelector('#ru3-q'); if (q.value !== st.q) { q.value = st.q; filter(); } }
    if (st.target) { const n = st.target; st.target = null; requestAnimationFrame(() => goRule(n, 'jump')); }
  }

  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  let navBtn = nav?.querySelector('.nav-btn[data-go="rules"]');
  if (nav && !navBtn && R) {
    navBtn = document.createElement('button');
    navBtn.className = 'nav-btn'; navBtn.dataset.go = 'rules'; navBtn.hidden = true;
    navBtn.innerHTML = `${IC.book}<span>${esc(tr('rules'))}</span><i class="n2-cnt" hidden></i>`;
    navBtn.onclick = () => go('rules');
    const after = nav.querySelector('.nav-btn[data-go="lfg"]') || nav.querySelector('.nav-btn[data-go="play"]');
    if (after) after.after(navBtn); else nav.appendChild(navBtn);
  }
  const syncNav = () => { if (navBtn) { const on = V3(); if (navBtn.hidden === on) navBtn.hidden = !on; const s = navBtn.querySelector('span'); if (s && s.textContent !== tr('rules')) s.textContent = tr('rules'); } };
  syncNav();
  setInterval(syncNav, 2000);

  if (!R) { console.warn('[rules3] rules-data.js не завантажено'); }
  const _go = go;
  go = function (page, arg) {
    if (page === 'rules') {
      if (!R || !V3()) { K.open(SITE + (arg && exists(arg) ? '#r' + arg : '')); return; }
      st.target = arg ? String(arg) : null;
      if (S.page !== 'rules' || arg) st.q = '';
      if (S.page === 'rules' && $('#view .ru3')) { markNav(); return renderRules(); }
    }
    return _go.apply(this, arguments);
  };
  const _refresh = refresh;
  refresh = function () {
    syncNav();
    if (S.page === 'rules' && S.me?.gameId) {
      if (R && V3()) return renderRules();
      S.page = 'play'; markNav();
    }
    return _refresh.apply(this, arguments);
  };
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (S.page !== 'rules' || e.key !== '/' || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
    const a = document.activeElement; if (a && (a.tagName === 'INPUT' || a.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || a.isContentEditable)) return;
    const q = document.getElementById('ru3-q'); if (q && !document.querySelector('#modal > *')) { e.preventDefault(); q.focus(); q.select(); }
  });

  const CODE2RULE = { cheat: '1.1', boost: '1.5', fakeshot: '1.6', weapon: '2.1', killchain: '4.2', skill: '4.3', bug: '5.2', spawn: '6.3', leave: '6.5', afk: '6.5', toxic: '7.1' };
  const link = n => `<a href="#" class="ru3-nlink" data-ru3-nl="${n}">${esc(tr('ru3Open', { n }))}</a>`;
  function patchNotice(card) {
    if (!R || card.dataset.ru3) return;
    card.dataset.ru3 = '1';
    card.querySelectorAll('p').forEach(p => {
      const b = p.querySelector(':scope > b');
      if (b && b.textContent.trim().replace(/:$/, '') === t('ntRule')) {
        const label = p.textContent.slice(b.textContent.length).trim();
        const code = Object.keys(CODE2RULE).find(c => t('rule_' + c) === label);
        if (code) p.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', ` · ${link(CODE2RULE[code])}`);
        return;
      }
      const walk = document.createTreeWalker(p, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT), nodes = [];
      for (let n; (n = walk.nextNode());) if (/\d\.\d/.test(n.nodeValue)) nodes.push(n);
      for (const n of nodes) {
        const out = esc(n.nodeValue).replace(RULE_WORD, (m, w, num) => exists(num) ? `${w}<a href="#" class="ru3-nlink" data-ru3-nl="${num}">${num}</a>` : m);
        if (out !== esc(n.nodeValue)) { const s = document.createElement('span'); s.innerHTML = out; n.parentNode.replaceChild(s, n); }
      }
    });
    card.addEventListener('click', e => {
      const a = e.target.closest('[data-ru3-nl]'); if (!a) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      const n = a.dataset.ru3Nl;
      card.querySelector('#nt-ok')?.click();
      setTimeout(() => go('rules', n), 50);
    });
  }
  const modalBox = document.getElementById('modal');
  if (modalBox) new MutationObserver(() => modalBox.querySelectorAll('.notice:not(.bc):not([data-ru3])').forEach(patchNotice)).observe(modalBox, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  const pres = document.getElementById('n2-pres'), pq = document.getElementById('n2-pq');
  if (pres && pq) {
    const addRow = () => {
      if (!R || !V3() || pres.querySelector('.ru3-pal')) return;
      const q = norm(pq.value.trim());
      const words = [tr('rules'), tr('n2_d_rules'), 'rules', 'правила', 'правило'].map(norm);
      const isNum = exists(q);
      if (!q || !(isNum || words.some(w => w.includes(q) || q.startsWith('правил') || q.startsWith('rule')))) return;
      const label = isNum ? tr('ru3Open', { n: q }) : tr('rules');
      const none = pres.querySelector('.n2-pnone'); if (none) none.remove();
      pres.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', `<div class="n2-pr ru3-pal${none ? ' on' : ''}" data-ru3-pal="${isNum ? q : ''}"><span class="ic">${IC.book}</span><b>${esc(label)}</b><span class="s">${esc(tr('n2_d_rules'))}</span>${none ? '<i class="n2-kbd">Enter</i>' : ''}</div>`);
    };
    new MutationObserver(addRow).observe(pres, { childList: true });
    const run = r => { window.N2?.closePal?.(); go('rules', r.dataset.ru3Pal || undefined); };
    pres.addEventListener('click', e => { const r = e.target.closest('.ru3-pal'); if (r) { e.stopPropagation(); run(r); } }, true);
    document.getElementById('n2-pal')?.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      const r = pres.querySelector('.ru3-pal.on'); if (e.key === 'Enter' && r) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); run(r); }
    }, true);
  }
})();
```

```js
(() => {
  const L = {
    en: { sSeason: 'Seasonal colors', sSeasonH: 'Interface colors follow the time of year: winter, spring, summer, autumn. Replaces the accent color while on' },
    uk: { sSeason: 'Сезонні кольори', sSeasonH: 'Кольори інтерфейсу змінюються з порою року: зима, весна, літо, осінь. Поки увімкнено — замість кольору акценту' },
    ru: { sSeason: 'Сезонные цвета', sSeasonH: 'Цвета интерфейса меняются с временем года: зима, весна, лето, осень. Пока включено — вместо цвета акцента' },
  };
  if (typeof I18N !== 'undefined') for (const k of Object.keys(L)) Object.assign(I18N[k] ||= {}, L[k]);

  const KINDS = ['winter', 'spring', 'summer', 'autumn'];
  const byMonth = m => (m === 11 || m <= 1) ? 'winter' : m <= 4 ? 'spring' : m <= 7 ? 'summer' : 'autumn';
  window.kzSeason = () => {
    const c = (typeof S !== 'undefined' && S.cfg) || {};
    if (c.seasonal === false) return null;
    return KINDS.includes(c.seasonForce) ? c.seasonForce : byMonth(new Date().getMonth());
  };
  function apply() {
    const s = window.kzSeason();
    for (const k of KINDS) document.body.classList.toggle('ss-' + k, s === k);
  }
  if (typeof applyLook === 'function') { const _al = applyLook; applyLook = function () { const r = _al.apply(this, arguments); apply(); return r; }; }
  apply();
  setInterval(apply, 3600e3);
})();
```

```js
  const SHIELD = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2.5l8.5 3.2v5.8c0 5-3.4 8.7-8.5 10.1-5.1-1.4-8.5-5.1-8.5-10.1V5.7z"/><path d="M8.3 12l2.6 2.6 4.9-5.2"/></svg>';
```
